reviews.comments: Great communication as well as an superb property and location!

When we where at the entrance from Puamana we already had a good feeling. When we where entering to the place from Elise the Puamana Ocean Breeze Bungalow we felt like at home. The place is even better as shown on the picture. It is very clean and tastefully furnished. The kitchen has everything you need to cook. And all the bedrooms are very nice. You got even surfboards or bikes to use. We had every morning our breakfast on the porch which was always a very nice start into the day. From the house you will get in approx. 30“ to the ocean where you can enjoy every day the moast romantic sunsets. Its just fantastic. Puamana Ocean Breeze Bungalow is located close to Lahaina where you also find a lot of nice restaurants and grocery stores. And from Puamana you also can do realy nice daytrips like going snorkeling or do the road to Hana, to Wailea Makena or you go to Haleakala where you have a nice few on 10000 Feet over Maui (if the weather is nice) And if you just feel like relaxing than the ocean pool from Puamana is the perfect place just to calm down an enjoy the beauty of the pacific. Right in front of the club house are two surf spots where my son and daughter went surfing every morning. We just can highly recomand this beautiful place and we are still overwhelmed. Thank you so much Elise for having us. You have been always so nice and flexible and did respond very quick to our e-mails and answers. We had a realy great time and we will miss this quiet and romatic place. We just love Maui and all the other Hawaiian Islands. 
Mahalo for everything. 

Lajos and Family

This was my first time using Airbnb and it was perfect!   The bungalow is very comfortable, in a beautiful setting and within walking distance (one mile) of shops and restaurants.  Elise had everything available for us and we felt right at home.  If we ever return to Maui, we would love to stay here again.   Thank you Elise!!!

We spent a week and a half at the Ocean Breeze Bungalow in Lahaina and it was absolutely perfect. The house was well appointed, extremely clean and  Puamana is centrally located to everything Maui has to offer. We had everything we needed to feel right at home. The complex is within walking distance of Lahaina. And a 30 minute drive to everything else. You really can't find a better place on Maui.
Elise was an ideal host and we had great communication from her and her onsite manager. 
One note - If you are looking for more of a party scene or a place to get a little wild this is probably not a great choice....if you want a sweet peaceful place that's not a pretentious resort, this is for you.
Lovely Place and quiet community

Elise was fantastic - quick and responsive to all communication.  She sent a very detailed e-mail with all the necessary check-in information. Her place was exactly as described and the photos were accurate.  It was, neat, clean, comfortable and well appointed. The kitchen had everything necessary to cook and prepare meals. The neighborhood was awesome - clean and safe.  It was an easy walk into town and located close to many of the activities we had planned.

Fantastic location with many amenities and easy walk to all the shops, restaurants and activities that Lahaina has to offer. Limited sand on the beach at location (December), but plenty of activities for the whole family to enjoy. Elise is a pleasure to work with; outstanding communication and information shared!

This is a wonderful property, private, and walkable to the town of Lahaina. Good for family or couples getaway. Elise was readily available for any questions we had! We loved hanging out on the back porch in the beautiful Maui weather!

Great location! Just a nice walk down Front street brings you to the heart of Lahaina. A beautiful Airbnb steps away from the ocean and in a very nicely maintained community.

Elise is very very responsive. The guests before us left the place in a mild disarray breaking various items but she let me know as soon as she found out and attempted to fix what she could in one day. She sent us a lovely basket of Maui-an goods to make up for the honestly very minor inconveniences, which was a very nice gesture. Check-in instructions very clear and easy.

The house has a lovely back deck, while although not entirely private as you can see the other neighboring decks, was a nice place to enjoy some meals.  She offers many of the essentials such as a SUP, snorkels, watershoes, boogie boards and a outdoor shower, which made going out to explore the beaches hassle free. The rooms are nicely appointed and we really had everything we needed. Could not have asked for a better place to stay.

Great location and very comfortable.  Comes with everything you need for a beach vacation including boogie boards, paddle/surf boards...  we watched the sunset every day from the pool/clubhouse area.  Elise was wonderful and very responsive.  Mahalo for a wonderful vacation!!!

Puamana is the best place to stay in Maui. Elise's place is also the best place in Puamana. It had everything we needed to relax, swim, eat and play. Thank you for sharing an incredible place with us!

We had a great time. Elise's is a nice place with everything you need for a fun trip to Hawaii, including kitchen equipment, beach toys, surfing and body surfing boards, and beach lounge equipment. There was one minor mistake in the listing but Elise promptly corrected it when it was brought to her attention and made amends for the confusion. Everything else was as described and made for a wonderful trip to Maui! Thanks for sharing your place with us!

I would definitely recommend Elise's condo to anyone staying in the Lahaina area. It is even nicer than the pictures suggest and we were very comfortable during our stay. Elise thought of anything and everything you could possibly need - from making a home-cooked meal to spending a day on the beach. Also, the community of Puamana is beautiful! Do not miss the ocean front pool - it's spectacular.
Don't hesitate to book here - it's a great value and you'll love every minute of your stay!

Elise's place in Lahaina was perfect for the couple days we visited. The home is in a great location off front street, close to multiple restaurants and shopping opportunities. She has a lot of beach equipment that comes with the house. We used the snorkel equipment, SUP, and surfboard. All equipment is in good condition and beach access is everywhere you look. A really great place for a quick beach vacation. Wouldn't hesitate to go back.

Puamana and specifically Elise's lovely townhome were perfect for our family of four's vacation in Maui. We had everything we needed, most importantly an absolutely beautiful and serene central location.

Check-In was easy and the property was just as described. The property is located within a mile walk of downtown Lahaina. Wonderful selection of restaurants and the nightlife is second to none. Elise responded immediately when we needed new batteries for one of the remotes and had an issue with operating one of the ceiling fans. Her on-site handyman Rick responded within minutes to assist us. The property met all our needs and I can highly recommend the property for a comfortable stay.

We had a great stay at Elise's place. The unit was comfortable for four guests. We loved the back patio area and having the charcoal grill was really nice. There was no beach access for us as the sand was covered by rocks however, this was stated in the description that beach access can vary depending on the time of year. The grounds were neat and clean and the views of the ocean are surreal. Elise was very responsive to any messages or texts. The check in process was easy and all the information was accurately provided by Elise. We had a great stay at Puamana and loved exploring Lahaina ( several shops and restaurants are close by). We would love to come back some day.
Incredible property.  Fast communications.  All the little touches (Hulu, grill, beach gear, charcoal, etc) were awesome!

This place his just amazing. Loved the private surfbreak! Very close to downtown lahaina. Elise was very accomodating for our schedule and responded very quickly. I don't have much more to say than our vacation at Elise's place was amazing!!
This was such a nice home to stay in. We had a fabulous time. The house had everything we needed for a fantastic holiday.

Elise's home is a beautiful home. It was very comfortable and located in the beautiful community of Puamana. The location itself seems as though it's right out of a brochure for Maui as it is right next to the ocean with huge palm trees everywhere. The location itself is very convenient as it is only a mile away from the center of Lahaina. It is close enough to get there were ease but far away enough that you can sleep while you can listen to only the waves crashing in the background. The house itself was clean and spacious. The pictures were very accurate in showing representing the home. Elise was awesome in getting back to me with any questions or concerns I had. She was also able to provide an extensive list of places, sights, and activities that you can do on the island. I know with me, I like to maximize my experience wherever I go. With Maui, there are so many places to see that it can get a bit overwhelming. The information that Elise provided was essential to narrowing down all the great experiences we had. All in all, my stay at Elise's home was an integral part to the amazing experience I had on Maui and would recommend this home to anyone!

This house was perfect for my family. Large upstairs and great location. Our favorite part was the patio. It was great to relax in the morning and have our coffee while listening to the birds and watching the lizards run by.

Elise's place is A-mazing.  Great location close to all the fun, but removed enough to be relaxing and quiet if you want.  Elise is a great host who was in contact and gave us all the information and responsive to questions.  She also has a great feel for the area and "things to do" restaurants etc.  The home is comfortable, cozy, and has all the creature comforts you may need.  I highly recommend.

It took 40 minutes to drive from the airport to Puamana and the instructions to check in were straightforward. Our family of five fitted in to the house comfortably and having two bathrooms was helpful. The house is tastefully decorated in a beach theme. The beds were comfortable and we appreciated the air conditioning coming from a New Zealand winter! The outdoor area was a nice place to relax and read. We used the beach gear provided, that was a bonus. The pool was a family favourite as were those amazing sunsets. We have great memories of our stay and would happily go back again.
We were so comfortable in this home.  Elise covered all the details and we appreciated it.  We hope to return.

Elise's place was amazing! The location was perfect - quiet and peaceful, yet still close to amenities in town. The nearby beach (a five minute stroll away) was very uncrowded. 

We traveled as a family of four, and our two teenagers loved having the loft space as their own hangout zone.

Sitting out on the lanai in the morning with a cup of coffee, listening to the birds and nature, was one of our favorite things to do. We also loved grilling in the evenings. 

We will definitely return! Thank you, Elise, for a wonderful stay.
The house is very clean, full of equipments and well furnished!! Elise is always available for info and suggestions... great host!!!

We had a great stay in Elise's Ocean Breeze house. It is clear that Elise and her family use the house themselves: it's not just another rental condo, but it shows that it gets quite some TLC. It feels homely and is well equipped (both on the water sports and the cooking front). It is a small, cosy house, but well laid out and it has A/C, which is not standard on Hawaii. 
Elise herself was very easy to communicate with. She responded within minutes to my emails and provided personal tips on what not to miss on the island. A perfect host. 

The only downside were the bugs, but I guess that's part of being on a tropical island.

We loved Elise place . 
Location , communication great , surfboard and paddle board for our use , 
We definitely recommend.

This property is absolutely fabulous!! It was exactly as described and offered everything you would want, and more! The host, Elise, was super quick to respond to communications, and provided lots of additional local information which we found very useful. The location was ideal, with just a short stroll into Lahaina to explore the many shops and restaurants. Having three pools on the property was excellent, as it offered a range of pool-time fun for both my children and my mother, not to mention all the surrounding beaches where my boys surfed everyday. We would definitely hire this house again if we are ever to return to Maui. So if you are looking for a little slice of heaven outside of the super-busy resort area of Kaanapali, and a home away from home, then look no further!

This was an enchanted, once-in-a-lifetime trip for my wife and me and that is in no small part due to Elise's gorgeous, safe, clean, perfectly located place. We were both fascinated by how much Puamana reminded us of our Southern California childhoods in the 60's and 70's - except it was the childhood we both aspired to and not so much the one we actually had! The grounds were immaculate, the location ideal, and the bright, beach-themed bungalow was absolutely perfect for us. We especially noticed how quiet it was - no traffic noise at all, just the very light purr of the waves in the middle distance. Elise was very quick and complete with all communication, which comforted me since we had never been to Hawaii and I really wanted to make sure we were stepping into a good situation. This was also a surprise anniversary/birthday trip for my wife so I needed everything to be perfect. With all the great beach-fun gear provided by Elise and the easy walk to the private beach (Puamana is a private, gated community), we had the makings of many warm, sweet memories. And yes, we did take her advice and had both morning coffee and sunset snacks at the clubhouse! I haven't even mentioned the location - a mile from the heart of Lahaina and just another 5 minute drive up to Black Rock. We took full advantage of both places and still had plenty of downtime to recharge and relax at the bungalow. We are still in the glow of the whole trip, but really, I cannot recommend Elise's bungalow enough.

Elise's place was  perfect for our mother/daughter getaway.  Elise was incredibly helpful, her place has nice personal touches and was very clean, and the location was perfect. We could walk into town for meals and enjoy the beach and ocean pool during the day.  We wanted to simply relax and we could not have chosen a better location for that.   We will definitely return.

We highly recommend Puamana and Elise - the facility was exactly as advertised- clean and easily accessible! We walked into town several times and used the quiet pool for laps, reading and relaxation! Neighbors were scarce but friendly and the weather was Stellar!! First time Airbnb - now committed to the process! Kudos
Great spot, walking distance to Lahaina, stocked with all the goods you need for the beach / cooking.
Well appointed beach bungalow feel. I wish we would have been able to use the beautiful Lanai but the weather didn't cooperate.  Next time!  Owner was very quick to respond.  Thank you!
Charming place close to the ocean. We loved the pool overlooking the ocean. Elise gave us great local tips and was quick to respond. Great trip!

The location is really great, near Lahaina but not right in the center of town. The complex is right on the ocean, a short walk to palm trees and shoreline, with a nice pool and clubhouse (though we didn't have a chance to use it). The loft is super sunny and great for spreading out, or for a family. And a shady back porch with outdoor seating on the garden area. Very nice, you won't be disappointed!
Great spot! Nice amenities, especially the property outside.

Elise’s place was fantastic for our family of four.  It was spotlessly clean with a well equipped kitchen for self catering and lots of towels and water activity equipment to use.  The location of the apartment is awesome - we watched the sunset and the whale activity from the pool house every evening and loved swimming in the ocean front pool.  Being close to Lahaina was also fantastic - good supermarkets, coffee and interesting shops.  We loved our time at Elise’s place.  Thank you Elise!

Elise’s place is perfect for a family! The house is stunning, clean and the location is simply the best. A short minute walk to the beach and the pool, and a few minutes from Lahaina’s Center. The backyard is perfect for some great dinners and some quiet breakfasts with the ones you love. Elise is an amazing host!

Wonderful bungalow just as described .
Full amenities ice chest, beach toys paddle board! Central location for walking into Lahaina.

Elise’s home was beautiful, stylish, clean, excellent location and great use of space. We loved the grounds and easy walk to town. She responded to any questions immediately. Every extra included for great beach days down to the ice packs and coolers. Would have stayed forever!!!

Elise’s Ocean Breeze bungalow was ideal for our family gathering and provided a peaceful, beautiful setting for our time together. Elise was very responsive to any requests I had leading up to our stay. The space included all the comforts of home, and we found it was the ideal location for the activities we enjoy. Very very nice!

What an amazing experience!   The home was beautiful and more than expected.  The private lanai with outdoor seating was a perfect start to every morning.   The home was tastefully decorated, clean, and welcoming!  The location was so perfectly close to downtown Lahaina.   Elise was lightening quick in responses when there was only 1 key left at the home vs 2, and 2 additional keys were made on the spot.   The home is in a wonderful private gated community with friendly neighbors/ guests.   The quiet hours also made for relaxing evenings to wind down after fun-filled days.   Our teenage son LOVED having a large upstairs loft all to himself as well.   Elisa also provided a wealth of local knowledge and helpful tips and recommendations as well. 

My only comments would be that while walking or biking into Lahaina is absolutely possible, there is no shoulder on the road and quite a bit of vehicle  traffic.  I don't recommend biking with smaller/ younger children if possible.   However, downtown is just perfect for walks, great food and drink options, and welcoming locals.  We can't wait to return!!!  Thank you for opening your home to us!  We will be back again.

Our family of five enjoyed a wonderful week at the bungalow! The location is excellent, close enough to town that it is convenient, but the property is not at all crowded. We used the pools on site and  walked down to the public beach at the end of the property. While the kitchen and bathroom spaces are on the smaller side, the loft easily accommodated our three older kids and the lanai gives ample room for everyone to spread out. You can enjoy a morning cup of coffee at the side of the bungalow, where Elise has set up a small table and chair set, and watch the surf roll in. We did experience a little noise from neighbors, but less than you would at a typical hotel. Overall this was a great experience for our family.

What you see on line is truly what you get with way more!  All the amenities you could hope for as well as a super location to club house and quiet pool. The trip into Lahaina is a mile away and an enjoyable bike ride or walk. We felt very safe in Puamana and would definitely recommend this unit to others.
What a wonderful place, close to town but the property feels like you are off the beaten path. Elise has it all covered,  appreciated the beach toys, towels and chairs.
Great space, loved the lanai, good location near Lahina.
Wonderful place. Great for families.

Great place and very responsive host.

We stayed for 2 weeks. We, as a family built great memories there!

Slight issues with the dishwasher, which they called a handyman very quickly for.

Small ant problem, but nothing we were concerned about.

We will be back for sure!!!!!

We stayed for ten nights and we wish we could have stayed longer. This bungalow is the far best that we have come across renting Air BnB. It was everything as promised and then some. The host, Elise, is very accomodating and was quick to respond to any questions and also came with suggestions for adventures around Maui. 
The location is great with both ocean access and close enough to Lahaina to walk there. The neighbourhood is very quiet and serene and the surrounding is lush. We highly recommend this to anyone who wants a part of paradise.

We have been approximately two weeks in Elise‘s host. Our stay was amazing, we didn‘t miss anything. There are all facilities and equipment, which make your holiday even better. The apartment is furnished with love and the Resort has everything, tennis courts, pools, beach access and by the clubhouse you can see the most beautiful sunset on the island. 
We didn‘t face no problems getting there as Elise explained everything very well! 
Summed up, best thing that we probably could have booked and we absolutely would go there again.

Elise's home is even better than any description, you've simply got to see it. Yes, Maui and Hawaii isn't cheap, and neither is the accommodation, but by heck it is worth it. The house is in excellent condition throughout and everything is spick and span clean. There is everything you need and more for your stay. Elise is a fabulous host and kept in touch with us as a hurricane threatened to hit the island. She gave us tips at every turn, not only to stay safe, but also where to find great and fun things to do on Maui. The location of her house could not have been any better to be honest. From Lahaina, we were able to see almost everything we set out to do before our arrival. Elise, thank you again for being such an amazing host!!!
Great location, stunning views from the clubhouse where we watched the sunset most nights. Would definitely recommend to others

Such a greay stay. Clean community with great facilities. The condo is comfy with a fun second floor that would be ideal for kids. Incredible pool that overlooks the ocean just steps away. Lahaina is a mile away. We walked it many times. Great dining. Sit and enjoy or, Fleetwoods and Pacific’O were our favorites, or carry out back to the condo to relax. For carry out I recommend Paia Fishmarket. Excellent and reasonably priced. 
Looking forward to our next visit!

Brian and Dieny
Illinois

We absolutely loved our stay it was wonderful! Such a perfect location and the property really is something very special. 

Highly recommended this property a truly wonderful, relaxing experience. 

Elise and Adrian are great hosts so responsive and easy to communicate with and very helpful.

Thanks so much Annmarie, Mel and Kylie.
Elise‘s house is beautiful with a lot of pretty details. The communication was always very kind an the answers on questions very fast. We highly recommend to stay in this super located house.

We loved our stay at Puamana.  The condo was just as expected. The complex is quiet and beautiful and convenient to everything in the area.  We hope to come back in a few years. The hosts were wonderful also.
Beautiful property!  Very comfortable and with great access to everything Maui has to offer.  I wish I lived there.
Great location

Puamana Ocean Breeze was a beautiful place to stay in Lahaina.  We loved everything about the unit including it’s location so close to the ocean pool and the club house for sunset happy hours.  I would absolutely recommend the unit to anyone traveling to Lahaina.

Loved staying here and would recommend to everyone. Completely accurate descriptions and excellent communication. Location was super convenient to downtown Lahaina but loved that it wasn’t right in the hustle and bustle. The best thing was having beach chairs, a variety of snorkel gear, coolers, beach bags, water shoes, umbrella, towels etc all available for use. Large outdoor patio space was lovely for morning breakfast. Would definitely stay here again!

Elise is an amazing host - quick responses and provides lots of suggestions for things to check out in Maui. The space was beautiful and well located in the complex - quiet but super close to the ocean and clubhouse. I would highly recommend staying here! Thanks again, Elise!
Great place, very convenient to Lahaina and all it offers!
Elise's bungalow is wonderful. Location is ideal for exploring Maui; home is very clean & well-stocked. Lovely decor. Watched humpback whales right from the sea-side pool!

We loved your place - it was all and even more than we hoped for. Nice clean - with so many little extra details, only a short walk to pool, or ocean. Already planning our next trip 
Thanks  Again - it was great

Perfect for a family! We had two little ones with us ( 1&4 ). During nap time we could hangout on the patio and still enjoy the sun. I do recommend renting baby gates if you have little ones that aren’t good on there feet still/get into everything. Watching the sunset out front of the club house and the whales breaching was truly breathtaking!!

host.host_about:
Férias, escapadelas, trabalho,... qualquer que seja o motivo da sua visita à cidade do Porto, o Oporto Trendy Apartments oferece-lhe apartamentos totalmente equipados, onde o conforto e bem estar foram pensados ao pormenor.

Holiday, getaways, work ... whatever the purpose of your visit to the city of Oporto, Oporto Trendy Apartments offers fully equipped apartments, where comfort and well-being was thought to detail.

address.government_area: Cedofeita, Ildefonso, Sé, Miragaia, Nicolau, Vitória

reviews.comments: Apartment was very nice and it's situated right next to the landmark Ponte Luis. It has refreshing terrace which was perfect during the warm nights. Communication with the host was swift and without a problem. Only downside was a staircase inside the apartment which everybody bumped into, and the only set of keys (keypads were supposed to work in the middle of our stay but they didn't) for four people.

Very cute and brand new place. Perfectly located close to the historic center with a convenient parking in front of the building. Confortable beds, nice terrasse facing the back court yard, performant wifi.
The host canceled this reservation 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
The apartment is clean and Morden. Newly renovated and it's right in the heart of Porto and we even find free parking space out of apartment.
Hugo es un perfecto anfitrión y la localización y estado de la casa fue perfecta

Hugo is a very professional and attentive host. We initially estimated our arrival at 4PM, but ended up arriving around 3PM and only gave Hugo 30 minutes notice. Regardless he was there waiting for us and gave us a thorough explanation of the apartment, location and sites for us to visit.

We are a family of two adults and two children. The apartment is not really optimal for small children, because of the rickety staircase. But we made due with the sleeping arrangements on the first floor and had a great time.

The apartment is small but very nicely decorated and was exactly as described. The location is great. Just next to the Ponte Luís I bridge and the riverside restaurants. The apartment faces away from the water but this allows for a small terrace facing toward the cliff side, which was very nice for a spot of air. 

Hugo also has a deal with a breakfast delivery service, whom left a beautiful basket outside our door. The service also catered to Hugos high service standard and replaced the coffee in our basket with chocolate milk, which was immensely more popular with our children.

I can only give my best recommendation to both Hugo and the apartment. It is a beautiful space in a prime location at a semi affordable rate. We only gave slightly more than we would have paid for a cheap hotel and half of what we would have paid at a nice one.

Le quartier des quais est très agréable.
L'appartement est moderne et bien équipé.
Il manquerait une climatisation dans la chambre du haut pour être parfait.
Bellissimo appartamento molto vicino alla zona del passeggio serale pieno di ristorantini di ogni tipo. Unica pecca per chi arriva in macchina nei periodi di festa è il parcheggio

Highly recommend location which is close to the hot spots, attractions and everything you could need. It's literally 2 mins walk from the main river restaurants and the view is breathtaking. Place was well maintained and very comfortable. 5 Stars!
appartement refait à neuf,propre et très bien situé dans porto. Bon accueil professionnel. Bon séjour.
Great location and beautiful apartment!
You can't find a better place to stay in Porto, really !

Das Apartement ist sehr gut gelegen und ausgestattet. Die Wohnung ist an den grünen Hang mit Gärten ausgerichtet. Das Beste war aber der Service des Vermieters und seine schnellen Reaktionen auf Anfragen.

El alojamiento está muy bien situado. A pocos minutos caminando del centro, y sin el ruido de alojarte en pleno centro. Además se puede aparcar en la calle. El apartamento tal como aparece en las fotos, muy bien cuidado y con mucha luz. El sofá tenía una pata rota, pero se lo dijimos e iban a arreglarlo. Sin duda repetiríamos mismo sitio el día que volvamos a Oporto!

This was a great apartment in a wonderful location right by the water. Everything was walkable including great restaurants and tourist attractions. The apartment also was clean and spacious. Hugo also was a excellent host who was accommodating, friendly and knew a lot about the city. Overall excellent place and experience in a beautiful city.
Excelente localização, apartamento limpo, bem equipado e silencioso.

The apartment was in a great location (nice walking/running paths by river) and easily walkable to good restaurants and sights in Porto. The apartment was clean and perfect for a family of four with older children. Communication with Oporto was very good and they stayed in touch with us even after our flights were cancelled, then delayed rearranging our airport transfer (highly recommend). Other plus, a key pad to enter building and apartment. No concern over losing keys or tricky entry!
The apartment was absolutely beautiful and in the best location in Porto. My girlfriends and I traveled to multiple places in Portugal and this was by far the best airbnb experience.

도우루 강변에 위치하고 있어서 매우 경치가 좋았습니다. 단지 창문으로 보이는 뷰는 강가 반대쪽인 절벽 뷰라서 집 밖에 나가야 도우루 강을 볼 수 있어서 그건 조금 아쉬웠습니다.
엘레베이터가 있어서 짐을 들고 다니기에 무척 편했고 침대도 푹신푹신하고 화장실도 두개라서 편하게 사용했습니다. 하지만 집에서 두번이나 왕거미가 나와서 너무 깜짝 놀랐네요...
그리고 마지막날 공항가는 택시서비스를 요청했는데 비행편이 늦춰지는 바람에 택시 픽업시간도 늦추려고 연락했는데 호스트와 연락이 되지 않아서 결국 원래 예약했던 시간에 그대로 출발해야했습니다. 호스트가 집이 많아서 그런지 연락이 잘 되는 편은 아닌 것 같아요. 그리고 세탁기가 있다고 써져있는데 세탁기 없습니다~~ 참고하세요!

The location was great, a sweet little outside terrace outside from the top floor.  Everything was very clean and new.  Guests need to know about the little spiral staircase...not for the aged,  nor for younger children.  The spindles could be taken out with a big suitcase and a bad misstep.  Everything was very accommodating.  However, one issue we had was our morning when we were leaving.  We were not told that the code to get into the front door and to our apartment would be voided exactly at noon.  We had to make a quick run to a shop just next door and got back to the apartment and could not get in.  We were 5 minutes late.   We finally got in and the cleaning crew was waiting for us with some very impatient faces.  We were all packed, we just had to toss a couple of things in a bag and leave.  We always tip cleaning crews, and this time we were able to hand the tip to them in person, which seemed to ameliorate the situation.  Otherwise, all went smoothly.  I broke a wine glass, but left money in it for a replacement.

The apartment is right on the river so you’re able to walk out the front door to amazing views. The apartment can easily hold two adults and two children,  however the loft space is completely open so privacy is a bit limited. 

The entire apartment is updated, new and clean. 

Checkin was also very easy.

The host, Hugo, was really helpful and informative. The flat was very well equipped - the two separated sleeping areas (enclosed room, and mezzanine) and double toilets were perfect for our requirements, and the keyless entries were perfect for autonomous comings and goings.
Great place to stay. Perfect location, received great information about Porto and the appartment was very clean.

The location is reasonably close to the attractions, though we were expecting it to be up the hill. Not much of an issue, except for the climb up via stairs or the Funicular. There's no laundry facilities within the apartment.

We really enjoyed staying here during our visit to Porto. The host Bruno was very welcoming and explained the city to us for 45 minutes, giving us local tips and places to visit. A bit strange that we had to pay 24€ per guest for “tourist tax”. But The location was perfect and the beds were comfortable. Would definitely book again.

For future travelers: Clean and private space on quiet end of river, close to funicular and great restaurants; appears recently remodeled; two levels with small terrace accessed from top level only; very small baths, kitchen and living/dining space; no screens on windows which is common; AC froze lower level but only way to cool upper level was to open windows which was not recommended due to mosquitoes, etc. Good for four people. Manager very accommodating and communicative.

The apartment was in a super location, right on the river! It was easy to walk to historic Porto and across the river to Gaia. The apartment was clean and very comfortable - the outside space was a nice bonus. The host was very hospitable and helped us upon arrival and with a dinner reservation. It was also really nice to have an elevator which is unusual in historic Europe apartments. We highly recommend!

name: 1 Stop fr. Manhattan! Private Suite,Landmark Block
summary: Private room, dedicated bath and a separate entrance. Totally renovated Queen Anne Historic Townhouse Home on a safe, Landmark Block. Only one stop from Midtown Manhattan! Enjoy the rear private Garden at breakfast time. Beautiful tree lined,quiet street. 4 subway lines ( E, M, 7 and G ) are one block away! Great restaurants, supermarket and cafes nearby.
space: Beautifully renovated bedroom suite in 1890 Townhouse on Landmarked block, only 5 minutes from Manhattan.  Dedicated entrance under stoop to foyer leading to bedroom suite assures privacy (my daytime office/library is in the rear of this floor). Includes one double bed (sleeps 2), & one  thick futon sofa bed (sleeps 2 addit'l ).Microwave, small refrigerator, coffee maker in room.  THERE IS NO TV. NO COOKING . WIFI available. A friendly, medium sized dog (Gus) is on the premises.   Private Bathroom (walk-in shower stall big enough for two).  Soap, Shampoo, Clean towels, hairdryer provided.  Housekeeper once a week.   Beautiful rear garden access to enjoy store bought breakfast. Close to East River waterfront promenade , MOMA/PS1 Museum, restaurants, shops, food market, laundry, post office.  Currently four  subway lines available only a block away ! Many films and TV series were filmed on the block during the year, including classics like 'Sex & The City, The Sopranos", and currently, "

neighborhood_overview: Beautiful historic block, lined with old trees and turn of the century residential townhouse architecture. The neighborhood has a great number of places to eat, including Italian, Peruvian, Thai and Chinese food, and the typical American Diner (COURT SQUARE DINER) thats open 24 hours. The LIC CORNER CAFE, around the corner, serves homemade pastries and sandwiches. LIC MARKET serves the freshest most innovative food in Queens. Film & TV crews are always filming on our block. Time-Out Magazine rated it "The 3rd Best Block in all of NYC!" We are a 12 minute walk to the new Gantry State Park, a $30 million Riverwalk Park with stunnung views of Manhattan.
notes: Towels, Hairdryer, Soap, Shampoo provided.
transit: Verty convenient to Manhattan, which is only one stop away! 3 lines( E, M, 7,) go into Manhattan,one line ( G ) goes to Brooklyn (Williamsburg and beyond). Airport connections from JFK, La Guardia and Newark are easy (JFK and La Guardia are the fastest). There is street parking in the evenings, although you can easily park at a garage 2 blocks away.
access: Direct access under stoop to hallway that leads to your private room. A dedicated, luxurious bathroom is next to room.  In the rear, a professionally landscaped garden can be used to enjoy breakfast & quiet time only. Smoking allowed in rear garden (till 10pm).
interaction: Only if they want. I enjoy and respect our mutual privacy. I will be present during most stays but I do often travel, and will leave the house either with my partner (Cristian ) or a qualified, trusted live-in House Sitter.
house_rules: No smoking inside. No outside guests.   No cooking. Appreciate taking off street shoes inside room. We have an old dog, so no pets please.

host.host_location: New York, New York, United States
host.host_about:
Photographer/Developer. 
I enjoy NYC tremendously but love traveling and have visited
over 40 countries. My house is filled with artwork from those travels.
I work my photography business from my home studio, in a restored 1890 landmark townhouse with all the modern amenities.
My house has been used for filming scenes for Sex & The City, The Sopranos, Gossip Girl & White Collar.
My photography column,"Orestes'LIC", appears every month in the local paper.
I love Asian, Spanish & Cuban food, along with a good bottle of red wine.
Talking about travel, art, design and photograph,is my favorite pastime. Sorry,I dont shop or know where the best electronics bargains are located ! 
I love giving great walking tour information of different parts of NYC, and info on non-touristy places to eat real food in the area.
I will provide you the privacy level you require to make your stay here is as comfortable as possible.
Enjoy a great, clean, stylish place to stay, only 7 minutes from Manhattan!

reviews.comments:
I had an excellent time at Orestes' place in NYC.

Quiet place with a private entrance to come back home at whatever time you want without disturbing anyone.

Laundromat around the corner and the closest subway is literally one block away, where the 7 train goes all the way into Times Square. Also two blocks away you have the E train that also goes into Manhattan and the G train that goes into Brooklyn.

In the area there's still a cozy and cheap diner that's open 24/7, a few stores to get supplies and a few other places of interest. Location was excellent, 10 minutes away from everything.

The room was great and packed with a mini fridge, coffee maker, TV, a sofa, full size bed and walk-in closet. There was also a private bathroom that had everything you needed and a very good shower.

There's also a garden out back where you can go outside in the mornings and just relax, eat breakfast, etc.

Orestes was a great host and gave me a lot of good spots to go sightseeing. Good person to chat with and quite knowledgeable about the city.

I think that for the price, you simply can't get any better.

Orestes was a great host and a nice guy.  The room was clean, comfortable, and cozy.  Also, his historic home is gorgeously decorated, really reflecting the level of detail that Orestes has in ensuring a nice experience for his guests.  The location was very convenient - easy parking and 1 block away from the subway.  We had a great time staying here and I would definitely recommend it!

This is very upscale and chic lodging in Hunters Point.  Everything about the room is positive, especially the warmth and friendliness of the host.  It is convenient (less than 2 blocks) to the subway and I was in the city in 10 minutes.  Lots of restaurants within walking distance and small coffee shops, laundromat, delis, etc.  It is a safe area, and you will especially love the totally restored units to the 1880s feeling, but with modern conveniences.
Great space, fabulous garden and very private.  My visiting inlaws stayed there and were very comfortable.  I would recommend to anyone.

My stay with Orestes couldn't have been better. He is a warm, kind and gentle person with a fabulous place and a sweet dog. I enjoyed being surrounded by beautiful artwork in a serene and rich environment that was created in Orestes' vision. If the weather had been warmer, I would have spent some time in his garden oasis. The location is convenient to midtown and Brooklyn without the Manhattan price tag. Plus, there's a great coffee shop/restaurant around the corner and an authentic 24hr. diner in the neighborhood.
The host canceled my reservation 10 days before arrival.

I had a great time staying here with my family. Orestes was extremely nice and thoughtful of us as guests. The room is lovely and the bathroom is great. As a whole it was a relaxing week here. With a beautiful garden and access to everything we need regarding accommodation. Better than any hotel I would say. And Orestes I thought I left my shoes there. They are pretty old anyway so you can throw them out! Thanks!!
Great host,great location. I hope to stay there again very very soon!

We wanted a place to stay close to everything but quiet and comfortable and we got it.   Orestes is a great guy and his place is beautiful.  We could be  in central Manhatten in10 minutes, the 7 line is a 2 minute walk just around the corner.  But when we were tired we could relax here, in perfect peace and quiet.    We always felt safe and welcome.   Thanks Orestes- we'll definitely come back.

What a wonderful holiday and a wonderful place to stay! We were unsure about staying in Queens is opposed to Manhattan, worried that we might feel slightly out of the way, but we had absolutely no need to worry at all - the subway is round the corner (next to the best chinese take-away ever!) and really does take you to the thick of it within ten minutes. There is also a lovely river walk about 15 minutes away which give you the most wonderful views of Manhattan, and there are loungers to relax on at the waters edge!
The house is absolutely beautiful (you can tell Orestes is an architect), you have your own front door and the room is plenty big enough (I stayed with a friend - she slept on the double futon which was very comfy). It also has air conditioning. The bathroom is stunning, with a huge steam room/shower, and it is not shared with anyone else. We were given plenty of fresh towels most days. Orestes' office is on the same floor and then the back garden is just lovely - a great place to sit and eat a takeaway or, as we did, sit and have breakfast.
As a host Orestes was faultless really! He was very friendly and helpful, and we enjoyed telling him about our day - he was happy to recommend places to see and to eat, but also totally respected our privacy and we felt would have probably left us totally to our own devices if we'd wanted. He also had a lovely little dog called Kiki!
There was no weird faff with deposits or cleaning fees, everything was simple and wonderful. I honestly can't wait to go back and I want to take all of my friends. Don't hesitate to stay here.
Thanks Orestes, it was fabulous x

My husband and I stayed for a week in January; the room and bathroom were warm, very clean, visually appealing, and comfortable.  We met Orestes briefly, as he was out of town most of the time, and he is extremely hospitable and helpful.  Chris, who was around the rest of the time, was also kind and available for any questions.
The location is convenient to a grocery store, decent diner, and several subway lines; it's pretty simple to get to Queens, Brooklyn, or Manhattan.
Future guests should be aware that while the guest room itself might be non-smoking, the rest of the house isn't.  Most of the evenings the cigarette smoke was unavoidable, though not too bad if you kept the door to the guest room shut.  (Being first-trimester-pregnant, my nose and nausea levels felt sensitive to this, but I imagine it wouldn't be an issue for most folks, unless you had asthma or some other sensitivity.)
On whole, it was a good home base for our week in New York; everyone was friendly and the accommodations were nice.

Orestes was a great host!  He was very helpful with any questions I asked him, and I had a lot :)  It was my first time in NYC, and he definitely made it easier with his recommendations (especially when it came to public transportation.)  He has a beautiful home.  I wanted to take that shower home with me!  Heaven!  Great location too!  The E train and 7 train were about a block away, and there is a 24 hour diner right around the corner!

We stayed two nights at Orestes' and it was, from far, our best AirBnB experience ever. The very spacious room is in a Queens historic district (very close to 5ptz, PS1 Moma and a typical American Diner...). We had everything we needed (wifi, clean and big private bathroom, comfortable  bed...). We absolutely recommend this place (which is only one stop from Manhattan - Lexington Av. /49th).

In the beginning we wanted to stay at a hotel in central Manhattan, but fortunately for us we saw Orestes room on the internet and it was an even better place to stay. It was great to be able to withdraw to the Queens peace and quiet after a long day in Manhattan - and only one subway stop away. Orestes house is located in a historically beautiful street and the room is comfortably furnished with a touch of creative people. Nice bathroom with a shower big enough for two and the sunny garden was beautiful.

It was nice to meet Orestes and Cristiàns hospitality, helpfulness and kindness and Kikki, the dog of the house, always greeted us welcome. We felt very welcome and our expectations were fully met. We will certainly return to this place again when we visit New York next time and can only give our warmest recommendations to this place.

A dream week in a fantastic place and a great guy named Orestes. Everything was much more than expected including the location just one stop from Manhattan by the airtrain/subway. Hope to go back there as soon as possible. Thank you Orestes.
Great host, very nice and understanding. Location was fantastic and interior photos don't do the place justice, its even nicer than it looks. Lots of good restaurants in the area too.

Orestes was an amazing host.  Very welcoming and warm and was able to give us advice for train routes to take and restaurants to visit!  His house and the room were amazing.  His place is very clean, comfortable, and extremely well decorated!  We loved the amazing shower and the adorable dog!

I can say without a doubt, that we'll be referring some friends to him and if we have the opportunity to come back to New York again we will definitely be staying here again.

Highly recommended!

Orestes is a great host.  His place is amazing.  The room is more like a suite in that it has a couch to watch TV in addition to a very comfotable bed.  There is also a small fridge  and coffee machine.  During our stay the temp was over 100 degrees outside but the room has great A/C so we were very comfortable.  Also, the room is super quiet.  The bathroom is fantasic....huge!  Great dog named KIKI too.

The location is 1 block away from the 7 train.  You can't beat this.  10 min to Grand Central Station and Central Park....15 min to Times Square.  The neighbor hood has many great places to eat.  I highly recommend LIC Cafe which is 1 block away.  

This is the ONLY place to stay in NYC!!!

Orestes is a very friendly and helpful host. We felt very welcome at his place.
The location is very convenient for a city break in NYC and especially Manhattan with 5 subway lines only a couple of walking minutes away.
The room has all you need and the bed was very comfortable.

Thank you Orestes - we will come back!

About location:
Great location! 5 min from Manhattan. Great neighborhood with laundry service, few market places to provide us all we needed and an Indian restaurant right over the corner. 3 minute walk to the subway!

About the house:
Great room! big. with A/C, T.V, fridge and coffee table. Towels available in the room and in the shower. All clean and neat. Big private shower. Big beautiful yard to enjoy breakfast.  Perfect. We really enjoyed staying there.

About the owner:
We had a nice conversation over the phone. I felt comfortable with my decision to book his place .Orestes the owner had his friend Gabbi waiting for us when we arrived. She guided us through out our visit and made us feel at  home.  She was kind enough to spend time on the computer, explaining us where to go and how to get there, as well as many important tips that made the difference in our trip. We were lucky to have her.
Orestes and Christian are great hosts and would love to come back and stay with them. Great location and quiet. The shower is AWESOME!!

just gonna start by saying "amazing"!!

we had such a great time at Orestes home and what a lovely home it is. we received a warm welcome and were made to feel at home. Everything about our stay couldn't have gone any better. Orestes gave us plenty info about the area, highlighting interesting places to eat and gave us travel advice which saved us a bit. We have kept in touch and will be going back next year. We just wish we were still there.

Many thanks Orestes
Was great meeting you!!

Adam and Sinead.

The house located near subway only a few minutes walk. The room is comfortable and restroom is clean. I will stay here again if I plan to visit New York. Thank you Mr. Orates for a lovely place to stay,

Designed by a gifted mind this place is an amazing spot to start discovering New York. The rooms and lavatories are very clean and it is obvious Orestes and Christian care about their home! It's very close to a Metro station which takes you to 5th Avenue and Central Park just within minutes. Well, when there isn't a superstorm approaching where most of the public transport gets shut down. But luckily we survived Sandy and felt very safe at this place. And on the day of our departure Orestes was kind enough to take us to that one Metro station which startet operating on a low level routine again and made it easy for us getting to Manhattan. 
However, as half of NYC was without electricity during our stay we have to come back and will hopefully stay here again!

We had a great time in Orestes .I can highly recommend  staying with him.The place is great,very close to Manhattan ,and we were glad choosing that place over the other and the cost connecting with being there.The place is  very well designed .I wish I could be that talanted,but I will steels some ideas anyway.We had great chat and helped us when needed,other wise we felt as we were there on our own.Book with confidence.

This was my first experience with an Airbnb stay and it surpassed my expectations!  Orestes is a gracious host who made me feel very welcome, taking time to show me his home and tell me about the area. His home has a wonderfully warm ambiance that is reflected in the room (and private bath!) I stayed in...both clean and spacious.  This historic street is a beautiful neighborhood setting and two subway stations (there might be more but I was just getting my bearings!) are within a few minutes walk that take you right into Manhattan.  This Airbnb experience made for a perfect mini-getaway!  Thank you, Orestes!

Two words alone would be enough to describe staying at Orestes...Simply Amazing!!! Orestes’ home exudes a special warmness, also thanks to its interesting décor which comes from the mind of two very talented people. Orestes and Cristian are wonderful, friendly and warm hosts; they made us feel extremely welcome and at home from the moment we arrived. As for location, we couldn't have asked for a better one. The triplets are ideally located on a quiet historic street where we could rest peacefully after long days spent out & about, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. There are loads of nice restaurants (try LIC Market if you get the chance, great food & atmosphere!) and shops close by as well as a 24/7 diner; just minutes away from Manhattan by subway (with multiple train choices) and only a short walk away from the best view of the skyline you'll experience by far! The room itself is perfect in size, comfortable and very clean; it also has a sofa, TV, mini fridge, coffee maker and walk in wardrobe which, albeit small, is extremely handy! The bathroom has the best shower ever, amazing ...I still miss it & wish I could have taken it back with me ;) Last but not least, there is a lovely garden at the back where you can unwind, soak in the sun or have breakfast al fresco! We really couldn't have wished for better! Thank you Orestes and Cristian for opening your home to us and  for making our stay perfect. Already looking forward to my next stay :)

Staying in Orestes' suite was a great treat. It is comfortable, immaculate, and very tastefully and interestingly decorated. The bathroom/shower is amazing and there is a lovely outdoor garden in the back for when the weather is good. Orestes was welcoming, friendly, and helpful, but not obtrusive -- an ideal host. Long Island City is a very interesting location, lots to explore, and the proximity to Manhattan could not be better. We will most definitely try to stay with Orestes on our next visit to NYC.

What a great location and comfortable, clean and charming place to stay for a visit to NYC.  All is just as presented in the description for this location.  Easy to get to from the airport, great location for use of the subway, safe and attractive, good food within one block and quiet, friendly accommodations.  You will not be disappointed if this is your choice. Orestes is a wonderful responsive host.

A great place to stay! The suite is very comfortable, cosy, clean and quiet with a lovely garden and perfectly suited in a beautiful street.
And it is well located: very close to the metro (3 lines lead directly to midtown Manhattan) and good restaurants.

Orestes was very friendly and gave us lots of interesting tips for NY. This Suite is the perfect place to discover NY and was an excellent home to us. We highly recommend it.

Our family of 3, including our 13 year old daughter recently stayed at Orestes' beautiful home.  The room and bathroom were very clean, spacious and very comfortable.  Sitting outside in a lovely garden having breakfast is something I would never had expected to do. The location is fantastic, we loved the quiet of Queen's and the short walk to the metro which quickly got us into Manhattan.  Orestes and Christian were very helpful and excellent hosts who made our trip run smoothly.  I wouldn't hesitate to highly recommend it to others and the next time I am in New York it would be my first choice.
Very nice house and Superb location. Our family did enjoy great stay in Orestes House. It is good choice and we will definitely choose this house for next trip to New York.

Very nice location, perfect for us. We really enjoyed staying with Orestes, he was very helpful and the house is just wonderful. Location if perfect (one stop from Manhattan, 5 mins walk to the subway) and the neighborhood is very nice and safe. The room and the bathroom are beautiful and breakfast in the garden was great.. but beware of the mosquitos, they love European tourists :D

I was very disappointed with my first airbnb experience. I was expecting an intimate local experience with the benefit of getting an insider's take on my first visit to the fabulous city that is NY. Unfortunately, Orestes was away on holidays (which I only found out when I rang him a day before I arrived) the whole 5 days I was there. He said a good friend (who introduced herself as his neighbor) would be living there instead. The first day a non-English speaking house-cleaner was there to meet me to pass me the keys. Because I spent the first afternoon sightseeing I arrived to a quiet house at 10.30pm and spent the first night not knowing who was in the house. The next morning at the first sound of noises/footsteps in the house I went upstairs to wait to meet 'the neighbour' before she headed off to work. This was the only time I saw her in my stay but awoke every morning to the sounds of multiply people coming in and out of the only entrance which is through the bottom front door right next to do the guest bedroom.  I was never told who was going to be in the house and by the end of 5 days I counted at least 5 people, one other guy living in the same house (who never introduced himself), a dog walker and work colleagues of Orestes who made use of the 2 workstations in the same level as the bedroom for at least 2 of the days. One work collegue was working until 1 am one morning. Considering there is an opaque ceiling to floor window in the bathroom which is clearly visible from the working area I didn't feel comfortable taking a shower at night. Also my "private" bathroom was used by the work colleagues. Although I was out for most of the days, due to the wooden floor boards I could hear people walking/stomping around late at night and early mornings. The photos are accurate, the house is nice. However, the room you stay in is on the basement level along with 2 work place areas. There were written rules left including one never to lock the front door when you were inside (otherwise you can lock others out!). I never heard from Orestes, was never offered help or advice and had no communication who had access to the house.  Disappointing considering all the rave reviews. I would have felt safer and got a lot more personal attention and clearer communication staying in a hotel. My girlfriend who also stayed a couple of nights was also disappointed by the fact we were sightseeing 'blind' and that we had no idea who was in the upper levels of the house. For safer, more personal attention and less wasting time on subways I recommend staying in a hotel around East Village. P.S. my bed sheet was covered in dog hairs.

We had a great stay at Orestes beautiful home. The roomes were exactly a described and we felt very at home and warmly welcomed. After a long day in Manhatten it was great to get in the subway for few minutes and relax in the quiet place, especially the garden.

An extremely helpful and welcoming host into a house that we loved. The design features were fantastic and the shower is by far one of the best I have seen.
Orestes is a very knowledgeable and courteous man and I would advise his house to any b2b costumer.
We can't thank him enough for his help and hospitality. Hope to return one day

Nuestra estancia ha sido confortable. Gran suite con una ducha excepcional. Orestes es un gran anfitrion y ofrece una gran confianza. Te da toda la informacion que le pidas. Conocimos tambien a 2 amigos suyos  Ray (escritor, le regaló un libro a mi hijo) e Ignacio muy atentos y educados. Teniamos todo lo necesario para el aseo (toallas, jabones,..), con nevera, cafetera con cafe,,, , seria interesante tener un pequeño microondas.
Sin duda recomiendo este sitio, metro a la vuelta de la esquina(1 min.), supermercado, buen barrio.. Es tan tipico y bonito que una noche rodaron una pelicula en la puerta de la casa.
Si vuelvo espero hospedarme en este sitio con Oreste.

Our stay was comfortable. Large suite with a fantastic shower. Orestes is a great host and provides great confidence. It gives you all the information you ask. 2 also met his friends Ray (writer, gave him a book to my son) and Ignacio very attentive and polite. We had everything you need for grooming (towels, soap, ..), with refrigerator, coffee maker with coffee,,,, it would be interesting to have a small microwave.
I definitely recommend this place, metro just around the corner (1 min.), Supermarket, nice neighborhood .. It is so typical and pretty shot a movie night at the door of the house.
If I look forward to staying in this place with Oreste.

My daughter and I  were so pleased that we chose Orestes's beautiful place in  Long Island City Queens for our First B&B experience . He was there to meet us and he had allowed us to arrive an hour early. It was clean and airy and plenty of space allowed us to spread out . He let us settle in and offered to help out if we needed anything.  He also let us have our privacy, although he does use the downstairs space for work, it is not noisy or intrusive and we weren't there much in the day. 
We had a split stay in NY and the first leg we stayed in an impersonal Mid Town Hotel - Just like any other city BUT
Staying in  LIC Queens was a real treat, it is so unique and very close to the river, has awesome city skyline views plus we worked out the subs easy enough and it was as close as he says. It only took us 10 mins on the sub to get home at night!. You walk that much at least to a hotel, and Subs are everywhere.  It was really nice to come home to a quiet space every night.  We also appreciate healthy food options and found really great food at a quality., modern Food cellar supermarket in Long Island City! it was awesome with a huge range of wholesome, organic  salads and healthy choices and only 5 mins walk.
I would absolutely recommend you consider staying here, in a beautiful street, with quiet neighbourhood, a lovely, rare city garden as a treat and so very close to Manhattan.  It is great value all around. Orestes was polite, respectful and helpful as a host. Thanks again Orestes. 
Catherine. Brisbane

This was our first experience with Airbnb and for sure not last. I can’t imagine better place to stay, really Orestes was perfect host. Unfortunately we do not have time to discuss more as we had been exploring city, but believe that this was not last time we had meet Orestes. :)
Orestes was every time available for our questions and helps us so much. I also really appreciate his big help during last day in NYC as we have been returning from East Hampton and need to leave our luggage for few hours due to late-night flight. Orestes helped us without any discussion.
Perfect for me was that not even house was beautiful but also Orestes is person you can rely on.
Before this experience we have been in NYC but we stayed in hotel, but as I said, no more! For everybody looking for place to stay in NYC this should be first option.
I nearly forgot the location (Website hidden by Airbnb) You have peace for sleep but so close to Manhattan. “Just one stop from Manhattan.” – exactly, take line 7 to Lexinton Ave…
My impressions from whole stay at Orestes’s beautiful house are hart to describe. I will remember this for long long time.
Unfortunately also our stay had one big disadvantage: we had to leave. :))) 
Orestes: Really thank you for everything. I am really happy to know you. 
RETURNING TO NYC? ONLY TO ORESTES’S PLACE!
 (Website hidden by Airbnb)
The reservation was canceled 13 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We loved our stay in Queens with Orestes. Beautiful apartment, fantastic location just a few metro stops from Manhattan, Orestes was very kind and welcoming. Without a doubt will stay with Orestes again next time we are in NYC.
Great place to stay- very conveniently located, quiet (for NYC), and all-around pleasant. Good host with good communication and nice space. Orestes himself is considerate and pleasant.

We had a great stay at Orestes place! The bedroom and bathroom were super clean, linen, towels and dishes were kindly provided. Perfect alternative to Manhattan as Times Square is just few minutes away with the subway. Very nice garden to have breakfast in the morning! - The private room that we stayed is very nicely decorated and has everything from a microwave, to a fridge with plates/cups/utensils all provided in the room, making it really convenient as you don't have to go all the way to the kitchen. Room is big & spacious, with a sofa, table & chairs. 
Cons:
- the exit of the subway station leading to the house only has stairs and no escalator/elevator. Hence if you have big/heavy luggages, it's quite a bit of work to carry them up & down. of course you can use other exits but they are further away.
-  the "ensuite" bathroom is not really adjoined to the bedroom, it is the next room beside the bedroom and you have to walk down the hallway to get to it. of course it is still privately yours and is a really cool bathroom equipped with different shower heads.
- Unlike some hosts who left keys for you in some secret place so that you can let yourself into the house anytime you arrive, Orestes does not do that and we waited a while for him out in the cold when we arrived close to midnight. of course I communicated my arrival time to him but he was out having dinner and missed the timing. well, I guess this is all part & parcel of the little hiccups of travelling.

We stayed for three nights. As first time travelers to NYC, we wanted to be close to or in Manhattan. We chose this property because it was close to the city but allowed us to escape the hustle and bustle. The property is only a minute walk from Courts Square metro and the subway goes directly into Manhattan. 15 minutes and you're in Times Square. It is quick, cheap (about $2.50 one-way) and convenient. An Uber or taxi from Downtown is about $30. The neighborhood itself is quintessential gritty Queens but did not appear dangerous and the street itself is beautiful and quite. 
The room exceeded our expectations. We thought it would be a small space, but it was the size of a standard hotel room. It was clean. It has a mini fridge, microwave, couch, double bed and air conditioning. The bed was soft and the room was quiet. The bathroom was fantastic. A proper bathroom with big shower, plenty of hot water - plus a sauna feature. 
Both Orestes and Cris were wonderful hosts. They were accommodating to our requests and were very welcoming with their home. They lived upstairs, allowing for privacy as well as access to free wifi and most of the whole bottom floor. We were also offered full use of the courtyard at the back, which would be perfect for breakfast in the sunshine or to read a book. 
This place is a definite gem and we would highly recommend staying here again.  Thank you again, Orestes and Cris for your kind hospitality.

Sehr nette kleine Unterkunft mit sehr netten Gastgebern! 
Die Lage ist perfekt und man ist sehr schnell in Manhattan!

Orestes was a wonderful host with an absolutely beautiful home. The space was exactly what we needed for our stay & the bed was super comfortable.
And honestly, it is by far the BEST location if you want to spend the day in Manhattan-a quick & easy 10 minute subway ride to Midtown.

Orestes's house is a lovely place to stay while visiting the Big Apple! 

Thanks once again.
Très facile d'accès depuis JFK. Appartement proche du métro, 10 mn de trajet pour rejoindre Manhattan. Nombreuses possibilités de restauration à proximité.

The location is on a historic classic block in Queens. The subway is around the corner. Manhattan is just minutes away. The Court Square Dinner around the corner serves great food, big servings at great prices. The Thai place next to the doughnut place is good to. There are several quality dinners within a couple of blocks. It is a much greater value to dine in Queens than Manhattan. At Time Square around Broadway and 48th we ate often at TSQ. Awesome ,delicious big servings. Strong Long Island Ice Tea for just 12 bucks.
 Can't wait to comeback!
We stayed for a week at Orestes place. It's a  nice place to stay and close to Manhattan. Very nearby are 2 metrostations, and it's a short walk to the East River where you can take the ferry.

Nous avons séjourné 10 jours chez Orestes et c’était parfait. 
L’accueil s’est fait en présence de l’hôte. Nous avions pu communiquer facilement avant notre arrivée sur les lieux pour fixer quelques détails. 
Ensuite tout au long du séjour Orestes a été très disponible pour nous, il nous a donné quelques conseil sur notre séjour et ce que nous devions absolument faire. 
Même si nous sommes dans une maison habitée la chambre est isolée et avec sa propre entrée donc c’est paisible. Hyper bien desservie en termes de transports avec 3 lignes de métro à 5 min à pied de la chambre. Une vue magnifique sur Manhattan et l’East River à 10 min à pied. Idéale au coucher du soleil :) possibilité de prendre le ferry aussi comme moyen de transport pas loin ! Bref tout les avantages de NY avec des hôtes à l’écoute mais pas envahissant :) je recommande vivement cette adresse !
Really friendly hosts. Location is really peaceful, quiet and very easy to get into the city using the subway.
Great place! Very close to the subway. Orestes was very amiable and we felt like our space was respected. This was our first shared Airbnb experience and it went very well!

I enjoy staying with them.
And It was very convenient to go to Manhattan :)

Orestes's home is a great place to stay if you want to live like a local! Most would think Long Island City is too far from all the action from Manhattanx but that's not true! It's only 3 stops from Times Square,  and you avoid all the hustle and bustle. The home is a 1t minute walk to the ferries, and you will have a chance to look at the spectacular city from across the water. Mind you,  if you are not ready to socialize, this place is not for you! You will have privacy in your own space but the host does work out of the home office beside your quarters, so you might hear each other when you're both on the same floor. My husband and I were more than happy to chat with Orestes and get some local tips from him so that's a big plus. Overall, it's a great and convenient place to stay and to get an authentic New Yorker experience!
Excelente anfitrión, el inmueble es muy bonito, tal y como aparece en las fotos, la ubicación excelente, sin duda una opción inmejorable para visitar NYC.
Expect a charming host, a nicely decorated and well appointed room, and an excellent location.
Location is so perfect and minutes away from the noise of Manhattan.  Easy to get to from airport, 1 subway stop to Manhattan, and incredibly great hosts!

Very fine place, very well connected by subways (3 lines), the room is big and quiet with AC. The private bathroom is luxurious. The hosts are very prevenants and gave good advices. It's the place to be to explore NYC in peace!!!! I recommand++++

Excellent emplacement : pratique d'accès depuis et vers l'aéroport JFK, plusieurs lignes de métro situées à proximité, quartier calme et reposant, beaucoup de commerces utiles. Salle de bain spacieuse et agréable. Propreté impeccable assurée par Orestes et sa femme de ménage. Disponibilité et réactivité de notre hôte. 
Nous n'avions pas bien compris l'annonce. Nous pensions que l'entrée indépendante était à notre usage exclusif ce qui nous assurerait une meilleure intimité et que notre hôte utilisait l'entrée située à l'étage. En fait, c'est une porte qui est empruntée par tout le monde : voyageurs, hôte et amis de l'hôte. Cela ne remet pas en cause notre séjour, c'est une mauvaise interprétation de notre part. L'avantage certain est que nous savions lorsque notre hôte s’absentait.
Nice location - excellent host. We enjoyed this stay in the home of Oreste.
Great location within LIC. Everything as described and pictured. Only sorry that the weather didn’t permit use of the lovely garden!
We had some nice days in Orestes apartment. The location is perfect - near East River.

You can expect a specious room, a large and very well equiped bathroom and a large garden. The subway is very nearby and Manhattan by metro is less than 10 minutes. JFK by metro and AirTrain is about 1,5 hour.

This is a great place to stay. The accommodation is ideally placed for visits to the Big Apple. Situated in Queens, the historic house is beautifully cared for. Your own private entrance leads to a spacious room that is clean and comfortable. There is a small fridge and microwave, a large bed settee and a very comfortable bed. It was a nice touch to have a dressing gown to use when accessing the well equipped bathroom which adjoins the bedroom. Orestes was brilliant at communicating with us and although we didn’t get to see him in person, his partner Chris  was so friendly and helpful, giving us great advice regarding restaurants and places to see that we felt like honoured guests throughout our stay. I booked this accommodation on the basis of previous reviews and i certainly have no reservation about recommending a stay here. Thank you Orestes and Chris, we hope to come back.

This Airbnb is a great place to explore NYC and surrounding areas. It’s only 1 stop from Manhattan, (it’s actually closer to Manhattan than some of Manhattan!). Orestes is a lovely, friendly, and welcoming host. We also had a special doggy welcome from Gus, which was lovely.... a home is not a home without a fur baby! The subway stop is also really close,  a 2 minute walk. 
To be honest, I could have spent my whole stay in NYC in that shower, oh my god... what an amazing shower and a gorgeous bathroom. 
The attention to detail is great too, with lovely artwork. Oh, and there’s a traditional diner around the corner that serves lush breakfast!  
Thank you Orestes for a lovely stay and for some great tips. If you’re ever in Wales, we’d love to return the favour!

My wife and I had a wonderful stay at Orestes’s place. The room was very comfortable and with an entrance right off the hall we felt comfortable coming and going. All the amenities were great and the house had a wonderful design. The location is central to many great restaurants and the subway to midtown. I personally enjoyed burger garage and the micro brewery fifth hammer, both right down the street. All of this added up to a wonderful stay for my wife and I. This is a part of NY everyone should experience once.

Orestes place is wonderful. The location in Queens is excellent, just a few minutes walk to the metro that gets you in to the city in a few minutes and JFK in about 40 minutes. The room is very comfortable and a lovely bed. The bathroom is exceptional, with large shower and steam room. There’s a microwave and refrigerator provided and a few coffee sachets. Whilst the room is private, it is adjacent to Orestes workshop, which is fine and has direct access into his apartment upstairs. The area is safe and nice to walk around. It’s only a 10 minute walk to the ferry terminal too and I’d recommend doing that as it’s a nice walk along the river too to the next stop down. We also thoroughly recommend the Court Square Diner around the corner for any time of day, the breakfast is amazing. Will certainly return next time we’re in New York and recommend.

My sister and I shared the room for 5 nights. We found Orestes to be very friendly and helpful. He has a very calm demeanor and we felt like we were staying with an old friend rather than a stranger. The room is comfortable and quiet, and the shower in the bathroom is the best! Very close to trains and you can also walk to Gantry Park and take the ferry to Brooklyn or Manhattan.

Everything was just perfect. 
The house was located in a very safe place, near by subway stations. The room was really large and spacious, and the bed was also large and comfortable. The host provided ample bedclothes, pillows and towels. The best thing about this house was that it was extremely clean. The restroom was equipped with steamshower(!!) and was also very clean. The host had a high level of sensitivity in art, so the whole house was decorated with beautiful pictures and props. He was also very kind and did not cause any inconvenience in staying. The picture he took in the garden will be the biggest gift of my life! 
If I ever come to New York, I will definitely stay in this house again.

Our stay at Orestes' place was great! The location is really good to explore NYC - we just needed 15min to get to times square. The room is really comfortable and we felt like home! Orestes was always kind and helpful. We can highly recommend a stay at his place!

Orestes was a good host. The room was exactly what we expected and it was nice to have private access to it so we could come and go without disturbing the family. He recommended a diner where the food was great. We would happily stay there again.
Great experience and great value!
Orestes was very kind and helpful! He was eager to help when needed and gave great recommendations! He even gave us fresh towels throughout our stay. We enjoyed it greatly!

Chambre grande et propre. Salle de bain magnifique ! Station de métro aux deux extrémités de la rue à 1 minute à pied. Commerces proches. Manhattan atteint en 15 min de métro. Très bon emplacement et super rapport qualité prix ! N’hésitez pas !

Orestes is an amazing host and his home is beautiful (with an amazing shower) :).  Furnished with art collected from around the world, we loved the cozy interior and comfortable bed. Located a heartbeat away from Manhatten, you will not regret staying here. Literally zero complaints.
Orestes muy atento y muy servicial ante cada situación, la verdad es que es un lugar para quedarse y disfrutar de la cercanía con todo.
Everything perfect .. I will be using this apt in the future

It was a great experience. I like the interior decoration, which is very artistic. Corridor painting is also very meaningful. The bathroom is nice and it's convenient to take a bath. The landlord is very nice, too. If you have any travel questions, you can ask him. Anyway, thank you very much.

Cozy space with an amazing bathroom! The outside garden is stunning even in the snow. Amazing breakfast spot just a block away.

Orestes was super nice and welcoming.

Also close to supermarket, parks, water and Domestic Airport. Book a room for yourself or Book both bedrooms for family and friends.

reviews.comments: Very close to airport, comfortable bed
Shuang's place was great. It had everything I needed for the Stay and was very clean. I had a small problem with the iron but Shuang had it fixed within minutes! Would definitely recommend.

Very clean and calm. We had one of the two rooms and shared kitchen and bathroom with another traveller (second room). Quiet nice place. Only a 15 minutes walk to the airport. Next time again :-) Thank you very much!
Shuang was very helpful and was very quick with his responses to any questions i had. Was clean and had all the things i needed to have a comfortable stay.

Shuang is a very organised and helpful host. all our questions had been answered quickly and accurate before our arrival. the room was spacious and clean with all the needs for our short stay. 
the location is near the airport and took us about 25min to walk there with heavy backpacks - easy!

definitely recommend Shuang!
