Shuang's place was perfect for our overnight layover in and out of Sydney airport. It's easy to get to and a short walk from the train station which took us right downtown. It was clean and comfortable. Definitely recommend.

This was a quiet, extremely clean, and cozy place to stay after a 11 hr. flight, and was only 10 min. away from the Sydney airport (about $18 taxi fair). I found everything I needed from internet code printed with local maps. I had to wait for my ride to arrive and I was able to wait in the common room and was even given coffee. I highly recommend this very nice and private granny flat. Thank you for the welcoming hospitality! I will stay again if come back to NSW, Australia.

Shuang was very helpful in providing instructions and tips to getting to his place. The room itself is very clean, spacious, and modern. The neighborhood is pretty quiet and the person/people I shared the kitchen and bathroom with were very considerate and quiet. Getting around was pretty easy as it was only a 12 minute walk from Wolli Creek station and shorter walk to a few bus routes that will take you to Sydney or surrounding suburbs. My stay was very short as I was heading to the airport, and it's a relatively easy walk to the airport if you don't have too much luggage. Otherwise, it's an inexpensive taxi ride or short bus trip to the airport, which works just as well. Would definitely try to stay here again if I'm ever in the area again.
It was one of the best places that I have stayed in and I couldn't have asked for a better place and shuang was a wonderful host

The flat was very modern and we'll equipped, I only stayed for one night but it was a pleasant experience. Only downside was the bathroom wasn't that clean, maybe due to sharing with another airbnb guest, because the room was spotless. Thanks for having me to stay!
Very comfortable and clean room. Close to food shops and airport. Was a nice experience. I'd love to stay there again. Very lovely host. Thank u very much.

Great place to stay when flying out the international airport. Great price, easy to get to airport ($12 uber). Highly recommend.

Shuang's place is totally fantastic both in terms of location and quality of the room. It's close to transit, quite easy to find with convenient arrangement for key pick up. And the room is well equipped with all necessities, and above all cleaned professionally, which is what I found to be key to a comfortable Airbnb experience. I was only here for a day and the proximity to the airport was a solid plus, yet I can see this could also be nice for longer travel thanks to the easy access to the city. Thanks for the nice experience and hope next time when I visit Sydney I could potentially stay again here.

The room was clean, comfortable, and well-appointed. The host even provided electric blankets for us, which were very much appreciated during the cold winter night. We were not chilly at all. The bathroom was very spacious and modern, similar to the room. Would stay here again!

The host was very accommodating as we had quite a few luggages with us. Very clean apartment with close location to the train. Also very close to the airport. Overall a fantastic value!

The rooms were separate from the main house and impeccably clean with white towels and bathmats supplied. Tiled floors and bench space in the bathroom with a washing machine.  Up the stairs on the balcony were clothes drying racks. The bed was comfy and pillows of high quality. 
Contact with the host was via phone and he or family attended to my requests. There was very little actual conversational communication. Overall a pleasant experience.
Beautiful and clean place. And close to the train station. You can walk.

The location is about 5 EASY minutes from international airport. Easy parking in private road.  Access clear amd simple,  Spacious bedroom, modern bathroom with AWESOME shower.  Kitchenette well equipped for simple needs.  Wifi excellent.   The bedroom door could be locked.  Great communication.  No traffic or aircraft noise - located in cul-de-sac.  Separate entrance to main house.  Have booked to return  for our next early flight.  Simple and great value

I rented one of two bedrooms on a ground floor. A living room/ kitchen and a bathroom were shared. There was a small frig and a small laundry machine. Rooms were very sparkling clean and new. A big TV was in a common living room. Communication was fast and clear. No need to see the host as keys were in a padlock and thus late arrival or early leave is fine. A host seems to live in a house annexed to the AirBnB rooms but entrances were different. Actually, his house is a proper detached house. 15 minutes walk to an international terminal. No need to take a cab if you go to an international terminal. Walk to an int terminal is safe but is not a no trainer due to a airport construction. But it is not too difficult to find a way to it. It is a great place to stay overnight if you have a morning flight. Very competitive price. Good for two people (queen bed), even with a small kid.

Very easy to access. It was about a 20 - 30 minute walk from the airport so we just caught an uber for around $8.00. We did share with someone else in the other room and they did get a bit noisy with their tv show when trying to sleep and can be a bit small if you're looking to watch tv as no couch, but for us we were just looking for a place to stay and it was great!

I would definitely stay here again for a convenient and super comfy layover at Sydney Airport.

This is very convenient location for the airport and, with Wolli Creek station only a 10 minute walk away, the city too. Comfortable bed, great shower, (and washing machine if needed). Perfect for my overnight stay. Thanks Schuang and see you on a future visit
位置距离悉尼国际机场T1航站楼很近可直接不行,从市中心坐火车到站距离房子有点距离,当天还下暴雨可打uber｡到达房间由于窗户没有关上,暴雨都通过窗户灌进打湿床铺,及时与房东沟通并改换了床上用品｡
Shuang's place is really nice. I liked the interiors. The bed is comfortable. Bedroom and bathroom are clean.

Nice place very convenient to the airport.

Since the last time I stayed here, they have added a tv to the room so you can watch netflix, which was a great addition. I recommend this place and would stay here again next time Im in Sydney
Lovely space to stay close to the airport
It was great stay! Quiet and clean!
Clean room, close to airport. Very convenient for an early flight! Easy self checkin system.

Everything was great! Easy check-in and Shuang provided directions that made it very easy to find the place. Super close to the airport so it was perfect for me. Added some nice touches that helped make the stay extra special.

It's really great experience to stay at your place.

Really appreciate it .
Nice cool place for summer and very clean
Easy check-in, easy communication, best location if you are coming from or going to the airport!
非常好!房东很贴心!
The place was spotless, well set out, comfy and had everything I needed
I travel on business and use Shuang's place. Very reliable and clean.

Great location for airport. Great washing facilities and flat was immaculately cleaned. 
Would recommend bringing some mosquito spray
very nice and clean place, close to the airport. Easy to self check in. washing machine is available.
Shuang and family provide kind direction, timely communication, and very considerate. Room is clean and cozy, walking distance to int’l airport.
clean, convenient as always
This was a great convenient and affordable stop over before our early morning flight.
Great place, with wonderful hospitality and conveniently close to the airport!

Very close to the airport, walking distance really. The common area and the bedroom were all very clean, and the amenities were great. Nice big bedroom and shared bathroom, there was a fan in the bedroom as well. Would definitely stay here again.
Great thanks
Nice place, better than the photos.

다음날 일찍 비행기를 타야 해서 공항 근처에 하룻동안 예약한 숙소였는데 가격은 제가 묵었던 다른 에어비앤비와 비교해 조금 높았지만 그만큼 값어치를 하는 숙소였어요! 공항까지 캐리어 들고 걷는건 좀 부담스러워서 기차로 이동했는데 아침 9시 비행기여서 6시 남짓에 이동했음에도 불구하고 공항까지 가는 기차가 운행해서 너무 좋았구요! 주로 중국인들이 많이 거주하는 아파트 지역에 위치한 조용한 주택인데 집 자체도 너무 예쁘고 에어비앤비용 숙소도 정말 깨끗하고 잘 관리해놓으신것 같아 편안하게 묵을 수 있었습니다! 제가 묵은 에어비앤비중에 방도 가장 넓고 시설도 정말 좋았어요. 방, 화장실, 공용공간 등 모든게 완벽하게 구비되어 있었고 콘센트, 샤워기, 냉장고, TV까지 사소한것들을 잘 제공해주신 것 또한 큰 배려심을 느꼈습니다. 시내까지 접근하기는 조금 부적당한 위치이지만 공항 근처에 숙소 잡으실 일이 있으면 꼭 이 곳을 추천드립니다!!

Perfect location to approach Airport and it was a best place between my Airbnbs in Sydney. All furnitures were well-prepared and clean. I think the host is always very careful about his airbnb. Highly recommended!
Very nice place, sparkling clean, host were lovely and extremely helpful. Will definitely recommend!
A great place close to the airport, perfect for a quick stay over or for a couple of nights.

So good place to stay, near to airport for take an uber not very expensive. Good details in amenities and everything that you could need (as umbrella for rainy day in sydney, for example). Everything nice and clean.
非常好的房东,在入住期间给到了很大的帮助｡

Shuang's place is exactly as described in the listing. The check-in and check-out process is super easy, which is great for the weary traveller! Convenient location if you want to be close to the international and domestic airports, plus within walking distance to the Wolli train station. The room was clean and stylishly decorated with little touches like mints. Bed is very comfortable and I had a great nights sleep! Very important if you have an early flight the next morning. I would stay again.

Clean, tidy 2-bed granny flat type place which you get one of the rooms of (separate keys). Super close to the airport that means walking is easy (assuming no big cases), but not under the flight path. The Train is less than 15 mins walk and has regular services straight into town.  Good cooking facilities and a nice bathroom. No AC if that matters to you, but does have a fan. Would be perfect for a city break or business meeting stay over.
Overall the place is lovely and affordable, it is near to the airport,  only $18 Uber to the airport. Best for people who need to catch a flight.

The room was large and clean as listed and it was a good experience staying there, and Ehsan was helpful as best as he could

name: REFÚGIO BOAS VINDAS!
summary: My apartment is very close to the historic center of the city (a 10 minute walk). You will really like it because of its location. The surrounding area has many services. The apartment itself is very pleasant and cozy. It's good for couples or families with children (over 2 years old). Pets are also very welcome.
space: Perfeita combinação do antigo com o contemporâneo. Você pode desfrutar de um apartamento completamente remodelado com mobiliário e eletrodomésticos novos.  Localizado (a pé) a: * 1 minuto da estação de metro 'Campo 24 de Agosto' - Linha E (violeta) que sai do Aeroporto.  * 10 minutos do centro histórico da cidade do Porto.
description: My apartment is very close to the historic center of the city (a 10 minute walk). You will really like it because of its location. The surrounding area has many services. The apartment itself is very pleasant and cozy. It's good for couples or families with children (over 2 years old). Pets are also very welcome.
transit: Do apartamento, a pé, você está em valores aproximados:  1. Estação de metro 'Campo 24 de Agosto' - Linha E Violeta (Aeroporto) (1 minuto); 2. Coliseu Porto (6 minutos); 3. Majestic Café (7 minutos); 4. Via Catarina Shopping (7 minutos); 5. Mercado do Bolhão (8 minutos); 6. Estação São Bento (12 minutos): conexão trem, metro, autocarros;  7. Rua Galeria de Paris (14 minutos): onde ocorre a 'Movida do Porto'; 8. Ponte Luiz I (15 minutos): ícone da cidade do Porto; 9. Torre dos Clérigos (16 minutos): vista estonteante da cidade.
access: Tu podes usar todo o apartamento, tendo total privacidade.
house_rules: Pedimos que, por favor, zelem pelo espaço como o fazem com sua própria casa. É permitido que fumem apenas na varanda do apartamento, mas não dentro dele.  Respeitem o tempo de repouso e descanso dos vizinhos, mantendo total silêncio entre às 23h e às 7h durante a semana e aos sábados, domingos e feriados entre às 20h e às 8h. No restante do tempo deve haver ponderação e bom senso na administração do barulho.  Não levem para o apartamento pessoas que não tiveram reservas previamente agendadas.   A hora da saída é sempre às 11h, mas um atraso nesse horário é negociável desde que solicitado com antecedência. Ao saírem deixem as chaves dentro do apartamento pendurada no quadro de avisos e entreguem o espaço arrumado como o encontraram.

host.host_about:
Sou uma pessoa de bem com a vida que aprecia conhecer pessoas, ter boas conversas e fazer amizade.  
As 5 coisas essenciais para mim são: paz de espírito, bons amigos, natureza, boa leitura/música e boa comida.

Silvia nous a reservé un super acceuil.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Le logement est super propre et fonctionnel 
Très bonne communication avant et pendant le séjour. 
On reviendra!

Sehr zentral gelegen; Die Gastgeberin hat uns zur besseren Orientierung eine Stadtkarte bereitgestellt. Schönes, voll ausgestattetes Apartment.
Schnelle Rückmeldung und einfache Kontaktaufnahme mit der Gastgeberin.
Fue muy agradable, nos recibio con puntualidad, nos explico todo muy bien y hasta nos dio un detalle de bienvenida.

Silvia was really sweet and very attentive -- she stocked the apartment with all the basics and more. The apartment is exactly what you would expect -- felt very homey and warm. Also conveniently located with metro station and supermarkets within a few minutes' walking. The small one-way street it overlooks can get busy (traffic noise) and the restaurant across the street a little noisy so not the quietest but was not an issue for me with the balcony doors closed. All in all great!

Apartamento muito acolhedor, moderno e limpo, com tudo o que é necessário. 
A Sra. Silvia foi muito simpática e facilitou-nos o horário do check-in mais cedo o que realmente foi muito útil para não termos de andar com as malas.
Recomendo!

Great place and a very helpful, professional host!

We arrived, drenched in rain (apparently one of those rare summer days when water decides to pour from the skies above Porto) and Silvia was waiting for us, with a bottle of wine as a little welcome gift! 

The apartment itself is very clean, cosy and ideally located in central Porto, perfect for those who want to explore the city.

Silvia è un ho sto meraviglioso!gentile,educata e disponibile. La casa era pulitissima,bella,in una posizione favorevole alle attrazioni. 
La casa è completa di tutto ciò che può servire per il soggiorno.
Grazie Silvia! Torneremo presto a trovarti!
Espaço acolhedor, muito bem localizado. A Silvia extraordinariamente simpática e disponível. Recomendo intensamente.

Silvia's place is amazing! It is super clean and very well equipped. The location was great, one minute away from metro and 10 minutes walking from the city centre. In addition, Silvia was an amazing host, super kind, concerned and thoughtful. 100% recommended.

Silvia -  невероятно внимательная и приветливая хозяйка. Еще до приезда она подробно ответила на все наши вопросы и дала подробные инструкции. А когда мы приехали, ждала нас, стоя на балконе.
Приветственная бутылка вина была для нас приятным сюрпризом.
Апартаменты  просто поразили нас своей чистотой и уютом. Есть все необходимое. 
Немного шумно, поскольку транспорт под окнами ходит и днем, и ночью. Но это расплата за очень удачное расположение. Рядом магазины, кафе. Метро рядом, но мы им практически не пользовались, всюду гуляли пешком.
В следующий раз, когда мы приедем в Порту, мы знаем где остановится.
Очень рекомендуем
Спасибо, Silvia

Sylvia a été très accueillante. Elle est vraiment très attentionnée, elle nous a fournit toutes les infos utiles pour arriver à l'appartement et avait tout prévu pour que le séjour se passe bien. 
L'appartement était nickel, très propre et exactement comme sur les photos. Il est très bien situé proche du centre ville historique. 
La rue en elle même n'est pas la plus agréable mais le quartier est central et très sympa. 
Je recommande vraiment l'appartement!

Wir haben zwar nur eine Nacht in Silvias Appartement verbracht, sind aber dennoch voll auf begeistert und werden es garantiert weiterempfehlen - womöglich sogar selbst sehr bald nochmal buchen. Das Appartement ist viel geräumiger und schöner als es auf den Fotos wirkt. Wir waren die zwei Tage in Porto nur zu Fuß unterwegs - strammen Schrittes sind es 15 Minuten bis zur wunderschönen Rua das Flores und dem Bahnhof Sao Bento. 
Silvias Appartement ist komplett ausgestattet - von Fön bis Waschmaschine (inkl. Waschmittel)! Die Gastgeberin war super freundlich, hat schon vor der Ankunft schnell auf Nachrichten geantwortet und uns herzlich - und mit einem Gastgeschenk - empfangen. Vielen Dank, Silvia, und bis zum nächsten Mal! 

We only stayed one night at Silvias apartment, but we liked it really much and will for sure recommend it - and book it again for ourselves the next time we'll spend Porto a visit. The apartment has much more space and charme than it seems in the pictures. We only explored Porto by foot - if you walk a bit faster, it's 15 minutes to beautiful Rua slas Flores and the train station Sao Bento.
Silvias apartment is fully equipped - from blow dryer to washing machine! The host was as nice as could be, answered messages promptly and welcomed us warmly - with a little gift as well. Thank you very much, Silvia, see you!
Joli appartement, bien équipé, très bien situé mais bruyant. Accueil chaleureux de Sylvia. Ville pleine de charme, séjour très agréable à Porto.
Nice and clean apartment near the beautiful old town (a 15 minute walk).  It is fully equipped .Fast communication with the friendly host.
très mauvais nous avons pas encore enlevé nos affaires quel était dans appartement quartier de prostitution.
Boa localização! A Sílvia foi muito acolhedora, óptima host. A casa é muito bonita, mais do que nas fotos. Tencionamos repetir esta experiência.

Все произвело положительное впечатление, начиная от бронирования и заканчивая выселением. Сильвия очень внимательный хозяин. Точно и подробно давала интересующую нас информацию. Квартира произвела благоприятное впечатление. Чистая, уютная, светлая, небольшая (но для трех человек хорошо). Находится в центре, до исторического центра можно дойти пешком. Все понравилось. Если будет возможность, то воспользуюсь сама еще раз и очень рекомендую всем!

Silvia nos recebeu muito bem.Foi muito simpática e atenciosa.Levei meu cãozinho Luca e quando chegamos encontramos vasilhas novas e uma caminha com manta para ele.O apartamento está todo novo e a limpeza impecável!
Gostamos muito da estadia! Recomendo!

Très bien accueillis dans l'appartement, conforme aux photos, tout confort avec en cadeau yne bouteille de vin.
Propreté digne d'un hôtel!
Et centre à proximité,merci!
Excellent host.  Fantastic location close to metro and short walk to downtown.
Silvia was excellent and considered.  I recommend her house.
Excellent séjour à Porto, en partie grâce à Silvia et son appartement. Hôte au petit soin que ce soit pendant, avant et même après le séjour.

L'acceuil réservé par Silvia était idéal, ses explications pour nous diriger de l'aéroport étaient très utiles. Le logement est dans un état impeccable, et est bien situé par rapport au dynamisme de la ville.

Un bémol cependant concernant le bruit dans la rue en pleine nuit (voitures, passants...) mais rien qui n'altère le sentiment agréable de notre séjour chez Silvia.

Je recommande !

Сильвия - замечательная гостеприимная хозяйка! Апартаменты найти очень просто благодаря подробному описанию Сильвии. Уютно, чисто, комфортно. Рядом с метро. В 15 мин от вокзала. 20 мин до центра. Все рекомендации вы легко получите у хозяйки.

Tudo perfeito! O apartamento é super bem localizado. Tudo novo, limpíssimo. Apenas um lance de escadas. Funcionou muito bem inclusive na viagem com a minha mãe (76 anos). Adoramos o vinho de presente, obrigado.

The apartment was very clean.You have all the things you need, even shampoo, soap, toilet paper and... a welcoming bottle of wine ! 
Silvia is very helpful and nice.
However there is noise in the street during the night.

The appartment is very nice, comfortable. The appartment is also very clean, which is very important for me. Near the appartment you can find Metro Station, restaurants and supermarkets. So I think the location is super nice. Silvia is also very kind. She gave us a bottle of port wine as a welcome drink. She explained us about the appartment and told us to feel like home, which is very nice of her :) Highly recommended to stay at her place :)

O apartamento é ideal para 1 casal. Muito bem localizado, Silvia é um encanto (até nos deixou um detalhe de bem-vindos), sempre preocupada e atenta conosco. A limpeza impecável e muito confortavel. Voltaria sem dúvidas!!!!
I really liked the experience, everything was very clean and perfect. It was a little cold in the apartment, but everything else was great.

We had a wonderful 3 night stay at Silvia's place. The apartment was very beautiful and spacious, very clean and well-equipped. There was everything we might need - lots of clean towels, extra blankets, wifi, shampoo, soap, a map of the city, etc. The apartment building was also very nice and quiet, close to a metro station and not too far away from the very centre of the city. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto!
Квартира в центральном районе. Все достопримечательности поблизости. Сильвия была очень гостепреимна и любезна. Спасибо Сильвия. Отдых в Порту очень понравился.

El piso de Silvia es precioso y confortable, tiene todo lo que necesitas para sentirte como en casa. Está muy bien comunicado y situado, a 1 minuto de la parada de metro y a 10 del centro, además tiene muchos servicios cerca. Estamos encantadas de haber elegido esta opción, tanto por el piso  como por la hospitalidad de Silvia y su hermana. Esperamos volver a veros pronto porque pensamos repetir!! 100% recomendable!!

Silvana (Silvias sister) checked us in and she was very sweet and attentive. They gave us a bottle of welcome wine which was very nice. The beds were very comfortable and three of us fit in the apartment comfortably. The bedroom is actually bigger than it appears. The location is great- within walking distance to the downtown areas and tons of restaurants and shops. Also less than 2 blocks from the metro. Also, there is no elevator but the apartment is only up one flight of stairs so it was fine for us. The only thing worth noting is that the kitchen is small and might not be ideal for anyone seeking to cook a large meal. That aside, this is a lovely apartment and I would definitely stay here again.
We ad a very good welcome. The appartment is pleasant, and the neighbourhood is very local, with a nice variety of restaurants.
Silvia很热情,为我们提供了详细的路线｡房子位置不错,设施很齐全｡

Нам заранее объяснили как добраться до квартиры. На месте нас встретил Виктор, друг Сильвии. Все показал и объяснил . В квартире новая мебель и посуда, сделан хороший ремонт. Новая бытовая техника  и все необходимое для проживания. Рядом метро и магазины. Бутылка вина и воды была приятным подарком. Единственный минус - очень холодно в квартире зимой. Есть обогреватель, можно нагреть квартиру, но очень холодный пол (берите тапочки).
Nice house, very near to augusto metro stop. All places are nearby to visit . Silvia is very helpful too.

L'appartement est comme sur la photo. Il est très propre et très bien entretenu. Silvia est l'hôte parfaite, elle répondra a toute vos questions et toujours prete a aider au moindre problème.
Le seul petit bémol est le quartier qui est un peu lugubre mais les gens y sont tres accueillant.

Silvia is an amazing host. She met us at her apartment and went over everything. She provided us with a list of "must see/go/do" as well as names of local markets, etc. Her apartment is located in a very eclectic neighborhood. It's got everything we needed for our stay and more (a bottle of wine waiting for us was a nice touch). It's clean, airy, cozy and located within walking distance to the river, Rua Santa Catarina and other attractions. We highly recommend Silvia's apartment.

We loved Silvia's place. It was so clean and so comfortable! It was close to restaurants, shops, super markets and more.  We felt like we were in the heart of Porto and the metro was only a one minute walk away and it was really easy and straight forward to get from the airport to Silvia's place. Silvia was extremely kind, great communication. She was flexible and easy going. It was everything we hoped for and more! Thanks again!

The flat is very comfortable and it is in very good location-close to the historic center of Porto and to the metro station.  We really loved it. Silvia is very nice and kind person, who helped us a lot.

O apartamento encontra-se em óptimas condições, super limpo, com tudo o que está descrito no anúncio e muito bem localizado. E a Silvia é sem duvida um amor de pessoa sempre pronta a ajudar! Recomendo a 100% o Refúgio de boas vindas! :)
Excellent apartmen and very good location. Silvia is very friendly and helpfully. I would go back now! Thank you!

Sylvia a été une hôte très agréable qui nous avait donné toutes les indications pour trouver précisément le logement, et elle nous attendait sur place, le Top L'appartement est petit mais très bien agencé et équipé. Il était conforme à nos attente et même plus il dégage une chaleur qu'on ne perçoit pas sur les photos. A recommander fortement

Het appartement is schoon, mooi ingericht en van alle gemakken voorzien. Prima Wifi en goede bedden. Geschikt voor 2 mensen, voor meer is het krapjes.  De plek is prima, je loopt zo de stad in, en winkels om de hoek.  Silvia is een uitstekende host, ze geeft prima uitleg, kaarten en wijntje liggen klaar, aldoor goed bereikbaar en geeft alle vertrouwen.  Ik kan eigenlijk niks te verbeteren vinden.
Recomendo sem dúvida alguma. A Sílvia é muito prestável. Localização perfeita! É possível fazer tudo a pé. 5 estrelas!

l'alloggio è molto bello, tutto nuovo e ben equipaggiato anche in cucina. posizione ottima, strada tranquilla ma vicino al centro e ai negozi. non serve la metro per spostarsi ed è comodissima con la metro arrivando dall'aeroporto. un ottimo connubio tra vari aspetti. pulizia e cortesia non mancano. brava Silvia, continua cosi :)

Het appartement van Silvia is precies zoals je ziet op de foto's. Niet onwijs groot, maar ruim genoeg voor een heerlijk verblijf in Porto. Het huis is van alle gemakken voorzien en super schoon. De bedden liggen goed!
De locatie is top. Heel eenvoudig te bereiken vanaf het vliegveld en alle bezienswaardigheden op loopafstand. De communicatie met Silvia verloopt heel prettig. Ik zou deze accommodatie zeker aanraden!

Excelente anfitriona, nos dio mucha información no sólo para conocer Oporto, si no también los alrededores. Siempre estuvo al pendiente y la comunicación con ella fue eficiente en todo momento. The flat is very clean and well-equiped, plus it is in a quiet area of the city, close to many restaurants and cute little breakfast places. The historic centre is accessible by foot. Silvia and her friend Mariana have been very welcoming, we'd love to come again!

Silvia's Wohnung ist toll gelegen: ein netter Becker, supermarket, empfehlenswerte Restaurant's und viele  Sehenswürdigkeiten - alles fußläufig sehr gut erreichbar. Die U- Bahn Haltestelle nur 4 min zu Fuss  entfernt. Wir bekamen gute Sightseeing-Tipps  and Silvia war immer sehr gut für  uns  telefonisch erreichbar.Die Wohnung war schön hell und suß eingerichtet. Vielen Dank Silvia!

Silvia nos deu muita atenção antes da chegada e durante a estadia.
O apartamento estava extremamente limpo.
É novo, bem equipado, espaçoso. Perfeito para um casal!
O apartamento é bem localizado, fizemos muita coisa a pé.
No quarto, dá para fechar a veneziana e deixar bem escuro. Fora que o vidro é duplo e não deixa entrar nenhum som no apartamento. 
Enfim, ótimo custo benefício. Voltaremos com certeza!

Жильё очень понравилось, удобное расположение - центр, метро, вокзал, магазины близко. Квартира чистая, уютная, есть всё необходимое и даже больше того. Единственное - вместо обычного чайника была кофеварка, но мы приспособились. Очень рекомендуем (Website hidden by Airbnb) Юля, Алёна

appartement irréprochable, nous avons été reçu agréablement par l'amie de Silvia. Bel emplacement pas loin du centre. La ville de porto est a voir, les gens de porto sont  accueillant.
Nous reviendrons au Portugal .

A localização é muito boa. Apartamento tem todos os utensílios de cozinha e para a casa. Parece que você esta na sua própria casa. Tudo muito limpo . Sempre que precisei de alguma informação a anfitriã respondeu imediatamente,  isso me ajudou muito.
Apartmant is just few minutes from centar of town. Silvia was excellent host and the apartment was clean and beautiful. I would strongly reccommend Silvia’s accomondation.

We werden warm welkom geheten. Heerlijk om zelf een geheel appartement ter beschikking te hebben, woonkamer met open keuken, slaapkamer, badkamer.  De locatie is op korte loopafstand metro en leuke restaurants en loopafstand oude stad .  Erg aan te bevelen.

Super lugar para disfrutar Porto,  cerca de centro. 

Todos tipo de comercios cerca,  super comunicacion con Silvia.

El apartamento de Silvia es un verdadero "nido de amor". Todo está puesto y equipado como para quedarse a vivir en Oporto. Gracias Silvia por todo. Mi recomendación para este este lugar es de 11 puntos sobre 10. Nuevamente gracias y quoenes quoeran conocer Oporto no sólo deben sino que pueden alojarse en este "nido de amor". Gracias por todas tus atenciones Silvia.  Besos de los argentinos Silvia y Carlos
Silvia's flat is very tidy, comfortable and well situated. Our stay was incredible thanks to her attention and hospitality. If some day we return to Porto we will borrow her flat again for sure.

Останавливались в мае 2018. Отличная квартира. Современный ремонт, идеальная чистота, все необходимое для проживания в наличии. Квартира расположена в центральной части Порту. Все достопримечательности в пешеходной доступности. Сильвия замечательная и гостипреимная хозяйка.
Мы своим выбором не разочарованы. Замечательный город, Замечательная квартира. Рекомендуем....
sem dúvida foi o melhor apartamento que ficamos, era limpo, lindo, e tinha tudo, ficava perto do Métro, e de comércio, dava para fazer tudo a pé e ainda era silêncioso

The apartment is clean and cosy. Suits the needs of 2 people. We had everything that we needed for our 4 night stay. It’s a 10-15 minute walk from the central parts of Porto, however very close to public transport, and very easy to get to the airport. We were greeted very warmly by Mariana and Silvia who gave us lots of advice about Porto.
Please note, even though it didn’t affect us and we never felt unsafe, there are a couple of active sex workers operating in at the end of the street all day. However, we loved our stay. Thank you!! :)

Very nice apartment, perfect to visit Porto. 
Silvia took care of us perfectly I would recommend it to everyone.

Wir hatten als 3-köpfige Familie (14-jährige Tochter) einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in Silvia Appartment. Die kleine Wohnung ist super top eingerichtet, sehr gut durchdacht, viele clevere Details, sehr sauber. Das Appartment ist noch schöner als auf den Bildern. Zur Straße hin sind zwei Fenster hintereinander, so dass man nachts trotz Straßengeräuschen gut schlafen kann. Beide Zimmer sind klimatisiert. Die Wohnung ist einfach schön und stilvoll eingerichtet.

Silvia ist eine sehr freundliche und herzliche Gastgeberin, sie hat uns sehr gut mit allen Infos versorgt, sowohl im Vorfeld wie auch vor Ort. Die Kommunikation war super.

Das Appartment hatte eine sehr gute zentrale Lage, um Porto zu Fuss zu erkunden, in 3 Minuten ist man an der Metro. Unweit der Wohnung gibt es Supermarkt, Gemüsehändler, Bäckerei, Cafés und Restaurants.

Eine bedingungslose Empfehlung unsererseits! Und einen herzlichen Dank an Silvia!

Silvia ist eine super Gastgeberin, sie antwortet sehr schnell auf Nachrichten und gibt hervorragende Tipps wie man zum Appartement  kommt und was ,an in Porto unternehmen kann. Wir wurden herzlich empfangen in einer blitzsauberen Wohnung, die mit allem ausgestattet ist. Es hat uns nichts gefehlt, wir waren vielmehr überrascht an was Silvia alles gedacht hat ( Regenschirm, Nähset, Einkaufstrolley,....). Das Appartement liegt nah an vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten die wir bequemem zu Fuß erreichen konnten. Und die elektrischen Jalousien haben gut abgedunkelt . In der Nähe sind zwei Supermärkte und viele Restaurants, dennoch ist es ruhig. Vielen Dank Silvia für diesen tollen Urlaub wir werden sicherlich wieder kommen

Die Wohnung liegt klasse, alles ist fußläufig zu erreichen. Der Bäcker ist direkt um die Ecke, ebenso die Metro. Sylvia hat viele gute Tipps und ist super freundlich. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank, Sylvia.

tivemos uma surpresa ao ficar alguns dias no apartamento da sílvia.
o imóvel é recém reformado,bem equipado e localização excelente.
o único problema é que você não vai mais querer ir embora.
o porto foi uma das cidades mais lindas que tive oportunidade de conhecer,
e olha que já viajei muito nesse mundão de deus.
a Silvia é super simpática e atenciosa .amamos tudo.
Un accueil très chaleureux, d'excellents conseils de A à Z, et un appartement très fonctionnel et agréable. Silvia fait tout pour que l'on passe un bon séjour. En bref: absolument rien à redire!

el departamento es muy bonito, funcional y céntrico, tiene lo necesario para pasarla muy bien, nosotros que desayunabamos y cenamos en el, tiene todo lo necesario para cocinar. muy agradable. Silvia muy atenta

Wir verbrachten 3 Tage in Silvias gemütlich kleiner Wohnung. Die Lage ist in Mitten der Altstadt und man erreicht alles gut zu Fuß. Das Appartement ist sehr gut ausgestattet und sehr sauber. Silvia war super nett, hat uns wertvolle Tipps gegeben und konnte uns bei allem weiterhelfen. Auch ein früherer Check in war möglich. Wir können die Unterkunft sehr weiterempfehlen!

Silvia is a wonderful host! She was very Quick to answer to our messages. She took the Time to welcome us and  gave us a lot of precious advices to visit Porto. The apartment is very clean and Well located just near the Subway. Thanks again Silvia !
Une hôtesse remarquable par sa gentillesse et sa disponibilité, sans oublier les attentions et surtout l'appartement super équipé, très bien situé, et très propre, je garde l'adresse pour mes amis

Silvia bolig er skinnende ren og ligger super centralt i forhold til den gamle bydel. Silvia selv er meget imødekommende og hjælpsom og gav os rigtig gode input til, hvad vi kunne gøre de 2 dage, vi var her. Kan klart anbefales!
Cozy, clean and convenient appartment near the old city.

Ultra propre, au coeur du vieux Porto, on s'est senti comme chez soi. Sylvana la co-host de Sylvia, nous a guidé avec gentillesse pour le stationnement et les points d'intérets. Merci encore et reviendriont sans hésiter.
Séjour & accueil parfait !

Friendly host and the place is clean and comfortable. We got everything we need!
If I come to Porto again, I will choice here!
超级舒服 干净的屋子 女主人特别热情 绝佳的体验

Bardzo dobra lokalizacja, blisko metro, supermarket, restauracje i główne atrakcje miasta. Mieszkanie czyste, w pełni wyposażone (m. in. garnki, kubki, talerze, sztućce, przyprawy, herbata, suszarka do włosów, klimatyzacja) zgodne z opisem i zdjęciami; wrażenia bardzo dobre. Silvia była bardzo pomocna i uprzejma. Pobyt w jej mieszkaniu był przyjemnością. Serdecznie polecam! I highly recommend this place and the host!

Aconselho o espaço da Sílvia a todos os viajantes, pelo seu conforto, limpeza, organização e comodidade, ideal para passar umas excelentes férias ou apenas  uns dias. Fica a 2mn do metro que nos leva a qualquer lugar. Fica a 10mn a pé do centro da cidade e onde não falta nada. E por fim a anfitriã Sílvia é de uma simpatia, atenciosa e cuidadosa com os viajantes. O que acabei de descrever corresponde exatamente ao anúncio apresentado no Airbnb.
Silvia is an excellent host and the property offers everything necessary to make Porto an unforgettable experience. Can't wait to return!

Silvia is an incredible host. She waited for us very late in the evening, taking time to explain how to live in the appartement ans showing us places to visit in the town.
She was very communicative ans compréhensive.
Thanks for everything Silvia.
We recommend the place for sure.
Apartamento aconchegante, limpo e organizado. A localização é boa, fomos a vários lugares a pé ... porém caminhamos muito. Valeu muito ficar nessa acomodação, certamente ficaria de novo.

Appartement très bien localisé et très propre.
Bonnes commodités.
Disponibilité de Silvia pour répondre à toutes nos questions.
Fortement recommandé sans hésitation.

Nous avons apprécié notre séjour à Porto ainsi que le logement bien placé, propre et moderne. Silvia est réactive. Nous avons été accueillis par une  amie qui a été agréable et soucieuse de nous donner des conseils.
Appartamento molto pulito. La proprietaria di casa è stata molto gentile per averci aspettate fino alle 23:30 per il check-in, molto disponili per le informazioni sul posto.
Super feliz com a hospedagem! Silvia foi extremamente atenciosa. Recomendo muito!!!!

In the apartment everything is thought out to the smallest detail. The hostess met a bottle of wine and provided information about the sights of Porto. The apartments are very close to the metro and the main sights. Next time we will definitely stay in this apartment. Thank you very much Silvia :)

Great place and wonderful hosts.The location is great and close by to everything you need. Sparkling clean and stylish you have everything you need. Silvia is a great host she gave us plenty of tips that helped us enjoy our stay in Porto. Definitely recommend staying at her place.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, so dass man die Innenstadt auch gut zu Fuss aufsuchen kann. Für die "fußfaulen" ist eine Metro-Station aber auch direkt um die Ecke. Das Apartment ist schön und modern eingerichtet und ist für einen Städtetrip in Porto optimal. 
Silvia ist eine super Gastgeberin, die sehr darauf bedacht ist, dass es Ihren Gästen gut geht. 
Ich werde bestimmt wieder kommen.

Нас встретила дочь Сильвии, Марианна. Очень милая девушка. Рассказала нам все о квартире и окресностях города. Квартира замечательная, чистая, уютная. Все продумано до мелочей. Нас даже ждал приятный сюрприз от хозяйки: бутылка вина и воды. Всем рекомендуем эти апартаменты. Нам все очень понравилось.
Recomendo este apartamento para a estada no Porto por qualquer período. A hostess é extremamente educada e se mostra sempre disponível.
Absolut empfehlenswert.
Foi muito agradável e tinha tudo o que era preciso.

Jesteśmy z rodziną drugi raz u Silvi , mieszkanie super czyste, dobry kontakt, lokalizacja, wskazówki, troska o gości polecam 
urlop czy weekend w Porto tylko u Silvi

name: Cosy rooms close to the metro and the River
summary: Welcome to your little pied-à-terre, let you enjoy the beauty of Montreal for a night or even a week. You are looking for rooms VERY well located, clean, close to the subway ? You found! Bike path and rest guaranteed :) 2 rooms closed with 1 queen bed in each of them :)
space: You will have two large rooms available for you with huge closet ! The living room has a tv and games (video and board) available for you Kitchen and bathroom are brand new as the entire appartement :)
description: Welcome to your little pied-à-terre, let you enjoy the beauty of Montreal for a night or even a week. You are looking for rooms VERY well located, clean, close to the subway ? You found! Bike path and rest guaranteed :) 2 rooms closed with 1 queen bed in each of them :)
neighborhood_overview: The place is so close to the water and 15 km bike path . This is a calm neighborhood with a 15 min metro ride to get downtown . Really convenient with nice restaurants and terrasses
notes: If you have any questions , please , ask and we ll be happy to help
transit: We recommend to park the car in the street and do everything by metro (8min walk- 15 min metro to get downtown)- best way to visit the city
access: Guests have access to all spaces except our room which let you more than 950 sq feet :) Living room , rooms , laundry room, balcony, kitchen , bathroom
interaction: We are always available to talk and give more information if needed . Knowing usually how long you stay , we give ideas of best places to eat/ visit We provide à metro map you can keep and write on, in addition with soap, shampoo , conditioner and towels ! We love talking to guest but stay aside when wanted

host.host_about:
Hi everyone, 

We are a couple of French people, living in Montreal for now more than two years. I am an assistant manager in a clothing store and Denis is an IT/electronic engineer.

We are clean, very lively, open minded and we like to meet new people from all over the world to share our experiences :)

Hope to see you soon !

reviews.comments: It was a very nice and warm stay. Alexia gave me detailed instruction in advance of my arrival. Denis welcomed me with a lot of information on the region. The location is very convenient pretty close to the River with a quite park and beautiful view. Room is cozy, clean with a lovely bookcase and quite a few French books to choose from. Overall a great stay. Alexia was so nice to arrange a pick up as I left the phone charger in the room. Really lovely hosts highly recommend!!

Alexia and Denis were very helpful from the beginning. Their house is located close to Verdun Metro and Wellington street so, eateries and shops are very close. The waterfront is about 4 blocks away and you can have a relaxing walk every evening. I wish I could have socialized more with Alexia and Denis. The stay was wonderful and I would recommend their place to my friends.

Alexia & Denis are awesome !  They made our Montreal trip very enjoyable. Denis gave all the travel information we need when we arrived. This location is very close to the subway station and BIXI, so we did not have to drive the car and had no trouble to get around the city. Highly recommended ~
Great hosts who were very accommodating and kept in touch. Nice apartment with on street parking and great local shops.
Very nice hosts. Denis gave us plenty of recommendations not only for our stay at their place but for our trip. The two rooms are spacious and beds quite comfortable. thanks for hosting us!

Dennis met us outside  when we arrived. He and his wife were very helpful in telling us the best places to eat, check out and visit, and also in helping us find our way around. They even got us a metro map to help us maneuver the city.  They provided toiletries and also allowed us to do a load of laundry even though that wasn't in the description.  The apartment was very clean  and comfortable. The apartment is about a half mile from the nearest subway station but the walk is very beautiful and filled with delicious restaurants and cafés. A must stay.
Very nice host! Thank you! We had a great time in your place.

Denis was very kind and helpful with everything! He made us feel right at home, and helped make us an itinerary for our stay in Montreal. The neighborhood was nice and quiet, and the house was about 10 blocks away from the metro station.
Alexia et Denis nous ont très bien accueilli. La chambre correspond bien aux photos et le quartier est sympa. Denis nous a bien conseillé pour la suite de notre séjour. Une adresse que je recommande.

Alexia et Denis sont très accueillant, nous avons passé une très bonne soirée! Merci à vous!
Je recommande!
The host canceled this reservation 60 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
A spotless apartment, and you barely know the hosts are there. There is only one bathroom, which we all shared. But there was never any issue.

It was my 3rd time staying at Alexia&Denis' place and they're not only hosts but truly good friends that you want to make. They're friendly and you'll never get bored when u have a conversation with them. They provide lots of suggestions and advice if you don't know where to go. The bedroom is nice and clean and backyard is awesome. We had a great supper time with A&D in their backyard and we made BBQ! The apartment is located near the water and park is beautiful. The area is quiet and neighborhood is pretty nice. It's 10 mins away from Metro(subway) by feet and we didn't have any hard time traveling around downtown by taking the train. I can't wait to see them again next time!

L'appartement est dans un quartier verdoyant et tres reposant. Les 2 chambres sont grandes et les lits confortables.  Alexia nous a accueilli et nous a fait sentir tres a l'aise chez elle. Elle a été tres accomodante pour l'heure d'arrivée et de départ et nous a même aidé à trouver un endroit pour imprimer nos billets. Je recommande!

Alexia and Denis were very accommodating and easygoing hosts - I really could not have asked for better representatives of Montreal! We had gone into the city not really knowing what to do, and Denis sat with us for a good 15 minutes describing in detail some of his favorite places and the best times to go. Both Alexia and Denis were fluent in English and French, and we would engage in lively discussions on anything from politics to vegetarian recipes to Mario Kart (be warned: Alexia is prepared to defend her championship title on the last one!) On the flip side, they are also perfectly fine giving you space whenever you wish to rest or simply avoid social interaction.
As for the listing itself, parking was readily available on the street and the location was an easy 10 minute walk to the nearest subway station. Bathroom and bedrooms were clean, and the wifi connection was good. The apartment is in a quiet residential neighborhood with no traffic noise, and there are no pets in case any guests might have allergies. I will definitely be recommending this listing to any friends or family visiting Montreal!
Loved the stay ! Will definitely recommend this place. The hosts are extremely friendly. They guided us to local favorites. Will visit them again !
Great value; Denis was a very helpful host! Exactly what you need for a short getaway.

Nice location. Good cafe nearby  called st.lo. bagels. Keep in mind check-in for first say around 6pm. Stay the next day then out by 9am the next  day.  That's two days accommodation which I thought was a bit inconvenient. Beds are fairly hard futon style. My travel buddy got very little sleep in other room. Host helpful with places of interest. Has recently installed new shower. Woken up by noisy traffic both days as close to busy road. Honest review . Nice hosts but probably look for something more comfortable next time. If you're looking for something on a budget this would be a good option.
Nice and quiet place!  Alexia and Denis are very friendly. We stay for one night.
Great place to stay

Séjour très agréable chez Alexia et Denis. Les chambres sont spacieuses et propres, tout comme l'appartement qui est également bien équipé.
Nos hôtes étaient disponibles pour nous donner des conseils même si nous ne les avons pas beaucoup vus car ils travaillaient beaucoup. Du coup, nous avions l'appartement pour nous la plupart du temps.

L'appartement se situe à 10-15 min de la station de métro Verdun mais il y a un arrêt de bus pratiquement au pied de l'immeuble pour s'y rendre.

Le quartier est calme et on y trouve tout ce qu'il faut pour se restaurer ou faire des courses.

Merci encore pour votre accueil à tous les 2! Au plaisir !
Denis and Alexia were very hospitable while I, my wife, and two kids stayed with them. Nice location, close to metro station. Recommended!

Alexia and Denis were great hosts. It was seamless experience finding the place, parking out front and getting settled in. They were very friendly and happy to help suggest things to do while we were on vacation. Would stay here again next time!
Very nice and friendly couple! Their place is very welcoming.
Alexia and Denis were gracious hosts and we'd definitely stay with them again!

Alexia and Denis were wonderful hosts and extremely helpful with the metro, things to do, and general information. There home was very clean, neat, and a great choice for our stay. Would book with them in the future, highly recommend!

Nous avons eu un super accueil et de bons conseils et suggestions pour notre séjour. Alexia & Denis ont été très sympas et pas du tout compliqués. On s'est sentis très à l'aise! Quartier tranquille et très bien situé. Merci!

Alexia and Denis were great hosts. Good communication before arrival. They are extremely helpful with a lot of information. The house was very clean and neat. Highly recommended and definitely to stay there again.

Alexia et Denis nous ont beaucoup attendus, nous venions de loin en voiture et avions pris du retard. Ils se sont montrés d'une gentillesse rare et très accommodants. Un seul petit détail, le lit dans lequel nous avons dormi était un peu dur pour nous, je conseillerais à des adultes de dormir dans la chambre au paysage grec où, d'après notre fils, le lit était confortable. Les enfants s'accommoderaient plus facilement d'un lit plus dur. Sinon, l'appart est très agréable et bien situé très près du fleuve et de jolis parcs. Nous recommandons chaudement ces hôtes.

Unser Aufenthalt bei Alexia und Denis war sehr gut und wir haben uns wohlgefühlt. Beide sind sehr nett, aufgeschlossen und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung liegt ca 10 Minuten zu Fuß von der Metro entfernt, die einen in 10-15 Minuten zum Zentrum bringt. Es ist sehr ruhig, man kann problemlos auf der Straße vor dem Haus parken. Immer gerne wieder!

It was my 4th time being accommodated by Alexia and Denis(*2nd time visiting with my boyfriend). Amazing couple who you really want to get to know about and have a deep conversation with. They provided useful information about what’s going on in the city. Check in and check out are flexible. Their apartment is close to the Metro station and neighborhood is quiet. We had a fun, relaxing and enjoyable during the long weekend. Looking forward to my visit again next time! Congratulations on your wedding~ Bon voyage ❤️

Super séjour chez Denis et Alexia ! Très accueillants et souriants, ils savent vous mettre à l'aise et sont disponibles dès que nous avons besoin d'aide ou de conseils. Nous nous sommes sentis un peu comme chez nous. L'appartement et les chambres sont spacieux et très propres, il y a tout ce qu'il faut pour passer un bon séjour. Le métro vert est à 10 min à pieds (trajet d'environ 10 min jusqu'à l'hypercentre de Montréal), et des stations de Bixi à proximité de l'appartement. Le quartier de Verdun est très mignon, et ne manquez pas la rue Wellington et la baignade dans le fleuve du Saint-Laurent à proximité ;).

Denis was very nice. We found the place easily under Denis's instructions. During the stay, I enjoyed several free talks with Denis. It is surprising to find he is an engineer and has the same background as us.

Great hosts, fantastic communication. Only thing missing was AC or a fan so the room got very hot with no air flow when it was over 90 during the day. No fault of the host, but perhaps a fan would be good. Very friendly and kind hosts who helped when we had a flat tire and offered to help find a shop to fix it. Would recommend if you need a close place to everything and kind people to chat with!

My first time using air b&b and also first time in Montreal; Alexia and Denis made it a great experience. They have a very clean apartment and are close to the Metro. The recommendations and map were appreciated! Thanks very much :)
Great hosts!

Nice quiet neighbourhood, parking available on street (better practice your parallel parking skills!), nice big rooms, clean and incredibly accommodating hosts. Me and two teammates stayed over a weekend and barely saw the hosts until the last day we were packing, but they were always a quick message away. Loved staying here.

Our stay with Alexia and Denis was better than expected. We interacted with Denis for the most and he was super friendly and always ready to give any advice on what to visit and where to go (the breakfast advice was awesome). Also, our group of four was super impressed with how clean the house was. five star
It was a good stay. We liked how quiet the neighbourhood was, and good location to everything.

name: 3bd/2ba Valley House Near Kaimuki, Upstairs
summary: Brand New construction, in valley neighborhood off of Kaimuki 10th Ave.  Surrounded by lush greens and mountains, 3 bed/2 bath house built in 2015.  You have the entire upstairs of a house, with a private entrance and assigned parking.  Private washer/dryer in unit.  Only 10 min drive to Waikiki.  If you have a big family I also have the downstairs unit (2 bed/1 bath, accomodate up to 8 people) available for rent.
space: 3 bedrooms/2 bathrooms, with a large and brand new kitchen (dishwasher, large fridge, stove/oven, microwave, pots/pans, coffee maker, blender, toaster, rice cooker, plates/utensils, glasswares, everything you would expect in a house).  Two rooms have work desk, and another work desk in the living room, providing a good place to put your laptops.  We have cable and fast wifi there.  The unit comes with assigned parking (fits 1 -2 cars). This brand new house is a country oasis away from the city with easy access to Waikiki and Honolulu downtown (10 min drive to Waikiki, 15 min drive to downtown).  The house is off of 10th Ave in Palolo neighborhood.  10th Ave in Kaimuki is a main street with great local restaurants, shops, bars and parks. Portable crib (pack n play type) available upon request (please request in advance).

If you have a large family or family reunion, I have both upstairs unit (3bed/2bath) and downstairs unit (2bed/1bath) of this house available for rent.    Because of how the house has two units, you may hear the noise, footsteps or feel the presence of the people in the other unit. If you need complete silence and privacy, this house may not be for you. A colony of wild chickens live in the neighborhood, and they can make noise in the morning.  Please do not park across the street where "No Parking" signs are, or you may get parking tickets. Do not use or block the driveway going up on the left side of the house as this belongs to a different property owner. This property is in a tropical environment, any food you leave out will attract ants. We provide ant sprays and traps upon request. If this bothers you, this unit may not be right for you.
transit: There are bus lines that runs on 10th ave in Palolo/Kaimuki, but having a car is recommended for this location.
access: You have your own assigned parking to park your car with private entrance to your unit.  You have your own washer/dryer in this unit. There is another unit downstairs (2bed/1bath) which is similar to this unit, also available for rent.
interaction: The owners live about 5 min away in the neighborhood so we are available to answer your questions or help in any way.  Texting is the best way to reach us, but please feel free to call.

reviews.comments: This beautiful home was beyond our expectations and perfect for our family stay. The neighborhood was quiet and close to Honolulu and Waikiki. Thereʻs a nice breeze that flows through the whole house, but if itʻs really hot, thereʻs 2 air conditioning units in the living room and master bedroom. Thereʻs also everything you might need for your stay- even a blender and cooler for a day at the beach.

Erika was a great host! She responded to emails and texts very quickly and answered any questions I had. I let her know that we would have our 18-month son with us so she provided some toys, books, a pack n play and a small plastic tub for him. She welcomed the adults with mac nuts, coffee and wine! The house is exactly as described and photoed. The only thing missing was a washer dryer but there's a laundromat right down the street. We'll definitely be renting from Erika again the next time we travel. Mahalo!

This is a new house, well equipped in a fantastic location. We really enjoyed the great views, the constant refreshing breeze up here--- so different from downtown and Waikiki. There are many lovely walks--- up to a massive Korean temple and a wild trail to a volcanic crater. Down at the bottom of the hill is one of Hawaii's best bakeries, and a number of very good restaurants.
Quiet and convenient house for those looking for a 3 bedroom accommodation. All comforts available.
Immaculate Space. Perfect Location. Prompt Response to question. AAA+
Enjoyed our stay had everything we needed to help us get the most from our holiday

A gorgeous house with everything you could need! Very clean! Fully stocked kitchen including many small appliances such as blender and toaster. Lots of dishes and utensils. Even a dishwasher and washer and dryer and beach towels! We were thoroughly impressed with both the house and Erika. Her communication was always very prompt and she took care of everything we asked. We could not be more pleased.  Location worked well for us. An easy drive to Waikiki and only 20 minutes to Hickham AFB in non-traffic times. Highly recommend!

The house was absolutely amazing. It was remarkably clean and extremely spacious. It's in a great location, very accessible to everything that the island has to offer.  I really enjoyed having a private garage to park our rental car. It allowed us to leave items in the vehicle without having to worry about their safety.  I was absolutely amazed with how gigantic the house was. We were provided with everything a family could need for a long extended stay. We will definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay. The unit was nice, comfortable and clean.  The kitchen was well-equipped.  It even had a blender.  Check-in and check-out went very smoothly.  Our host, Erika was very accommodating and promptly replied to any questions we had.

Our stay was wonderful! Erica was great with communication, check in & out was truly effortless. The house was spacious, very clean & well equipped with everything you need for a long or short stay. The washer/dryer was awesome to have! Erica provided plenty of laundry soap & dryer sheets! All rooms have an AC unit if needed. Easy access to Waikiki & highways. Great mountain views. Great option for a large group! Thank u Erica!

This is my second time at erikas! But this time a different unit from where I stayed previously. Everything is as listed and communication was even better. Quick to respond and very welcoming with really easy check in and check out process. Thanks again Erika!
Nice place. Very clean and spacious. Located within a short distance to Waikiki
Erika was an amazing host. Easily accessible and very accommodating. Would definitely recommend.
You must stay here, it is comfortable and stylish and has everything you could need to enjoy a great stay.

Erica is a wonderful host and her place is great for large groups or families. I had two little kids with me and she accommodated all our requests. She even bought us breakfast items and would not let me pay for it.  I highly recommend staying at her place! A++++++

A lovely place! We loved the location - within 15 - 20 minutes of most places we wanted to go! The apartment was very clean and in great shape. We appreciated the guide books (especially “Oahu Revealed”) and the current information provided. Erika responded quickly to emails and clearly communicated all the information needed about WiFi, parking, etc.
Our party of 6 was very comfortable in the space. I liked that there were empty hangers available in the closets and power charging strips available. 
We appreciated the air conditioners, but as others have mentioned the main living space has nice windows and we rarely turned it on. My husband and I did use the “fan only” feature on low during the night, which worked well to cover the sound of some very early roosters.
We walked to the Mu-Ryang-Sa temple a few times, which is a little less than a mile and worth a visit. You can also drive up to it.
This was a great place to stay and I definitely recommend it!
it was a great experience. Erika helped us a lot. the house is not too far to the beach. And it provided nearly everything we need. I just love it.
Very clean and cute. The host was quick to respond and answered questions. Left good “need to know” details for your stay at the house
I recommend this place..
This house is in a really good location for exploring the island. Very clean and small touches that help you feel comfortable. Would love to come back

Amazing spot, even better than it looks.  It's a bit far from most things, around a $20 uber so really not bad at all, also don't trust the weather, the clouds hit the mountains so it seems like it's always drizzling but it'll be completely perfect in Waikiki.
Staying here brought me back to my childhood when life in Oahu was a lot simpler and waking up to the sounds of nature brought back so many wonderful memories.
This is the second summer we have spent at Erika’s house in Palolo valley, and we love it. Super clean, great location, and thoughtful upgrades. AC in all the rooms, and now has a washer and dryer.
Great place to stay and good location.

This place is Wonderful for a large group or Family. Very well furnished and attention to detail is great. Bath supplies, kitchen eating and cookware are all covered. Erika is a nice host, quick to respond and friendly. Even little details like a step in the bathroom so little ones can use the sink are there. Very thoughtful! Mahalo nui loa!
Great place. There was everything there that we needed. The air conditioners were a bit noisy, but it's better than not using it. Good location and parking was great.

Staying at Erika's place was awesome.  She provided so many extra amenities and her home is pristine.  It is centrally located to all the sites and restaurants. I haven't had my family all in one place, at one time and all very comfortable.  
All the comforts of home away from home.  
Erika is super organized, gave great instructions and answered any questions very promptly.
We highly recommend staying at Erika's place.

The house was close to everything, super clean, and had everything we needed to make for a great vacation. (boogie board, coolers, beach umbrella, as well as everything we needed for laundry) We would love to stay here again the next time we visit Oahu!

Erika made my first Airbnb stay an easy breezy experience. She responded super quickly to all my inquiries and requests, such as a pack n play and baby tub for my daughter, and was very understanding when we had a miscommunication involving one of our guests (which was totally my fault). 

My husband initially wanted to stay with another host, but ultimately let me pick, which was the right choice. Erika’s house has a dishwasher, in-unit washer/dryer, and TWO free parking spots, amenities which the other house did not have. She provided everything needed for a comfortable 10-night stay. Literally the only thing we had to buy was toothpaste and baby wash!

We come back to Hawaii almost yearly, but doubt we’ll need such a big house soon. Would love to be Erika’s guest again. Maybe next time we’ll check out the smaller downstairs unit. Mahalo, Erika!
Great location,  perfect amenities

O apartamento da Marcela,é exatamente como está nas fotosporém não tem cofre,como descrito,não haviam lenções suficientes nem cobertores para 3 pessoas e uma das camas(solteiro)estava quebrada.A Marcela não nos recebeu,conforme combinado(estava viajando) e quando telefonei para ela,ao chegar no aeroporto,,como combinado,fui atendida por outra pessoa que me falou que ela havia viajado.O check-in que deveria ser as 09:00hs,só poderia ser feito as 11hs porque a pessoa que lá estava hospedada resolveu alongar sua estadia,acho que isso foi uma falha,que não deveria ter acontecido.Ficamos muito inseguras também porque a portaria do predio estava em reforma,devido a um onibus que entrou,por acidente nela,e a frente do predio estava fechada com compensados de madeira,e isso aconteceu 3 meses antes de nós alugarmos o apartamento,acho que nos devia ter sido colocada tal questão,antecipadamente,para que decidissimos se queriamos ou não alugar o apartamento,com aquelas condições de segurança.A localização do apartamento é muito boa,os porteiros são muito educados e gentis,mas não há cameras de segurança,como nos foi dito que havia,sugerí que fosse colocada uma trava de segurança extra na porta de entrada do apartamento,pois acho isso importante para o (Website hidden by Airbnb) check-out Marcela foi ao apartamento e ela é muito educada e pediu desculpas,mas no check-in,falamos com ela apenas por telefone,e não gostei de seu atendimento.Não conseguimos conectar a internet também...enfim,acredito que Marcela tem um ótimo lugar para oferecer,mas talvez por falta de experiencia,nossa estadia foi bem conturbada,infelizmente...desejo sorte a ela e se corrigir as questões acima citadas para que não mais aconteça com outros hospedes...recomendo o local.

The apartment felt more like a room in a budget hotel than an apartment with character. It looks like it has been cheaply and hastily furnished for Airbnb use with the bare minimum and nobody ever lived or planned to live there.
On arrival, the host was not there. The keys were left with the doorman who did not speak English. Luckily we had a friend with us who spoke Portuguese, otherwise it could have been quite a problem.
The shower is absolutely terrible. It's one of those flimsy electrical showers that warm up water as it flows through. Therefore, we had to choose between proper water flow or warm water, both was not an option. We went for the middle and ended up having showers with a pathetic, weak lukewarm stream of water. Also no hot water in the bathroom sink. The air conditioning made so much noise that the neighbors complained and warned us that it might catch fire (!).
There were absolutely no essentials in the apartment, except 3 small bars of soap. There was only 1 electrical outlet near the bed, so not exactly a "laptop friendly workspace" either (we had to take turns using the outlet!).
On the plus side, the location is indeed fantastic. It's right in the heart of Ipanema, with tons of nice shops and restaurants around.  The beach is only a 5 minute walk away. It also feels very safe, even very late at night. 
We would recommend this place to travellers who want a great location but don't plan on spending much time in the apartment (or showering!).
