description: Ap4 is  located at Mouzinho da Silveira Street, in downtown, and in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Center. This apartment is on the 2th floor  and it's an apartment full of light. For privacy windows don't allow outside visibility. It has 1 bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, a dining area and a cozy living room. whith TV cable and free wi-fi. São Bento's Train Station and the Subway are just a 2 minute walk away You can see and choose  other apartments "cliking" on myprofile page. The apartment has 1 bedroom with a double bed of 140, 1 bathroom,  a kitchen, a dining area and a cozy living room with a confortable seat that can becomes a double  bed of 140. The full bathroom is equipped with hair dryer and complimentary toiletries. The building where the apartment is located , belongs to the 19th century but was completely rebuilt  in July 2016.  The building has a common laundry room with washing machines and dryers that can be used for a modest sum . Personal check-in is done till 8pm
neighborhood_overview: With a privileged location, you can visit the old city on foot , without any means of transport .In Mouzinho da Silveira Street you can find diversified traditional stores  and many handicraft products and plenty of restaurants. A few minutes walk , you will find : Aliados avenue,  Ribeira, Arts district,   Clérigos tower, the Porto Cathedral , Lello bookstore, Stock exchange palace, S. Francisco Church and others. The property is 300 meters from Rua Galerias de Paris , a lively spot for nightlife with numerous bars and restaurants.  Ribeira is one of the most vibrant place in the city,It is located 200 meters from the apartement. Crossing  the bridge you can visit the famous wine cellars of Porto where wine tasting and tours are available.
notes: The building did not have an elevator , so it is not advised to reduced mobility persons. The apartment has large windows that let in plenty of light, but without visibility to the outside.
transit: São Bento's Train Station and the Subway Station with a direct connection to the airport (São Bento – yellow line) are just a 2 minute walk away. Starting from the station of São Bento you can visit several bordering cities of Porto, very charming like as: Braga , Guimaraes, Aveiro , etc.
access: The building where the apartment is located , belongs to the 19th century but was completely rebuilt  in July 2016.  The building has a common laundry room with washing machines and dryers that can be used for a modest sum . Personal check-in is done till 8pm. After that hour you can access the apartment by an access code that we will provide you. We can provide with extra-cost a personalized transfer from the airport to the apartment.
interaction: Sheets and towels are available at no additional cost The apartments have fully equipped kitchens , but if you prefer to eat out and taste the local cuisine , there are many dining options within walking distance ,from traditional restaurants to ones with Michelin stars.

Todo perfecto

The appartment is all renovated so it is very clean, functional and above all, very well located in the historical center. I recommend this place without any doubt!
Thanks again!

This appartment was perfect : clean, very well located (very centered in porto) and spacious. For sure if I come back to Porto, I'll take the same.

Super appartment.

The apartment is great, excellent location and everything is brand new !
Pedro checked us in, he was very kind, told us everything we needed to know, and we even had some Porto wine at our arrival.

Would definitely recommend !
This is a really good place to stay in Porto. Manuela's flat is very nice, well cleaned and close to the main city attractions. I'd strongly recommend it the ones visiting Porto.

Apartamento bonito y acogedor en el centro de Oporto, muy bien situado cerca de todas las atracciones de la ciudad: monumentos, barrio de la Ribera, metro, etc. Muy nuevo y limpio. Las únicas pegas: no hay ascensor ni climatización (aire acondicionado ni calefacción). Pero seguro que Manuela se encargará de acondicionarlo pronto. Es una estupenda anfitriona.

En el apartamento de Manuela y Pedro nos sentimos genial.
Una ubicación perfecta para poder llegar a todos los puntos de la ciudad de Oporto.
Manuela fue encantadora y nos esperó y nos enseñó el apartamento. Muy simpática y agradable. Las fotos corresponden con la realidad, está todo muy nuevo y limpio. 100% recomendable!

Un apartamento céntrico, limpísimo y decorado con buen gusto. Una botella de Porto te está esperando, nada más entrar. Manuela nos atendió muy amablemente en todo momento. Lo recomiendo a todo el mundo

Très bon séjour dans cet appartement parfaitement situé au centre ville. Manuela a gentillement ajouté un lit bébé pour nous et les voyageurs suivants. Pas de clim et quelques bruits dans la rue piétonne le soir, mais rien de grave. Très bon appartement.

Nous avons passé un super séjour à Porto, l'appartement est bien aménagé et est situé au cœur du quartier historique il y a donc pas besoin de voiture.
Notre hôte travail dans un magasin en bas de l'immeuble ce qui a facilité notre arrivée.

Great apartment! Ideal location in the centre of Porto: a few steps from Sao Bento station, and a few minutes' walk from Ribeira on one side, and all other main attractions on the other (Sé, Torre dos Clérigos...).
The apartment is stylish and comfortable, Manuela is a very kind host. I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Porto!

Our apartment was located in a renovated building that only contains airbnb properties. Its location is central, it is perfect to visit Porto, everything can be done on foot. 

Manuela was waiting for us on the tin store located on the ground floor. She was quite nice and offered us helpful advise on parking and local restaurants.

The apartment itself looks exactly like the pictures and it is big enough for a couple and a kid. It is modern and nicely decorated. The kitchen is basically equipped, don't expect to cook there but you have everything for breakfast (do buy/bring tea and coffee). The 
bedroom is comfortable. Though it doesn't overlook Muzinho da Silveira street, which is quite a busy, you can still hear some noise at night and in the morning evening but nothing too bothering.

We though it was a good price for money, especially as we booked it shortly before our arrival.
Very nice place, great location and kind host!

El apartamento es tal como muestra las fotos, esta muy limpio y muy céntrico. Manuela estuvo pendiente de nuestra llegada y al alojarnos nos recomendo sitios a los que ir y donde comer. Repetiriamos seguro.

Excelente localização, próxima do metro e pontos de interesse, confortável. Corresponde às fotos publicadas. Anfitriã nos ofereceu vinho do Porto na chegada, muito gentil, nos deu dicas e informações úteis.

L'appartement est très agréable : immeuble refait à neuf, appartement très fonctionnel, très propre, et super bien placé dans Porto. Manuela est très gentille et prend le temps de nous accueillir. Son magasin - situé en bas de l'immeuble - permet de laisser ses affaires le jour de l'arrivée ou du départ. Everything was as described, very clean and close to the city center.

Très agréable séjour, Manuela nous a accueilli dans ce logement, conforme à la description. A proximité de tout, métro à 2 minutes à pied. Je recommande vraiment cette ville et cet appartement. :)

This is one of the best Airbnb experiences I've ever had. My sister and I spent a beautiful weekend in Porto. We were greeted by Manuela and Pedro. They provided a great guest book full of suggestions and map that guided our entire weekend. Highly recommend!

Super voyage à Porto en partie grâce à ce super logement idéalement placé et très bien équipé ! Il y a tout ce dont on a besoin et l'accueil était très agréable 
Un grand merci !

Manuela & Pedro apartment is very cute and has a perfect position. They're so helpful and when we arrived they left us lots of advices about restaurants, place where to go after dinner and place to visit. I recommend it!

Muy buena experiencia. Muy centrico por lo que puedes ir caminando a todos los sitios, lo cual es un verdadero placer. Lo recomendaría a mis contactos
My girlfriend and I had an amazing stay in Porto and this locaton was perfect!

Genial estancia, muy buena ubicación entre la Ribeira y la estación de Sao Bento. Genial apartamento, Manuela la anfitriona hasta se molestó en ponernos una cunita para nuestro bebé. Además hay unos patés y un poco de vinho de Oporto esperando al huesped. Primera experiencia airbnb genial gracias a una increible ciudad como es Oporto y una gran estancia.
Agradeço a simpatia e disponibilidade dos anfitriões, sempre prontos a ajudar. A localização do apartamento é excelente, tem muito boas áreas, é limpo e muito confortável. Aconselho vivamente.

Nos abrió Madalena y fue muy amable, el apartamento tal y como se ve en las fotos. Buena ubicación, buena atención (nos obsequiaron con vino y pate al llegar) y estaba todo muy limpio. Lo recomiendo sin lugar a dudas

Appartement agréable et propre. Bien situé si vous voulez visiter Porto à pied. conforme à la photo, très bon accueil et aide si vous avez besoin. Un joli bouquet de fleurs et un verre de porto pour notre arrivée. très agréable. Pedro et Manuela disponible si besoin. The bottle of Porto was very good ! Thanks

L'appartement est très accueillant et idéalement situé dans le centre historique de Porto. Pedro qui nous a accueilli parle un français impeccable et nous a gentiment conseillé pour nos visites. Beautiful apartment, exactly as pictured, great location, very simple check in, Manuela was an excellent help with local suggestions for various restaurants, equiped kitchen, excellent shower! Highly recommend!

I think the best quality of this apartment is the location! It's so easy to get to from the airport. And it's a great spot for exploring the city. The apartment itself is quiet and clean. Couldn't ask for more!

La estancia ha sido perfecta. El piso es tal como se describe en las fotos y está muy bien ubicado. La comunicación con Manuela siempre muy fluida y la recepción por su parte también muy buena. Muy atenta en todo momento.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis : Manuela répond au téléphone, nous a réservé une voiture avec chauffeur pour notre trajet de l'aéroport à l'appartement.

Un très bon rapport qualité-prix pour découvrir Porto !
Possibilité de laisser vos bagages dans le magasin au pied de l'immeuble (ouvert le dimanche) le jour de votre départ afin de profiter des derniers instants l'esprit tranquille !

Manuela’s flat is great - the location is super central and we were able to walk to everything. It’s also very conveniently near metro and bus lines so getting to and from the airport was a breeze. It was so clean and cozy, and we’d definitely stay again!

My stay in Manuela's place was absolutely amazing!
The location is great and the apartment felt homey&cosy.
Also she had some good tips for places to visit, which was really helpful, especially when having only a weekend to explore.
Would love to come back one day. :))
Place was very central. Room was very neat. Madalena was very helpful with check in and explaining us what is all around. Great stay! Totally advised!

Manuela’s apartment is centrally located and close not only to the Sao Bento station but also to the main attractions of the city. We found valuable advice about the places to eat in the brochure that she has prepared for her guests. The place is sparkling clean and very comfortable!

Really clean, nice, and safe feeling place. Like someone else there are ppl doing drugs behind the place which is a bit unnerving but they can be ignored. I felt very safe in the apartment and coming and going. I would highly recommend the place.
위치좋고

Tout était parfait, propre spacieux, très bien situé pour découvrir Porto,
Accueil  très sympa , Madalena tient la boutique au rez de chaussée, une épicerie fine de conserve de poissons, c'est donc pratique.  un petit verre de Porto nous attendait dans l'appartement. Bref, nous recommandons vivement cette adresse qui est idéalement située pour visiter Porto

Great place close to train station so it was easy to take some day trips we wanted. Hosts were quick to respond to any question. The apartment was decorated with a stylish African theme which we loved. Double windows were excellent for making  very quiet nights for sleep. Beds were nice and comfy.  Would definitely stay again.

Manuela and Madalena were fantastic hosts. Their space is lovely and centrally located to a lot of the sightseeing spots in the city. Thoughtful, attentive, and always willing to offer suggestions on what to see and do, these two were great hosts.

The location is perfect: 5 minutes walking down the street from Sao Bento station, it is the very center of Porto. The apartment itself is on the 3rd floor (and make note that there is no lift). It is fully equiped with all the necessary things including hair-dryer and coffee-machine. I should also notice the bed which is remarkably comfortable. There is no washing machine in the apartment but there is a laundry in the same house (for additional cost). Also there is no air conditioning, however there are two fans which were enough for me to feel comfortable in hot days. The design of the apartment is great too. In the house there are several similar apartments which are rented by the same hosts, and on the ground floor there is a shop where the host works daily, so  it is very easy to find her if needed. She was very hospitable and told me everything about the apartment and the neighbourhood to make my stay comfortable and interesting. There was even a printed booklet with lots of useful information on the diner table along with some snacks and port wine. I had to leave very early and it was very easy to do without meeting the host: you can just go and leave the key inside the apartment. I strongly recommend the apartment and this wonderful hosts.

Fantastic apartment, spotlessly clean, in a perfect location for accessing all the sights. Luggage storage downstairs in the owners shop outside of check-in time is a nice touch. Would definitely come back.

This was a wonderful place to stay - can’t imagine a better location.  No matter what we needed - to pick up a sweater, drop off a parcel, take the train, walk to the metro for a football game, it’s all right there.  It kind of feels like all of Porto is your living room and the bedroom’s just steps away.  Manuela and Madalena were wonderful hosts, and very easy to find and communicate with.  The book of recommendations for places to eat and things to see was very helpful.  It was clean and had everything we needed - a wonderful place to stay!

The location is perfect, near everything! Manuela was very attentious and we were able to leave our bags after check-out. We always ate outside so can’t comment on the kitchen but seemed well-equipped. It was a little too hot but the apartment has 2 fans that come in handy! Overall very good!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Manuela et Madalena. L'accueil fut chaleureux et en un français parfait. Nous avons eu de bons conseils pratiques et de bonnes adresses pour notre séjour. Le petit guide mis à disposition est rempli d'activités très intéressantes. La disponibilité des propriétaires est excellente au vu de leur proximité (dans la boutique au pied de l'entrée du bâtiment). La localisation est excellente, nous avons pratiquement tout fait à pied et les transports en commun sont proches. Nous recommandons ce logement.
One of the better places i've stayed in.  Superb.   It's newly renovated and has all the finishing touches, extras, surprises, high quality fit-out, heating cosy, comfy, amazing.  Stay here!!

l'appartement est très beau, propre, bien situé et très confortable. Manuela et Magdalena ont été très accueillantes. Elles sont pleines d'attentions.
Je recommande vivement de loger chez Manuela et Magdalena.
Very good

Manuela was a fantastic host! Thoroughly knowledgable about the area, gave great tips and offered port wine and a free gift from her excellent preserved seafood store right downstairs. I highly recommend picking up some tins before leaving Porto! Space was sparkling clean, had all the amenities you could need.
Manuela's place is an excellent choice for travellers. Very cozy, clean and a great location, close to the subway. She received us with some Porto wine. I do recommend!

Antonio was incredibly responsive and thoughtful about my stay.

Antonio was very quick to answar any question we had in regards to the check in and chech out.  we actually got in very late the first day and he was very comunicative. Also, the place is very conveniently located, the apartment is spotless and well furnished with a full kitchen. I will definetly recomend.
Some things were not perfect, but only things that can easily be fixed. We left private feedback to Antonio. In general the apartment is good and the location is great.

Antonio seemed like a wonderful host when I first contacted him about renting this place.  However, once we arrived it was not quite the same; the furniture was not the same as the pictures in his listing.  I booked this place specifically because he listed it as one bedroom and one pull out couch.   I wanted the second bed since I was meeting my dad in NY.  However, I think the most suspicious part of this whole transaction was the fact that the address he provided us was different from the one in his listing.  I contacted customer support and worked with Diane and Megan.  They were kind, courteous, and responded quickly using both phone and email to contact me.  After their investigation, they agreed that Antonio misrepresented his listing and I was refunded the whole amount.  I have really had some great experiences with rentals from Airbnb but I will always remember to save all communication, pictures, and information from the host in case there is ever a problem like this again.

Great location and a lovely space!
We had a great time staying at Antonio's place. 
Extra plus for early check in and late check out :)
A un bon airbnb
Antonio was responsive and helpful when needed - though we haven't missed anything. Great location, very nice place.

A nice and spacious apartment in a very convenient location. Fully equipped and extremely clean. Antonio was very kind and always available. The only negative point was a quite noisy heating fan especially in the bedroom (the host has been now informed and he's going to investigate)

This was me and my girlfriends first time in New York and we loved staying at Antonio's spot. It's a really nice cozy house and is in a great location! Numerous bars, restaurants and shopping stores with in walking distance and the neighborhood is safe. Literally a 5 minute walk to the L train and in total probably 15-20 minutes to get into Manhattan. On top of having a nice home, Antonio is also an awesome host! He has great street knowledge of New York and his recommendations were always spot on. Our flight coming in and going out of New York were late and he was really flexible with us checking in and out. If you are going to New York, you MUST stay at this Airbnb and you will not regret it. Trust me.

This was a fabulous place to visit.  The location was excellent and the neighborhood was great.  In fact it was so enticing we ended up spending most of our time in Brooklyn.  Antonio was a great host and the house was a pleasure to stay in.  I'd gladly stay there again given the chance.

Antonio’s place is well located, minutes away by subway to Manhattan, in a good neighbourhood to experience the renaissance of Brooklyn in all of its funky coolness. It’s a restful relief from the heaving crowds of Midtown.  The space is well appointed with top of the line kitchen fittings, s/s appliances, spotless bathroom and a super comfy huge bed. There’s also an inflatable mattress that developed a leak the first night regrettably.

Antonio was always super responsive and helpful. You won’t be disappointed with your stay.

He made sure we got the keys, kept great communication to make sure we were ok, and was an overall awesome host! The pictures are accurate, the place nice and quiet. The bed was very comfortable, air conditioners worked well and there is an elevator.  His place is also centrally located, so it made seeing NYC super easy. If/when we are in NY we hope we can stay there again. Thank you so much Manos, you were a perfect host!!!
Manos was a wonderful host. His apartment was excellent and in a lovely neighborhood. Within walking distance to everything I needed. I highly recommend this apartment.

Manos's apartment overall is pretty satisfying. It describes exactly the same as it is on Airbnb page. The room is clean and cozy. The location is convenient to everywhere. A lot good rating restaurants are nearby. We spent a great time here. The host responds quickly and always asked us if we need anything or whether we are good. I would suggest to stay here if you are coming with 2-3 people.

Manos is a great host! Always easy to get in touch of and made sure everything was going well. The place is perfect! Good size apartment / Plenty of space! The balcony is a big bonus! The location itself is prime. A very relaxed part of Manhattan. A short walk to many different venues and definitely a lot of good places to eat. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone!

Manos is a great host. He was available whenever you needed him. The apartment is perfectly how he describes it and it is easy to get anywhere from there. Me and my friend stayed there for nearly 3 weeks and our stay was amazing. I would definitely want to stay there aging in my next visit.
Really nice place! I'm lucky to have found this room on Airbnb - great value and perfect location. Manos was easy to talk to and set things up well for my stay.

Manos is a perfect host and his place is just as on the pictures. The location is also top notch, just a few minutes walk from Flatiron building and well within the walking distance from most of Manhattan landmark.
You will be wowed.  Look no further. An amazing host.

Fantastic host. Very accommodating. Helps you settle in and check out. Always available for any question you have. 

The flat is as described. Large couch, with huge TV with Roku and PS4!Shower has good pressure though not the best. Water is hot. Oven working perfect. No microwave. Fridge with freezer. Balcony is a huge plus for smokers. A lot of closet space to hang your stuff.  
Central heating, so warm flat in winter. However when its warm outside can get too warm inside. 

Large Elevator available in the building. 

Closest subway station is 23rd street madison garden. Around 7-10 minutes  walk. Green line subway is closer, around 5 minutes walk.

All in all, best stay could have wished for!
Perfect place! Couldn't of asked for better and would love to stay again next time I'm in New York.

Manos' place is just as pictured and described. We enjoyed the area, especially Madison Square Park and we were able to make the sleeping arrangements work with 2 adults and 2 little kids. It was very quiet at night. Overall, a great trip.
Loved the love location. Plenty of closet and drawer space.  The apartment was super clean. And Manos was so positive, helpful and easy going.  I'd book this place again.

Manos was a great host. From the get-go he was communicative and made arrangements to pass the keys off to me. His place was comfortable, stylish and in a central neighborhood close to bars, restaurants and transport. Would definitely stay at Manos's place next time I'm back in the city.

This was just a perfect stay. The location is great, apartment is comfortable with everything needed. Despite the fact that all the tourist attractions are close, the apartment is quiet. Definitely will be back!

Very nice location, amazingly quiet for Manhattan standards, easy commuting to any possible destination, super communicative and chill owner, everything you need for life, business and pleasure is within the close proximity.
Manos is a great host and the apartment was fantastic - perfect location and had everything you need. Very comfortable.
What a fantastic place in a great neighborhood. Everything I needed was right there. Manos is a wonderful host - excellent all round.

LOVED LOVED LOVED Mano's Apartment! I will be staying here again without a doubt. The location is amazing, your blocks from the best of the city and yet it's not overrun by tourists. It's so easy and Manos made everything simple. It was a magical trip from beginning to the end :)
Great place. Great host. Perfect if you want to see the city and beautiful location wich is not too busy and chilled at night.
Excelente lugar y muy buena la ubicación.

I would rather not .

The location is close to the subway. The apt has an elevator and is quiet. The host is personable and the apt is comfortable. We enjoyed our stay here

Great location with easy access to restaurants, bars and public transportation.  Quiet neighborhood, which is great after a full day in the city.  Very clean apt with all the amenities one would need for a stay in the city...will def stay again.
Great location for getting around New York. We had a fun time.

I stayed at Gianni’s apartment for 32 days, and  I couldn’t have asked for a better home away from home! 
The place was very accurate; cozy and beautifully furnished.  Kitchen and bathroom were totally clean, which was of high importance to me. 
Not only were all kitchen appliances existent - from toaster, to food processor - but also of good quality. 
The location and building are both extremely safe. I felt at ease at any time of the day. 
Another advantage is that the apartment is within a short walking distance to subway stations, Madison park , Empire State, clothing stores, restaurants, pharmacies, and organic health food stores! 
As for the host, Gianni has a truly kind character. Even though I had arrived a little late to the apartment on my first day, he was understanding and made me feel comfortable. Furthermore, he took the time to show me around the neighborhood.  He was also very responsive and willing to help at any time, literally! Once I was locked out of the apartment at 11 pm, I reached out to him and he came for help a few minutes later. 
It was a wonderful stay, and I highly recommend this home.

Very nice place, very nice host. The location of the apartment is great, everything is right around the corner. The apartment was clean and lovely, even the details. Manos is a very kind person that helps you with anything you need. We had a great time in New York at the apartment!
amezing

We stayed in Manos' place for 10 nights. 

The apartment was great and it quickly felt like home. It has everything you need - equipped kitchen, nice living room with a TV + media like Netflix. 
In 5-10 minutes you can get into a subway, and if you come back a little late, the neighborhood is safe and quiet.

We did have some issues during our stay, obviously, but Manos was very communicative and responsive and helped with everything. For example, the elevator didn't work. We also had to check in very early and check out very late, but Manos suggested many helpful options for us - which we were very satisfied with.

This was our first time on Airbnb, and like we told Manos, that was definitely a positive experience on our side.

we highly recommend Manos' place!

I recommend this appartement well located and well furnished

reviews.comments: Caroline was a great host from first contact. Her home was clean, in a great location, and she went above and beyond to make us comfortable (water, maps/brochures, snacks, and plug converters). The guest house is modern and had its own entrance for privacy but Caroline was available to call on in the main house if necessary. It was a great stay and we would highly recommend her as a host.

Passei dois dias na casa com meu namorado nos jogos olímpicos, foi ótimo!
A Caroline nos recebeu no horário combinado, e deixou a gente entrar mais cedo, as 10h, e sair mais tarde no check-out, conforme os horários do nosso ônibus.
A casa é recém-reformada, cozinha ótima, roupas de cama e banho novinhas e tudo super limpo. Na cozinha, tinha frutas e água na geladeira. Nos sentimos em casa!
O bairro é familiar, com algumas opções de restaurante por perto e uma padaria na esquina. O metro fica a 3 quadras. De carro, menos de 15min do Maracana.
Obrigada por tudo, Caroline!!

Chegamos as dez horas da manhã do dia marcado e fomos muito bem recepcionados pela Caroline que nos mostrou todos os cômodos da residência junto com suas funcionalidades. A casa encontrava-se muito limpa, bem abastecida com utilitários de cozinha, inclusive cafeteira, torradeira e liquidificador. Também é muito bem equipada com televisão (NET), wi-fi, um aparelho de som, ventilador grande na sala e ar-condicionado no quarto. Sobre esse último, encontramos uma cama confortável, lençóis e edredom limpos e de boa qualidade, além de toalhas de banho e de rosto e até mesmo dois roupões.

Todas as vezes em que tínhamos alguma dúvida, Caroline sempre foi prestativa, inclusive nos permitindo sair um pouco mais tarde no (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza, recomendo a estadia e em breve pretendo retornar.
O espaço é super aconchegante, confortável e limpo. A anfitriã não poderia ser melhor! Recomendo para qualquer ocasião!

Dear Kylie, you are an amazing host! Good communication, we get the key without any problems and the apartment was as described. The location is a good start n order to discover Manhattan and the Central Park.

Kylie's place is small but big enough for a couple to comfortably stay in. Although located in a relatively quiet corner of town, it's just under a 10 minute walk to the Lincoln Center subway station, which made it a good base camp for exploring Manhattan. Our only complaint was that a lot of the host's personal belongings remained in the apartment, which made the stay feel a little more crowded and uncomfortable than it otherwise would of. This was a relatively minor issue, and one which I'm sure will be easily remedied for future guests.

Kylie's place is pretty good overall. Kylie is very communicative and accommodating. The apartment is well kept and everything that is in the listing is there. Some of Kylie's stuff is there, but she hides it in such a manner that you barely notice it while you are there. There is a train station near by that can take you to Time Square and downtown. There are also some pretty good restaurants and a Duane Read near by which is very convenient.

If you're looking for a great place to stay in NYC for a trip, I'd recommend staying in Kylie's apartment! The location was the perfect spot for our Memorial Day weekend trip. The place was clean and very quiet and in a great spot. We were so lucky we found this apartment!
Great place for a great price in a great location. Kylie is very accommodating and helped make our stay as enjoyable as possible!

amazing host! don't expect luxury but you'll have everything you need. Kylie's place is a typical small Manhattan appt but she decorated it to make it pleasent to stay in. you won't get much natural light but that's the standard in Manhattan. Kylie was always responsive and kind. I highly recommend staying at her place!

Amazing location, great building near Lincoln Center, Broadway, Central Park, and more! Apartment is cozy and spacious (by NYC standards). Excellent host and you’ll find everything you need here. Hope to stay there again next year!

reviews.comments: Margarida was a great host, she met us from the station and made sure we had settled in, saying we could contact her for advice about the area. She made us feel welcome in her apartment.

Margarida nos acogió fenomenal en nuestra llegada, estuvo siempre atenta a nuestras necesidades y nos informó de la oferta cultural y gastronómica alrededor del apartamento. 
Este se encuentra en una zona residencial muy tranquila, donde no encontramos problemas de aparcamiento. Estaba muy limpio y todo acorde a lo descrito por Margarida, lo que nos gustó fue sobre todo la luz y el aire fresquito (han sido días calurosos) que entraban.
En cuanto a limpieza y comodidad, muy bien también! 

Muy cerca de la casa probamos dos cafeterías que nos encantaron para desayunar (rico y barato): Porto Rico, ubicada en Rua de Oliveira Monteiro, 491-497; y Regata, enRua de Nossa Senhora de Fátima, 421.

(Podéis encontrar info sobre restaurantes en esta página (Website hidden by Airbnb) 

Ubicado a 10min de la Casa de la Música, donde la oferta cultural es amplia, y del Mercado del Bom Sucesso (opción ideal para picar algo cerca del apartamento aunque no la única). 
Al centro normalmente íbamos andando (alrededor de 20min) pero otra opción es coger el metro desde el centro y andar los últimos minutos; el trayecto que realizamos fue: De Sao Bento>Trindade> Casa da Musica (Carolina Michaelis también está cerca).

La opción más corta para ir andando (o eso nos parece) es Dr Carlos Cal Brandao (e ir callejeando) aunque también se puede ir hacia la Rotonda de Boavista y bajar hacia Jardins do Palacio de Cristal (buena opción para ver atardecer).

La verdad que ha sido una estancia perfecta y repetiríamos encantados :)

Margarida was very helpful and she made us feel welcome. She explained everything about the apartment very well. She even gave us loads of tips on where we can go for good restaurants, bars etc. We could always ask her anything during our stay about anything in Porto, it was really helpful. I would defenitely recommend this place to others.
Margarida is a very nice person and has a nice apartment!

Margarida was very nice when we arrived and gave us good advice of what to do. The appartment was in a good neighbourhood. Easy to walk to the center of the city. Everything was clean. We really loved our stay at her appartment!

Margarida es una persona atenta y siempre dispuesta a ayudar; Oporto una ciudad hermosa llena de rincones en los que perderse. Lamentablemente, es difícil llevarse una imagen positiva después de que te roben. El día antes de nuestra partida encontramos la luna del coche rota, y todo lo que había de valor, sustraído. Es una práctica habitual, no fue una excepción. La consiguiente desesperación, al estar "abandonados" en otro país, sólo la conoce quien la padece. Además, no habíamos aparcado en una zona  conflictiva, sino en un barrio residencial, muy cerca del apartamento. 
Lo verdaderamente problemático no es el robo en sí, sino el hecho, ante la perspectiva de un largo viaje para volver a casa, de no tener ayuda posible: que el seguro no responda, no tener internet en el teléfono, etcétera, hecho que probablemente constituya un incentivo para los ladrones, pues es obvio que actúan desde el rencor.
Si Margarida dispone el aparcamiento trasero a la casa todo será más seguro. No le recomiendo a nadie dejar el coche en la calle.
Es recomendable también, controlar los precios de las tarifas de datos, ya que la Wi-Fi que nos fue brindada solo funcionó el primer día, y se hace muy necesaria estando de viaje. 
Por otro lado, es difícil llegar a entender para un español (que tenemos fama de fiesteros y gritones) como es posible que en una zona residencial todas las noches se reúna gente en una plaza a beber y hablar hasta las cuatro o cinco de la mañana. El caso es que como la visita ha sido en agosto y el calor era insoportable, teníamos que tener las ventanas abiertas y era muy difícil dormir, pues la gente no tenía ninguna consideración ni civismo en este aspecto.
Esto no pretende ser una crítica destructiva; quizá tuvimos mala suerte, y aunque creo que hay aspectos a mejorar, el apartamento es una  buena oportunidad para conocer la ciudad, sobre todo por su relación calidad-precio y porque Margarida responde siempre con una sonrisa. Aun teniendo en cuenta los aspectos señalados, estoy seguro de que con el tiempo el recuerdo será bueno.
Un très bon accueil de la part de Margarida. L'appartement est propre et bien placé par rapport au centre ville. C'est une adresse que je recommande !
A Margarida foi muito simpatica e o apartamento estava impecável. obrigado :)

Margarida est une personne adorable! elle nous a laissé un guide de porto avec ses annotations pour que notre voyage soit le plus agréable possible, l'appartement correspond parfaitement aux photos. l'appartement est entre 2 stations de metro très facile d'accès, et proche de la rotunda.

Un espacio austero pero cómodo, bien comunicado con el centro aunque a un buen paseo. Tiendas en la zona. No hemos tenido problemas de aparcamiento ni de seguridad, la zona es tranquila. ottimo, Margarita simpatica e accogliente. l'appartamento pulito. la posizione abbastanza comoda per il centro. ottima esperienza. lo consiglio

Um local agradável com espaço muito higiénico. Facilidade para estacionar sem pagar.
Obrigado Margarida

Casa limpissima e luminosa. Cozinha nova com todo o indispensável. Colchao e almofadas 5*. A Margarida foi super disponível (esperou por mim a chegada até às 22.30). Rua silenciosa apesar de estar a 5 minutos da casa da música.

O apartamento da Margarida é ótimo! Excelente localização, perto do metro, que facilita ir para onde quiser, em qualquer direção em Porto, seja a passeio ou a trabalho. Próximo à várias paragens de autocarro, assim como mercados e ao consulado do Brasil em Porto.
A Margarida foi muito gentil sempre, me atendendo com presteza e agilidade.
Foi uma ótima estadia em Porto cidade apaixonante!
Super voyage à Porto. L'appart était très propre et Margarida est très gentille et disponible.
Simple but cosy and very clean flat !
Muy recomendable. Muy bien ubicada,a 20 minutos andando. Excelente atención de Margarida y un excelente alojamiento!
Margarida was very friendly and very flexible with our check-in time. Photos are almost an exact match to the apartment. Great natural lighting.

Appartement très bien pour un couple ou une personne seule. Le clic-clac n'est pas très confortable. Bien situé, métro, bus...les petits défauts sont le bruit car l'immeuble n'est pas bien insonorisé, et le chauffage insuffisant l'hiver. Mais Margarida  est très accueillante et à l'écoute.
Nice apartment to discover Porto !
Great stay - no problems at all, flat was exactly as described, and Margarida was very helpful and communicative both before and after arriving.

Margarida was very helpful and well organized. She had great tips and a number of brochures and magazines about Porto. She seemed very friendly and  was eager to accomodate us. The space is really nice, ideal for a couple and allows for some nice down time should you want to take a break from walking around.
Estancia ideal para visitar Oporto, ligeramente apartado pero en 15-25m  al centro, merece la pena.
A casa da Margarida é linda! Super bem localizada, limpa, completa! Super indico! Amamos!

The flat is located near the city center, it‘s a nice fifteen minutes walk. Margarida welcomed us, even though we arrived pretty late, with a warm smile! The place is sweet, we cooked a lot and found everything we needed. We were three and had enough space for our clothing and everything. During our visit in porto it was pretty rainy, so the bathtub and the radiator were a big plus :-)

L'appartement est bien situé (3 arrêts de tram/métro du centre). Il est très lumineux, il y a un balcon fermé (loggia) et  un balcon classique.
 Il est un peu frais (en avril 2018) mais Margarida avait fourni de nombreuses couvertures !! :-)

Elle a aussi était très arrangeante à notre arrivée (on lui a laissé nos bagages car on est arrivées un peu tôt et les voyageurs précédents étaient encore là) et nous avait envoyé plein d'adresses et de suggestions pour notre séjour.

Tout s'est très bien passé.

Everything was nice !

Très bel accueil. Elle nous a même expliqué ce qu'il y a faire proche de son appartement et comment se rendre en métro pour aller au centre-ville de Porto. 
Métro à environ 5 minutes à pied. Café instant avec bouilloire sur place. Elle nous a même laissé des maps des environs et des points à aller voir.
Merci
Margarida was very friendly and helpful, and she got lots of leaflets, guides and magazines about Porto. Flat is big and super clean, in a quiet, residential neighborhood. Recommended!
Excellent accueil de la part de Margarida. Très attentive et concernée par les voyageurs séjournant dans son logement. Logement bien situé et fonctionnel.

A nice flat with a balcony in Boavista neighbourhood ! Margarida provided us with much useful information before our coming and was there to welcome us even though it was quite late ! That was really pleasant. Margarida also left some reading about Porto in the flat which helped us not to miss the best places ! The flat is located next to Casa da Musica, Mercado Bom Sucesso (you definitely need to go there for food) and other nice places. In terms of transports, we had a nightbus coming from the airport right next to the flat, which was really convenient (daybus also to the airport works). Day buses + metro are just from 2 to 10 min walking, it is really easy to reach the center of the city or to go to Foz do Douro to see the beach. A really good plan to stay in Porto !

Margardia was friendly and left a lot of great information for us on things to do and places to eat. The apartment is simple but has everything you need. Very close to a bakery and within walking distance of the historical distance. There were slight issues with the door, but they were fixed promptly.

Very nice apartment, clean and with everything you need! Ideally located, near Boavista/Casa da Música, a bit out of the city center but still super close! Margarida was very nice and helpful! I recommend this place!

Margarida est très réactive aux messages.
Elle parle aussi très bien français.
L'appartement est propre et très bien situé, pas loin des bus et station métro.

Appartement tout à fait conforme aux photos et description: propre, clair er confortable. Proximité immédiate du métro et bus directs vers l'hyper- centre en bas de l'immeuble. Accueil chaleureux de Margarida. Je recommande.
Great flat, great location and great landlady. This is a perfect place to stay few days in Porto
Honnête comme présentation et bien situé dans la ville pour se déplacer. merci de votre accueil agréable.

Very nice and welcoming host. Even though not in the exact center of porto, the apartment is conveniently located near the metro station Casa de Musica and all the metro lines leads to the center in a few minutes. The apartment in itself is very bright, with spacious rooms for a couple or a few friends. The neibourhood seems calm and we did encounter any difficulty to sleep

Very nice stay in Porto. Margarida is flexible and helpful. 
The flat is good and 20 to 30 minutes walk for the hyper centre of Porto (3 metro stops from the centre if you don’t want to walk).

Wir sind nach Porto für 5 Nächte gefahren. Da das Alles etwas spontaner passiert ist haben wir auf Air BnB nach einer Bleibe gesucht und sind schnell fündig geworden. Wir hatten Glück, das zu diesem Zeitpunkt die Wohnung frei war. Diese scheint ansonsten immer sehr gut ausgebucht zu sein. 

Die Wohnung ist genauso wie auf den Bildern. Sie ist hell, sauber und Alles notwendige ist vorhanden. Wir bekamen sogar auf Anfrage noch zwei Strandtücher. Es sind schon ein paar Lebensmittel vorhanden wie Kaffee, Reis, Honig etc.. 

Die Wohnung hat einen Balkon zum gemütlich draußen sitzen. 

Das Bett ist so wie in der Beschreibung - ca. 135 x 180. Es muss daher ein bisschen gekuschelt werden. Die Kissen sind auch etwas zu klein für meinen Geschmack. 

Die Wohnung ist mit wenig Gehminuten an eine Metro angebunden mit der man sehr gut in die Innenstadt kommt. Etwa 15-20 min. Von dort kann man Alles erkundigen und auch schnell mal nach Matosinhos zum Baden fahren.

Alles in Allem eine sehr gut Alternativ zu einem Hotel. Es mangelt an nichts und die Wohnung ist sehr freundlich. Es sind auch einige Bücher und Magazine über Porto vorhanden um sich ein wenig einzulesen.

Die Gastgeberin selbst ist sehr nett. Wir haben sie zwar nicht persönlich getroffen aber sie hat uns weiter geholfen falls wir fragen hatten. 
Am Tag der Ankunft hat ein Freund von ihr auf uns gewartet und uns denn Schlüssel gegeben. Unser Flieger hatte Verspätung und wir hatten Probleme mit dem METRO Ticket (Tipp: Ticket wenn möglich schon vor Reiseantritt kaufen Porto-Karte oder Andante Karte), aber das war Alles kein Problem.
Margarida is a great and kind host. The apartment was good for a short trip and big enough. Fully recommendable!

Margarida nos ofreció todo tipo de información sobre la ciudad y además nos recibió personalmente. El apartamento es lo que se ofrece, a 20min del centro caminando, no se hace muy largo, nosotros no hemos necesitado otro transporte para movernos por la ciudad. Muy recomendable

Appartement qui permet de découvrir une autre partie de Porto, proche de la Casa da Música qui est un bâtiment exceptionnel. Un peu de marche pour rejoindre le centre ancien, mais en métro tout se fait très rapidement. Je conseil ce logement.
The flat is clean and spacious. It is located next to a metro station and next to the shops . Margarida is very reactive and gives us some good adresses.
Appartement bien situé, pas loin du métro, parfait le pour visiter porto !

Tout d'abord merci à Margarida pour son accueil. 
Celle-ci nous a communiqué avant notre arrivée comment se rendre à l'appartement ainsi que les lieux à visiter à Porto (monuments, magasins, restaurants, vues etc etc). 

Concernant l'appartement, il correspond au descriptif et est très propre. Il est situé à 20-25 Minutes de l'hyper Centre et 30-35 Minutes des quais (du pont Luis). L'appartement est aux pieds des transports en commun (métro et bus) qui vous emmèneront directement en centre ville. 

Le point négatif de l'appartement son isolation (comme tous les logements au portugal quasiment). 

Je recommande donc cet appartement pour un séjour à Porto. 

Clément

Good location, 20 minutes to the center. Quiet area. Spacious apartment. Free parking near the house. From the window of the neighboring house meets a black, mustachioed, cute dog :) Say hello to him! Thank you!
good❤️
Perfect stay! Would definitely recommend and would stay here again. Lovely host

Margarida is a nice host and the flat is well located (tram, restaurant).
Definetly a good and simple accomondation.

Gostei muito da minha hospedagem em Porto. O apartamento, além de extremamente limpo e organizado, é cheiroso! Há tudo o que a gente precisa. Quando eu cheguei, estava chovendo e tinha até guarda-chuva e capa de chuva à disposição. Achei muito bem equipado. Margarida é gentil, responde a todas as mensagens com eficiência! Recomendo!
Appartement très bien situé. il est lumineux et très propre. Margarita nous a renseigné et fourni plein d'informations très utiles.
nice and clean place
Great place, host is very hospitable, location very good (just off the touristic buzz, but close enough to the centre).
Un appartement très bien placé et bien arrangé. Très propre. La hote était superbe. Tout s’est bien passé.

Check-in molto flessibile, casa pulita e con tutto il necessario asciugacapelli e asciugamani compresi. La casa si trova a 20/25 minuti a piedi dal centro ed ha anche due fermate della metro nelle vicinanze per raggiungere tutte le parti della città.
I have never booked via Airbnb so I was a little nervous.. The pictures were exactly as it looked, flat was cleaned.. All stuff (toilet paper, towels etc) was available.. I can recommend!
Margarida is a great host and very kind, her apartment is perfect for a Porto visit. Really good location, I enjoyed my stay there and recommend her place!

5/5 communication, flexible check in and very friendly host. Most amenities I've had in an AirBnB so far, from toiletries to cleaning products and coffee/tea as well as multiple towels  and pillows per person.
Great little place and good value, highly recommended!

name: Penthouse with stunning 600 sq ft roof terrace
summary: My place is good for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers.
space: Beautiful views over Hollywood Park - balcony in the apartment as well as 600 sq ft roof terrace.  Contemporary but warm and stylish furnishings.  Roof terrace has dining area with barbecue and sitting area with sofas and armchairs.
description: My place is good for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers. Beautiful views over Hollywood Park - balcony in the apartment as well as 600 sq ft roof terrace.  Contemporary but warm and stylish furnishings.  Roof terrace has dining area with barbecue and sitting area with sofas and armchairs. You are welcome to use the whole space as your own when you are my guest. I am happy to give you dining tips in the neighborhood and always free to have a coffee. My corner of Sheung Wan combines the old and new in HK - lots of wonderful restaurants, cafes and bars.  Art galleries and antique shops, quirky clothing and designer shops too. Very easy to get taxis outside the flat and the no. 26 bus is right across the street.  5-10 minute to the MTR and a 15-20 minute walk into Central.
neighborhood_overview: My corner of Sheung Wan combines the old and new in HK - lots of wonderful restaurants, cafes and bars.  Art galleries and antique shops, quirky clothing and designer shops too.

interaction: I am happy to give you dining tips in the neighborhood and always free to have a coffee.
house_rules: No smoking inside the flat as there is a balcony and roof terrace. No more than 2 guests. No loud music on the roof terrace after 11 pm as the police will attend. No parties.

host.host_about: Ex investment banker, headhunter and now tech start up entrepreneur.  Multi lingual and well travelled.  Loves HK, enjoys cooking and good food, passionate about martial arts, hiking and long evenings with great friends especially when there is music!

address.street: Hong Kong, Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong

reviews.comments: Barbara was a most gracious and generous host.  She went out of her way to make me feel comfortable and (in effect) have a home away from home.  Her apartment is nothing short of amazing.  It is a great size for Hong Kong, incredibly comfortable, spotlessly clean and elegantly furnished.  The apartment is an an oasis from the hustle & bustle of Hong Kong.  It is perfectly situated on Hollywood Road, in the thick of a great selection of restaurants & bars and parks and is walking distance to Central & SOHO.  The apartment is open and airy, filled with natural light and is perfect for the business person that needs space to work out of or just to have a breather from the Hong Kong pace (a real luxury for Hong Kong).  The rooftop garden is a real bonus.  What a wonderful and unique experience.  I highly recommend this to any business person and discerning traveller.  I hope to return there soon.  Thanks Barbara! :-)
Luxurious and spacious penthouse in a trendy neighborhood; the pics really don't do it justice. Smooth communication and check-in. Would definitely recommend. Thank you for a great stay!

Barbara's place is fantastic and she is a wonderful host! We stayed for 10 days and felt at home as soon as we walked through the door. Really enjoyed the neighborhood - it was fairly quiet at night, but just a few blocks to walk to the shops and restaurants along Hollywood Road (the art/artisan shops at PMQ were our favorite). The kitchen is well equipped and there are two grocery markets within a few minutes walk (one Chinese-style and one English-style), so it was easy to make breakfast each morning, open up the balcony doors, and listen to the birds chirping in the park across the street. Barbara was very helpful with suggestions on dinner places - she gave us 6 suggestions within a 5 minute walk; we made it to 5 and had a great meal each time. The Sheung Wan area is very convenient to Central and it's easy to pick up taxis, trams, and the MTR within a few blocks of the apartment to get anywhere in the city. We'd definitely book Barbara's place again if we return to Hong Kong.

A very beautifully furnished space in a very trendy area roughly equidistant from Sai Ying Pun and Sheung Wan MTRs. Lots of cool cafes, restaurants and bars surround the flat. Check-in was easy and communication with Barbara was fast and effective. The doorman (particularly a charming gentleman by the name of Albert) gave tips to travelling around the area and it was always a nice feeling to see a familiar face when returning to the apartment. Will definitely stay in this space again if I get the chance!

AMAZING - the Penthouse in real life is 10x better then the images, PLUS the rooftop is so amazing and has such an amazing view it's all to your self with enough furniture to have 8 friends up there ( though I was by myself ) 

The community is amazing there's a MUST go to coffee shop right next door ( I forget the name ) 

Wifi is great 

Bed was super comfy 

Barbara is super helpful and I couldn't recommend the place enough, was worth every penny!
A real gem, beautiful apartment, well located we loved staying here. Barbara is a great host and was super helpful. Would highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay at Barbara's house. It was very clean and Barbara has a great taste of designing the house. The kitchen, bathroom, dining area, all of those are very well decorated. The location is very convenient, and it was a great experience exploring this side of the Hong Kong island. There was a great combination of modern and histories.

Barbara’s place is wonderful and perfect, it’s very comfortable and have a great design, totally same with the photos who shown. 
And the place really bring us a cozy home feeling when our staying, and the environment is quiet and peace, and also nearby the convenience store. 
The location is convenience too, if you’re familiar with the tramway, it’s so much easy to roam around the central.

A wonderful location and a beautiful studio nest to come home to, what more could one ask! You can find endless places to explore within walking distance, and a range of simple cafes to hip restaurants. So different from staying in the usual hotels. Highly recommended for the discerning Airbnbist.

Amazing apartment in the most stylish central area of hong kong. It is close to all the shops and restaurants that you need on your holiday and even for your longer term business trip. Highly recommend.

An absolutely wonderful place to stay while exploring Hong Kong.  Beautiful apartment, clean, wonderful views and open spaces...a rarity in HK.  Kitchen was well appointed, bed was comfortable, shower spacious and washing machine/dryer a nice plus for longer stay.  Doormen are sweet and always there to help.  

The location is great with a 5 minute walk to the two closest metro stops (we used Sai Ying Pun A1 mostly) and a few grocery stores.  This area provides a lot of atmosphere with many small Chinese stores and a couple temples nearby.   Cute cafe for morning coffee on ground level of building.  Hollywood Park across the street.  Antique stores just down the street and nightlife of LKF and SoHo are within walking distance but far enough away to not disturb your sleep.

Barbara was very responsive and easy to communicate with.  She made suggestions on a few restaurants too.  A perfect place to call home during our stay.  We will be back on our next visit to HK!

Barbara went out of her way to make our trip special. Because we arrived late on a Sunday, she took the extra step of asking what did she could have waiting, and she also made excellent recommendations regarding local restaurants and bars. The space was lovely and the neighborhood is a perfect mix of old and new. I loved the balcony and roof, and enjoyed waking  up to the activity across the street at the park each morning. There is also an interesting small temple perhaps a block or so away. The walk to the MTR is perhaps 10 minutes, and there is plenty of access to shops and food. I highly recommend this space for anyone visiting Hong Kong!

I’m always too lazy to write reviews but this trip has really changed my view towards HK (housing and residents etc)! I was on a hectic blitz like business trip and booked this apt very late at night after exhausting myself at work. Despite such a crazily short notice Barbara immediately arranged a key for me to get in without any complaints. The 24hr doorman is always so nice. I didn’t have a chance to wander around but as far as I know restaurants, convenient stores or even hospital are all downstairs and IFC (the usual working place) is just 5-10min taxi away. I’ve had some terrible experience staying at Airbnb HK previously and switched back to the boring 5 star hotel mode since then. But I would now defo place Barbara’s apt as my top choice whenever I travel to HK. I would sincerely recommend it to anyone who wants to have a down-to-earth experience in HK esp those on business trips. Last word, the pano view is amazingly refreshing - you’ll know what I’m talking about if you are familiar with the HK housing conditions ;p

Barbara's apartment is in the perfect postion on HK Island , close to an MTR, not far from the ferries ( an easy walking distance) lots of good cafes and restaurants in the area and grocery shops if you want to self cater. Being on Hollywood Road it is also close to lots of popular tourist (Website hidden by Airbnb) is a very stylish, beautiful apartment but also very practical and extremely comfortable. It had everything you could possibly need during your stay and was spotlessly clean. The roof terrace and balcony are a real bonus too. It overlooks a beautiful little park and the area is very quiet at night. Barbara was a very helpful host, easy to contact and quick to respond to any queries. The concierges were also very curteous, friendly and helpful ( especially Albert!) I really hpe we can use Barbara's aprtment on our next visit to HK!!
My second time staying here. Barbara prepared some super delicious fish congee for me. Love this place so much!

Wonderful AirBnB with a beautiful view over the treetops of the park next door. Very spacious and comfortable with lots of natural light. Perfect location on Hollywood Road, walking distance to SoHo and the Sheung Wan or SYP MTR. The 24/7 front desk is super helpful and friendly, and Barbara is a wonderful host!

Barbara is a lovely person!
She gave us a lot of tips about HK which made our trip awesome.
The apartment is amazing, clean with geat view and location, walking distance to everything.
We highly recommend this space for anyone visiting Hong Kong!

Really, a great apt to base yourself - agree with all previous reviews. Comfortable and stylish apt. We liked the neighbourhood for its restaurants & cafes.  In walking distance - but just far enough away - from the craziness of Central.

Amazing place. It’s more beautiful than pictures. The big balcony has a great view of Hon Kong buildings .  The apartment is good designed. A lot of Chinese paintings and photos. Bathroom is made from marble, elegant. The kitchen has everything you need. The bed is very soft. And most thankfully, there is 24h guard, help us a lot.
房间会比照片美很多,充满了设计感,还有一个超级大的阳台,风景很好,楼下就是荷里活公园,周围到处都是咖啡馆､小吃店､商店,去半山扶梯､九记牛腩走路大约10多分钟,楼下的保安叔叔超级和蔼,感恩!
Barbara’s place is perfect in every way - location, comfort, and style.  We had a wonderful stay and enjoyed meeting Barbara.

The place is great, was exactly what we were looking for! Location is also great and Barbara is so quick and helpful in her replies. Thanks for all your help with the booking Barbara, we’ll be back and booking again soon! :)

This is a lovely flat in an excellent location. The property is as described and perhaps even better in real life. The flat is beautifully decorated and finished. It’s also very safe with a 24 hour concierge. Lovely location , close to everything
Good location. Nice building and overall place. Totally recommend!!
We simply loved our stay at Barbara‘s place. It’s very homely, stylish, centrally located with lots to discover just in walking distance. Barbara is a very responsive and helpful host.
It offers a big rooftop which is a great place to enjoy the night view of Sheung Wan. And the location is perfect. You can easily find some fine restaurants nearby.

We had a great time staying in Barbara's place.  The apartment is well located with easy walking to the ferry, the central train station, lots of shops/restaurants and other sites.  The place is well designed and clean. There is a small park across the street and a cafe downstairs.   Barbara was very responsive and pleasant to work with.  The front desk staff in the lobby were also very nice.

Barbara’s place was great. She was very quick to answer any questions that I had. I arrived late but she was there to greet me and have a drink with me. It was a great place to stay on Hong Kong Island
Perfect location, both doorman are extremely helpful and speak perfect English. Just like being at home
Beautiful flat in the best neighborhood in HK. Thank you Barbara!

We loved staying in Barbara’s penthouse. It is stylishly furnishes with a beautiful outlook over the park - in a brilliant location. Located in an eclectic neighbourhood, the penthouse is within walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops, bars, public transport and lots of attractions on Hong Kong island.

The apartment is clean, spacious and the roof top is an amazing space to watch the lights of Hong Kong - whilst enjoying a wine. 

We worked during the day from the apartment - and it was extremely spacious - so much so both of us did not feel like we were on top of one another.

Barbara is an exceptional host - quick to respond, providing lots of recommendations for local places to eat and visit. Her doorman was also very polite and helpful.

A great place - highly recommended. We hope to stay here in the future.
호스트의 세심한 배려와 아기자기한 인테리어가 너무 좋았어요. 그리고 밤에 전경이 어떤 호텔보다 편안하고 멋있었습니다.

reviews.comments:
This was a great listing and an amazing place to stay. Sofia's place is clean, well decorated and just the right amount of space for 2-4 people. The space felt cozy and we loved it. We were only a bit disappointed that we found out at the last minute that there was no AC (as listed) but Sofia was very understanding and compensated us based on our experience. 

Sofia herself is a great host who is very attentive right from the first moment we wanted the place. She kept in touch by email and text and even checked in with us daily. The instructions she left were clear and she was available to help when we needed anything. The neighbourhood was nice and quiet as well. 

I would definitely stay at this listing again!

Sofia's place was exactly as advertised. It was really clean and her directions were very clear. Sofia kept in contact with us to make sure everything was ok. Her restaurant recommendations were good as well. I would definitely stay at Sofia's place again. I really liked her condo and the neighborhood. The building was very quiet and we enjoyed staying there. 

Thanks again for everything Sofia!
The apartment is great, clean, modern, easy to find, and with all the amenities we needed

We had a beautiful stay. The pictures represent the apartment perfectly. Sofia is a sweetheart and was a pleasure to deal with. The apartment is conveniently located near the highway & the metro. Will definitely try to stay here next time we're in town!
Un logement parfait. Très propre et très  tranquille. On se  sent comme chez soi. On retournera, si les dates sont disponibles. Le contact avec Sofia a été facile.

Place was exactly as advertised. Just outside downtown Montreal and a quick drive into the heart of it. Owner was more than helpful, was available to answer any questions we had for the entirety of our trip. Would highly recommend staying here if you are looking for somewhere close to downtown without paying downtown prices.
Good

Honestly, this is one of the best airbnb experiences I've had so far! Sofia's place is really close to public transit, and she lives in a nice quiet neighbourhood. Although I didn't get to meet her, she made sure everything was ready and easy for us. Check-in was a breeze. I'd definitely try to stay here again whenever I plan another trip to montreal!
Tres beau sejour

Clean place, good owner. :)
Spacious apartment.

Sofia has a cozy apartment in a quiet place in Montreal. It is perfect to relax, and it is very easy to go downtown or other places from there. the kitchen is complete, the washing and drying machines are very modern and efficient. We had a wonderful time in Montreal, and hope to get back soon!

My mom and I loved staying at Sofia's place during our trip to Montreal. Her place was clean, quiet, and well equipped for a very comfortable stay. Parking behind the building was so convenient. My mom had to work from home for a couple of days, and the living room made a great home office as well. Definite recommend for a peaceful retreat in Montreal that's still reasonably close to downtown.

Die im obersten Geschoss gelegene Unterkunft hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Sie war mit allen Annehmlichkeiten einschließlich einer Vielzahl von Lebensmitteln ausgestattet. Parkmöglichkeit besteht hinter dem Haus. Die Wohnung ist über ein Treppenhaus erreichbar. Für den ersten und letzten Zugang muss die Außentreppe benutzt werden. Zur nächsten Metrostation sind es 7-8 Minuten (Preis für Hin- und Rückfahrt 6 Dollar pro Person).

I had an amazing experience, Sofia directions was very clear and precise. 

Thank you

We had a great stay at Sofia's place! Photos are accurate. One private parking spot behind the apartment was very convenient.  It's one the third floor with no elevate, which was no problem for us. 

There is no air conditioning, but in the middle of June with the window cracked open and the fan on, it wasn't a real issue.

It's about a 10 minute walk to the subway, depending how fast you walk. We took the subway every day and  got very used to the walk. There aren't many things to do in the area, but with the subway so close, it didn't really matter to us.

At first glance, the neighborhood appeared a little sketchy and run-down, but we never had an issue. It's a very quiet neighborhood with quiet residents who seem to keep to themselves. And the interior of the apartment is very welcoming and well furnished.

All in all, we had a great time and would stay again! Montreal is a beautiful, relaxed city and I recommend it!

Sofia's place is money worth for it's value. Although it's not located in a very good neighbourhood but this is the place where close to downtown and easy access to any where. Sofia is a good host, she prepare her place like a home for family traveler and give very clear instruction and everything are accurate.

Appartement très bien situé, proche d'un metro et cartier tranquille. Sofia était facilement a rejoindre en cas de probleme. Le condo était impeccable, très beau séjour, je le recommande sans hésiter!
Great location, close to downtown and the Metro.  Nice quiet neighbourhood and the unit is as described.  Great value when visiting Montreal.
Great two bedroom place close to the metro with off street parking.  Easy check in/out.
The host canceled this reservation 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
100% recommended

The appartement is really lovely. There is enough space for 3 to 4 people and it offers everything you need. The parking lot behind the Building is an advantage. With Uber it took 10 minutes to get downtown. We would stay there again.
Very clean and cute place! Comfortable and felt like home! I would recommend!
Sofia's place was clean, tidy and looks just like it did in the photos! She made it easy to check in and out and parking on site was convenient. Location was great too!
Excellent house. Great house. Very organized host communication wise. Would definitely come back!

This apartment is way more lovely & cozy than what you see in pictures. Sofia is such an amazing host she made our stay a home-coming experience. It is close to all public services yet very tranquille at all time. THE best stay we have ever had :)

Sofia’s place was great, exactly as described, nice and clean and Sofia was so quick to answer and helpful with any questions, would recommend to anyone and definitely stay at her place again! Million thanks!
Great apartment. Host very quick to answet any question. Very clean apartment.
I had a great stay at Sofia’s. Didn’t run into any issues.

It was my first time coming to Montreal and Sofia was a great host. She was very responsive and helpful. Her condo is really clean and there are plenty of street parking. She also has a parking spot in the back but I did not use it because it is easier to park in the street. One minor complaint that I did have is that you can smell cigarette in the bathroom. It is probably from the neighbors smoking. I did let her know and hopefully this issue can be addressed in the future. We just left the bathroom vent on and it seem to help. The location is decent and about 10-15 minutes from Downtown. Overall I had a great stay and would recommend it.
Sofia’s place was great! Easy to get to with easy access to downtown Montreal. All parts of our stay were convenient and easy. The ad is accurate and Sofia is a great host!
Excellent accueil dans un petit quartier calme et sympathique. Merci Sofia !

Sofia’s place is very nice , it is a lovely home and had everything we needed for our stay, everything looks like the pictures and everything listed was there, the location is not bad and only 20 mins away from downtown Montreal whiteout traffic, I didn’t find any restaurants in walking distance but there is many close by in a car. There is two cornerstones conveniently on each block near her place , which was nice. We just had to be careful because there is a lot of personal things that belong to the host in the home so we tried to be as respectful of her things. A lot of person touches to the home. 
If you can’t take the stairs than that would be the only issue other than that everything was great. I would recommend this for people needing a quiet place to stay not to far from everything

Sofia is a wonderful host who have put the time into ensuring visitors have clear instructions on how to get to her location, as well as clear check in and check out procedures. The home itself was very tidy and spacious, with a gorgeous kitchen and balcony. For those travelling with a vehicle, it is a great location -- within a quick drive to downtown, and she had a parking spot available. I would highly recommend this space for folks with access to a car or are comfortable using public transit to get around. Thanks, Sofia!
Great, clean place. Close to downtown. Exactly as described. Great communication with Sofia. Thanks!
Good all around place to stay in Montreal.
Clean, quiet, comfortable and near the metro. It was just right for 3 of us, and Sofia was easy to reach.

Great space, everything you need in a roomy, well located apartment. For older people be aware there is no elevator so it is a little tricky getting to the top floor. 

Would definitely rent again, Sofia was very helpful and her place is so well equipped.
Great place and location.

The best in MONTREAL!! Sofia’s home will give you everything you need! This was my first Air BNB booking and I am so impressed. 

Sofia is really a professional and AMAZING host!

Thanks Sofia :)

Sofia’s apartment was perfect for our family trip to Montreal. The apartment is extremely clean, spacious and walking distance to the Metro. Sofia was a great host and very responsive. The apartment is a great home base for a trip to beautiful Montreal.
Très bien situé à proximité du centre mais avec le plaisir d'un quartier résidentiel.
Great host and exceptional accommodation for all seasons except summers.

un appartement très lumineux et très proche du métro ligne verte. le parking est un vrai plus et il y a aussi de la place dans la rue. Confortable avec tout le nécessaire et supermarché accessible à pieds. Une bonne adresse. 
Sofia a été de bons conseils.
Sofia's place is very nice, close to downtown and we could reach her easily when we needed help. We liked style of the living room and kitchen,  very cute. We'll be staying here again :)
Was a wonderful stay at Casa Sofia! Will definitely be back!

Super appart lumineux très bien équipé dans un quartier calme. il est à proximité d'un supermarché, proche d'une station de métro et vite rendu en centre-ville.
Sofia est une hôte très attentionnée et répond très rapidement à toutes vos questions.

Sofia’s place is just like the pictures, it was clean and neat! Sofia would pick up her phone as soon as we would call. Everything was explained clearly with instructions. Great place definitely recommended!
Great value for a very nice condo. The parking spot was a definite plus!
everything was super!

Sofia's place is very clean and good for us family of four. 2 bedrooms are cozy and comfortable. She is very responsive although we didn't have the luck to meet her. Recommend to anyone who is planning to explore Montreal!
Lovely apartment and a lovely stay. Sofia is a great host. Would come back again in the future.
Great place to stay lots of mirrors which is always nice. Short/cheap cab rides to the port or downtown for $11-16. I would stay with Sofia again!

Sophia's apartment was amazing, beautiful and spacious. Clean and very comfortable beds. Sophia made sure we got in safely by texting me and made sure we had everything and that she could be contacted if we needed anything. The building was quiet and the location was perfect for where we were touring around the city. The pictures show exactly what it looks like and it's affordable. Thanks Sophia, we would stay here again.
Sofia’s place is modern, comfortable, and in a great location. Can’t beat it, especially for the price.

Well located in quiet neighborhood. Walking distance to Atwater Market (20 minutes) and to Chez Nick in Westmount (20 minutes from market). Quick response from Sofia made our stay even better. Try "Entre Ciel et Terre" (8 min walk) for quaint dinner...food is excellent! Highly recommend Sofia's place.
We had a very nice stay! Sofia was responsive to all messages and everything went smoothly with no issues what so ever. Very close to downtown as well. Greatly recommend!
Nice place!
Très bel accueil, décor chaleureux et bonne description des environs. Je recommande.

Wonderful apartment. Super close to the metro. Only thing i would mention is to be aware the apartment is up three flights of stairs, which could possibly cause issues especially with bags. Otherwise, we had a lovely stay & would come back in a heartbeat.

Excellent place in Montreal! Our lockbox was frozen shut at check in, but Sofia answered and helped us out right away so we could get in! The space is very stylish, clean and comfortable. Definitely recommend her place :)

Séjour très agréable chez Sophia. Pratique pour stationner et accéder au métro (7min à pied). Appartement propre et bien équipé.
La literie était confortable.
Je recommande cette adresse.
Sofia’s place is a great choice. Comfy bed, stylish apartment, good location! Sofia is quick to respond to all questions and was very helpful with check in and local suggestions.

Sophia is the definition of a SUPER HOST .. great communiction.  Her home is stylist and sparkling clean with plenty of amenities.  Location is amazing especially if you have a car (parking avail. on premises); you can drive anywhere in greater Montreal in less than 20mins although the abundant construction in the city may delay you a few mins.  Special thanks for the late check out.  cheers :-)
keep in mind, you have to climb up 2 stories(there's no elevator) thus it's not ideal for the elderly or physically handicap.

Great location, close proximity to city. Parking provided, close to metro.  Fast wifi, quick responses. Highly recommend!

name: Double/single room, bathroom & garage in Poblenou
summary: My house is a perfect, new and beautiful flat for staying some days in Barcelona. It’s 10 minutes walking to the beach, and 15 minutes walking to two shopping centers (Diagonal Mar/Glories), Agbar tower, Forum or CCIB. It’s well communicated with the rest of the city by tram (Fluvià station) bus (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) (in front of my home) or Metro (Selva de Mar). There is a Touristic Bus Stop near: 300m. And It is 10 minutes walk to one of the most typical streets for eating and drinking: Rambla Poblenou
space: The bedroom (double room or single) has a private bathroom only for guests. There is natural light in all flat and the bedroom has a window to the street. The floor is made of parket and it’s impeccable. In the room you have a closet for your belongings. There is an iron in the closet and towels for the beach. if you need any other item please let me know and I will try to bring it. I am always happy to help you make you feel comfortable. The private bathroom (will be only for you as I have my own) has a shower. There are fresh clean towels, shampoo, body gel as well as hairdryer. There is also a cabinet in the bathroom for you to store your toiletries.

While you are here you can always whatssapp me or use messenger if you have any questions on how to get around or simply for recommendation.
