reviews.comments: Das Zimmer und das dazugehörige Badezimmer sind geräumig, sehr gut eingerichtet und sehr sauber! Die Wohnung ist sehr modern und sehr schön. In der Wohnung gibt es alles was man so braucht.  Die Kommunikation lief sehr zuverlässig und unkompliziert. Die Lage ist fantastisch, es sind nur wenige Minuten zum Strand, aber dennoch sehr ruhig. Ein sehr schönes Einkaufszentrum "Diagonal Mar" ist nur wenige Minuten entfernt. Direkt vor der Tür gibt es viele kleinen Läden und Cafés. Eine Metrostation sowie eine Tramhaltestelle sind auch vor der Tür. Froilán ist ein perfekter und sehr sympathischer Gastgeber! Ich habe mich sofort willkommen gefühlt. Vielen Dank Froilán für die schöne Zeit in deiner Wohnung!

Ich war mit meiner Freundin zum ersten Mal in Barcelona und das war meine erste Unterkunft, die ich über Airbnb gebucht habe.
Ich muss sagen wir waren wirklich positiv überrascht. Er hat uns vom Flughafen zu unserer Unterkunft und wieder zurück zum Flughafen mit seinem Auto gebracht und zwar gratis. Er wollte einfach nichts von uns nehmen. Für die Stadteroberung haben wir ebenso gratis zwei Fahrräder bekommen. 
Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer sehr guten Lage, bis zum Strand braucht man weniger als 15 min. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön eingerichtet mit einem Balkon mit tollem Ausblick über die Stadt. Der Gastgeber war fast nie in der Wohnung und wenn er kurz da ist war er sehr hilfreich und hat uns insider Tipps gegeben. Zum Schlafen hat er ein eigenes Zimmer mit eigenem Bad und WC, somit komplett getrennt von uns. Ganz ehrlich kann ich diese Unterkunft jedem empfehlen und ich hoffe wir werden wieder mal Froilans Gäste sein :)

Frolian was a fantastic host and we thoroughly enjoyed out stay in his flat! The location is great, flat was stunning and spotless. Froilan was absolutely sweet and he made us feel at home. He was really helpful and advised us on how to get round in Barcelona and he even helped with our transfer to and from the airport. If i go back to Barcelona i would definitely want to stay at his flat again!

Froilán is a very courteous , likeable and pleasant host. 
Before my arrival he has been in touch with me constantly via (Hidden by Airbnb) . 
The apartment and my room were super clean and also decorated very tastefully. The kitchen has a full equipment, and I was allowed to use everything. 
During my trip Froilán told me great tips to see some beautiful places in Barcelona. I felt very comfortable and would definitely come again. 

Thank you very much Froilán!!!

Froilán is a very kind and helpful person, he was really interested in us, helped us out with all problems (he reserved a parking spot with his car for us), gave us a lot of insider tips for Barcelona and much more.
The flat is really nice and clean, we had our own room and own bathroom.
We used the modern kitchen a lot and enjoyed nearly every meal on the beautiful balkony.
All in all, 5 stars and a big Thank you to Froilán!

Froilán est un super hôte, il nous a super bien accueilli et même réservé une place pour notre voiture afin de ne pas devoir chercher une place. L'appartement était super propre et la chambre parfaite. on a passé un très agréable séjour, et cest certains que nous retournerons lors d'un  mon futur trip à Barca!

Froilan was amazing! He got me from the airport and insistet not to take any money from us. Besides, he offered me all the comfort and even sth to drink and fruits. His appartment is very clean and good value. With tram or bus you will get quickly to any place in Barcelona. Great value for money.

Froilan is a perfect host for a dream vacation.

The house is absolutely amazing, the location is perfect and very close to the best beaches, you basically have everything you'll ever need in his beautiful modern flat. 

He is extremely helpful and answered our messages during our stay within seconds and advised us with all the tips to make the best of our stay. 

Froilan thank you so much for the amazing hospitality and we owe you so much for this. 

Don't hesitate to catch this place - you will never regret - promise!

Froilan is super-friendly, very helpful and he will do everything to make you feel like at home. Apartment is pristine, accessible (including balcony!) and very close to La Rambla Poblenou - best place to eat in Barcelona. Room is spacious and very comfortable.
The apartment is very comfortable, very clean and you can really enjoy your stay there. Froilan us really a fantastic and kind host who always smiles.

My stay at Froilán's was perfect. He was greatly helpful and his place is very nice. I went to Barcelona because of a Conference, but I could enjoy the city as well, which is wonderful! Definitely, I would visit Barcelona again and would stay at the same place! :-)

everything was just great. the owner is very outgoing, caring and sympathetic person! location of the apartment in a nice area, 10 minutes - and you are at the sea. near a supermarket and mini-shops that are open around the clock. we are fully satisfied with our trip!!!

Nous avons été accueillis très chaleureusement par Froilàn qui nous a d'abord trouvé un emplacement pour la voiture. Après la visite de l'appartement et les explications sur les commodités des lieux, notre hôte nous a même offert une bouteille de vin local que nous avons fortement appréciée. La chambre est agréable et la salle de bain indépendante est un plus.
Froilàn a toujours été à l'écoute de nos besoins par message parfois et qu'il a su même anticiper parfois.
Froilàn est gentil, serviable, discret et de bonne compagnie.

Friolan was amazing!! You could not ask for a better host!! His house was the only place we stayed where we had access to a/c and we're able to make the house cooler.  INCREDIBLE!! Out of 8 stays in Spain  his house was the ONLY one that matched the amenities listed on his page!!  Very clean and he went above and beyond for us.  You will not regret staying with him.  And he was extremely helpful and willing to give suggestions.  10 STARS!!

Froilán is a fantastic host, communicates quickly, and has an excellent, clean, and comfortable home. The bed is also support comfortable. What more can I say that hasn't been said? I would recommend this place and I would consider staying here again in the future. Froilán was also gracious enough to give me a ride to the airport as well.

Au top ! Froilàn est un très bon hôte, son accueil et ses conseils nous ont permis de passer un très bon séjour (malheureusement trop court). Son appartement est à proximité du tram et métro pour un accès facile en ville. La chambre est propre, pas bruyante et une salle de bain privative, un vrai confort. Nous recommandons fortement :)

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Froilàn, un accueil chaleureux et beaucoup de bons conseils.
L'appartement est bien situé, joliment décoré, propre et agréable. Les photos et le descriptif correspondent fidèlement. Le parking et sa douche privative sont un plus :-) 
Une très bonne adresse à recommander.
Muchas gracias Froilàn !!

I usually don't take the time to write reviews, not because I don't want to, I just always forget to, but for him, it's a MUST! It was a great experience! He will make you feel like home. Good place. Good location. Good value. Good host. Good everything! Thanks again for hosting.
Everything in the apartment was great. Froilan was a great host.

Froilán was our favorite host during our two-week trip to Spain. He is super nice, friendly and professional. He really made us feel at home. More than at home, actually! His home is beautiful, modern and very clean.

He went out of his way to help orient us at the beginning of the visit, telling us how to best use public transportation and pointing out all of the key attractions in the city. Some of his suggestions were highlights of our vacation. 

When we were getting ready to leave and drive to our next destination, he packed us the most delicious oranges which we snacked on for the next several days. 

We cannot recommend Froilán enough. We are now back home, a week and a half later and we we are still talking about what a great person and wonderful host he was!

La estancia en casa de Froilán fue mejor de lo esperada, en parte porque la casa es tal cuál aparece en las fotos y en parte, porque es un anfitrión muy amable que se preocupa constantemente por la comodidad de sus huéspedes.
El primer día nos recomendó sitios para ver y para comer y solucionó todas nuestras dudas con respecto al transporte y funcionalidad de la casa. 
Pese a que por motivos laborales no hemos estado mucho con él, el contacto vía (Hidden by Airbnb) ha sido continúo y ha sabido responder perfectamente a todas nuestras dudas. Es un gran anfitrión muy cercano y amable, que ha hecho que nuestra estancia en Barcelona sea perfecta. Un anfitrión de 10. Si queréis una buena estancia en Barcelona, no lo dudéis.
acceuil tres chaleureux appartement bien situe et tres propre

Our stay with Froilán was a pure delight. You couldn't ask for a better host. He is a very friendly guy and always had some great tips for us, as well as advice. 
The flat and the room are both very nice and clean. The location is not the most central but it's very easy to get to the center and back (even later at night).
It's safe to say that our already amazing trip to Barcelona was made even more enjoyable by our stay with Froilán :)

Froilán is very welcoming and helpful. His apartment is just perfect: nicely decorated, clean, situated close to the public transport and within walking distance of the beaches and Barcelona's downtown. We could also enjoy private bathroom and free parking place. We highly recommend this accommodation!

It's difficult to know where to start to express the pleasure and the joy of my stay at Froilán's place))) To say it short, it was just perfect!!! To say it with more details, I would like to mention that starting with the booking, communication, providing of arrival information and welcoming me at 22 pm at the door, my stay in Barcelona started very relaxed and comfortable. Froilán's flat is located near all different kind of public transport such as bus, tram, metro. His place is very very clean, spacial and comfortable. The room has a comfortable bed,  a table & a chair, a huge closet, a mirror and an iron & an ironing board. Additionally, I had a spacial bathroom with a shower for myself. In the kitchen, coffee, tee & cookies were offered. I felt welcomed from the first second of my arrival! Additionally, Froilán  provided tones of useful information about public transport, sightseeing & restaurants. This place and Froilán as your host, is just totally recommended! Barcelona is sunny, tasty and welcoming! Just enjoy;-)

Froilan was a fantastic host! He was very responsive to messages and was able to help us out a lot! The apartment was spacious, very tidy and clean and it has a nice balcony with table and chairs to enjoy breakfast and dinner outside. Great location, 10 minute walk to the beach and 5 minute walk to nearest metro station to get in to the city! Overall 10/10, this was mine and my girlfriend first bnb experience and what an experience it was. Thank you again Froilan

Froilán was a very good host. He's very polite, friendly and helpful. If you have ans questions you can ask him.
The appartement is very nice; clean, comfortable and very good located. One of the best stays i've ever had! 
Muchas gracias, Froilán :-)

Hemos pasado 4 noches en casa de Froilán y todo estuvo perfecto! El piso muy bonito en un edificio moderno, la habitación y baño tal como descrito en las fotos, todo muy limpio. La ubicación muy bien conectada con distintos medios de transporte. Lo mejor la hospitalidad de Froilán, siempre muy amable y con una excelente comunicación antes y durante el viaje, nos ayudó bastante! 100% recomendable hospedarse ahí.

Froilán was a great host. He gave us all the informations what we needed, communication was excelent and fast via WhatsUp. If we had any questions he was always happy to help. The flat was modern ,clean and tidy and the bed was very very comfortable. The room was great size, lots of storage spaces and a built in wardrobe. Good location, easy to get to the beach. I definitely recommend him.

L'appartement se trouve dans un quartier résidentiel et relativement calme. L'immeuble est récent est d'un standing haut de gamme. La décoration moderne et raffinée est inhabituelle pour cette gamme de prix. La chambre est spacieuse et le lit king size très bon. De plus il y a une salle de bain indépendante et l'on a un accès libre à la cuisine et au séjour. Wifi disponible
Concernant notre hôte Froilan, il s'agit d'une personne vraiment joviale, aimable et au petit soin pour ses invités mais en toute discrétion et sans être envahissant le moins du monde...
Pour les transports il y a le tramway à 100m et celui-ci permet de rejoindre rapidement le métro avec le même ticket.
Cerise sur le gâteau, le propriétaire met sa place de parking privé à disposition ce qui est sécurisant dans une ville qui fait la chasse aux voitures étrangères !!
A recommander sans réserve !

Our stay with Froilan exceeded our expectations. He was extremely helpful and friendly. He got in touch with us before we arrived to let us know the best transport options from the airport, to make sure we knew exactly where the flat was, and to tell us about some great free events that were happening while we were in Barcelona. He also sent us a message to let us know that he had beach towels we could use so we didn't need to bring any. When we arrived at 1 am, he was there to greet us and was very friendly. He showed us around the whole apartment, explained how everything worked and he had bought us some things for breakfast. The flat was very clean and spacious and had a lovely balcony. The bathroom and bedroom were both great and matched the description. He provided us with everything we needed and more - towels, beach towels, aftersun, breakfast and coffee, we could use the kitchen, we could borrow his two bikes to go to the beach. He even brought us fresh cherries from his parents' house. He was extremely polite, friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Our only regret is that we did not stay for longer! We highly recommend Froilan and his flat. The location is also great - quiet, safe area near the seafront and the CCIB conference centre and with excellent transport links to the nearby city centre (metro/bus/tram). Muchimas gracias Froilan, eres un excelente anfitrion!
Frolian is a wonderful, kind and friendly host.  His place is in a quieter part of town and across the street from a lovely park.
The apartment was nice and clean with good facilities. Great location. Froilan had bought juice and bread for us! Everything was handled smoothly, nothing to complain about!!

Froilán's place is the nicest we have stayed at. Clean from top to bottom, the room was big and comfortable, and the apartment had AC!! During our stay in Barcelona we had a few bumps in the road, and Froilán was there for us and helped like we were family. He was the most understanding person ever, and so accommodating through it all! Truly one of the kindest people you will ever meet! Thank you again my friend, we hope to come back soon! :)

La estancia donde Froilan ha sido fantástica, siempre pendiente de nosotros desde el momento en que hicimos la reserva.  El piso es tal cual en La foto, limpio y cómodo. La ubicación es excelente. También Froilan ha sido muy atento en darnos tips sobre que hacer, que visitar, como llegar a nuestros destinos. Nos hubiese gustado compartir un poco más. Como anfitrión tiene 10/10

Froilan was a terrific host. Organized, clean and super friendly. We had our own spacious room and our own bathroom with the ability to use the kitchen, bikes, laundry machines, etc. And by far one the best beds we had during our trip. He provided us a map and information about the city and was so quick to respond to any questions or concerns we had. The apartment is near a Main Street that can take you anywhere! We also used the bikes offered several times to get around. Loved our time here in Barcelona and the time we actually spent with Froilan getting to know him :) 100% recommend!

Froilán's flat is exactly as described, it is lovely and near by shops, beach and restaurants. He is an amazing host who made our stay in Barcelona so easy, we had an amazing time.  He was very accommodating even when we were very late arriving and he had to work the next day. He was so helpful always making sure we got the most out of our time. We really enjoyed having the bikes to explore and all the great advice he gave us
Froilán es un anfitrión  muy atento y cordial, pendiente de ofrecer soluciones y o propuestas a sus huéspedes!!!

This airbnb is exactly what it describes! One of the best places you will ever stay. It's close to the beach and transit! The host, Froilan, is super friendly, attentive and provides great communication. He is very accommodating! He let us check in very early after a music festival and let us check out later than the usual time! :). He explained all the transit routes to us, and answered all our questions. His apartment is very clean, quiet, and in a beautiful neighbourhood! Froilan provided us with coffee, tea , water and beer :) and of course some delicious croissants for the morning! I love Barcelona and I hope to stay here again when I come back!! Love love love this place!
Great place to stay. Very clean and nice. If you want to go to the beach, Froilán has two bikes for free to use. The metro or tram station are very close. Froilán is great host.

We really enjoyed our stay! The location is awesome. Really close to the sea or public transportations to take you to the city. We used Froilans bikes to discover the city which was great! He helped us alot, told us where to go and eat etc. it was great! Especially when you travel by car since he has a great parking space! Totally recommend staying there.

Hermoso departamento, en una zona residencial. Cerca de la playa y comercios y medios de transporte.
Froilán nos prestó bicicletas que nos facilitó para conocer La hermosa Barcelona. 
El es muy bien anfitrión, muy servicial y muy buena persona.

Ik was samen met mijn dochter van 8 jaar bij Froilan voor 4 dagen. Slaapkamer en eigen badkamer erg netjes. Froilan is heel relaxed, behulpzaam, gastvrij, attent. Top! We voelden ons heel erg welkom. Tram en bus om de hoek. Strand 10 minuten lopen. Sagrada Familia 35 minuten lopen. Vlakbij gezellige restaurantjes. In de ochtend gezellig ontbijtje en koffie op balkon. Froilan had drankjes in de koelkast voor ons, heel lief. In de avond nagenieten van de dag op balkon met mooi uitzicht op Torre Agbar. Kortom, we hebben genoten!!!

Froilán is echt een fantastische zorgzame gastheer. Na duidelijke instructies hoe naar het appartement te komen, werden we warm onthaald. Alles was super netjes en schoon. We kregen onze kamer (erg netjes, fijn bed en airco!) te zien en de badkamer die alleen voor ons gebruik was. Daarna liet Froilán ons zijn fietsen zien die we mochten meenemen voor een tour door de stad. Hij bleef contact houden om te checken of alles naar wens was en stond altijd klaar met tips om de stad te ontdekken. Fantastisch verblijf gehad!

Ne passez pas à côté de ce bijou ! 
Froilán est un hôte exemplaire : drôle, attentionné et de bons conseils. 
L'appartement, moderne, se situe face au parc, à proximité de la plage (10 minutes à pied), et des stations de tram/métro. La chambre est confortable, la salle de bain privée est spacieuse et le balcon attenant à la cuisine offre une vue sur la Tour Agbar. Des vélos aux serviettes de plage (et j'en passe), tout est mis à disposition pour y passer un agréable séjour.
Sans aucun doute, nous reviendrons !

There is a reason that Froilán is rated a super host- he is utterly amazing!  We could not have asked for more - wine on arrival, bikes (which we put to very good use), maps, beach towels and a beach bag - wow!  His communication is excellent - you have every detail you need to get to his flat, find places to eat, he beach - and he is kind enough to check in you by text during your stay, just to make sure everything is going well.  We visited at a sad time for his city, but joined him in celebrating the spirit of Barcelona - the terrorists did not win!  The people of Barcelona will not let violence diminish their spirit - we had a great visit in a flat that was perfect for us!! Thanks again, Froilán!!!

Very good and safe district, new building, superclean apartment with everything you may need. Close to the beach, and if you need to get to the center - it take just 20 minutes by bike. The district has a good transport connection.
Highly recommended!
Froilán is a very good host, ready to give you a good advice about the city.
Froilán, thank you for a perfect stay.

Great location- close to the Barcelona conference centre. Public transport almost outside the front door. Clean spacious room and bathroom and lovely kitchen. Hospitality was great with coffee,tea and croissants available for breakfast. My host was friendly and kind and available to give directions and tourist advice.
Cool host, hospitable and polite!

It was great staying at Froilan’s place. It had everything we needed for a comfy stay and Froilan’s hospitality was outstanding.
The room is not huge, but you have your own bathroom right outside of the room providing enough private space. The kitchen is fully equipped and from there you have an access to the balcony  where you can enjoy your morning coffee. 
The location of the apartment is well accessible and the area is pretty neat. It takes one 20 - 25 min bus / tram ride to get to the city center and the bus stops are just right outside of the apartment (btw public transportation is pretty cheap in Barcelona). On the opposite side of the street to the apartment there’s a nice park and the beach is also not far away.
I’d be happy to come back to this place!

Froilán is a 5 star host, very friendly, giving a lot of tips, helpfull, always making sure all was great for our stay. He also has the apartment prepared to feel like home, with amazing details such as snacks, umbrella, maps, etc... The apartment itself is modern, clean, with own bathroom, access to kitchen and balcony.

è stata una bellissima esperienza, froilan è una persona davvero speciale che cerca in ogni modo di essere d aiuto ed è sempre disponibile lasciando all ospite la privacy necessaria. la casa è molto pulita, letto comodo e bagno perfetto! sono completamente soddisfatta della mia scelta !

Personne très gentille, d'une grande discrétion et soucieux du bien-être des personnes qu'il reçoit.
Que des (Website hidden by Airbnb) recommande vivement Froìlan

El departamento es excelente, desde la ubicación del departamento hasta los detalles que tiene el lugar. Froilán desde el primer día muestra la mejor predisposición, te ayuda y aconseja en todo (que vías públicas tomar, donde ir a almorzar/cenar e ir a recorrer). Realmente una experiencia muy buena. Recomiendo y volveré!
Отличное местрасположение. Замечательный хозяин. Квартира очень уютная. нам все понравилось! Спасибо Froilan!

We loved staying in Froilán’s place. It is very nice decorated, clean, has all the amenities. Conveniently located near restaurants and the beach. It is quiet at night. We really enjoyed the balcony in the mornings for coffee and in the evening for a glass of wine (provided by the host). On top of all that, Froilán is a kind, gracious host who goes out of his way to make his guests feel comfortable. We felt like we were at home.

Der Aufenthalt war sehr sehr gut! Nach einem Streik unserer Fluggesellschaft  half Froilán uns bei Telefonaten, Bustickets und wir durften sogar spontan noch eine Nacht länger bleiben!
Es war sauber, schön eingerichtet und eine nette Gegend!
Froilán war zu jeder Zeit erreichbar und hatte immer gute Tipps.
Unsere Zeit in Barcelona war wundervoll! Vielen Dank für alles! Wir kommen gerne wieder :)
Froilán a tout fait pour que notre séjour se passe parfaitement bien, rien à redire à part que nous recommandons ce Airbnb à tous, vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés :)

L'appartamento è pulito e ben organizzato. Froilan è disponibile e discreto. La camera da letto è ampia e comoda, con armadio grande. Il bagno ha tutto il necessario, salviette e asciugamani per la doccia. La cucina può essere utilizzata e sono messi a disposizione i fornelli  e anche il microonde, c'è pure uno spazio riservato agli ospiti nel frigo. Il terrazzino è comodo per la colazione all'aperto. L'appartamento non si trova in un quartiere centrale ma è ben collegato da più mezzi pubblici al centro di Barcellona e Froilan ha sempre un consiglio per indicare come spostarsi al meglio.

We stayed in Froilán's apartment for the second time, the location is excellent if you use a bike or public transport. The room, bathroom and other parts of the apartment are in perfect condition. Froilán is always ready to help. Highly recommended!

Our stay at Froiláns place was absolutely perfect! It is in a very friendly and stylish area and is only a 15 minuet walk from the beach and about a 40 minuet walk to the center which we didn't even do because Froilán was kind enough to lend us his bikes for the duration of the stay meaning we were able to get into the city center in less than 15 minuets. We felt very welcome and Froilán was exreamly accommodating even despite the fact we had a late ferry the evening we were leaving! A massive plus was the free and exreamly secure parking in a garage underneath the flat where we were able to leave our car safely for the duration of our stay without any extra cost which was a huge bonus! We can't recommend this place highly enough as it is such good value for money and we would definatly stay here again if we returned to Barcelona. Thankyou!
We were well received and the appartment was great and well Situated. Frolan is really Nice. The host is very discret and has nice simple rules.

Die beste Unterkunft die ich bisher über Airbnb gebucht habe. Froilán ist ein hervorragender Gastgeber und super hilfreich in allen Angelegenheiten. Er hat uns Tipps rund um Barcelona und bevorstehende Veranstaltungen gegeben. 
Ich kann sein Apartment ausdrücklich empfehlen! Danke für deine Gastfreundschaft, Froilán! :)
Excelente lugar parar estar en Barcelona.
Perfect space. Very clean, close to amenities and transportation. Lots of little touches that made it feel like home. Froilán was a very good host. We rarely saw him but he was quick to communicate.

Friolán was such a great host. He helped us with everything, what we need. And even, if we did not meet such often, he was still keen to helped us online. He is really hospitable and nice man. The place was in perfect distance to center and to the beach. As Froilán let us use his bikes, we can discovered a lot of from Barcelona within few days. Thanks a lot :)!

name: Rushcutters Getaway
summary: Spacious sun-filled 100m two bedroom apartment moments walk to Kings Cross, Potts Point, Paddington and Sydney CBD.  Reverse cycle air-conditioning & heating, secure underground parking, Intercom access, visitor parking and fibre to the building wi-fi. There are buses towards the City, Circular Quay, North Sydney, Chatswood and Bondi next to the apartment, there is also Kings Cross train station 6 minutes walk away. Perfect for couples, business travellers and families.

reviews.comments:
We had the pleasure of meeting Marina in Ian's Absence.
Ian's place was fantastic in terms of location, cleanness, hospitality, etc...
Ian, and Marina were easily accessible via email and phone. 
The only drawback was the renovation noise from other units in the building which was out of Ian's control and knowledge.
Overall, we found Ian's place a great place for travellers and would definitely recommend to anyone who has a plan to visit Sydney.

name: Rumo
summary: Localizado no centro da cidade, perto de espaços de arte e cultura, parques, belas paisagens, da estação do metro Carolina Michaelis e os encantos da ribeira do Porto.  Vai adorar, devido ao seu conforto e privacidade!
space: Espaço totalmente privado.

host.host_about:
Sou o Zé Paulo, vivo no centro da Cidade do Porto em Portugal. 
A minha grande paixão é viajar, e convido quem tenha os mesmos gostos que eu, a vir visitar este lindo cantinho que é, Porto/Portugal, País muito interessante com muito, muito para descobrir....

address.government_area: Cedofeita, Ildefonso, Sé, Miragaia, Nicolau, Vitória

reviews.comments: Our experience in Porto was great. My wife and I enjoy the city. The room is near a metro station and if you like walking you can go to the center by this way also. We are very happy, and we meet people very kind, specially Maria that is a great person.
Most friendly host in Porto!

A Maria foi sempre muito atenciosa (antes e durante a viagem) e extremamente simpática. 
É evidente que o quarto foi preparado com muita atenção, com muita limpeza e carinho.
O quarto é uma suíte, a localização é excelente, muito perto do centro da cidade, diversos restaurantes e transporte público.
Caso retorne à cidade, eu consideraria me hospedar novamente nesse quarto.

A Maria foi impecável. Fez mais que o necessário para assegurar que a minha estadia fosse agradável. Garantiu transporte da estação de autocarros até à casa. Como os dias que passei no Porto foram incrivelmente quentes, a Maria arranjou um frigorífico e uma ventoínha para o quarto para me manter fresco. O quarto estava limpo, a cama era confortável e o quarto bem localizado, deslocado da confusão, mas central o suficiente para ir a pé onde quisesse (era também próximo de metro, ainda que não o tenha usado). Recomendo.

Chambre fidèle à la description! Bien située, à vingt petites minutes du centre. Commodités à proximité. Nous avons eu un problème d'odeur non lié à la chambre même, et Maria nous est rapidement venue en aide. Nous la remercierons encore de nous avoir gentiment hébergé. Belle ville et un séjour très agréable!
Maria is a very good hostess, the room was clean, subway, spost a towel when you go to the beach. I definitely recommend :-)
Excelente ubicacion, aunque no conocimos a Maria todo estuvo perfectamente coordinado y muy limpio

Maria est très gentille et très arrangeante.
La chambre était très propre, toute neuve et très bien située par rapport au centre de Porto.
De plus, plusieurs bons restaurants à proximité immédiate.
Séjour d'une nuit seulement, bonne localisation. L'hôte est très accueillante.  Chambre très propre et pratique, seul bémol le lit qui est un peu dur.

La habitación de María perfecta! Muy nueva y baño nuevo. Está un poco alejado de la zona centro pero se llega andando fácilmente. María fue muy atenta y mantuvo comunicación continua antes y durante el viaje. Oporto, maravilloso. Muchas gracias! Leire y María

la chambre était dans la maison de Maria qui est en rénovation.
la chambre était bien rénovée, propre, avec une salle de bain et un wc indépendant et propre à la chambre
le seul petit bémol était le bruit de la rueà cause des (Website hidden by Airbnb) chambre mériterait d'avoir un double vitrage

Siamo stati bene nella stanza di Maria, si trova a 15 minuti a piedi dal centro, in un quartiere tranquillo e sicuro. Abbiamo avuto un piccolo qui pro quo il giorno del nostro arrivo, ma dopo di quello Maria è stata sempre molto disponibile via wh***app a darci informazioni utili per migliorare il nostro soggiorno a Porto. La stanza è molto piccola per due, ma la posizione ottima.

O espaço de Maria é bem localizado, próximo ao Metro. Quando chegamos, o local estava em obras e o cheiro de tinta era muito forte, nas duas primeiras noites o cheiro incomodou bastante e a cama não era confortável. Porém, no geral, o espaço é bom e bem localizado, Maria nos recebeu muito bem e nos explicou direitinho como funcionava a acomodação.

Très bon logement de qualité, accessibilité du métro proche, problème d'insonorisation de la pièce et craquement du parquet qui peut être dérangeant au milieu de la nuit mais logement avec un très bon rapport qualité prix

Maria à été très accueillante, très jolies chambres et appartements en rénovation  (rue plutôt calme) donc tout y est neuf, propre et nickel ^^ bien située à proximité des lieux à visiter ! Obrigado por tudo Maria!

O Zé e a Maria são maravilhosos! O quarto era limpo, as roupas de cama e a casa de banho impecáveis. Foi uma experiência ótima e recomendo a todos! Muito perto do centro, de mercados e padarias! Já vou indicar para amigos que vão a Portugal! 
It was really great! I loved it :)
Trato muy bueno y cerca del metro. Merece la pena
Emplacement ideal et tous les soins et services sont excellents.

Das Zimmer von Zé ist in einem großen Haus gelegen, indem viele Räume vermietet werden. Die Lage ist gut, man erreicht die Innenstadt von Porto fußläufig innerhalb von 15min und es sind Einkaufsmöglichkeiten direkt um die Ecke.
Der Check-in verlief leider nicht so, wie wir es uns gewünscht hätten: auf unsere Nachrichten vor Ankunft wurde nicht geantwortet und als an der angegebenen Adresse niemand öffnete, mussten wir zweimal anrufen, um zu erfahren, dass die falsche Hausnummer angegeben war. Das Zimmer wurde uns auch nicht von Zé gezeigt, sodass wir sie gar nicht kennenlernten in der Zeit. Das Zimmer an sich war nicht schlecht, eine kleine Küche sowie eigenes Bad waren vorhanden. Die Küche war allerdings gar nicht ausgestattet, wir hatten zwar Teller und Besteck, aber keine Töpfe usw. zum Kochen. Auf der angegebenen Handnummer gingen immer verschiedene Leute ran, welche nur Portugiesisch gesprochen haben, sodass wir auch keine Info bekamen, ob wir uns irgendwo Küchenutensilien leihen können. Auch haben wir Zé über Airbnb eine Nachricht geschrieben bezüglich der Ausstattung, bekamen jedoch erst 3 Tage später eine Antwort- das war an unserem letzten Tag. Leider auch sehr negativ ist, dass man wirklich jedes Geräusch der Nebenzimmer hört und die Dämmung des Zimmers auch nicht besonders gut ist, sodass es nachts sehr kalt wird und die Handtücher durch anstauende Feuchtigkeit nicht trockneten.

Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis insgesamt ist okay, jedoch war die fehlende Kommunikationsmöglichkeit ein absolutes no-go. Des Weiteren würden Kleinigkeiten (wie Kleiderhaken, zwei Stühle statt einem am Tisch...) den Aufenthalt deutlich angenehmer gestalten. Wir würden das Zimmer nur eingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

Desde o início Zé foi muito atencioso e imediato nas respostas, esclarecendo tudo para que a estadia fosse a melhor possível. O quarto possui o necessário para uma hospedagem tranquila e com privacidade. A casa inteira, no geral, dispõe uma ótima infra estrutura e a Maria esteve sempre presente para ajudar e tornar ainda melhor os dias que estive hospedado. Localização excelente.
Good and cosy accomodation. The host is so nice and friendly!
Muy bien ubicado y con baño en la habitación  cama cómoda limpieza impecable

Zé Paulo e a equipe que o auxilia, incluindo Manuela, são pessoas excelentes e extremamente dispostas a ajudar. Todas as questões foram solucionadas com rapidez e a comunicação foi ótima. O espaço é adequado e com facilidades que nos agradaram bastante. Recomendo a todos!

Los anfitriones son muy buena gente, atentos para que estuviéramos cómodos en todo momento. La casa está a unos 20 minutos del centro caminando, no necesitamos transporte público en todo el viaje (siempre que no te importe andar). La habitación era cómoda, salvo porque cuando fuimos el tiempo era malo (lluvia y viento, y entre 7 y 15 grados en marzo), y la habitación no tiene calefacción, así que pasamos frío al no tener un calentador.
Por lo demás todo bien, repetiría en casa de Zé en verano, o si solucionase el problema del frío en el resto de épocas del año.
Nice apartment close to city center, metro station and shops. Perfect for short trip to Porto.
très sympa
L'alloggio di Ze è nuovo e molto bello. È vicino al centro di Porto, solo 10 minuti a piedi. Inoltre Ze è stato molto disponibile a rispondere ad ogni nostra richiesta.

Todos os anfitriões são muito simpáticos: Zé, Maria e Manuela. A acomodação é muito bem localizada. Quarto e banheiro super limpos. Disponibilidade para uso de outras utilidades. Nada a reclamar! Ótima experiência!

I am 100% recommend this place for several reasons:
1- Ze and Maria (host) are very kind and helpful, they do their best to understand you using (Hidden by Airbnb) translate hehe, which actually worked very good.
2- The place is clean, fully equipped and ready to use/sleep.
3- close to Lapa station, which is one station away from Trindate. from Trindate you can change to all lines and go any where.
4- The place has a washing machine and a dryer, which I used twice during my staying. Maria helped me to understand the machine instructions since it is in Portuguese.

Finally, I would like to thank Ze and Maria for their great hospitality.
Chambre simple mais propre . Situé à 5mn du métro venant de l'aéroport et à 10 mn à pied du centre de Porto. Coin cuisine  pratique pour se préparer un café . Terrasse agréable au calme
The place is a great value for money. Very well located, private and with all the amenities one may need. Ze was up late waiting for me to arrive and was very helpful. Definitely recommended.
Exellent lieu pour les vacances
Great place
La ubicación es perfecta ... la habitación espaciosa y muy limpia ! Sin lugar a dudas volvería mi próximo viaje a Porto :)

Contact agréable. Le logement est à 15 min à pied du centre historique avec un accès façile aux transports en communs. Logement tres propre et conforme à la description. Seul bémol, la literie n'était pas très confortable.

Tivemos uma Excelente experiência o Zé e a Manuela sempre muito solícitos. Local muito bem localizado a poucos metros da estação do metro. Espaço muito limpo e confortável. Espaço é repleto de muitas comodidades o que nos surpreendeu bastante. Vale lembrar também que os objetivos, a mobília e a cama todos de primeira linha e funcionais o que enaltece ainda mais a excelência deste espaço.
Perfect location! Helpful Host!
Thank you very much for your hospitality.  We are glad that we choose your apartment for staing in Porto.
Tudo certo .

A localização é ótima e o quarto bastante espaçoso, apesar de um pouco abafado pela falta de iluminação natural. O banheiro estava limpo. E a recepção do sr Zé e da Manuela, sra responsável pela limpeza, foram ótimos!
I was very happy with the room. Clean and cozy. Only a walking distance from the airport metro and the beautiful sightseeings. Can recommend to everyone.
L'alloggio è piccolo ma davvero carino.ha tutto quello di cui si può avere bisogno e il centro è raggiungibile in 15 minuti a piedi. lo consiglio!
Zé welcomed us very friendly and we had a nice stay in Porto!
On a passé un séjour très agréable dans la chambre de Ze. Tout est bien, situation, prix, tout est disponible à proximité

The room is simple but it was very clean. Ze was very responsive throughout and check-in was easy. I also like the fact that it is an independent unit with full privacy. On the down side it was very noisy in the mornings due to cleaning in the other rooms and other guests, so we did not sleep well .

name: In the heart of Copacabana - Bolivar 4-5 guests
summary: Apartment in the heart of Copacabana. Close to the main restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. Close to the metro and a few meters from the beach. Photographs taken by Airbnb's own photographer, reflecting reality. Copacabana is a classic and central district, with easy access to great restaurants and services. The apartment is very nice and comfortable, and can receive families and groups.
space: Excellent location, residential building, cozy! Good neighborhood. Excellent price. The apartment has 1 bedroom and can accommodate 5 people.  The bedroom has a double bed and the living room has a sofa bed which can sleep two people. The other guest (fifth) could use the extra mattress, as needed.

The neighborhood never sleeps.  Because it is a tourist neighborhood, policing is reinforced, and the transport network is optimized. There are many choices of restaurants, supermarkets, bakeries, and bars.  The beach has kiosks that work until dawn, as well as the bars with live music. The area that the apartment is located has 2 bakeries and 3 markets in a two-block radius. Ease of access to amazing.

house_rules: Sejam bem vindos  Por se tratar de um prédio residencial a síndica solicita dados dos hóspedes, é compreensível, assim é possível maior segurança para todos. Após a conclusão da reserva eu gostaria que você me enviasse seus dados e dos outros hóspedes que virão com você. Nome completo, estado de origem e número de identidade. --> Lembre-se o check in é após as 15h e o check out antes das 10h. Não é permitida a entrada de animais. Quando sair desligue o ar condicionado e os demais eletrônicos. Sei que o calor do Rio é forte, mas por favor tenha esse zelo. Por favor, não fume dentro do apartamento. Não faça barulho de 22h às 07h. Lembre-se da lei do silencio. Não faça festas, não incomode os vizinhos. Coloque saco nas lixeiras ao utiliza-las e lembre-se sempre de colocar o lixo na lixeira. Sejam bem vindos a Cidade Maravilhosa! :)

reviews.comments: Descrição precisa e adequada. Entregou exatamente o que se propôs!
Miria é uma pessoa muito prestativa, o apartamento cumpre o que está descrito no anúncio, localização muito boa. Recomendo a todos os usuários Airbnb.
Uma excelente experiência. A Miria foi muito gentil e o espaço limpo, confortável e super bem localizado.

Apto espaçoso. Idêntico as fotos. 
O único problema foi com o chuveiro, nao funcionava no quente e estávamos viajando com uma bebe. Mesmo no Calor do Rio, ela nao poderia tomar banho frio. 
Mas demos um jeito. 
Fora isso, foi ótimo. 
Localização muito boa, próximo a mercados, bancos, ponto de ônibus.
Great apartment just 3 blocks away from the glorious Copacabana beach! One block toMetro! Miria is lovely! Her daughter was really helpful translating for us! :-)

Fui muito bem recebida pela Miria.
O apartamento dela é muito bom e espaçoso.
Ela foi muito tranquila e simpática.
O local é muito bom e o prédio tmb.
Vou ficar lá mais vezes!!!

A estadia no apartamento da Miria foi incrível! Localização maravilhosa, apartamento excelente, muito limpo e tinha TUDO que precisamos para passar uma semana perfeita na cidade maravilhosa. Só precisei falar com a Miria no check in e no check out. Hospedagem melhor que em muitas pousadas/hotéis que já me hospedei. Local muito próximo da praia, do metrô, de farmácias, supermercados, padarias. E a Miria é uma excelente pessoa, muito atenciosa e carinhosa. Muito obrigado, Miria!
Localização muito boa. Muito perto de estação de metrô e avenidas que passa bários ônibus. O prédio é bem legal! Super bem atendido. Recomendo o apt. Só uma pena não ter WiFi.
El departamento es amplio y muy cómodo. Está súper bien ubicado y estaba impecable cuando llegamos. Lo recomiendo

La relación precio y calidad es muy buena.
La zona es segura y hay negocios muy cerca.

O espaço é muito bom, bem dividido. Fica a 50 m de uma rua super movimentada, mas mal se ouvem os carros e ônibus passarem. Tudo silencioso, tranquilo. Ótimo endereço, prédio super familiar. Um quarteirão do metrô e das principais vias de Copacabana. Perto de tudo. Adorei minha estada no apertamento da Miria, muito obrigada por toda hospitalidade e flexibilidade.
Ótima localização e otimo espaço!
Um espaço bem aconchegante, arejado, fácil acesso a tudo com metrô logo ao lado. Miriam bem atenciosa, e apartamento super limpo
Súper bien ubicado

Eu e um amigo ficamos 4 dias no apartamento da Miria. Achamos a localização excelente, na quadra ao lado do metrô e a poucas quadras da praia de Copacabana. Os porteiros do prédio são prestativos e a região é segura. Adoramos e pretendemos voltar!

O espaço é muito bom, condizente com o valor cobrado, o local em que fica também é muito bom, próximo as praias e tranquilo. O que ficou a desejar é não possuir Wi-Fi, essencial para quem esta em uma viagem.

Apartamento de excelente localização, perto de supermercados, padarias, farmácias, bancos, restaurantes e a poucos quarteirões da praia. Local seguro e com possibilidade de andar a pé tranquilamente. É perto do metrô, ponto de ônibus e estação de bikerio. Só achei a cama de casal um pouco desconfortável, pois ela está irregular, senti falta também de Wi-fi, porém vale o custo-benefício.

Miria foi muito simpática em todos os momentos, desde antes da chegada ate o checkout. Sempre disponível para tirar dúvidas. Jamais encontraríamos um local tão bom por 68 reais na diária. Pertissimo do metrô, à poucas quadras de Ipanema e da praia de Copacabana (aproximadamente 3), perto de  comércio e de 4 mercados. O condomínio é seguro (porteiro 24h) e silencioso. Não possui maquina de lavar mas para mim e meu namorado isso não foi um problema (lavamos na mão mesmo), além de ter varias lavanderias ao redor. Aconselharia apenas aos próximos hóspedes que levassem toalha (pois é um item bem pessoal). O quarto era um pouco diferente da foto pois tinha um guarda roupa e uma bicama, mas isso não é um problema. O quarto possui ar condicionado e a sala um ventilador bem forte. Agradeço a Miria por toda hospitalidade e sem duvidas voltarei ao apartamento quando precisar me hospedar no Rio.
Segunda vez que fico no apartamento da Miria, local maravilhoso! Só tenho a agradecer pela hospitalidade. Obrigado :)
Departamento super recomendable, cómodo y de excelente ubicación!

Apartamento super confortável para 4 pessoas, bem arejado, gostoso de ficar, ótima localização, tem um estação de metrô (Cantagalo) que faz conexões a varios  pontos turístico da cidade, tem uma panificadora logo na entrada do prédio, mercados próximos  e uma avenida repleta de restaurante para quem optar comer fora... poucas quadras da orla, super tranquilo para andar à noite  e caso prefere andar nas bike Itaú, tem no mínimo 2 pontos de encontro, ahh! Pode ir com elas  até Ipanema. Amamos o lugar e o apartamento.  Voltaremos mais vezes Miria, obrigado pela recepção . Ahhh, os porteiros são super simpáticos também .

Nuestra estadía en este departamento estuvo excelente. Gran ubicación, cerca de muchos mercados, a una cuadra del metro y a pocas de la playa de Copacabana. La atención recibida por Miria fue muy amable y siempre estuvo a disposición. Eramos 3 personas y estuvimos muy cómodos, si vuelvo a viajar de manera similar, sin duda elegiría este lugar nuevamente.

host.host_about: We live in Kent, WA, USA.

reviews.comments: Condo was as pictured. Nice to have a washer and dryer. Convenient location for day trip to kayak/snorkel Kealakekua Bay or to head into Kona town. Walking distance to groceries. Lovely lanai for sunsets.

Diese Unterkunft war sehr sauber und das Condo war modern ausgestattet. Die Lage war phantastisch.
Man konnte aus der zweiten Etage das Meer sehen. Wir haben jeden Morgen auf der Veranda gefruehstueckt.
Die Anlage war sehr gepflegt und der Gemeinschaftspool sehr sauber.
Die Lage war sehr gut, waren aber schon mal im Sheraton in der Naehe, kannten also die Gegend.Keine 3 Minuten mit dem Auto zum Supermarkt.
Es war sehr ruhig, man konnte sich wirklich erholen.

Place was bigger than expected, very airy, had the feeling of living outside (a plus) kitchen, appliances and dishes had a slight mildew smell understandable since place is pretty open. Dishwasher isn't the best, felt better washing our own dishes (didn't mind). Certain areas of the condo I felt needed better vacuuming job before we got there since shoes were not allowed in the condo, (personal preference) and we were walking around barefoot. Screen doors weren't very secure surprised they kept as much bugs out as it did :) view from both balconies was amazing, surrounding property is beautiful. Was nice to see previous tenants leaving odd items behind for use, so as we, left couple floating noodles, sunblock, aloe, and few non perishable items.. Also nice convenient was extra beach/towels.

Nice little condo in a pretty resort area.  Great view and updated kitchen with nice furniture.  Nice little updated resort pool.  Downsides: No bathtub, one tiny awkward shower, no air conditioning, very early 10 am checkout and late check in at 4 pm, Realtor lock box on door, cleaning crew arrived at 9:55 am while we were leaving from our stay.
Great view, good value,nice location

name: Chic City Pad with Leafy Outlook
summary: Recently renovated and truly spacious studio apartment in the heart of Potts Point. Within walking distance to some of Sydney's best attractions and an easy 8 min walk to Kings Cross Train Station. Beautifully renovated and appointed, you will have access to free Wi-Fi, the new kitchen with cooking facilities, washer & dryer and the building's stunning pool!  The space works for solo adventurers and business travellers, with the comfortable queen sized bed making it perfect for couples.
space: My studio apartment is beautifully renovated and spacious, with a super comfortable queen sized wall bed, making it perfect for a relaxing stay in Sydney. There is a full sized kitchen with cooking facilities, if you feel liked a home cooked meal and coin operated clothes washing and drying facilities on every floor of the building.  Access to the apartment is hassle free, through the gorgeous new entry foyer and up the newly refurbished lifts. The apartment has free wireless internet and a HD TV, with access to online movie rental services, if you feel like staying in. I know you will love the space and the city views from the large windows, as I have endeavoured to see to every detail, to make your trip and stay as comfortable and convenient as possible.

neighborhood_overview: Potts Point is one of Sydney's premier suburbs. Its tree lined streets, beautiful old apartment blocks and easy access to Sydney CBD, Royal Botanical Gardens, Woolloomooloo Wharf, Circular Quay and all of Sydney's best attractions, make it one the most desirable places to live and visit in Sydney. You'll love the local cafe and restaurant scene and the gorgeous boutique shopping that is literarily on your doorstep. A perfect place to base yourself for your stay in Sydney.
transit: Kings Cross Station is an 8 min walk straight down Macleay and Victoria Streets, where you can directly access all of Sydney and the Airport. Potts Point is a popular suburb close the CDB, so there is also a multitude of bus services on your doorstep and there is never a shortage of taxis.
access: You will have full access to all the facitilities of the apartment, such as kitchen, bathroom, laundry, wireless internet etc.  The building also features a swimming pool, which you are welcome to use at your leisure.
interaction: I will be available 24hrs each day during your stay, just phone or email me. I will also most likely be there to check you in and show you around the apartment when you arrive in Sydney.

host.host_about: Hi I'm Vickie! I am an avid traveller who loves my city and Airbnb allows me to share it with you and!!! I truly enjoy meeting new people and look forward to welcoming you to my beautiful city.

reviews.comments:
Spend a great 2 nights at Vickie's studio. Well decorated, had everything we need and surprisingly spacious. It was my first time in Sydney, so the location was just perfect; many good cafes and restaurants near by.

Vickie is an amazing host, she made sure we were comfortable and well adjusted. Great person to communicate with.

Merci Victoria pour votre charmant accueil, votre appartement est charmant dans un quartier animé avec des cafés et restaurants à proximité. 15 mn à pied de CBD et de l'opéra de Sydney. La vue de l'appartement est dégagée et très bien exposé.
Merci pour vos messages de compassion suite aux attentants de Nice. Je vous recommande cette adresse.
Fabienne

What a fabulous Studio in the centre of Potts Point. I was lucky enough to be one of the first to stay here. Everything is lovely, fresh and new. It's quiet, but at the same time has everything on the doorstep. Vickie is a wonderful host and made sure I was comfortable.

Vickie was a lovely host and did everything she could to help and make our stay enjoyable. The apartment is in an excellent position - close to restaurants and cafes as well as walking distance from the city. The apartment itself is great with a very comfortable bed and has everything you need.

Vickie is an amazing host with a beautiful apartment. Location is incredible- right by lovely restaurants and bars, and only a quick ride into the city. The apartment itself was gorgeous- so clean, light and airy. Queen bed is super comfortable as well. I highly recommend this apartment, and would love to stay here again. Perfect Airbnb experience.

The apartment was exactly like the photos, brand new and very clean.
The bed was a fold out from the wall, very comfy and the pillow and blankets were amazing.
Perfect apartment! Great local restaurants and supermarket across the road. Perfect and professional communication from the host. Well done. I will stay here for business again.

Great location! A very nice area with lots of bars, shops and restaurants close by and a nice stroll to the city. Clean, modern and comfortable apartment. Very friendly and helpful hosts who were great at communicating and made us feel very welcome. We would definitely stay there again!

The studio was clean and nicely furnish. The sofa and bed are comfortable, and the apartment has a ledge by the window with chairs to people-watch in the day. It has everything necessary for a short term and long term stay. There is a big TV with chromecast that was so useful when my partner and I simply hung in the apartment after a day of exploring.

Victoria was prompt in responses and prepare materials abt the area and the facilities that were very useful. Check-in process was very easy. 

Highly recommended, and will be very happy to be hosted by her again when I visit Sydney.
Apartments is small but it is nice and well located. The street is good and plenty of good restaurants and just 5min walking to king cross station

We really enjoyed our stay at Victoria's place. It was a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location; close to all shops and amenities. Kings cross is only a short walk away but most days we walked through the beautiful botanic gardens to Central Quays. 
We really appreciated being able to stay until after lunch on our leaving day. The apartment was beautifully clean and although cosy had everything we needed.
Vickie was an excellent host and responded to any queries very promptly despite being away at the time.
I would definitely stay at this apartment again if visiting Sydney.

We stayed at Vickie's apartment for five nights and we enjoyed it a lot. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures and it's well-equipped, beautiful and cozy (the bed is especially comfortable). 
Victoria was very friendly and easy to communicate with. When we had issues with the wifi, she immediately came over and sorted everything out, although it was already 8 or 8.30 in the evening. She also gave us a lot of information about restaurants, bars and sights in the area. All of her recommendations were really good too!
We had an amazing time in Sydney, thanks to our great host Vickie and her lovely apartment. We can definitely recommend this place! :)

Victoria è un Host perfetto. Ci siamo sentiti molto spesso per cordinare il viaggio. La casa è molto vicina al centro molto pulita e graziosa.  Se dovessi tornare a Sydney sicuramente sceglierò nuovamente questo appartamento.

Vickie is The perfect host. She is very nice and polite. The apartment was cute and clean. The location of the flat is good and Vickie gives you recommendations of were to have good meals next to it. We would definetly come back there if we ever came to Sydney again!

Victoria's Chic City Pad was an an excellent stay!! She made my friend and I feel really welcomed from the start! She communicated clearly about the arrival time and gave us great advice about the city. She also checked in regularly to ensure we were enjoying our stay. The neighbourhood is very posh, a less than 30 minute walk from the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, as well as the Botanical Gardens. It was easy to find from Kings Cross train station and we loved the modern feel and look of the flat.
Great apartment close to everything. Vickie was really easy to communicate with on our arrival and knowledgable of the area too! highly reccomend.
The apartment was amazing. Perfect location. So comfortable and had everything we needed. Victoria was communicative and attentive. Would love to come back.
Awesome location and great host. Flexible with arrival and departure needs too. Thanks for a great stay Vickie!

Victoria was super quick to respond to all questions, the location is amazing, great area for cafes and bars, also very central to close to the train so it's very to get around.  Lovely and clean space, it was a pleasure to stay

Check in was very easy. Victoria was there to meet me, explained the area, where everything was and was very helpful in letting me check out later. It was a great stay, definitely recommend the space for any solo travellers and the area for anyone who is looking for great food, and a nice relaxing atmosphere.

Victoria's apartment was perfect for exploring Sydney for the weekend. It's comfortable, well equipped and super convenient to everything Potts Point has to offer. Victoria was a great host too, meeting me on check in and showing me where everything was in the apartment. I'll be back if I need to stay in the area again :)

Victoria's place saved me from a terrible previous Air b&b experience I was in. It was extremely clean, comfortable, quiet, and relaxing. She was more than helpful when I arrived and had great pointers on what to do in the area. I wish I could've stayed longer! Highly recommend her place.
Victoria was a very welcoming host. Her place is excellently located

Loved staying in this apartment! Perfect location to walk / jog down to Botanical gardens & Sydney Opera House & Sydney Harbour Bridge! Which we did Worthing 1hour of checking in! Lovely secure building with nice friendly reception staff. Check in was easy- Vickie's communication was so great- although she couldn't make it when we checked in- she sent her lovely son who showed us all we needed to know! The apartment itself has a nifty pull down (wall) bed which is super comfortable - more than initially expected! 

The apartment has perfect use of the space- lots of natural light and natural decor- nice and fresh! 

Perfect size for a short 3day break in Sydney! Beware of the shower- quite a puzzle to regulate the hot and cold when having a shower... 
Overall a great stay- highly recommend!

Perfect host! Vickie was so helpful and full of great recommendations. 
The location is perfect! Such a lovely area! 
Great coffee across the road at Bottega Del Vino (and that's coming from a melbourner).
Across the road from Woolworths, lovely bookshop down the road and great restaurants on your doorstep! 
The apartment is small but full of light! 
Perfect for two people. 
Will be staying back here if ever in Sydney again.

Vickie was an absolute lovely host!  She rushed to clean the studio and get us in as early as possible and was an absolutely amazing communicator.  She helped with any and all questions even while staying at other locations throughout Sydney.  I highly recommend her studio as she is prompt and a joy to be around!
The apartment is lovely and the area is simply perfect. A fantastic walk through the Botanical Gardens to Sydney's CBD. Loads of great restaurants, bars and cafes on your doorstep.
The apartment is in a great location in Potts Point.  There are many restaurants, cafes, and markets right outside the door.  We really enjoyed our time!
Victoria was a very gracious and friendly host! The apartment was clean and as described. She gave us a lot of great recommendations for the area, as well.

Victoria was at the studio apt to greet us, show us where everything was and to give us advice on finding our way around Sydney. She was very pleasant and helpful.  The apt was very clean, had all we needed and was easily accessible to the CBD, the Opera House and harbour. Lots of restaurants, cafes, shops close by plus a food market right across the street.   A very nice and secure building.

A great experience staying at Victoria's place in Potts Point! Cozy place with great views.. we loved looking out the windows at the comings and goings of the street below. Also very centrally located, it was easy getting anywhere! Everything you need is available at the apartment and with Woolies just across the street, it was easy getting anything else you need too. Victoria is very responsive, and a pleasure to communicate with. Thanks for the great stay Vickie!

Cozy place to stay for a few days. We had a minor issue in the apartment and Victoria was quick to respond and provided a quick fix. The location is  walking distance to the botanical garden with access to grocery store across the street and good restaurants along the street.  Would stay again if we return for a visit in the future.

Vickie is a great host! Such a lovely and helping women, we had a wonderful time at the apartment.
I can totally recommend Vickies Apartment for a trip to Sydney and would definitely stay there again, if I get a chance to.
The apartment looks just like on the pictures, you will find everything nice and clean. The kitchen is perfect for having breakfast and little snacks at the apartment, but you can cook there as well.
The train station is within walking distance. However we mostly walked into the city as you can walk by the water and see the main attractions (opera house, Harbour Bridge). It's a nice walk of about 20min.
Vickie was very helpful with every question we had and replied within shortest time.
THANK YOU for everything, Vickie!

We loved staying here!  
Vickie was the ultimate host:  Timely, clear communication, extra amenities, and useful tips for this ideally-located (easy walk to key areas) fun, funky, highly diverse neighborhood with a great vibe.
Stay HERE, you'll be glad you did.
We had a great time in Sydney staying at Vickie's lovely flat. The location was perfect, the flat was well furnished, and Vickie gave us a great welcome. Thanks for letting us stay.
Great little place in a perfect location ... bright and clean

Amazing experience with Vickie, even though she was unable to be there when we arrived she made the process a breeze and phoned us to make sure we had everything we needed. Vickie was quick to respond to messages and any problems we had. She also provided chocolates, milk and coffee for us until we were able to get to the shops (which is only across the road). The appartment is super close to everything! takes about 25 minute walk to the cbd, and 10 mins to kings cross station which was perfect for us. I would  100% recommend Vickie to anyone who needs a place to stay in Sydney. Thank you again!!
Victoria was a super host. The place was very clean and looked just like the pictures. It was in prime location. We thoroughly enjoyed staying there.

Die Unterkunft liegt ca. 20min zu Fuß vom Zentrum entfernt. Der Check- in verlief unkompliziert, Viktoria war vor Ort und hat uns viele gute Tipps für Sydney gegeben.  Es gibt sehr viele gute Restaurants und Cafe's in der Nähe. 
Das Appartement war 
sehr sauber, ausreichend groß und das ausklappbare Bett war sehr bequem. Eine kleine Küchennische war ebenfalls vorhanden, wo man alles für ein kleines Frühstück finden konnte. 
Wir würden auf jeden Fall diese Unterkunft noch einmal wählen!

We had a great stay at Vickie's gorgeous pad! Vickie is super easy to deal with,  the apartment is well lite and quite spacious and close to all main shops, cafes and public transport - the perfect spot for a girls night out! The bed is extra comfortable too. Thank you Vickie ☺
Clean & spacious apartment for two. 5-10 mins walk to King's Cross Station. Woolworths right across the street. Victoria was very nice to wait for us at the foyer for check-in, highly recommended!
You would enjoy Victoria and she is very helpful with any suggestions on what to do in Sydney and questions and help with anything to do with Sydney.  Enjoyed her company as well.

Ein fantastisches kleines Appartment im pulsierenden Stadtteil Potts Point. Alles hat gepasst! Vickie hat uns um Anreisetag herzlich empfangen und uns viele nützliche Tipps gegeben. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können Vickie und ihr Appartment nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen.

We stayed in Victoria's place for a bit more than a week. The location is just outstanding; cafes, restaurants, cinema, public transport....everything is so close and nevertheless the flat is quiet at night and with air conditioning perfectly temperature wise at night during summer. We loved our time in the flat and thanks to Victoria it was a perfect start.

L'appartement de Victoria est très beau, très agréable, bien situé, très propre, il est parfait. Nous avons adoré ce logement. Il y a tout à proximité, transports, cafés, restaurants, supermarché, à 30 minutes à peine à pied de l'opéra de Sydney et son centre-ville. AMAZING! The apartment made my trip to Sydney- such a chic space in an awesome neighborhood. Am already planning my trip back!

This is a lovely little apartment in a great area.  Benefits are being close to Kings Cross train station so you can train straight from the airport changing at Central. You can walk into the city through the gardens.  Having a supermarket across the road is great too. Highly recommend this place.
Great location, really clean, funky apartment. Good for one or two travellers. Generous supplies and easy communication. Highly recommended!
really good location in Potts point close to everything. Host suggestions  were great and was really helpful. I'd recommend this apartment had all the essentials. small and cosy.
We had a really good time, the apartment is as great as advertised. Perfect place to discover Sydney, by foot and public transport.
Great little apartment, amazing location
Thanks a lot for a very pleasant stay at your apartment! We enjoyed it and recommed it! Also you are an amazing friendly host!
A great place to stay in Sydney.

Victoria's apartment was perfect for us.  We enjoyed the area for its cleanliness, restaurants and cafés.  The convenience to the train after a busy day to come "home" was very nice.   An easy walk to central city was our daily preference. 

Victoria's apartment is well equipped and clean.   Everyday we were pleased to wake up there.  We would definitely return to Victoria's Chic City Pad with leafy outlook.

Thanks Victoria for offering  your apartment to others, especially to us!!
 Bruce and Alston Johnson 
from Virginia, USA
Great location!
房东很贴心,提前几天提供了入住指南而且很清晰,能够方便自助入住｡房间干净整洁,还贴心准备了牛奶果汁巧克力,还有健康的麦片和不健康的泡面,非常全面｡房子距离最近的火车站十分钟,公交站就在楼下,不过悉尼公交经常延误｡房子对面有超市和药店很方便,附近有邮局,沿路很多吃东西的地方｡总体非常好,值得再次入住｡
Nice little place for a short Stay, food for breakfast including coffee was provided and the area is great as you have nice cafes and Restaurants close.

El apartamento de Victoria es genial! La ubicación es excelente, muy cerca del centro y de la estación King Cross. El barrio es bellísimo! Estaba super completo, con todo lo que podría necesitar, tanto en la cocina como en el baño..... muy recomendable!!!! Lo volvería a elegir!!

Amazing apartment in a lovely part of Sydney. The apartment has everything you need during your stay and more. Victoria was a fantastic host and I wouldn't hesitate to stay again. A 20 minute walk via the botanical gardens to the opera house, makes it ideal for exploring the city!

We had a great stay at Vickie’s apartment. The location is central and there are plenty of nice places to eat and also a supermarket across the road. Vickie was very helpful in messages as unfortunately we didn’t get a chance to meet. I would definitely stay again!

This apartment was perfect. Its a great location with easy access to transport around Sydney and most places are within walking distance. The local area surrounding the apartment is very nice, with lots of restaurants, bars and shops.

The apartment was very clean and ideal for us as a couple. Check in was straight forward with good communication from Vickie. Would happily stay here again.
Excellent location, walking distance to the Opera house, plenty of restaurants around. The Airbnb unit is very nice, clean and comfortable for 2 in a very secure apartment building
Great place to stay if you plan on staying a night or two. A little farther than I expected to the opera house. Had to Uber
Great place to stay at!

This was a wonderful stay; the location could not be more convenient and trendy. Vicki provided excellent local recommendations, which was helpful due to the sheer volume of cafes and restaurants within walking distance. The room was comfortable and clean, and Vicki went well above and beyond to save me when I'd locked important personal items inside the room after checkout (I don't want every guest taking advantage of her emergency hospitality, but I can't thank her enough)!
A great apartment ideal location, very clean and everything perfect
Exceeded expectations!
This is a perfect place to explore Sydney from, and Vickie is an excellent host!

Couldn’t be a better location. There’s a food store across the street to stock up and you could spend a month just exploring in walking distance.  The laundry down the hall was very nice to have or you can use a laundry mat across the street.  I’d seek out this very spot if I return to Sydney.

I did not have the opportunity to meet Vickie, but everything was clearly and quickly communicated. The apartment is beautifully and functionally decorated, with everything present you could need. The internet is fast and reliable, the kitchen well-equipped. I slept very well in the bed, with a choice of pillow hardness. The place is perfectly located, not far from restaurants, and a very lovely 30' stroll through the impressive botanical gardens to the Opera House. Highly recommended place to stay!

Great location with choices for everything you might need (cafes, restaurants, supermarket, transport (bus, rail to CBD), within easy reach.  For walkers, wending your way down to Woolloomooloo, Mrs Macquarie's Chair & Botanical Gardens is a treat.  Vickie's city pad is a comfortable, tidy, pleasant retreat with a lovely view.  The immediate surroundings are excellent, as is the building in which the apartment is situated.

Our stay in Sydney in Victoria's apartment was great. It is nicely and conveniently located in the beautiful Elizabeth Bay area. Public transport can be reached easily and even a walk to the Opera House is easily possible. The apartment is small but equipped with everything that two people need. Even breakfast and coffee was there. We would stay here again!
Perfect base for exploring the city and very well equipped.

The actual unit is in a great location and we enjoyed the walk to the Royal Botanical gardens and Sydney Opera House.  There is also a nice coffee spot down the street.  Unfortunately, in the listing, it says there is free street parking and we could not find any free street parking.  Upon arrival I called the host about the free street parking and she said there was not any.  We would have to park in the paid garage next to the premises, which would be $30-40 per night.  Or drive into another neighborhood (not close) to maybe find street parking.  We were staying 3 nights so that could be up to $90.  I would have figured out a different place or other parking arrangements if I knew ahead of time.  Later she messaged and said that the free street parking is limited by time.  I feel that is quite unfair to say free street parking if it is only for 1 hour or so.  So if you are traveling with a car, this is something to consider.

Victoria's studio apartment is a compact space that is thoughtfully outfitted. The location is great with plenty of amenities within easy walking distance and an easy bus connection to the CBD. Simple meals can be cooked in the kitchen on the hot plate and microwave, however even that can be tricky as there is no extra counter space to do prep or hold hot items other than on the hot plate. Victoria was very accommodating and attentive in her communications.
Amazing location, nice cozy apartment !
good location, nice & clean apartment plus if you need anything Victoria is super fast in answering, would stay here again :)

Very clean, lift very useful, many extras (milk, juice, coffee, etc., pamphlets to discover the city), host very quick to answer our questions, well decorated, 30 minute walk from opera house. Would recommend
A fab apartment in a great location. The view from the big window is lovely and great for people watching. The cafe at Elizabeth Bay Marina is a must for breakfast. Victoria was a great host.

What a great apartment and host. 
Vickie made our stay amazing, a very lovely person.
The place was very modern and clean. At arrival Vickie welcomed us with som
good info about the area and Sydney, and some sweets.
Apartments location was really good, and a lot of great restaurants.
We can't wait to revisit and stay at this great place again.
Love Max and Daniella.

Saubere Unterkunft mit perfekter Lage um Sydney zu erkunden. Die Sehenswürdigkeiten sind fußläufig erreichbar.
Das Apartment ist klein aber völlig ausreichend für 2 Personen und gut ausgestattet. Wir würden uns wieder für dieses Apartment entscheiden.

시티에서 조금 떨어져있는 거리지만
시티까지 가는 버스가 도보2분 거리에 있고
중대형 마트가 집앞에 바로 있어서 편했어요! 실내는 정말 깨끗하고 잘 정돈되어 있었고 햇빛도 정말 잘 들어옵니다!
Victoria’s place is amazing! Great location with a short walk into the CBD, clean and tidy, tips about the local area and much more. Would recommend to anyone!

I arranged this Airbnb for my parents to come visit Sydney and Victoria was more than happy to help them with instructions and personal requests! Will definitely stay again. My parents thought the place was beautiful and were so excited they kept sending me photos of their stay! Well done Victoria! Thank you so much.
Well located and comfortable place. Generous host. Clear communication. Comfortable bed and pillows. Great shower. All good! Highly recommended.

Fabulous location with wonderful restaurants in walking distance.    

It was also an easy walk into the city taking only about 20 minutes.  In addition, the hop on hop off bus picks up just down the street.   

Victoria provided excellent communication throughout our booking process as well as the check in process.
Compact and well located. A great place for a short stay in Sydney.

Victoria’s place was spacious enough for two people and very clean studio. Its location was pretty good. She helped me and responded very quickly whenever I needed her. There is public coin washing machine and dryer on the same floor ($3 each) Everything was quite pleasant and safe.

name: bonita y comoda habitacion en el piso céntrico
summary: Lugares de interés: Bar Cañete, teatro Liceu, Ramblas, Mercat Boqueria, Maremagnum, Barrio Gótico, Born......, Mercat de Sant Antoni. Te va a encantar mi lugar debido a los techos altos y la ubicación. Habitación es amplia y muy tranquila. A dos minutos de las Ramblas y teatro Liceu. Vive un gato conmigo. Es muy tranquilo. No molesta. pero aviso por si  eres alérgico. Bienvenido!
description: Lugares de interés: Bar Cañete, teatro Liceu, Ramblas, Mercat Boqueria, Maremagnum, Barrio Gótico, Born......, Mercat de Sant Antoni. Te va a encantar mi lugar debido a los techos altos y la ubicación. Habitación es amplia y muy tranquila. A dos minutos de las Ramblas y teatro Liceu. Vive un gato conmigo. Es muy tranquilo.
