reviews.comments: Tres bonne accueil, souriante
Quartier sympa proche de la rambla, hôte sympathique, logement propre

Hatten einen sehr netten Aufenthalt bei Kateryna. Das Zimmer ist sauber und groß genug für 2 Leute. Kateryna selber haben wir leider nicht kennengelernt, sondern nur ihre Mama Nadya. Sie war freundlich, zuvorkommend und sehr kommunikativ. Das Zimmer ist sehr zentral und nur wenige Minuten vom Hafen und den Las Ramblas entfernt.

Hey Kateryna and Alex,
It was great to stay at your comfortable, cozy and beautiful place. You were very kind and nice;))), we felt very welcome.
The breakfast you made for us was a big suprise, thank you for that!!!
Your open handed personality made us feel like home...
Thank's for the nice stay.;)))
Leonarda&Stefanie

Kateryna and Alex are truly the perfect hosts! They responded to our request immediately and greeted us with warm welcome, open house and a smile. Our room was beautiful and clean, also the entire house. Katya gave us clean towels to shower, gave us free access to use the kitchen and made us feel at home.
The location is perfect, a minute walk from the boqueria market and la ramble. We definitely recommend this host!!!

Kateryna and Alex are super hosts! we contacted Kateryna pretty late and she responded immediately. From the moment we got Katya and Alex made us feel at home, and we're very welcoming. Our room was beautiful and the entire home was clean and present. Katya gave clean towels to shower and let us use the kitchen freely.  The house is in a perfect location, one minute from La Boquria market and La rambla.... we had great time staying at their place it was just perfect!
sólo para decir que estamos saliendo y pasamos una muy buena semana en casa. Espero que la traducción es buena. tchao

L'accoglienza è stata eccellente.  Katerina è molto gentile e disponibile. La zona era proprio ideale è ci siamo trovati bene . L'unica cosa era il rumore fastidiosissimo di un generatore elettrico di un vicino. Nel 2016... non ci dovrebbero essere sui balconi! Comunque, in casa tutto ok!

Очень классное жилье. Гостеприимная хозяйка приняла нас раньше положенного времени. Рассказала о городе, посоветовала интересные места для знакомства с городом. Комната чистая, в одной минуте ходьбы от Рамбла, но ночью тихо. Все вышло лучше, чем можно было предположить. Катя, спасибо

Very nice place in the centre of Barcelona! You are just some steps from the main pedestrian street, public transport and all the bars and restaurants, and 30 min walking to the beach! Kateryna is very nice and welcoming, and always prepared to help and make your stay perfect. The room is great. Thank you for everything! Cheers, Heike & Paulina
Kateryna and Alex are wonderfull and they have a lovely cat. The house is very nice and close to everything. In my next visit to Barcelona I will stay again for sure.

Kateryna est très gentille et très accueillante tout comme son chat Sherlock qui est très mignon. L'appartement est proche de la rambla et d'une station de métro. Restaurants, bars,... Au pied de l'immeuble. L'immeuble est assez insalubre et peu rassurant mais l'appartement de Kateryna est bien. Une super hôte ! Adorable ...
Very nice stay at Kateryna's place ! The location is ideal, all the center of Barcelona is reachable by foot. We felt like home in her flat. I recommand it
The location is very good and Kateryna is very nice, she replied my message very quickly every time. Although we just spent short time in this home, it is so sweet and the cute cat is frendly.

Kateryna war eine unfassbar nette Gastgeberin, die mir gleich bei der Ankunft herzlich entgegen kam und hatte kein Problem damit, ihr Apartment zu teilen. Ihr Zuhause hat wirklich die perfekte Lage für einen Aufenthalt in Barcelona - zentral gelegen, konnte man wirklich alles zu Fuß erreichen und abends war man in Windeseile von La Rambla und den nächsten Bars im Zimmer. Alles war sauber und hatte seine Richtigkeit und auch wenn Kateryna tagsüber meist arbeiten war, hatte man immer ihre flauschige Katze zum kuscheln und betüdeln :) ich würde jederzeit wieder bei Kateryna wohnen, wenn ich es noch einmal nach Barcelona schaffe!
Die Unterkunft ist sehr zentral gelegen und hat ein grosses Zimmer. Die Gastgeberin ist total nett und auch die Katze war sehr lieb. Ein idealer Ausgangspunkt um die Stadt zu Fuss zu erkunden.

Mi estadía en el piso de Kateryna fue excelente. Ella es muy amable y atenta a todo lo que puedas necesitar. La habitación y el baño son amplios y cómodos. La ubicación no podría ser mejor, muy cerca de las principales atracciones de la ciudad. El broche de oro fue su gato que es super cariñoso. Cuando vuelva a Barcelona, seguramente elegiré quedarme en lo de Kateryna.

very friendly host, so kind and gladly helped us when needed :)
the room was clean and it was a cosy appertment in a perfect location, and frankly a very good price when you compare with other places.
also the cat sherlock was super cute and nice company ^-^
when i go back to Barcelona i would like to come back here! ;)
Great stay, just what we wanted right in the center and super friendly. Thank you
My girlfriend and I are already planning another stay...just to see Sherlock! Fantastic accommodation
Good location and nice host
The host canceled this reservation the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Wszystko zgodne z opisem oferty.

This was the perfect place for us. The hosts were cheerful and very friendly. Place is in a good location, off La Rambla. Nice and quite flat, kind of unexpected for this part of Barcelona. We already miss Sherlock and  hopefully we can go back very soon. Thanks Kateryna!
Malgré une arrivée tres tardive Katharina est restée disponible pour nous accueillir. Le logement est très bien : bonne situation, propre et agréable. Nous reviendrons sans hésitation
We had a great stay. Located close by the Ramblas, close to the metro and in the centre of Barcelona. The apartment was nice as well.
Good location, clean and comfortable apartment, lovely shower and lovely cats :)

L'entrée de l'immeuble est sordide et très dégradée, mais logement bien placé puisque proche de la Rambla et du métro. Chambre de taille agréable mais ne fermait pas à clés; le volet qui donne accès à un balcon commun ne se verrouille pas. Salle de bains de taille agréable. Logement très propre. Je n'ai vu qu'une seule fois Kateryna, sa maman était sur place et est très sympathique. Nombreux commerces dans la rue, c'est pratique. Peu de bruit car la chambre ne donne pas sur la rue.
We loved being so close to Las Ramblas and La Boqueria Market. The host was very accommodating to our schedule for checking in and out. A very good experience overall.

Meine Kinder haben bei Kateryna gewohnt, es hat Ihnen sehr gefallen, vor allem die gute Lage. Sie selber haben sie kaum gesehen, da sie viel unterwegs waren, aber das vorab schreiben war super unkompliziert. Haben bestens geschlafen.
Very friendly host, also her mom. They allowed us to let our baggage so long as we want in the apartment. Very clean, comfortable. Apartment is very central, but the room is quite. Thanks.

Idéalement située à 200 m de la Rambla, cette chambre et grande et confortable. L'accueil tout sourire de Kateryna est un plus. Si l'immeuble et la cage d'escalier peuvent paraître vetuste, il n'en n'est rien de l'appartement qui est charmant est très fonctionnel. La chambre est très calme. Nous avons vraiment beaucoup apprécié ce peid à terre dans cette belle ville.

Die Position ist gut aber die Wohnung ist zu alt. Der Bett ist nicht bequemlich. Das Preis lohnt sich nicht so. Die Katze ist so komisch und kann man nicht streicheln. Aber insgesamt ist die Wohnung gut.

Well situated near the main tourist area, but on a side street and the room and balcony face a quiet interior courtyard.  Kitchen and bath are well equipped.  Bed is comfortable and room is spacious.  Kateryna's mom greeted us and showed us around, but stayed discreetly out of the way.  Thank you for a wonderful visit to Barcelona!
Jättebra läge! Väldigt lättsam och tillmötesgående värd

Amazing!!! We were not sure about getting a private room as we usually get a house for ourselves....but this was amazing!!   
Thanks to Kateryna and her lovely mum!!! 
Súper clean, tidy, close to everything and everywhere 
We loved it and recommend it

Dziękuję :) 
Byłem razem z córką i oboje jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni z pokoju. Gościnność Kateryny sprawiła, że czuliśmy się bardzo dobrze. Czyste mieszkanie i blisko Rambli oraz metra. Z pewnością odwiedzimy Kateryna ponownie. Polecam :)

Kateryna's place is perfectly clean and comfortable and a great location- around 3 mins walk to la rambla. We were dissapointed however by the fact that we did not really get a double bed but rather 2 single beds pushed together. I think its also important to note that when we stayed there Kateryna was not living in the flat herself but her mother was. There was also a distinctive smell of cigarette smoke throughout the flat however we managed to keep this out of our room by having the door shut at all times. Overall our stay in Barcelona was fantastic however I feel that for the price we paid the above issues were not really acceptable.  If these could be fixed I would be happy to stay here again as the flat was in a good location and kept clean.

Even though our trip was planned last minute, Kateryna made sure we arrived comfortably. She was also very helpful and fast to respond to anything we needed. The location was central and walking distance to everything.
Eine echt super und freundliche Gastgeberin. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und mit der Kommunikation hat alles super geklappt. Ich freue mich auf das nächste mal. LG Dennis

Very central location, but was quiet overall and felt safe walking around. Kateryna's mom stays in one bedroom and is very quiet and pleasant. The second and third room is rented out. There were times when the apartment smelled like cigarettes but was likely because the patio doors were open, and neighbours smoke on their patio. We closed the doors when we left the apartment and did not have that issue again. Would recommend!

Great Location to explore Barca, the appartment is a 1-2 min walk off the Rambla and the next Metro Station. 
Late check-in went very smooth, Kateryna even got out of bed to let us in shortly before midnight. 
Otherwise we did not feel too comfortable, most of time there were other people in the appartment rooms, not really knowing if they were family members or other guests?
Would definitely go there again !!
Adoramos tudo! A gentileza dos anfitrioes, a limpeza, a localizacao.... perfeito pra nós!!! Nos sentimos em casa
Stay was wonderful. Great location close to Rambla and the Metro very convenient!

Excelente lugar, ubicado a dos cuadras de La Rambla y lleno de tiendas, bares, restaurantes y muy cerca al barrio Gótico. Departamento muy cálido con excelente ducha. La comunicación y el trato con las anfitrionas también! Lo recomendamos!
Excelente ubicación junto a La Rambla. La habitación era amplia. El baño y la cocina compartidos muy limpios. Lugar muy recomendable!

Kateryna's place was really wonderful. Such great hospitality; she provided us with everything we needed as well as offered coffee and muffins. The apartment was very warm (during the winter) which was nice, and the place was very clean as well. When you first get to the building, it looks a bit sketchy, but don't be worried, her apartment is really well kept up. And of course the location is super central, steps from La Ramblas. Would recommend.
Host eccellente.....da provare

Спасибо Кате за отличный хост, дружелюбие и гостеприимство! Очень улыбчивая и отзывчивая. Дома чисто и уютно. Ответила на все вопросы, помогла разобраться со многими вопросами на месте. Будем рекомендовать друзьям)

Passez outre l'aspect de l'entrée et de la cage d'escalier délabrés : l'appartement est très bien, parfaitement situé. On y dort super au calme alors qu'il est si proche de l'animation.
Kateryna  accueille avec le sourire et laisse à disposition tout ce qu'il faut pour être comme chez soi au cœur de Barcelone.
very nice and very good
Host was welcoming and insightful on local amenities and tourist attractions. Very neat, clean and spacious accommodation. Perfect location. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
Great Host and amazing Location .
That was nice to stay at her flat!

Катя прекрасная хозяйка и человек. Приняла нас раньше времени из-за ситуации, в которой мы оказались с предыдущим жильем, всегда была на связи. В квартире идеальная чистота, все есть для комфортного пребывания. На случай жары в комнате был вентилятор, но вообще, благодаря тому, что окна выходят в патио, комната не прогревается слишком сильно. Хорошее расположение для туристов, все центральные достопримечательности и порт в пешей доступности, есть миллион супермаркетов в округе, работающих до поздна.

Super Lage, die Zimmer sind okay, Kommunikation etwas schwierig(außer man spricht russisch) und die Ausstattung der Küche ist etwas sperrlich.
Will man jedoch nur einen sauberen Platz, in super Lage zum schlafen, ist diese Unterkunft nur zu empfehlen.

We selected this apartment as it is close to the metro and Rambla, the popular tourist street. However, we were surprised that the description did not say that there are 50 steps in a poorly lighted staircase to the apartment. Kateryna’s mother Nadia, greeted us and lives in the apartment. They rent out another bedroom and had several guest during our 8 night stay. Our bedroom had a comfortable bed but was not air conditioned and quite hot even in September. It had a small hanger for clothes which was inadequate. There was a strong smell of cooking from other apartments. Nadia is also a smoker which was bothersome as we don’t smoke. It was very difficult to adjust the temperature of the water, especially in the shower.  Even taking a short 1 minute shower, the water went from boiling hot to freezing cold since the water heater is too small or malfunctioning. The listing included use of the kitchen, but Nadia appeared not too happy that we cooked some meals there. There is a washing machine in the kitchen and after the 3rd night, we asked Nadia if we could use it. She agreed to it. The other guest also used the washing machine. After the 6th night, we needed to wash another load. When the washing machine was in the spin cycle, Nadia came into the kitchen with very angry words and stopped it. There is no excuse for this behavior and it left us with a very bad impression.
Really close to the attractions, and the host was super cooperative and kind, the house was very clean and Barcelona is just greattttttt!

I would not recommend this apartment. It is cheap, but the quality is poor. Small room, horrible bed (when you want to sleep don't use the bed). The pictures in the ad are nicer than then reality. Don't go.

Buena ubicación, no hay ascensor y hay mucha grada. A uno lo confunde que dice Primero! Y no cree que es el primer piso pero esta mas de cincuenta gradas arriba. Si no eres muy exigente, si no llevas mucho equipaje y gozas de buena salud, aprovecha la excelente ubicación

Alex y Nadya son muy amables. La comunicacion fue buena y reactiva.
Piso muy bien ubiquado, centrico, cerca de las Ramblas. Habitaciones para alquilar, piso tranquilo, no ruido de la calle. Con todo que necesitamos (supermercados, transportes, bars...) Yo recomando! Gracias Nadya y Alex.

Despite the entrance of the building which looks very old and the 50 steps of stairs, the appart is good, clean and calm. It is also very well located. Nadiya and Alex were kind and good welcoming. During my stay, the two other rooms were occupied by other tourists, they were kind as well, there had been no problem. One thing to enhance, it is regarding a problem of warm water in the shower, I hope that this will be fixed asap so visitors in winter will not be obliged to finish their shower with cold water.
Thanks Nadiya and Alex and God bless your daughter.
Nadya is amazing host. The place is cozy and super clean. The location also is super nice,5 minutes walk to la Rambla. Definitely going to come back and more than once!)
Una habitación sombría, sin nada de luz exterior, el balcón da hacia una pared, las gradas del edificio están muy sucias y deprimentes, maña comunicación con los anfitriones,

Clean and nice place. Good beds and a nice shower. Location is perfectly close to a metro station and the Main Street in Barcelona. Owners Nadiya and Alex are very friendly and flexible. We would recommend staying here.

Attractions include: The Australian Museum: The Australian Art Gallery: Sydney Opera House: Botanical Gardens: Hyde Park: War Memorial: Sydney Fish Markets: The Rocks: Luna Park: Sydney Harbour and Harbour Islands: Bondi and Harbour Beaches: The Aquarium: Taronga Zoo: VMax and the Ferry to Many. neighborhood_overview: This is a vibrant and cosmopolitan area with plenty to do and see.  Attractions include: The Australian Museum: The Australian Art Gallery: Sydney Opera House: Botanical Gardens: Hyde Park: War Memorial: Sydney Fish Markets: The Rocks: Luna Park: Sydney Harbour and Harbour Islands: Bondi and Harbour Beaches: The Aquarium: Taronga Zoo: V Max and the Ferry to Many. Don’t forget the Sydney Festival and The Bridge Climb. Keen shoppers will enjoy a variety of shopping experiences from weekend markets to High End Designer Outlets.
notes: Small convenience store right across from the building. All long weekends are a minimum 3 night stay, all public holidays are charged at the Weekend Tariff and Easter is a minimum 4 night stay. We have a one week minimum stay with any New Year's Eve booking.
transit: The apartment is a 5 minute walk to Wynyard railway station and then a 3 minute train ride to the city centre. There are also local buses, light rail, Taxi's & Uber available.
access: There are 1 set of keys available which are picked up via the lock box at the front door so those in your party can come and go easily during your stay. Ground level entry for easy access with suitcases, groceries etc and a lift to the 1st floor.
interaction: We won't be around to interact with you, however Joanne does live locally and is on hand if required. We will be available to help with check-in, check-out and any questions you have during your stay.
house_rules: Standard Terms and Conditions of Temporary Holiday Accommodation: Note: Variances can be agreed on but only by arrangement with the owner in writing. Deposit of 50% non-refundable is required to secure the booking. Payment of the rental deposit constitutes the clients acceptance of these Terms and Conditions. Balance of the rental amount must be received in full 28 days prior to occupancy. If not the owner has the right to cancel the booking and attempt to re let it.  Cancellation if caused by the client, money paid is not refundable unless the house is re-let for the entire period. If it a refund is made due to the property being re-let then a $100 cancellation fee will apply.  The owners will make every effort to ensure the property is available as booked.  However the owners reserve the right to make alterations to bookings due to unforeseen circumstances. To maintain a good standard for our guests we require certain conditions to be complied with. host.host_about:
Joanne – I’ve always loved to travel and even though my three boys now keep me closer to my home in Sydney’s Inner West, I take every opportunity to enjoy family holidays in apartments and houses booked online throughout Australia and New Zealand.

Ali – I’ve been living in the Blue Mountains since 1993, so I could be called a local! This means I have a wealth of knowledge about this amazing part of Australia that I have decided to call home. It also means that I have the opportunity to stay in some of the most beautiful and unique houses in the world.

reviews.comments: Joanna and Ali's place is nicely located in the CBD and close to anything you need. The home is neatly kept and well presented. My interstate guest enjoyed the stay and any issue that came up was quickly looked after.
El apartamento es amplio y está muy bien ubicado ya que está en el centro, además tiene una parada de tren a 3 minutos caminando.
Really nice apartment with an excellent location in Sydney, I totally recommend it! Also Joanne and Ali are really nice, as they solved all my questions really fast.

Location was excellent and perfect for the places I had to visit during my stay.  Apartment was clean and tidy with sufficient amenities.  7 Eleven across the road was convenient and Commonwealth bank on the corner was handy.  Couple of small issues but sorted with the Hosts.

A lovely little apartment! Comfy bed and everything that we needed for our stay in Sydney. This isn't flash - staying here is about location, not amenities. Super close (walking distance) to everything you might want to visit. Some slight issues with the shower and a little cramped - this is a place for two people for a couple of days maximum! We didn't meet Joanne and Ali but they were great arranging flexible options for our stay.

Very good location!
I just thought the place had an old smell that irritated my allergic nose. :( But may be just me...

The apartment is in a great location. It  does not have wifi and as I was spending two week for work it was an inconvenience so do bare this in mind. I tried to contact the hosts about this and did not get a reply from them. After an issue a week later to do with cleanliness Rob their property manager did reply to me and was very kind in offering me a meal for free for the inconvenience and got a cleaner to come in. 
A nice apartment on the whole which  just needs some TLC.

It's a convenient one bedroom apt for one person, if you don't need wifi (which is rare and unbelievable), neither a long and relaxing hot bath (there's prob with hot water, I kept it low to avoid running out of hot water at the end of my shower), nor a quiet sleep in the morning (massive noise in the neighborhood due to tram construction). This apt is all about location in the city.

The place was spacious and comfortable but the best part about it is the location. It's in the center of town, making all the major destinations easily accessible. In addition, Ali and Joanne were very accommodating with our early check in. The amenities, however, were lacking. We were hoping to shower after our long flight but there were no bath towels when we arrived. I texted Ali and the towels were delivered while we were out for lunch. There was only one tube of shampoo and conditioner provided that were clearly taken from hotels. There was a bar of soap for bathing and it had obviously been used before. The previous things I can deal with, but for our 5 night stay for 2 people, there was only one and a half rolls of toilet paper. I texted Ali for toilet paper, shampoo, and soap twice, but received no response.

I loved the apartment, but it needs to be better stocked.
The host was very helpful, and all went smoothly.
We stayed here for a family of four. Fantastic location! Hot water pressure could have been stronger but otherwise it's fantastic accomodation for a short weekend away.
Great location,  clean and hosts very friendly.

Communication with the hosts was great and immediate. The apartment is very centrally located and within walking distance of all galleries, shops etc. Perfect for a couple or two friends happy to share a room.

Great place, central and quiet. The actual building is quite old, but the apartment itself is fine. Internet is provided in the form of a 4G dongle. All the cook wear was very useable. The hot water pressure is low, like some of the other guests have mentioned but overall useable.

The location is great, for both business travellers and tourists.
The place is easy to find, great location, very close to westfield and supermarket coles. But there is no shampoo and shower gel in the apartment.

This cozy apartment had everything we needed for our new years holiday in Sydney. All the main touristic spots are literally walking distance (Darling Harbour, Circular Quay, Sydney Town Hall, main shopping centres). When we needed to use the train, Wynyard Station was just a couple of blocks away. Savings time and money with this prime location was definitely a bonus.
The flat feels bigger than in the pictures. The building feels old but once you get inside the flat everything is well kept. The main bed and the sofa bed were comfy and with white crisp linens. Had plenty bath and face towels. Did not find a problem with the hot water pressure as previously stated (might have been fixed). There are washing and drying machines in perfect working condition. The bedroom has a ceiling fan that was enough to sleep, there were a couple of pretty hot nights outside but we only needed to turn on the aircon for a couple of hours and the entire flat would cool off. The kitchen has everything needed to prepare all meals.
Dealing with the host was also a pleasant experience. All the information requested was given in a straightforward manner without delay. 
Overall, a great experience! Highly recommended

The apartment is nice and perfect for city stays. 

My disappointment came when my 70yr old parents we kept awake all night from major reconstruction. Bins are also collected at 130am from outside the apartment. We were not told this was happening.

My mum recleaned on moving in. The dust on top of units and cupboard and under the bed was terrible. Expect a light clean and sheet change on arrival

My parents left 4 nights early and i moved onto my couch. 

No response when feedback was given after stay. 

I would recommend the apartment when Sydney tram works is complete in 2018.

My stay got of to a bumpy start as the room had not been prepare for my arrival, I assume there was a communication issue between the cleaner and the owner, but the owners rectified the problems the following day, and also offered $60 to cover a couple of meals for the inconvenience .

overall my stay was good and description and pictures where accurate, location was great, 5 mins walk to wynyard station,15 mins  to darling harbour & 3mins to woolies.
I may stay again and would ask for confirmation on the room been ready  before my arrival.

A great one week holiday in Sydney for 1st time ....... certainly not the last time, would come again to stay and will recommend to others! Very comfortable and well equipped should you wish to make your own break, lunch to dinner.
Great place to stay in. Clean and well equipped overall. Very near to darling harbour and to nearest train station.

Nous avons passé 4 jours à Sydney, et le séjour dans l'appartement de Joanne et Ali, très bien situé au centre-ville, nous a permis de visiter la ville en nous déplaçant souvent à pieds. 
L'appartement est confortable et bien équipé, et 3-4 personnes peuvent y séjourner avec plaisir.

You can't beat this location. We stayed for almost a week and walked or took a very convenient train everywhere that we cared to go. The size of the apartment was adequate and comfortable but not terribly large. It was reasonably clean and put together but not luxurious. The hosts were very kind to allow us to check in several hours early and we never actually meet anyone in person as the key was conveniently in a lock box. Overall it was consistent with the description and our expectations. I would recommend this for others particularly given the convenient location.
Excelente ubicación. Cómodo apartamento y de fácil alquiler..
Good
Nice and tidy place right in the heart of the Sydney CBD. Great access to all things in the city.
Very good!
Very good!
Very central location. The place is not big, but cosy for 2 people. Host is a bit hard to reach, but the check-in is easy enough.

The apartament is very good. It is very close bars, restaurant and metro station. It is perfect for a couple. The apartment does not receive much sunligh. But this is not a problem. I and my girlfriend recomend the Joanne apartament. Everthing is good.
Excellent location

The apartment was central and nicely set out.  The sofa bed is a click clack and not very comfortable.  The air con didn't work and therefore the apartment was stuffy as we felt we couldn't safely leave the window open.
We would stay again due to the convenience for the city.

We had a great time! Location is perfect, walking distance to Circular Quay, to the train, bus stops,shopping and the supermarket 3 min away! Apartment had everything we needed: equipped kitchen, washer, dryer... very comfortable place! Would definetly recommend it!
Great location.
great location and value

This compact apartment is well located in the CBD for walking down to the quay/Opera House/Park. It is a little tired and shabby. It is fine as a base but not so good if you need spend much time there. The windows look out onto the wall of the neighbouring building and the noise from the street and the garbage collectors goes on into the night.
Good location with near most tourist spots in CBD. Just few mins walk to QVB,Darling Harbour...etc. Easy check in and stylish decoration. I will stay again if I come again.

Good central accommodation near train and bus . Bed is soft but slept well. Good for a few nights in city, I stayed for business and it was great with lunge and kitchen for breakfast etc or dinner if you wanted. I ate at local eateries nearby. Easy to book, 
Great for 1 or 2 travelers, easy entry, secure building . I would stay again. So convenient . Thank u Ali.
Well kept apartment in a great central location. Hosts made stay easy.

Location was great. Perfect to walk to just about all the sights. The unit was small  but had all you would require for a shot stay. Having a washing machine and dryer was a plus. My only negative was the oven was dirty and the floor could have done with a good wash.
Despite the building being quite old, the apartment was very tidy and well looked after.
Amazing home right in the city. Can’t beat the experience and atmosphere by Joanne/Ali’s place! Had a lot of fun with my friends
Best Location and the Suite is Spacious  ❤️

The apartment is very well located! You can walk to the shopping centers, the Sydney Opera or the Harbour Bridge! The kitchen has everything you need!
We had a good time at Clearance House!
Perfect, problem free stay.

The location of this apartment is great - close walking distance to Sydney’s main attractions and anything else in the CBD. There is a Woolworth Express right around the corner to stock up on whatever you would like for food, snacks, or sundries. Very convenient.

The apartment windows look into an alley where it is noisy early from garbage trucks, vehicles, and other maintenance. The hosts informed us about this.

We had issues checking in as the apartment was not cleaned, which got resolved. That said, we never received confirmation from the host or property manager, after specifically inquiring to both, if the bed linens were laundered after the previous guest left or the bed was just made with the same linens.

A few comments about the apartment. The mattress is less than acceptable IMO.  It is lumpy and springy and we could get a good sleep the 4 nights we stayed. Hard to believe this has not been replaced. So, while the apartment is functional as described, it is in need of TLC and better property management attention. The bath and kitchen amenities seem mostly to be leftovers from other guests and there are just some things worn out such as the shower head that does not stay in place making it difficult to shower. 

Communication with the host was very responsive during the  booking stage but once confirmed and money paid ... and when issues occurred, they were, well let’s just say, less than responsive.

Personally, despite the location and premium this apartment should command in the CBD, the value IMO is EXTREMELY low for what they charge when considering all the other factors outlined above and more that I communicated to the hosts directly. I have offered suggestions to the host directly and constructively for them to improve based on above and other details ... however, I have not received a response of course.

That said, you will love CBD ... a visit to Baxter’s Inn is a must (you will  understand when you finally find it and immerse yourself with the locals for a drink - there is no food). We had amazing dinners at Bistro Papillon (steps from the apartment) and at Bambini. A visit to QVB (Queen Victoria Building), Strand and area is a shopper’s haven and both are a must do. Special mention to the ladies at Cue (a ladies fashion shop ... fine Aussie designs). When (not if) you go to the Opera House, be sure to walk through the Botanical Gardens. Lots to explore and enjoy in Sydney.

I sure wish our experience at “Clarence House Apartment” was not the last accommodation image we had on an otherwise impeccable 24 day experience of Australia.

Michael

The apartment was in a great location and near restaurants, bars, grocery stores and transport. The self check in and check out process was simple. The place was clean and spacious as per the photos. I'd recommend this apartment to anyone and will stay here again.
Awesome location! Super accomodating hosts and a relaxing decor, made for a great mini break.
Super endroit bien placé

name: Contemporary Remodeled Ocean View Villa in Kapalua

Our romantic retreat is situated in a quiet and well appointed cul de sac at the top of The Ridge at Kapalua. Enjoy imposing direct views of both the Pacific Ocean and the internationally famous Kapalua Bay golf course. Please note these nightly rates include the 14.4% hawaii tax.
space: What makes this condo unique from most of the condos in Kapalua and at the Ridge villas , is that this is a town house style corner unit situated on 2 floors , meaning living area , kitchen and then bedroom upstairs all share the breathtaking ocean views of Kapalua bay .

host.host_about: This was our home and we loved living here, however we have extended our family and now have a little boy so we decided to move into a slightly bigger house on Maui.

reviews.comments:
This house is wonderful! 
It is one of the best Airbnb experiences ever. 
Beautiful neighborhood, very nice apartment (big, elegant and comfortable) with everything you may need. 
Everything was perfect: car park, easy access, beautiful views, two fantastic bathrooms, garden and terrace, etc. 
Definitely top!

Leila's place is truly amazing. A very clean, well equiped and beautiful place for our stay on Maui. The view from the terrace was great. I would recommend friends to stay here and if ever be back in Maui, I would reach out to Leila again!

A truly piece of paradise. Lovely decorated and very clean.

We hope to happily return one day. :-)

Mahalo

Albert & Maya

Hi! Staying at Leila's condo in Lahaina was my first ever AirBnB stay! Leila was accessible. She responded to any questions I had very quickly. She was always helpful! Her condo was amazing! Very clean, just as described, and I loved the location! Woke up to so much sunlight! A great view of the ocean! Had breakfast on our patio everyday! There is a cool breeze that will make you never want to leave! As for drive, it was less than an hour from Kahului Airport and the drive to several beaches were less than 10 minutes, I would highly recommend staying at Leila's!! It was a great experience!!

Thanks again, Leila!

Can't speak highly enough of the house, great location.
House was immaculate, owners were helpful and got in touch with us to make sure all was ok. 
Great value for money and would highly recommend!
Beautiful lovely house! We really enjoyed our stay and believe it is perfect for everyone looking for a beautiful quite place on the west side of maui.
Beautiful contemporary place with everything you would need and the location was great being a short walk from Kapalua bay (swimming snorkeling) and many great restaurants and a grocery store.

The views from the bedroom
And great room are wonderful - hard to leave!   The location is perfect for us because we think Kapaluna is the best at
Area of Maui

Leila was an excellent host. We had a delayed flight and did not arrive to the condo until 1:30am. Easy to find. Easy to access. Excellent amenities. Beautiful view! Quiet. 
Very responsive to any questions. 
Location is awesome! Walking distance to beaches, restaurants, etc. or easy & FREE shuttle (5-10 minute wait) in the Kapalua area.
We are looking forward to working with her again in the near future.

We stayed here on our first trip to Maui and we couldn't have had asked for a better place to vacation. From the spacious living areas to the modern decor, Leila's condo is located in a prime spot with spectacular views of the Pacific Ccean. After staying at her place, I wanted to highlight 4 great things about our experience: 

1) Resort amenities- there is a complimentary shuttle that can take you between the Ritz Carlton and Montage resorts from your villa, along with other places in the Kapalua resort. This is great, especially for trying the top rated restaurants at the resorts without having to pay for parking...plus you can have a glass (or bottle) of wine and let someone else worry about the driving :) Or you can walk!

2) Accessibility- Whether you are looking to take in a nice stroll along the beach or play a round of golf, her villa is nestled right in the heart of the Kapalua Resort. Even in the rain, you can enjoy the nice pool with a covered eating area! And I need to mention that the views from her condo are breath-taking, so if you fancy a night in, hers is the place to do it!

3) Her Condo- I've stayed at hotels and resorts before, but I have to say that her villa exceeds anything you can find at a high end resorts. The wi-fi was strong and fast - able to be used among multiple devices. And the entire space was so clean! We had the security of knowing that the crew didn't just do a once over and be done, but actually took the time to make sure that it was ready and prepped for us, as if no one had stayed there before us. I'm a stickler for very nice bedrooms and beds, and hers was not only comfortable, but also offered me a great night's rest after a day of beach, beach and more beach :)

4) Leila & Dan - They have been a gracious host, allowing us to stay at their condo. They were quick to respond, always providing us with best in class service, and were able to provide some great recommendations on activities and events to do on the island. 

I want to thank you for taking the time to read my review. Our experience staying at Leila and Dan's condo was great, and we truly enjoyed the time we spent on Maui. I cannot thank them enjoy for allowing us this great and special opportunity, and for giving us a chance to experience this beautiful island in a way that like no other. For this we are very grateful! 

We wish you all the best in booking your stays through AirBnb and hope you have the opportunity to stay at Leila and Dan's condo... we hope to as well very soon! 

Mahalo!
Great location, clean and comfortable place. Leila was a responsive, helpful and kind host!

Excellent place to stay, modern with an incredible view from the bedroom. Perfect place to stay for our mini honeymoon. It really felt like a home and we look forward to watching the place grow and change with each trip to Maui.
This house and location was truly amazing and the views breath-taking!  The neighborhood was quiet and close to everything we needed!
Really good place to live in. Love it, great view! Quite clean close to beach! Def stay there if I have the chance again!

The place was perfect for us, we went to wholefoods and got our supplies for the week. Was able to do our own cooking and relax at the beach everyday. Not alot of food choice around the area for breakfast/lunch so recommend doing own shop.

Very classy place!  Check in was a breeze and since we didn't have to meet up with our host to get the keys, we were able to arrive quite late.  The "instant book" was also really nice.  This house is on a beautiful golf course in a quiet and scenic neighborhood.  We were able to watch giant crashing waves and humpback whales from the porch.  Just lovely.
Fantastic place!

Beautiful location! The view was great and the community was so quiet and convenient. Room is well stocked and comfortable. Very clean and the host was very easy to talk to and responsive. There are no beach chairs or cooler to use FYI. We hope to be back to Maui soon! Definitely would stay here again.

Leila's place was quiet, secluded, and in a beautiful neighborhood on a golf course. The house had an incredible view from both the living room and the bedroom, and while there was an air conditioner, it wasn't needed due to the lovely breeze. The house is walking distance from a small beach, and is a quick drive to the Honolua General Store which has coffee, pastries, sandwiches and hot food, toiletries, towels, sunblock... pretty much everything. 

The house comes equipped with travel size shampoo, body wash, hair conditioner, and bar soap. It also has a small hair dryer.

There are beach umbrellas and chairs in the backyard ready to be taken to the beach.

The wind gusts can get a little loud at times, I think because of how the house is situated on the hill. The bed was a little bit lumpy, but mostly soft and comfortable. The house renovations are gorgeous and look brand new, and there's a huge second bathroom with a great bathtub not pictured in the photos! Very clean, bright, and lovely. As other reviewers said, the photos do *not* do this house justice.

Overall, it was a wonderful place to stay. Thank you!
A+

We loved this place. We like to hike and the Kapalua Resort has plenty of hiking trails available. And when it rained for two days, we had a great place to hang out and watch old movies! Everything you need, very comfortable and pretty. We used the A/C for only one night (I don't like air conditioning) because the design of the louvered windows meant we could control the breeze that constantly flowed through the house, keeping us cool.
Great place
Wonderful place. Very clean. Leila is excellent with communication. View from house is beautiful. House is tastefully decorated.

Leila was wonderfully responsive and helpful with multiple aspects of traveling with our baby. Her condo was spotless with a beautiful view of the sunrise. It's within waking distance of two quiet beaches, the Ritz Carlton and the market. Very quiet and serene--a nice change of pace from the busier resorts of the island.

Leila's place is great - beautiful inside with an awesome view. There are multiple beaches close by, including one where we found four sea turtles swimming and eating. The villa is in an area of Maui a little farther away (about an hour driving) from the main resort hub where a lot of activities are, but the Kapalua Resort is right on the highway that connects you easily to the rest of Maui. The villa is also about 20 minutes from Lahaina, a great town with lots of restaurant and shopping options. If you're looking for something quieter than the resorts or a place bigger than a hotel room - definitely consider this villa!

Leila's place is absolutely perfect. My husband and I stayed for 5 days on our Babymoon and it was a picture perfect home within walking distance of two gorgeous beaches, great restaurants, and beautiful views.

We can't wait to come back in a few years with our little one!
This place is absolutely gorgeous. We will try to stay here every time we go to Maui in the future!

This is a wonderful space to call home on Maui.  There are plenty of beaches and beautiful scenery everywhere you look. 
The beach on the property feels like it's a  private one.  We recommend renting a car so you can explore the other side of the island.  Maui is a special place!  We highly recommend staying at this property as the hosts will make it incredibly easy for you.  Thanks Leila!

If you're looking for a slightly secluded location, but still located within a short walk to two of the best beaches on Maui, you can't do any better than this house. We were also pleased to find a convenience store and a couple of nice restaurants all within a mile walk. The bed was incredibly comfortable; the view was outstanding; the house was clean. What more could you ask for? Turtles? We saw 2 of them on each of the visa to the nearby beaches!
Beautiful place. Quiet. Great beaches. Clean. Great deal.

Leila's place is a quiet sanctuary. We loved looking out of our windows and seeing beautiful views of the water and colorful flowers! We kept the living room sliding door cracked open at all times to let in the constant and refreshing ocean breeze. The decor is light and airy, the kitchen is a good size for two cooks and has the basic appliances, and having two showers was convenient.

We frequently took advantage of the short walk to the beach and Kapula resort amenities (specifically ziplining, putt putt golf, and the cafe). Additionally, the place is a 15 minute drive to Lahaina, which we found to be a fun town with great restaurants and shops.
Beautiful scenic location with a quick drive to many beaches. Easy check-in and out process. We would love to stay here again when we visit Maui!

This place exceeded all expectations and was ideal for my girlfriend and me. A short walk to the beach, a beautiful coastal trail and restaurants it really was perfect. The views from the back porch and bedroom made for an great what to start and end the day.
Leila was very prompt with communicating check-in information. Home was very nice and in a great location. Great view!
Great location to beaches and stores. Quiet, clean, and beautiful views.  Would definitely stay here again!

Great, 2-story condo in a nice area near the Ritz Carlton. Easy walk to the beach where there is a nice path and lots of weddings happening on the beach! Great sunset! The place is clean and decorated well. There is a downstairs shower and upstairs bath/shower. It was nice to have both. Views from the room are beautiful. Great stay and great value!

The pictures definitely don't do it any justice! Such a beautiful and airy villa perfect for two. It's a bit of a drive from the more central/touristy areas but the beach a few minutes walk behind the villa was fantastic and often times not crowded. We found plenty of yummy and affordable restaurants within a 10 min drive if you don't feel like indulging too much within the resort. We had a bit of trouble with pool access but other than that I highly recommend anyone to stay here. We also found ourselves using the downstairs shower most due to convenience after a long sandy day at the beach. We look forward to our next visit to Maui!

We really loved everything about this place! We appreciated the decor, cleanliness, location, scenic view and quiet pristine community. It was so nice to see and feel the ocean breeze from the living room and bedroom. I would love to stay here again if I'm ever lucky enough to make it back to Maui.

Great hospitality and good place to stay!
We really enjoyed our time there and would like to stay there again in the future.
Thank you.

My husband and my stay at Leila's place was perfect for us.  Good access to public beaches for snorkeling which was great.  Walking distance to the pool and wonderful view! Golf a plus which we did one day.  Villa is on the 8th hole and great to go out and view sunset too.  Restaurants were great too, but nice to have the convenience of the kitchen if you wanted to eat in.  Thanks so much!!
Sincerely,
Marty and Charlie

We have just had a wonderful holiday at Leilas place. It is well positioned in the beautiful Kapalua area of Maui with magnificent views out to the ocean. This property is extremely spacious and well equipped for 2 people and the coastal decor is fresh and restful. Staying at Leilas means you are within walking distance to spectacular beaches, walking tracks, restaurants and a well stocked local store. We love walking so the walk back home up the gentle hill and steps was always a pleasure. Leila is a fabulous host who responds promptly to any communication. All instructions about the property are extremely straight forward and we didn't encounter any issues whatsoever in our time there. 
I believe this property presents excellent value for money in this exclusive location and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it.

Leila's place is amazing! My wife and I stayed here for part of our honeymoon and it was perfect. The area is nice and relaxing, which is exactly what we were looking for. Sleeping and waking up to the sounds of the ocean was probably our favorite part. The views from the balconies are spectacular! And it's just a short walk to the incredible Ironwoods beach. We will definitely be back here, it's just a matter of when. You won't regret your stay here!

Lelia’s place is fantastic. The remodel is so tastefully done. Like other users mentioned, we mostly used the downstairs bath as it was so convenient. Lelia was responsive and checkin/checkout was seamless! Great stay!

Great place!! You will feel at home, comfortable and private.
Beach walking distance.
The only problem for us was the long driving to central Maui, which we did everyday. But West Maui is just awesome and there is no much need to drive around too much if you do not want to
Host very helpful !!

We had the most fantastic time and enjoyed the accessibility to kapalua beach as well as the local trails, restaurants and Napili market. The view from our Lanai was beautiful each day and we spotted a few whales on occasion as well! We would definitely stay here again!

The condo is situated at the top of the Ridge which provides wonderful views of the sunrise and the ocean.  The location is ideal if you like to walk because you can walk down to the beach, to hiking trails, or even to nearby resorts where we found the perfect spot to watch the sunset each night.
There are simple stylish touches that made the home feel modern and cozy, like the chairs by the lanai and the bench seat downstairs. We loved waking up slowly in the mornings to smell of fresh brewed coffee (the coffee maker works great!). There was a convenient beach cooler bag in one of the cabinets and cozy robes -- really nice touches!
We had one minor issue that is no fault of the host, and may just be the unlucky weather... It was quite windy in the area our first few nights, so windy that we did not get much sleep. I don't know if this is typical for mid-December, but one other reviewer did mention a similar issue. The wind was howling and whistling through the doors and windows. Finally by our third night, the wind calmed down and from then on everything was absolutely beautiful.
It is a convenient quiet location, walking accessible, easy parking, clean, and comfortable. The kitchen was bright and sunny, well stocked with dishes, cutlery and containers for making simple breakfasts and beach picnics.  We picked up wonderful fresh fruits at the nearby Nipili Farmers Market (on Saturdays).  Aside from the windy days, we had a wonderful stay here and it presents an incredible value compared to the nearby resorts.

Leila's home in Kapalua is very well done and sits a perfect spot to see great views of the ocean. There are many special touches throughout Leila's place. Very easy to walk around Kapalua from her home. My wife and I live on Maui so this was a staycation for was and it turned out to be exactly what we were looking for. Mahalo Leila, we will be back.

My husband and I rented Leila’s condo in Kapalua Bay and had a wonderful time. The condo is remodeled and super cute! We were celebrating our wedding while we were there and got married at The Montage. The Montage was walking distance from the condominium. The view outside of Leila’s place is absolutely gorgeous, you can see the ocean from nearly every window. It was the perfect amount of space for Tim and I, and if we stay again in Kapalua we would be delighted to rent again from Leila. If you walk down Ridge Road, it will lead you to a beach with a hiking/walking path. Make sure to take advantage of this! The beach is not crowded, and it feels very local. The hiking path is also a great workout and a wonderful place to check out the sunrise/sunset. Thanks for everything Leila, we had a wonderful time.

Leyla’s place is very nice, airy and has a warm and stylish decoration.  We felt at home immediately. The kitchen is very well equipped. The location was perfect for us to explore the northwest of Maui. Spotting whales from the Lanai and the upper balcony is unforgetable for us! 
The sunsets visible on the property really are spectacular.
Communication with Leyla was very easy and clear. 
Thank you very much for sharing your wonderful place with us. 
Lots of Love 
Markus and Sabine

We had a wonderful stay at Leila's place and enjoyed waking up to the gorgeous view every morning. It was great being in a quiet area that's conveniently located to both nicer restaurants (Merriman's, anything at the Ritz) and casual places like Honolua Store - everything you need is there. The place is clean, spacious, comfortable (although the bed is a little soft for my personal preference), and tastefully decorated. We had a few rainy days during our stay but didn't mind at all as we got to enjoy lounging at the Airbnb while drinking wine and still enjoying the view.

We had a very good time at Leila’s house. The house is very nice and spacious for 2 with a wonderful look over coast and ocean. 10 minutes walk to nice beaches. The interior is very nice and modern and the kitchen is well equipped. Leila responded very quickly to our questions.

Leila's villa in Kapalua is an incredible spot, up on the hill a quick walk from 2 of the world's best beaches. We loved the pleasant breeze through the villa all day & night! The decor was beautiful and everything was very clean. If you're looking for a bit of privacy and want to avoid those 'mainstream' hotels in Lahaina, I strongly recommend staying in Kapalua at Leila's villa.

As soon as we settled in, we were awed by the breath-taking expanse of azure water and sky from the unit's two levels. As a bonus, it is a short walk to the pool, beach and walking trails. We were also pleasantly surprised by it relative proximity to the Ritz Carlton complex and the famed Plantation golf course (where the  PGA's year opener Tournament of Champions is held). The unit, which backs onto the Bay golf course, is well kept and spacious with an updated kitchen and second bathroom (the main bathroom upstairs, however, is not, which may be a bit of a letdown to some). The veranda off the living room is a delightful place to have breakfast to the cacophony of cardinals and finches (and a few more we failed to identify). The fairly high-end community where this unit is located is well maintained, secure, and almost enveloped with verdant vegetation.

Leila’s place is quiet and serene. My new husband and I stayed here after our wedding at Ironwoods Beach, which was so close by. We were able to walk to great restaurants and even Napili beach. 

The house was beautiful with stunning views and charming decorations. The bed was the most comfortable bed I’ve ever slept in. Parking was a breeze, everything was easy!

Leila's place was lovely. A suggestion to my husband and me from friends of ours. Good location. Many beaches nearby and 2 pools. We spent a lot of time in Lahaina as it was less windy and had more sunshine it seemed. I think our only dislike was the bed. The foam topper was a bit lumpy which made sleeping a little uncomfortable at times. Other than that, it was great!

Leila's villa is located on a beautiful resort walking distance to the beach.  There is a great hike along the coast that is breathtaking. It was wonderful to wake up to an ocean view! The villa was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Leila was a great host and I would highly recommend a stay here!
Convenient location with great views, good value.

A great getaway in Kapalua. Leila has the sign-up and check-in working perfectly.  What ever you would need is there in the unit.  The views are wonderful, especially from the bed!  The great views are because the unit is up high which means there will be walking up and down hill  to get to activities which we grew to enjoy.  Kapalua has shuttle service that took us up and down the times we didn't want to walk.

Gorgeous home, you won’t be disappointed. You need to drive to most tourist places, but the neighborhood and amenities are top notch. There is a beach within walking distance, and the hoa has a nice pool.
I have stayed in 8 to 10 Airbnb homes a year for business and pleasure for the past 3 or 4 years. This is hands down the nicest one ever!

This place was amazing. Leila was very easy to work with and provided all of the check in information well before hand so we felt prepared when we arrived - an important factor when you're traveling to various places over the course of a 10 day vacation. The townhouse itself was quite a bit larger than I had expected and had really great views of the ocean and shoreline. If we had had a little more time here, we would've used the shuttle service to venture around the area and see more of the resorts below us...but we'll just have to save that for next time!

Leila’s place was beautiful! You could lay in bed and see the ocean and it was a fairly quick walk to get down to the beach and the fantastic cliff walk! We had a blast! It was also very close to a general store which carried everything you could possibly need. Highly recommend!
Wonderful location and very close to restaurants and a great beach.  We spent every morning eating breakfast and taking in the amazing views from the lanai.  Overall, excellent spot!

By far the best air bnb i have stayed at to date. This place looks exactly like the pictures. The unit backs on to the kapulua bay golf course. The view from the living room and bedroom is of the water. The location is well located within walking distance from the Ritz and Merrimens (best restaurant we went to during our stay). Further, Kaanapali and Lahaina are within driving distance. Best of all, Leila is incredibly responsive. We had to contact her relatively early in our stay about getting into the house and she responded within in minutes. Further, she accommodated us when we asked for a late checkout on our last day (as there were a few days the place was unoccupied following our stay). This really helped us out as we had booked an early half day excursion on our last day and needed a place to shower, change and pack afterwords.  Both my bf and I agreed that if we come bacl, we would stay here again. I would highly recommend staying here. Thank you Leila!
Great place, great view, excellent location. There was always a nice breeze flowing through the place, we had a wonderful stay.
Leila's home is truly INCREDIBLE! It beyond exceeded our expectations, and is significantly larger than the pictures show.

Leila’s place was super stylish. The views are incredible, and it’s a nice, quiet neighborhood. 

The AC works well, but it can definitely get steamy in the bathrooms if you’re accustomed to exhaust fans that are typical on the mainland. 

Leila is very responsive and helpful. 

Be sure to close the door quickly in the evening though, as the locals (little frogs and lizards) like to jump in the door. 

Overall, it was a great stay.

5+* - Leila's place is a unique apartment in Maui. All the things you'd want in an exceptional apartment all found in the same place: - Beautiful apartment - the pictures cannot do it justice - it's a modern multi-floor apartment. Sliding doors make it so easy to get the breeze in both the bedroom and the living room and kitchen. Porch and patio make it easy to soak up the morning, afternoon, or evening. - Beautiful modern kitchen, including great appliances mean it's easy to go shopping for fruit or local food and enjoy it on your schedule. - Location is spectacular, not only because you've got views, but because the resort association takes care of the grounds around the apartment and in the complex. When you sit on the porch you can enjoy the view in a clean and well taken care of area. - Close proximity to the west-side of Maui, without being in the bustle. Everything from local beaches with great snorkeling, great local food spots, resorts & malls, and quick drives down to the other west-side beaches. When you return to the apartment, you get to escape and go back to a quiet and beautiful view. - The apartment is well thought out and stocked - there is everything you'd need for a long stay including a kitchen with all the appliances & pans & knife sets, fully stocked bathrooms with extra supplies, the linens you need, beach chairs if you need them, binoculars, lots of chairs and couches, great high speed internet & wifi, tvs with good service, multiple bathrooms and multiple sinks, really anytime we needed anything it was likely to already be in the apartment. If we did want to buy something, there are multiple stores a few minutes away. - Leila is a great host, using clear and well tested instructions for getting in and out of the apartment (keys, internet, directions, parking, etc.) and is also very responsive on the platform if you have any questions or changes. She's local which gave us comfort if things went wrong. - We happened to be on Maui when hurricane Lane (which became tropical storm Lane) hit us. Leila was a great host during that time, the apartment felt rock solid and we never had any concern for our safety, and the resort grounds around it were extremely well maintained and cleaned right after the storm. So it's rare, but if something does happen - this apartment that's built so well and is on higher ground, managed by professionals 24/7, is a great place to be. Leila also offered us a place to stay with her (not the AirBnB) if the hurricane hit and we had no where else to go. Thankfully, we were able to stay in the apartment (and Leila was able to extend our reservation) - but that's the true definition of a great host. Highly recommended - couldn't ask for a better apartment or host in Maui. Hands down...

Really nice and peaceful apartment in a beautiful location in Maui. The apartment is fully equipped with everything you need to enjoy a beach holiday including towels, sun umbrella and beach chairs. We particularly enjoyed having access to a really nice pool and bbq area. The beaches that are within walking distance of the apartment are some of the nicest on the island. Overall a fantastic place to stay, would definitely recommend without hesitation!

This place is in a great location with an amazing view of the ocean.  The host Leila was super nice and helpful.  We got their super early and she made sure the cleaning was expedited so we could get in early.  We had our wedding ceremony at nearby Ironwood Beach and everything was perfect for our stay.  We will be back.  Bonus info: great air conditioning, very clean and well decorated, lots of room, amazing views, nice grounds and landscaping, everything you would need in a place.

Leila’s place was absolutely beautiful. The view is amazing and the place is super clean and nice. We were there during hurricane Olivia and she let us stay until it was safe to drive. This was an absolutely amazing find and everyone should stay here!

Leila’s place was nothing short of perfect. Perfectly located, quiet and spacious. Everything was exactly as described. Leila’s place made our first trip to Maui feel like we were at our own home. Highly recommend!

I can't say enough good things about Leila's beautiful home in Kapalua. The home is situated on a small hill within the resort so the view of the ocean is magnificent. The interior has a fresh, modern look but still feels very cozy. The location in Kapalua puts you near some of the most amazing beaches in Maui, as well as amazing local restaurants, cafes and shops. My girlfriend and I loved being able to explore so many different areas but also be so close to the beach. We didn't make use of the pool and bbq area but it's accessible for guests. In addition to Leila's recommendations, make sure to check out the Maui Revealed book she has in the living room for great options for dining, beaches, and other hidden Maui gems. The bedroom offers a large comfy bed, TV, and balcony with the same amazing view of the ocean. Other amenities that we enjoyed were the 2 full baths (one of which is humongous), great AC units, dedicated parking spot, and stocked kitchen. Leila was always very responsive as a host and we knew if we ever needed anything, she would be there to help us. Overall, I highly recommend this beautiful, clean, and comfy home to anyone spending time in Maui.

Amazing location. The lanai/patio was a perfect spot in the morning to enjoy coffee and breakfast. The views from both the patio and the bedroom were picturesque. The location is quiet and just what we needed for a peaceful getaway!
incredible space. Very comfortable and the view from the decks are amazing. Walking distance to beaches, restaurants, and trails. Would love to stay here again.
This place is awesome! friendly host and amazing views! the best place in kapalua.  Highly recommend
Very nice
Beautiful! We had a stunning week in  Kapalua. Leila was wonderful, as is this stunning condo on the ridge.

We had an amazing ,wonderful time!
Leila's place is clean and beautiful. We sat outside and had a wonderful view of the ocean, as well as, to be able to watch the whales jump.
Great house, really looks like on the picture! the best thing was looking at whales while eating breakfast!

neighborhood_overview: The neighborhood is very quiet and typical. You have metro very near!
transit: There are some options for you to come from the airport to the apartment: - Private transfer to the apartment (Lux car): 9€/person 2 to 3 people (private driver pick up at Arrivals) - takes 20 minutes (can be used for 1 person but will cost 18€) - Transfer service in a private bus from Airport to the apartment (private driver pick up at Arrivals):    -  4  to 6 persons: 9€/person - takes 25 minutes - Metro (you should leave on General Torres stop) - 2,45€ / each person - takes 35 minutes + 2 minutes walking Service is provided by a business partner therefore is subject to availability. Car park at 20 meters (price 6 € per 24 hours)
access: Guests have access to all the amenities of the apartment.
interaction: When you arrive you will be met by Concierge Service that will receive you for check-in and share with you tips about where to find special places to eat, visit and have fun.

host.host_about: The Porto Concierge ajuda  os proprietários de imóveis que pretendem alugar as suas casas mas não têm a possibilidade de receber os seus convidados. Alugar uma casa é um trabalho árduo: garantir a sua limpeza e a manutenção da casa, receber os seus convidados quando chegam e estar disponível para eles durante a estadia. Se vive longe ou se simplesmente não tem tempo suficiente para fazer tudo isso, não se preocupe, nós podemos ajudar.

address.street: Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal
address.government_area: Santa Marinha e São Pedro da Afurada

reviews.comments: Everything was fine
Felt very welcome, great house, good location, very clean, lots of information about Porto. Overall a great few days.
We were really happy with the place. It was close to everything but still separated so we could have our own place. The terrace is huge and sunny. I would recommend the place to everyone!

Logement conforme a nos attentes , le séjour s est relativement bien passé , 2/3 petite chose sont a améliorer comme mettre a disposition un ballet , une serpillère ou bien même un parasol pour la terrasse extérieur qui est génial mais en heure de chaleur on ne peut pas en profiter sans parasol ... Une bouteille de vin nous attendait a notre arrivé , ça nous fait très plaisir en arrivant après le voyage ... Sinon que dire d autre parfois quelques odeurs de canalisation d égout , c pas très agréable mais ça dure pas longtemps généralement , sur ce les chambres étais vraiment bien , très confortable et avec clim ... La cuisine est fonctionnelle et il ne manque rien ... Le salon est agréable également , le logement a donc contribué a notre très bon séjour a porto ...

La casa es preciosa, pequeña, pero bien equipado; cuenta con una gran terraza y está en una zona tranquila. Justo al lado hay una estación de tren, desde la casa se oyen los trenes, pero no molestan demasiado a la hora de dormir. Aunque la casa contaba con garaje privado, tuvimos problemas para dejar el coche en él, por lo que el dueño acordó pagar el gasto en wl párking de la estación de tren cercana (3'50€ al día). Nos dejaron una botella de agua y otra de vino como obsequio de bienvenida. Si quieres conocer Oporto y alojarte en una zona tranquila y cercana, es una buena opción
Quartier proche de l'activité (15 min à pied des quais de Porto)

La descripcion de la casa es perfecta. Muy buena situacion y zona muy tranqyila. Al lado de la casa esta el tren y un parking muy economico. El tranvia pasa a 1 minuto caminando.
Como megativo decir que el baño de la habitacion tienen que arreglar el tema del olor, hay que cerrarlo que no se soporta.
Deberia de tener una escoba y recogedor. Por el resto todo genial.
I think Jose does not exist, the guy who came did not know the place at all. The place was clean and just renovated. The neighbourhood doesn't feel really safe but we did not have any problem at all.
Good location, really nice apartament, convenient for families with children due to lerge terrace. The only minus is the paid parking place. Recomended.

merci pour la bouteille de vin !
spacieux, clean, bien équipé et très grande terrasse.
super logement.

The place deserves 6 stars !
 We had the entire house and it has excellent. The location is 1 min away from the metro station, 10 minutes away from the river side, prefect location. 
The apartment had everything: a big terrace, clean bathrooms, beautiful rooms and you could find all that you need there: hair dryer, iron, sandwich maker, toaster, everything. 
We did not meet the host is person, we communicated by e-mail and what's up, his response was in minutes, he even gave us tips and tricks regarding Porto. 
I definitely recommend the place .

A casa tem um espaço muito bom. Comporta 6 pessoas de maneira excelente. Como pontos positivos posso citar a localização, a cozinha bem equipada e com coisas novas, camas e travesseiros de boa qualidade. Como ponto negativo principal foi o mau cheiro do banheiro do quarto, muito forte. Outro ponto é a questão do estacionamento, que entendi quando aluguei que era do imóvel, mas, no entanto, é em um estacionamento privativo próximo. Quando cheguei ao local, o responsável pela casa que me recebeu informou que voltaria no penúltimo dia para reembolsar o valor gasto com o estacionamento, mas não foi o que aconteceu.
Quando liguei me passaram que deveria encaminhar por email os comprovantes de pagamento, e assim seria feito o reembolso. Não tenho como afirmar se funcionou ou não, pois até o momento ainda não obtivemos respostas sobre o assunto. Tirando esses pequenos
percalços, tudo foi excelente. Voltaria com certeza para a casa em questão.

The White Dove is a beautiful house in a beautiful neighborhood. José wasn't there to show us around, but he gave us the information we needed by phone and there was someone else to show us around. The beds were very comfortable and the terras in the sun is lovely. We enjoyed our stay in Porto very much.

It took more than 24 hours for The Port Concierge to reply us the day before check-in due to change in itinerary. We called, texted, messaged numerous times and couldn't contact them until 10am that day. That was a bit disappointing. Other than that the house was great, comfortable bed and soundproof environment. The kitchen doesn't have all the essentials such as oil, only salt. The free wine and water was a nice touch, but still having all the necessary amenities for cooking away from home was more important. Overall a good stay.
A casa é ótima, bem equipada com quartos confortáveis e limpos. Próximo ao metro e com um curta caminhada chega-se facilmente a Ribeira. Adoramos!!! José é um excelente amfitrião.

La casa está bien equipada y es funcional. En la cocina hay una cafetera de cápsulas Delta por lo que si no llevas de casa a lo mejor te quedas sin desayunar ya que solo había 2.
En el pasillo hay sensores de movimiento así que por la noche no puedes moverte sin que se encienda la luz y por el día también se enciende así que no creo que ahorre mucho.
La terraza es agradable para comer si hace buen tiempo.
La situación está bien aunque no está en el Centro de Oporto. En 5-10 minutos paseando llegas a la Ribera del Duero (lado de Gaia) y está a 20 metros de la estación de Metro General Torres que te lleva hasta el centro en 10 minutos. Difícil aparcar por la zona porque es zona de estacionamiento regulado 24h, en la estación de metro hay un párking en el que puedes dejar el coche 24h por 5€.
El anfitrión fue correcto y nos permitió salir un poquito más tarde
Great stay. Secluded but not far from city center. Very spacious balcony. Perfectly equipped kitchen. Perfect for vacation with friends.

La maison et la terrasse étaient exactement comme sur les photos, les lieux étaient propres et la cuisine était parfaitement équipée !
Je recommande vivement ce logement pour vos séjours à Porto

Modern villa with all facilities required for a comfortable family stay - in good location to walk to riverside cafe's, restaurants and attractions, or take tram to City Centre. Cost effective car park and tram station literally next door. Only slight negative is the neighbour has two dogs that are put out every the night that bark at anything that moves!

Un logement confortable et bien équipé à proximité du métro et du quartier Gaia. Nous avons apprécié les lits confortables pour se reposer de nos journées de vadrouille dans les rues en pente de Porto. Seul point négatif, la rue est très passante.

Przestronny dom z trzema sypialniami, bardzo blisko centrum. Bardzo dobra komunikacja. Dużo miejsca przy domu do wypoczynku. Minusem jest hałaśliwy pies sąsiada, często nie pozwalający spać w nocy oraz mała ilość szaf w mieszkaniu.

The app is a splendid stay for exploring Porto and the right portwine side of the city.
The app was as desribed and nice and clean. Only minor was the dog next door, that opviously still is alive, barking most of the day. The house has allthough a good isolation of noise from dogs and the street trafic.

Jose's home is located in close proximity to all the main Porto sites making it an ideal place to stay when visiting Porto. My family and I had a very pleasant stay at White Dove. The apartment is spacious and is equipped with everything you may need for a short stay. We particularly enjoyed sitting out on the terrace enjoying the sunshine!

La casa es tal cual en las fotografías. Hay tres habitaciones y las tres con aire acondicionado.  por la noche nos fue de gran ayuda aunque la ciudad no es demasiado calurosa por la noche pero nosotros los usamos.  De la casa a los puntos más turísticos de la ciudad como el Puente de Luis I hay 5 minutos andando.  Merece la pena estar en Vila Nova de Gaia por que así estás cerca pero no en el epicentro.  Hay super cerca .  super recomendable

La casa è pulita, grande e accogliente. La posizione accanto alla metro perfetta. Si arriva a Porto centro in 5 minuti. Per la macchina c'è un posteggio coperto a pagamento accanto all'appartamento che costa al giorno 5 euro. La terrazza è bella  grande con tavolo e sedie e un salottino da esterno come si vede dalle foto. Per la mia famiglia è stata un'ottima scelta!

Logement bien situé, conforme aux attentes! Facile d'accès, spacieux propre et fonctionnel. 
Manque de savon

Hemos estado cuatro días en Octubre.
La situación es perfecta para visitar Oporto ya que puedes ir andando al centro y al mismo tiempo está lejos del bullicio.
 Hay supermercados cerca y aunque el tren pasa cerca, no se oye.
La casa está muy bien, espaciosa, todo nuevo, las habitaciones grandes,..., una terraza grande y bonita, genial para pasar unas vacaciones.
Por poner una pega, no hay muchos utensilios en la cocina, no había fregona, bayeta,..., para limpiar. 
Por las noches se oye ladrar a unos perros que molesta bastante.
Pero, a parte de esas pequeñas pegas, todo lo demás genial.
La casa es igual que las fotos.

Gracias por todo, Jose.
Susana

It's a beautiful place which is nicely located next to a metro station, which takes you to the city centre in just a couple of minutes. It was tidy, and a concierge left us a nice bottle of wine. Biggest 'problems' were a couple of dogs barking outside, and some rooms were a bit moist. All in all a great stay!

Estuvimos 4 amigos y fue todo genial!!! El apartamento genial. Las camas eran comodísimas y Jose fue super amable. Todo perfecto. El único pero la ubicación. Estaba lejos del centro y en cuesta pero fue lo de menos. Volveremos seguro!

Great stay. The perfect house with the perfect service. We did a last minute booking and everything went smooth. Everything was very clean and the comunication was perfect. The house is incredibly luxorious and fully equppied. Highly recommended
Great place. Great location.

Localização excelente, perto do Metro e com Parque Estacionamento a 100 metros (pago 5€ dia)
Espaço exterior da cada com mesa e sofás para degustar um bom vinho tinto Douro ou Vinho do Porto
Espaço Interior suficiente para 6 pessoas.
Exactly as expected. Great location for train station and the tourist area
Superbe maison dans les hauteurs du fleuve... Très bien situé, une terrasse immense... Top
A casa é excelente , extremamente limpo e organizado . A localização é ótima .

This home was beautiful with amazing views, great concierge Services and can easily walk to anywhere.  Tough for elderly to walk as it is on top of hill. Loved the villa style home with the patio for enjoyment

Adresse à retenir difícil de ne pas aimer 
Propre bien équipé et très bien Décoré

White Dove is a great place to stay, very private, centrally located and the has biggest terrace in town. A bit noisy because of the frequent bus stops (local and tourist). We had a fantastic time during our staying in Porto
