Floor wasn’t clean either – could not walk around without shoes. The bed matters was used and should be replaced. Flat advert mentioned that smoking is allowed but we couldn’t notice smell of cigarettes which was good.
La ubicación del depto de koni es fantástica! Muy atento a los detalles, la verdad nos gustó mucho nuestra estadía ahí. Nos gustaría volver!
The appartment is really comfortable with a really good location. It was really perfect for the two days we stayed in Barcelona.
The place was in the perfect location. I would definitely book here again if I were to return to Barcelona!
Would highly recommend this place, was so comfortable and homely and in a brilliant location!
Perfect localisation!! 5min from plaza catalunya! It as clean and quiet. We were 4 and it is juste perfect. Transport is really easy. I highly recommend it!!

We had a great time at Koni’s! The apartment was the perfect size for our weekend get away. The location was great as well. The sites and bus were very close. We rode the aerobus in from the airport and left our luggage at luggage locker on Sunday before flying out. Super convenient and close by. We also walked everywhere while staying in Barcelona. The host was always quick to respond as well. We were traveling with our 7 month old son and she had a crib and high chair for him to use. Thank you Koni for a great stay!

Koni’s place is extremely central to all Barcelona points of interest. The metro station is across the street (Uriquiaona/L4 line is your stop), the flat is on the 4th floor offering a sunny view, sits above a cafe offering delicious pastries and coffees, and is within walking distance of a quite a few places. After walking the city all day, you’ll be surprised to realize how close the flat is; always felt like we were one stop away- and after a long day, you take the ride rather than walk back. 
We would definitely stay here again.

overall a good stay with great transport links, nice and clean, good area, lovely building and comfortable apartment.

the issues we had:
-noisy club people located opposite making noise at 4am at the weekends only
-sub par mattress with spring sticking out the sides
-poor quality and just 2 pillows

aside from the 2  issues which i believe are easy solvable we really enjoyed our stay and would gladly return once they have been rectified
A very nice apartment.

Koni responds to messages fast and the place was great! It was close to public transport which made it easy for us to get around the city. Some of the tourist spots are easily walkable. The place is also near restaurants, fast food chain and a 24 hr convenient store which was great! Would definitely stay in Koni’s place whenever I’m in Barcelona.
Excellent place. Particularly helpful with check in and bags.

Lovely apartment in a very nice location. Local cafes etc on same street and 24 hour shop came in handy. Not too close to Touristic areas but within walking distance to all. Apartment was clean and as discribed, would of been nice to have some extra clean towels for long weekend stay but wasn't a big issue. Great communication and details prior to arrival. Will recommend to others. Thanks again
Отличные апартаменты ,суперхозяева,чистота,расположение просто фантастическое-в самом центре,не шумно,все необходимое рядом!

The house was amazing, we loved it - all the decor, we had extra blankets, pillows; the kitchen had everything and the bathroom as well; and the cleaning was impeccable which I think is very important!
Very easy to find and to get around town, close to everything.
Always ready to help, very good host!
We recommend this house and when we come back we know where to stay again!
Great location
The apartment is ok condition and is much smaller than I expected. Very good location and friendly and flexible host

Hermoso piso en Barcelona. Cerca de todo. Silencioso a pesar de estar en una zona céntrica. El contacto con Oriol fue siempre inmediato. El acceso al piso por códigos en ambas puertas hacen que uno pueda llegar a cualquier hora sin pensar en que le está haciendo perder tiempo al anfitrión. Sólo le falta una lavadita de cara a las paredes del interior para estar igual a las fotos. Salvo eso todo perfecto. Volvería sin dudas.

Logement très bien placé dans le centre de Barcelone dans un super quartier.
La décoration est très sympa et les équipements convenables convient parfaitement pour voyager avec un bébé.
Petit bémol rue assez bruyante surtout le vendredi samedi (discothèque en face de l’appartement)
The perfect location to see Barcelona on foot. Centrally located between La Sagrada Familia and Barrio Gótico, it was a breeze to see all the sights.
The house is gorgeous in a central area from which you can reach all Famous places. It is great for a family, good space and very comfortable.
Great apartment in an amazing location. You cannot get closer to the city than this and Koni was great to deal with! Thank you.

Non ho avuto di conoscere Koni personalmente,ma la comunicazione tra di noi è stata veloce ed efficace. siamo stati li con un altra coppia di amici e un bimbo piccolo di 3 anni. gli spazi sono giusti. forse l'unica nota negativa,era la rumorosità di notte della strada e  dei locali, ma che i realtà era anche una nota positiva in quanto si era in pienissimo centro , a 4 minuti da placa de catalunya. l' appartamento era molto pulito e confortevole.. consiglio vivamente a tutti di soggiornarvi... SUGGESTED

This apartment was in the best location! close to everything central but not surrounded by tourists. I would say this is a great value and was a very clean and tidy apartment. Would definitely recommend to friends staying in Barcelona.
Ubicacion excelente parada de metro bajo. Tienda  24 horas enfrente. La casa genial muy comoda y limpia.
접근성이 무척 좋고 깨끗한 집인데 밤에 좀 시끄러운게 단점이에요. 창문을 좀 이중구조로하면 좋았을텐데.. 하지만 다른건 전부 두말할것없이 좋았습니다!

Muy buen lugar! Cerca de varios servicios como restaurantes, farmacias y bares, hay de todo en el lugar, y si te gusta caminar nosotros lo hicimos hasta las ramblas, sagrada familia incluso hasta la playa. Tiene todo lo necesario y es muy cómodo y acogedor, y Coni siempre atenta y respondiendo nuestras inquietudes. Lo recomiendo.
Toplocatie! Alle voorzieningen in appartement aanwezig! Supermarkt (24u open) rechtover app. Bakkerij en lekkere tapasbar naast app! Vlotte communicatie zowel voor als tijdens de reis! Aanrader!

This place is seriously one of my favorite Airbnbs. It was in the perfect location (placa catalunya, metro stop, and las ramblas). There was a grocery store and plenty of restaurants near by. The place itself is very spacious, clean and modern. It was an easy check in process as well. I studied abroad in Barcelona for the semester and this was the best way to end my stay. It is a block away from my favorite bar (George Payne) as well as a short walk from the Arc and the Sagrada. The host is very friendly and did his best to make us feel welcome. He provided accurate directions to the apartment and there were very nice touches (shampoo, soap, detergent, towels, etc) I HIGHLY recommend staying here.
El departamento es muy comodo y amplio para dos o mas personas. Esta situado en una zona que te permite acceder a diferentes lugares caminando o en metro. Lo recomiendo.

Le logement est bien placé et la communication facile. Mais nous avons été déçues du logement après avoir vu les photos du site airbnb. Quand nous sommes arrivées, deux lits d'appoint avaient été montés dans le salon, prenant tout l'espace, alors que nous pensions simplement déplier le canapé lit au moment de dormir. Il manquait la table basse, le tapis, les coussins sur le canapé. Les draps de la chambre étaient dépareillés et anciens. La poignée de la salle de bains était cassée. Il y avait des moutons de poussière dans le salon.  Enfin, le checkin devait se faire à 13h. A 14h30, les agents de nettoyage étaient encore en train de faire le ménage. Nous ne sommes revenues qu'en fin d'après-midi.
great location
It has been a nice stay in Koni's place. The home is very stylish and had all amenities for a comfortable stay. The location was good, close to city center.
Great apartment with a great location. Walking distance to restaurants and areas to explore the city. Apartment was equipped with all we needed ! We enjoyed our stay at Koni's place
Superbe appartement , très bien situé.
Apartment is functional and conveniently located

Appartement propre et super bien situé. Il y a tout l’équipement nécessaire. En plein centre et proche de tout. Super bon rapport qualité prix. 
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.  Je le recommande !

The appartment is very clean and tidy. Very well situated in the heart of Barcelona. 
I can fully recommend this appartment.

Excellent location, nice space. Was surprised that there was no hand soap - would have been a nice touch. Bed is not very comfortable, but you get what you pay for and for the low nightly price  this apt is a good value.
We didn’t spent much time in the apartment as we were always out and about. Close to major plaza and shopping areas. No more than 4 people. I would book again at this location, Highly recommended.
Wonderful flat, very close to everything and beautifully decorated!  We will stay again!
Very central, easy walking distance to everything! Very comfortable space

The location of the apartment is great, with good restaurants and cafes within close walking distance.   The size of the apartment and layout of beds is best suited for groups of 4 or less.  We had several text exchanges with the host and he was prompt to answer but his responses were not appropriate for our concerns.
Fantastic location, well managed apartment that was clean and easy.  Enjoyed my time there.

The apartment is really nice, we can find everything we need. And it’s so convenient for us to go shopping and visit the city. Both checkin and checkout is self-service,and the guidance in the apartment is very helpful.
Highly recommended!

My husband and I truly enjoyed our stay here. We could walk or access the metro to get wherever we wanted to go. There are so many great places to eat in the area and so much. To see and do. The apartment is in a safe spot and very comfortable.
Ubicación excelente

The location was outstanding. We were just a couple of blocks from the airport bus, steps from the old town, and with easy access to the Passeig de Gracia. This meant that we could get just about everywhere we wanted to go on foot. Apartment amenities were basic, but we had everything we needed. Communication and logistics were clear and easy to manage. Overall, just what we were looking for.
Great Location! Easy check in and check out! Highly recommend!
The apartment provided is very clean and comfortable, so that our family can enjoy a wonderful holiday just like living in our own home. We will come back again !
Very central place. Apartment has no many space, but for short visit of the city it is very good choise. Recommend!

This is the perfect place to explore Barcelona. Easy to access but totally secure in the heart of the city the apartment is super comfortable with everything you need .. loved opening the shutters to watch the street scenes below. Fantastic bakery next door.
Highly recommend this place
Piso es muy lindo y cómodo. Muy bien ubicado a 3 cuadras del inicio de la Rambla. Todo funcional y con estilo.
Location idéalement située près de la rambla ; commerces à proximité.

The apartment is in a fantastic location near Placa de Catalunya. Oriol and Claudia were always very quick to respond to questions and were helpful in providing suggestions. They have a great instruction booklet set up with pictures that makes it easy to figure things out in the apartment. The apartment is newer inside and clean. We enjoyed our stay. There is a great bakery/coffee shop called 365 next door which made for a cheap and easy breakfast and lunch.

Die Wohnung ist in einer super Lage um die Stadt zu erkunden. Das Apartment ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hat eine Klimaanlage! Wir waren mit fünf Erwachsenen im Apartment, wofür es zu klein ist. Es handelt sich um ein Schlafzimmer mit einem Doppelbett, sowie ein Wohnzimmer mit einer Schlafcouch, einem Schlafsessel und einem Klappbett. Für drei Personen ist es super geeignet. Solange die Fenster geschlossen sind, ist es sehr ruhig für eine Stadtwohnung. Da eine Klimaanlage enthalten ist, kann man auch gut bei geschlossenen Fenstern schlafen. Einziges Manko war der Duschkopf, der dringend mal erneuert werden sollte, sowie die Handtücher, die uns nicht so richtig frisch vorkamen. Die Kommunikation mit Oriol lief hervorragend und durch eine kleine Schlüsselbox an der Tür ist man auf keinen Zeitpunkt zum Treffen angewiesen. Mit weniger Personen, immer wieder gerne.

Very good location whilst still being quiet because with air con you can keep the windows closed. very clean, lots of towels and linens provided. We had our 16 month old with us and it was safe for her to explore the apartment and even some crayons provided. A great base for a few days in Barcelona.

Excelente apartamento, maravillosa ubicación!!!
Anfitriones muy atentos y cordiales. 
Sin duda, volveríamos a quedarnos en este apartamento!!!
Great location, close to major tourist areas. Perfect for our needs! Thanks again.
Hemos pasado una estancia muy agradable. Aconsejamos el piso a todos los que desean estar en el centro, a proximidad de los lugares turísticos, bar y restaurantes.
Oriol’s place was really easy to get to an very convenient. It was spacious and clean. We had a great time walking around the gothic quarter.

Oriol's place is an excellent place to stay if visiting Barcelona. The location is right in the centre and can't be beat. Despite being central there is no road noise with the windows closed. The airconditioning is excellent and means this is possible in the heat of summer. The apartment is small, but even with two extra beds in the living room there was plenty of room for 4 adults. Oriol's wasn't there for check in but his instructions were super clear so we didn't have any issues. The kitchen is sufficent for preparing light meals. Wifi is good and easy to log on to. There was some noise from the neighbors as expected in an apartment block but this stopped at a reasonable hour. All in all are great airbnb, I would be happy to stay again.
Nuestra estadia en Barcelona fue muy agradable, el departamento lindo y muy limpio, gracias, y guardo la direccion para mi familia y amigos, ya sabemos donde volver a hospedarnos sin ninguna duda
Great appartment in Barcelona, with lot of shops, restaurants and things to see closeby. Not disappointed!

We stayed 2 nights and enjoyed it. the apartment is in an excellent location, walking distance to everything and especially the bus to and from airport. The apartment is also spacious and comfortable. I would definitely recommend this place.
公寓就在加泰罗尼亚广场附近,去到名品街和市区的景点都很方便｡楼下就有地铁和公车,公车可以直达海边｡挺精致的小公寓,打扫的很干净,出入都有门禁,很安全~不过希望房主还是提前把被子准备好,就不用我们再找被子了｡
Good location, metro, buses, cafes, and bars nearby.  Nice walk to the Gaudi apartments and old town.
This apartment is in a great location in Barcelona. Overall, this is good option, but the place is pretty basic.

Thank you Koni for a great stay in Barcelona! The central location of your place is ideal for exploring the city, it was perfectly clean, nicely decorated and the instructions on how to use everything in the apartment were very helpful. Self check in is so convenient as well!

Fantastic option for staying in central Barcelona.  As well as being a very clean and simple apartment, there are two advantages relative to others: very efficient air conditioning, and great double glazing meaning the apartment is both cool and quiet.  Good night's sleep guaranteed!
Cute apartment in a very convenient place to explore Barcelona from. Enjoyed a festival with food trucks along the park nearby!!
Overall, we had a very good experience. The place was very clean, and the location was great. We would definitely stay here again.

This was a nice place and great location in Barcelona- very close to everything. We appreciated the elevator, easy check-in and stylishly cute apartment. Nice bathroom and kitchen. Private bedroom was nice. The bed was a little too firm for our liking and pillows very small. Street noise was distracting for sleeping, but luckily there was a fan to plug in for white noise. Communication was extremely minimal with host/owner and felt very impersonal. I felt it was maybe slightly overpriced.
Great location. Close to the attentions. Lots of restaurants nearby.

The location was great! Apartment was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. The hairdryer and shampoo and soap in the bathroom were a nice touch. I do wish there was hand soap in the bathroom though, since this is often something you don’t travel with. Thanks for a great stay in Barcelona, Koni!

Checking in was easy and the location of this place is SUPER PRIME. It’s literally nearby a popular neighborhood El Born, and in between the center point of everywhere you should be, Passeig de Gràcia, etc. This is my second time in Barcelona so I really loved the location. Another plus is how secure this place is, equipped with cameras in the lobby and the apartment door has a triple door bolt lock. The apartment itself is very standard and equips just good enough for what you need. Only complaint was how thin and cheap the pillows were, as well as blankets were (felt thin as a towel) and the actual bath towels were also very thin and rough. Also wish there was actual hand soap in the bathroom... I had to take the dish soap from the kitchen to move to the bathroom to use as hand soap.
Excelente ubicación muy cerca de metro urquinaona, caminando se llega a todo. Sólo incluiría mas limpieza y detalles de parte del anfitrión hacia su huéspedes.

The location was GREAT.  Very central to many sites and attractions.  Close to public transportation and Plaça de Catalunya.  We were a little concerned about noise but other than the first Friday night (minimal noise), it was very quiet.

If this is your first time, or tenth time in Barcelona, I highly recommend Koni's place. it was centrally located to all major sights and very close to a metro stop for those further away. Koni was very responsive to any questions we had and made sure everything was perfect. The apartment was  very tidy and cute! They had a lot of appliances and items that might make your stay a little more comfortable! I highly recommend.
Good location to stay in Barcelona

Das Apartment von Koni ist sehr zentral gelegen und ideal um Barcelona zu erkunden. Die Metro sowie ein 24 Stunden Shop ist in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Wir haben zu dritt 3 Nächte dort verbracht und die Größe dafür ist passend. 
Der Check -In mit Schlüsselcode hat ohne Probleme funktioniert. 
Das Apartment ist sauber und alles Notwendige ist vorhanden.
Die Mikrowelle war nicht funktionstüchtig (sofern wir nichts falsch gemacht haben ;)
Auf alle Fälle würden wir das Apartment empfehlen und wieder kommen!
Convenient location and nice room
Koni is a superhost easy to communicate with. The apartment is supernice with perfect location. Highly recommended. Thank you Koni.

Everything was perfect, clean and confortable. The apartment is only 5 minutes away from La Rambla, 1 minute away from train station. A big plus is the elevator, for lazy people like me  
I highly recommend it!!!
Would highly recommend. Host is very communicative and the apartment was very beautiful and very clean. Location was great.
Koni's place is very nice and comfortable. The location is perfect for exploring Barcelona and his communication is excellent. Highly recommended.

La ubicación excelente, al lado del centro plaza Cataluña y parada urquinaona abajo. El apto espacioso y correcto. El colchón un poco incómodo y algo pequeña la cama d matrimonio (1,35). Sartenes y toallas muy viejas. El resto ok y cómodo todo, tb atención del anfitrión en todo momento.
Perfect location, nice style, towels didnt smell well, bed not very comfortable and small for two people.
The apartment location is fabulous . Near plaza Catalunya, the metro, nice restaurants. We have enjoyed a lot our staying .

Nous n'avions pas de chauffage il faisait froid dans l'appartement. Nous étions deux le lit était petit. il n'y avait pas de couverture pour la personne qui dormait dans le salon.  Pas possibilité de prendre un café à notre arrivée. Si non Koni était très réactif à la demande de réservation. L'appartement est très bien situé. Je recommande cet appartement.

Great place! The apartment is incredible and clean, the location is amazing—so central, and the host is extremely accommodating and communicative and helpful! I will definitely stay here again in the future!
Koni's has a very nice apartment in a very good location. In addition, Koni was an excellent host.
Oriol was a great host. Great location,  nice and clean apartment, big enough for us 3 adults and 2kids. There was everything we needed and it was just perfect! Thank you very much!
Oriol was a great host and very responsive. This is a great option for those looking to stay in Barcelona. Great location and very clean place.

Koni's apartment is in one of the best locations to walking anywhere in the city! It was a 5 min walk to Las Ramblas and many great restaurants.  The neighborhood is pretty quiet at night but you can hear some noise from neighbors so if you're a light sleeper, heads up! If you are looking for an apartment in one of the best locations in the city, then this is your place!

위치가 아주 훌륭합니다. 초역세권!이고 중심지라 이동하기 편했습니다. 따듯한물 잘나오고 체크인이 쉬워서 좋았습니다. 와이파이가 빠른편입니다.
다만 옆집? 윗집? 소리가 잘 들립니다. 방음 약한거 빼고는 좋습니다. 맽으리스가 조금 꼬졌는지 중간중간 꺼져있습니다.

Esta en el centro de Barcelona cerca del Catedral de Barcelona. En camino ay muchas tiendas de marca y restaurantes de todos tipos. También atrás del catedral esta en barrio gótico y mucho más. Este lugar fue perfecto si estás aquí por 2-5 días.
Great location, highly recommend for a mini break in Barcelona
Cute place, clean and good location. The host made the entire process easy.

Highly recommend this place!  It was charming and spotlessly clean.  The location was amazing (just a couple of blocks from Plaza de Catalunya, where the Aerobus dropped us from our trip into the city from the airport - only 5,90 Euros each).  Two Juliette balconies for looking down on the city street.  There was also a book of helpful information in the place, and the self-check-in was a breeze!
Easy check-in, clean flat and really good location.
非常方便的地理位置!机场A1直接到达广场,走大概5多分钟就到房子了,旁边就是地铁口,楼下有便利店和餐厅,有电梯,非常完美｡全程自助入住,入住流程非常详细和简单!另外推荐一家餐厅,ARUME｡从这里出发走路的话大概在10-15分钟吧~巴塞罗那是个很美丽的城市,圣家堂还没有完全竣工,下次一定还会再来的,这个房子是个不错的选择!
Absolutely central, steps away from the metro and really close to all attractions in Barcelona. The house is big enough for 3 or 4 and it even has a washing machine. Smooth check in and helpful host!
The flat is very well located. You can go by walk to many famous places around. We enjoyed the stay here.

name: Terrace Appartment
summary: Apartment in the top floor of a residence building with a front terrace and a back balcony.Located in a central zone of Porto it features easy, fast access to the city center: 13 minutes walking to the pedestrian zone  or 4'  to metro station   Apartamento no último andar de um prédio de habitação com um terraço para a frente e uma varanda nas traseiras. Localiza-se numa zona central: 13 minutos a pé  até à  zona pedonal da Baixa, 4 minutos a pé   até à estação de Metro (tempos da GMaps)
space: É possível guardar o carro na garagem do prédio. Parking in the building.

Parking in the building.
house_rules: - Não são permitidas festas ou eventos. - Não é permitido ruído das 21:30h às 9:30h

reviews.comments: The accommodation was much nicer than we had anticipated, too big for two people (and hence more expensive) but perfect for us because our grandchildren came round on several occasions.  It was clear that Alexandra had spent much effort (and money) to make the place really nice, but there were minor problems with the area (workshops at night and a noisy lift in the early morning) that might deter the very sensitive and light sleeper.  The beds were very comfortable and the shower room and (2) toilets immaculate

Alexandra was so friendly and helpful, she really made us feel very welcome! She went above and beyond to make us feel at home at her place. The apartment itself is beautiful, clean and a great space with everything you need. There is a gorgeous view of the city from the terrace. The city is easily accessible by metro or 30 mins walk. We had a great stay, thanks Alexandra!

Tivemos um excelente estadia! O apartamento é exactamente como está nas fotos. Todo o espaço está muito cuidado. A Alexandra foi uma excelente anfitriã, respondeu sempre muito rápidamente às mensagens e facilitou a nossa chegada ao apartamento. Recomendo!
Casa muito bem localizada, fui muito bem recebida e a Alexandra foi muito prestável. Recomendo a quem quer passar uma otima e agradável estadia no Porto.

The apartment had evrything we needed , it was nice to be able to sit out on the terrace at sunset .
Apartment was extremely clean 

Recycling facilities on the street are limited , and we were noit sure where to take recyclable items

Alexandra s'est montrée disponible (accueil à minuit) et très prévenante. Elle parle un français parfait ce qui est un plus. Elle partage ses bons plans (cafés, restaurants..) avec joie. 
L'appartement est clair, spacieux et agréable. La rénovation est soignée. 
Chacune des deux chambres dispose d'un lit double et de sa pièce d'eau : WC et lavabo pour l'une, salle d'eau et WC pour l'autre. Deux couchages supplémentaires (deux lits simples) sont installés dans le salon-salle à manger. 
La cuisine est moderne. Elle permet d'y préparer et d'y prendre ses repas à deux personnes. Pour davantage de convives, la terrasse nous tend les bras. Le tout est d'une propreté impeccable.
Deux points moins favorables : un ascenseur bruyant qui ne permet ni les endormissements sereins, ni les grasses matinées ; et un emplacement un peu excentré. Il faut compter une petite trentaine de minutes pour aller dans le centre à pied : prendre le métro, tout proche, dès que l'on peut, parce que ça monte au retour.
Le quartier est calme et plutôt résidentiel, en cours de réhabilitation.
Un mini-supermarché très économique (Dia) et un boulanger se trouvent à proximité.
Nous n'avons pas regretté notre choix!
Encore merci Alexandra.
Fantastic place to relax after exploring Porto - not one but two balconies and very nice furnishings too! Would highly recommend.

Excelente Apartamento no Porto. Espaço bem confortável, com ótimas instalações, banheiro e cozinha renovados e com ótimo aspecto. Ainda há um ótimo terraço para passar um tempo observando a v do bairro. A localização também é boa. Há uma pequena distância a pé do centro e servida por uma linha de metro. Recomendo. 5 estrelas!
Just a couple of stops on the Metro from the centre of everything. Very comfortable. Good communication. Alexandra was very easy to deal with.
El apartamento tiene todo lo necesario y una bonita terraza.

Spacious and beautiful flat with huge balcony and sun in the evening.
Very nice introducion from Alexandra to describe Porto.
Very helpful and fast in responsing.
Nice trip to Porto :) Thanks for that.

This apatment is vell located, near 100 m from metro station. Around this place you can find many shops for food, cafe etc. The rooms are very clean, good furniture inside, there are two toilet room that is very comfortable if you stay here with children or two or more pairs. Very large terrase and balcony are very useful if 3 or more people live in this apartment.  Friendly and sociable nature of the mistress of the house. Full satisfaction!
O apartamento é central. Próximo de restaurantes e de transportes públicos. Recomendo.

Casa bella pulita confortevole . La signora Alexandra disponibile e gentilissima come tutti i portoghesi che abbiamo incontrato. Consigliatissimo. 
Grazie di cuore per aver reso speciale la vacanza.

Alexandra e seu apartamento são mais que 5*. Incrível hospitalidade, apartamento amplo, limpo, funcional, muito bem localizado. E com uma terraça incrível. Nos proporcionou uma ótima experiência na cidade do Porto. Recomendado 100%.

Alexandra's apartment was really lovely and neat.It had everything we needed for a great stay in (Website hidden by Airbnb) was only a short walk to the market around the corner, which was great as we did a lot of cooking, in her well equipped kitchen
The train station was only 5 minutes walk away which made for easy connection to the airport 
Overall we had a fantastic stay at Alexandra's apartment, far better value than a hotel.
Highly recommend to others.
Thank you Alexandra, for being a great host and for all the information on Porto, hope to see you again some day!

Merci pour tout Alexandra, très bonne accueil et magnifique appartement. Nous étions idéalement situé à la fois près du centre ville et proche aussi du stade du Dragao. Les lits sont confortables, vous avez une belle terrasse pour prendre votre petit-déjeuner sous le soleil de Porto. Pour les fans de foot vous êtes à 15min du stade du dragao. Tout cela pour dire que je suis plus que satisfait de mon séjour. Je recommande chaudement cet appartement en cas de visite de porto.
La casa es espaciosa y amplia para 6 personas perfectamente, cerca del centro y con una anfitriona maravillosa, repetiría sin dudar, Alexandra es muy atenta y se portó muy bien con nosotros.

Apartamento exatamente como está nas fotos, limpo e boa localização.A Alexandra foi uma excelente anfitriã e fomos muito bem recebidos ! 
Foi uma estadia muito bem passada. Recomendo
Alexandra gave us tips and information of where to go in Porto was always at the other end of the telephone to answer any questions we had. All in all a very considerate, welcoming, interesting host.
Casa acogedora, limpia y completa facilidad para ir al centro andando y Alexandra muy atenta en todo momento. Muy recomendable
Recomendo a todos não só em relação a Alexandra como também o apartamento em si. Obrigado.

Nous avons passé un bon séjour à Porto. L’appartement est modeste mais propre dans un quartier ouvrier, bien situé et proche des moyens de transport pour faciliter la visite de Porto. Nous nous attendions à ce que le bruit de l’ascenseur soit réglé....mais il persiste toujours c’est une question structurelle de l’édifice.

We really enjoyed our stay in Alexandra's apartment! The apartment is big, clean and has everything you need! Also, it is very nicely located which makes exploring Porto very easy. We were able to check-in at a later hour which was great! Would definitely recommend staying at Alexandra's apartment!

sehr schönes Apartment.
die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. es gibt zwei Schlafzimmer mit Doppelbett, und ein Wohnzimmer wo zwei Schlafcouchen stehen. die Küche ist gut ausgestattet und es ist sogar eine Waschmaschine vorhanden.
die Lage ist nicht im Zentrum aber man kann ohne Probleme in 10-15 Minuten die Altstadt mit  all ihren Sehenswürdigkeiten erreichen. zudem ist eine Metro Station nur ein paar Minuten entfernt von der aus man alles sehr gut erreichen kann. auch Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind in direkter Nähe. ich würde das Apartment sofort wieder mieten und ohne Vorbehalte weiter empfehlen.

Very nice apartment.
The hostess is very friendly and helpful. There are two bedrooms with a double bed, and a living room where there are two sofa beds. The kitchen is well equipped and there is even a washing machine available.
The location is not in the center but you can easily reach the old town with all its sights in 10-15 minutes. Moreover, a Metro station is only a few minutes away from which you can reach everything very well. Shopping facilities are also in the immediate vicinity. I would immediately rent the apartment again and recommend without reservation.
logement très bien situé à 5 minutes du métro et spacieux

Alexandra is such a great host: she was very kind, thoughtful and let us feel at home the second we arrived. The communication was great, it was super easy to get in touch with her and she replied really fast. She even send us information about ongoing events in Porto around the time we were there. The apartment was a great place to relax, there are two supermarkets within a 5 minute walk and the station Marques. So you can either walk downtown (20-25 minutes) or take the metro (5 minutes). We'd definitely come back to Alexandra the next time we stay in Porto!

Alexandra was a great host! The appartment was very clean and spacious, as well as well equipped and well located. It is 15 minutes away from the center by foot and very close to a metro and bus station. The check-in and out timing was flexible, which was a plus to the excellent welcome we received with a pleasant talk and some suggestions and recommentations. I encourage you to stay in Alexandra's flat and enjoy a wonderful trip in Porto!

Alexandra was really responsive in communication, and was there to check us in when we arrived, with plenty of information about sightseeing, local restaurants etc. The apartment is spacious, well-equipped, clean, quiet, and has TWO amazing balconies. Note that while the apartment is very central in Porto, it's not *right* in the touristic center. You can walk to the Ribeira neighborhood in about 25-30 minutes (passing lots of restaurants, shops, churches) - and the apartment itself is in a very residential, non-touristy  part of the city, which is exactly what we were looking for. Porto is very hilly (gorgeous!) but plan accordingly for distance AND elevation changes!

Ótimo espaço, amplo, limpo com tudo o que se pode precisar para uma estada de vários dias, bem localizado, próximo ao metrô e ônibus. Da varanda se tem uma vista incrível do por do sol. Ficamos no apartamento por 16 dias e não sentimos nenhuma falta de carro. A Alexandra é uma pessoa muito simpática, gentil e sempre esteve pronta a responder aos nossos questionamentos, tanto antes quanto durante nossa estada. Só temos a agradecer e, numa próxima viagem ao Porto, com certeza esta será nossa primeira escolha.

Lejligheden er perfekt til en tur til Porto. Den ligger meget centralt til de fleste ting, der er værd at se. Lejligheden har en perfekt størrelse til en familie, og altanen er perfekt til at sidde og nyde sine måltider på, kort sagt en perfekt base for et ophold i Porto.

Appartement très propre, il est situé à 15 min à pied du centre de Porto. 
La terrasse est le gros plus de cet appartement.

Logement spacieux et impeccable proche de toutes commodités et du centre animé de Porto.... Belle étape pour les amoureux du Portugal où il fait bon séjourner, dormir (literie exceptionnelle !) et profiter de la grande terrasse !
Merci à Alexandra pour son accueil chaleureux et son français parfait !
Nous y reviendrons avec plaisir !
Nathalie et Nicolas (mère et fils)

Really nice place. The furniture is amazing, there is a lot of rooms and the tarrace was our favourite. Kitchen has everything you need. The place was very clean. Localization is great, a lot of caffes, stores and a park nearby, city center within walking distance. The owner is a very kind and patient person, she was very helpful. The only downside of the place is really slow wifi. Also, be careful of the self locking front door.
All in all, an amazing place I'd recommend to anyone :)
Everything was OK, we had a perfect time at Porto. Many thanks to Alexandra!
Everything was fine, it's a really nice place to stay while you're in Porto, is a 15 minute walk to get to the center of the city.

L'appartement est conforme à la description. Le quartier est calme. Métro, commerces ( dont poissonnerie et boucherie) sont proches. Le balcon à l'est et la terrasse à l'ouest permettent de pouvoir toujours profiter du soleil. Il y a un cabinet de toilette avec WC en plus de la salle de bain. Le séjour et la communication avec Alexandra ont été très agréables. Seul inconvénient : le bruit de ascenseur.
Very nice and calm place, highly recommended
Great apartment, well located with great outdoor space, on a calm street... Alexandra was a great host :)

reviews.comments: Fabulous views, beautiful renovation, great kitchen facilities, spotlessly clean, private and relaxing.
Amazing home in fantastic location. Exceeded already high expectations. Clean, modern, comfortable, oceanfront, semi-private beach, great hosts.

Fantastic home - perfect location sunsets were amazing- private yet accessible- host was fantastic with communication- showed up within minutes when we needed a jump- but left us to total privacy in general. It's a very open home with ocean sound all day and night - perfect spot on North Shore - I have traveled a lot and this was a special and unique spot with a great vibe. Highly recommended Aloha
We had a great stay here. Pictures and description are totally accurate. Location is good and right in the middle of a ton of beaches within a short drive if you want to go away from the house.
We had a great time staying here. The house is lovely, and the location is amazing. Every sunset blew us away. Will definitely be back.
Stunning location.

name: Charming apartment in Plateau Mont Royal
summary: The apartment is in the heart of the Plateau-Mont-Royal, at the border of the Mile-End. All the cafes, restaurants, and boutiques you'd hope for are nearby. The place is also at a 2 min. walk from the Laurier Metro Station, which will take you downtown in minutes. The Parc Laurier is 10 min. away. The place is comfortable, homy, and welcoming, ideally located in a central neighbourhood. Good for couples, small groups, solo adventurers. Families (with kids) are also welcome!

Fully-equipped kitchen, with bar stools. Cozy living room/dining area. Cute, quiet balcony in the back.  The bathroom is rather small but convenient. Self-check in, which allows for more flexibility.

reviews.comments: Really great place ! Super close to the metro station and many restaurants. Host was amazing with communication and check in was smooth.

On a passé une merveilleuse experience dans l’appart d’emilie. Endroit magnifique avec beaucoup d’espace et un balcon ensoleillé et tranquille. Emilie est très arrangeante. Merci! On reviendra avec plaisir!
Super apart bien placé
Emillie was very kind and hospitable, great stay!
Appartement tranquille, bien situé c'était parfait !
I highly recommend Emilie's place. Its super convenient and 10 min drive to downtown. If you are lucky you can find a parking spot right by her apartment. Its clean and comfy.

Our stay was great! 
Emilie's apartment is the true Montreal experience (I used to live there). The classic walk-up, the original details: hardwood floors and crown mouldings, the quaint balcony to sit and enjoy your morning coffee. Her place is incredibly close to the metro station and the location is incredible, it has all you need for shopping, eating, drinking, sight-seeing, you name it. Emilie was a great host, and it was very easy and quick to communicate. Our check-in was a breeze :)
Clean and cute space in a beautiful location
Le logement est idéalement placé pour visiter Montréal.

Really homey, classic Montreal vibes. Balcony was very enjoyable. The door was a bit of a hassle as well as there was no toilet paper however for the cost it was well worth it! Great location too close enough to pretty much everything but residential enough to find some calm in the city!
Great place, in a great location. Emilie was quick to respond to any questions.
Rapport Qualité prix parfait, appartement bien situé (metro et épicerie à 3-4 min) propre et charment.

host.host_about: Kahea Zietz is the Broker for Hawaii Life Vacations, a local real estate company offering vacation and long term rentals.  We are based on Kauai with rentals and real estate on all islands. We offer island hosts, property managers and offices statewide. Our rentals are professionally managed and each home comes with complimentary concierge services. We look forward to hosting you.

reviews.comments: All in all, we had a wonderful stay here. The location is excellent and the room was private and quiet. We had a few bumps with checking in, but Jason the property manager was very quick to fix the problems and follow up with us when finished. FYI- the air conditioners are portable window units, so it can get very hot in the unit rather quickly if not turned on. The kitchen was fully stocked and we were even greeted with tea, cookies, and cold drinks in the fridge. Great amenities like candles, wifi, Netflix, and a double shower head (though the hot water tends to run out very fast that way). We also were directed to download an app which didn't seem entirely necessary (and pretty difficult on an island with limited service), as the same info was found in the confirmation email and by asking Jason for the wifi password. With all that, we'd definitely stay here again if we return to Kauai.
Great experience
This home was a great place to stay and we enjoyed our time on the south shore immensely while here.

The place was fantastic and exactly how it was featured. It was easy to find and was in an amazing location in PoiPu beach. There is a restaurant next door, a place to rent water gear, and amazing snorkeling literally 100 steps from the place! I will definitely come back to Kauai again and hope that this place is available! Thank you!!

Well, this is way overpriced. It is very clean, has a good kitchen and the location is good, BUT very small, 3rd floor no elevator, no pool, a really noisy air-conditioner that you can't turn off because it gets really hot in minutes. The host did not send the locker combination and did not respond for another 30 minutes, we had to wait. So, not my best experience with Airbnb (

100 steps to Poipu was average. We enjoyed our stay here. Pros: This was a good location to the beach, restaurants, running paths and outdoor activities. The location felt safe; unit was clean; had coffee pods waiting for us to use, and water in the fridge. Cons: we never received a welcome packet, so there was no instructions for entry, internet use, or check out procedures; the AC was off when we arrived and took forever to cool down the unit; the bathroom smelled like sewer, which never diminished; washer and dryer situation was sketchy: one washer was inoperable, the other was partially taken apart; Kahea, the property manager was minimally responsive, and seemed annoyed when contacting her for entry and internet use instructions. Overall, I would say that cost of the stay was a good value.

The location was great - less than 100 steps to beach and very close to a surf shop. Also a 3min drive to the closest shopping center with food and general store. The house was also very clean with enough space for 3 ppl and maybe even more. Good kitchen but there were no cooking essentials - oils etc. 

Bad part - I didn't know this property is on the 3rd floor and it was a hassle to bring our luggage up. Also, the condo does not have good ventilation so it gets hot very easily. We had to have the AC most of the time which was a bit loud. The property manager also warned us not to use the hair dryer when the ac is on. 

Besides that, the house had beach chairs, umbrella so it was great to not spend money on that. I liked this place but would have been great to have the disclaimer about the 3rd floor beforehand. Thanks for a great stay!

Worked out ok, very close to the beach. Hated that we were told to download an app. I said I couldn't (or wouldn't) download it and was sent email directions for check-in, internet, etc which was much better. Check-in/internet/check-out was very easy and I didn't have any issues. There were beach towels, beach chairs, a cooler, basics for the kitchen like salt, oil, cooking spray, and a lot of cleaning supplies (we gave the place a once over to keep it neat during our stay and was nice to have all of that available to us). Area was safe, neighbors were friendly and was close to a lot of neat things to walk to. 

Because of the name we counted the steps and its over 200 steps to the grass park BEFORE the beach for our 5'1 traveler and over 160 steps for our 6'3 traveler and that's is starting counting after you leave the 3rd floor condo and walk down stairs and to the street. We stopped counting at the grass because it wasn't close to 100. :)

Personally, I would not stay here again with 4 people because if you are going to the beach a lot there is no good place to hang up wet things to dry out for the next day. Parking is also not a lot of fun if there is a tenant in 8; its just harder to get out. Also, there was no table to eat at with family, just two counters for 2 people to sit at. And there is no coffee maker, there is a keurig but no actual coffee maker (we had two coffee snobs in our group so it mattered to them). Otherwise location was great and if those things (table, coffee maker, and a deck or place to hang wet things) don't matter to you its a great place to stay. 

I agree with other reviews that is was very very hot/stuffy when we got there. The main room is south facing and gets a lot of sun/heat especially if the windows are closed it gets extra stuffy. We stayed at a different location the week prior to this and it was always nice and cool with no AC. Here we needed the AC for the first 2 days, we tried without it and opening all the windows but the circulation wasn't great. Day 3 we felt we were on top of the stuffiness and in the evening turned it off and worked out great with windows open.
Very cleanly, had everything we needed from beach towels, beach chairs and cooler! Enjoyed how  spacious and great of a location it was! Will definitely recommend!

Everything was excellent, thoughtful, and thorough. Best part of all was the brief walk to the beach/park. The condo was very clean and orderly upon arrival, there are AC units in each room, Netflix on the TV, beach towels, beach chairs, fully stocked kitchen utensils, and comfortable beds. We couldn't ask for anything more and had an excellent stay.

The condo was very nice and a good size for our family of five. We were able to fit our pack and play crib easily into the bigger bedroom. It was a plus to have a tv in each room- and they were all equipped with Netflix, etc. it was just down the street from the beach and there is a small convenience store within a short walk. The views were beautiful and there were enough dishes and pots/pans to live and cook comfortably. One drawback was not having a dishwasher- so we had to hand wash everything after each meal. From other reviews, I expected trouble with he A/C. It wasn't a huge issue, but it was definitely very hot and humid by midday and into the night. We had the fans and all three A/C units running and by the middle of the night it was cold- we turned them off in the middle of the night and were comfortable through the morning of the next day. We used the laundry facilities- make sure you have quarters on hand when you go down there. Parking was a little tight as you are in the very last stall and wedged between a car behind and the building to your left- take caution when pulling in and out. We really appreciated the beach gear (umbrella, chairs, towels, cooler) available for guest use! Overall, we were very happy with our stay. My only real complaint Is that Kahea seemed preoccupied and was not good at responding to questions or concerns-  we didn't have any major concerns, but if we had, I would have been out of luck. She seems to be unavailable or unwilling to help guests after booking.

We loved our stay, and are sad to leave. The condo is nicer than the photos and the location is amazing. Would stay again!!! Bring snorkel gear because there is great snorkeling just a short walk away!

Excellent value at top notch location.  Further from the beach than 100 steps but still really close.  The condo was really hot and stuffy when we arrived and it kind of remained that way the whole time we were there but was not a deal breaker.  It was updated and clean.

This unit is decorated nicely and is in a good location. We greatly appreciated the use of beach chairs and umbrella.  Due to issues such as consistent sewage smell in the bathroom, cockroach issues and ineffective means of cooling the unit I would not stay here again.

Perfect, super close to a white sandy beach for all ages, surfing and restaurants. Still quiet (except for unavoidable roosters) clean, safe and easy. All the things you need. It has AC in all the rooms but we turned it off as soon as we arrived, windows and fans in every room was just what we wanted. So close to the beach you can hear the waves crashing.

Das Appartement ist nur wenige Meter vom Poipu Strand entfernt. 
Es ist sehr schön eingerichtet und war sauber. 
Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist top. 
Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen und würden jederzeit wieder zurückkommen.
Great apartment. Super clean! Would highly recommend.
Stay was great
Great place, great location, best beach on the island (in my opinion). Loved the stay, my wife and I got married here and couldn't be more happy! Thank you!
Very nice place; everything needed for a beach stay provided. The condo is new, very clean and comfortable. AC provided in all rooms a big plus.

Great little condo, would rent again when we go back. All rooms have portable A/C units. No patio, but we truly only slept here, otherwise we were out exploring. Some coffee, beach towel, beach chairs and snorkel gear provided.

Nice place.  Perfect for our needs.  We stayed with 3 people.  Quiet residential location.  Walked to very nice beach park Walked to Waiohai resort where other family was staying and is the main reason we chose this place.  Walked to Breneke's restaurant too.

This place is a must.  Only 2 drawbacks were being on the 3rd floor, and a/c units need to be emptied every 8 hours by the occupant.  If you're not home, you come back to a hot house.  No other complaints, and everything on the profile was accurate.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

great location, extremely close to the beach, place as per photos, great place to stay.
 only thing to note is that the air conditioning is very loud.
This was the perfect location! Just steps from one of the best beaches in Kauai! This condo was super clean and even had amenities that were were not expecting. We would definitely stay here again!

Very clean, updated and great location. The AC was also a benefit of this place. Convenient that it has designated parking and access to a shared laundry unit. We appreciated the beach gear and stocked kitchen as well. Would recommend this place to friends and stay here again!

A great place to stay, the effort of walking up all those stairs is worth the view.  Sitting at the kitchen bench eating breakfast while looking out the window is very relaxing.  Being able to walk to the beach is a big plus, the snorkeling is great, and we saw seals and turtles almost every day.  Access to the laundry is unreliable.  Other top things to do from here are the drive up Weimea Canyon, and kayak up Wailua River with a hike to the Secret Falls. We had a very relaxing week here.

This is an amazing apartment that is truly only steps away from a very nice beach. It was super clean and very well equipped. There is also lots of beach equipment. We called the service company a few times and they were very responsive - for example, they helped us find a great babysitter for our daughter one evening. 

Would definitely recommend this place!

This place lived up to all the great reviews and more.  This was our first time to the Island and I picked this location because it was 100 steps to the beach but ended up getting so much more.  The home was clean and inviting.  It had A/C and Tv's with internet in every room.  The Kitchen had everything you need to cook meals and had a coffee maker and a Keurig.  The location is prime and has multiple restaurants you can walk to in 2-10 minutes.  We rented a car but after a couple of days driving around came to realize we were on the best part of the Island and stayed at the Condo most the time.  The communication with the host was quick and easy.  There is a washer and dryer on site and shower to rinse off after you return from the beach.  They provided 2 laundry tabs, dish soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, beach towels, towels, and toilet paper.  They also had some 2 beach chairs, body boards, snorkel gear and some flippers.  You will not be disappointed at all.  I think my only caution would be to someone with conditions that would make going up and downs stairs an issue.  It is on the 3rd story of the complex but the view out the windows every morning and evening is worth the stairs.

host.host_about: I travel a lot and happy to share my space with someone while I'm traveling. I'm very optimistic, friendly and love to stay at the local places when I'm traveling.

reviews.comments:
The place was exactly what I looked for my stay and was great for my business trip.

Location is great. It's a few blocks from 23rd Street train station, which is convinient as you can take E train directly from JFK without transfers. Other metro stations are in walking distance as well. Super close to High Line and in very nice street block in Chelsea, very quiet which is not usuall for the busy NY. Great restaurants/bars in walking distance. 

Host is attentive, informative, and made sure that I have everything I need for my stay. Fast response. Easy to communicate. Keys pick up/drop off are easy. Accommodating. 

Place is on a smaller side (well, it's NYC) but perfect for me as I was by myself. It has everythings I needed and nothing I didn't need. Comfy bed. Modern kitchen space to prepare coffee/food. Super clean. Lots of light during the day. Washer/dryer, which is kind of luxury in NYC. Bathtub to relax. Building is clean and quiet.

Gina was the most welcoming host and provided everything I needed and if not she was quick to organize.  Great at communication - I knew exactly all the detials for my stay very quickly and efficently. Plus, she gave local tips and hot spots to try - fab! I would highly recommned this apartment. It is small, but well equipt, fantastic location and in the heart of Chelsea! After living in NYC for three month here I cam to love the washing maching in the unit (luxury). I loved my extended stay and enjoyed living there.

This is my the most favorite place to stay in Manhattan. This is a high-end area of Chelsea with beautiful trees, beautiful people and beautiful cafes. It's been my second time booking this flat, and I have no regrets. 

The host is fantastic. She is so accommodating, so polite and so friendly. She is always available over the phone / text/ email to answer all the questions and to give any recommendation on secret spots in NYC. She always makes me feel like I'm coming to visit my good friend's place who is out of town. 

Her place is well kept, spotless clean, modern and has an exposed brick wall for added character. The key pickup&dropoff is super smooth and available 24/7. 

This is great for a nomad like myself or a business traveler or even someone who wants to explore NY as a real New Yorker and avoid all the touristy spots yet be conveniently close to them. This is no large place but totally perfect for one person. 

There are the best bagel place, lots of bakeries and coffee shops in the neighborhood. Also it's conveniently close to subway. And forgot to mention, it's just one block from High Line!!! One of the evening I stayed, I saw a famous producer at the restaurant close by - I know it's not about the listing but the neighborhood is so cool. 

Love it! Recommend it! Looking forward to be back!

the location is perfect. I felt calm and safe
deli, 24hours cvs ..etc, everything is near the place.
it was my first AIRBNB, Gina makes me use this later again :) she is really kind and sweet. always ask me if there are problem with place! also whenever I'd like to contact her to ask something, she replied directly :)
you will not regret if choose this lovely place!

This is a very comfortable, clean and convenient place to stay in. Gina is one of the best, very rare and responsible hosts that you may not know still exists, She was always concerned about my stay in her well stocked apartment. Living there is made even easier by the availability of a washer/drier within the room, its proximity to the 1,2, E and C subway stations and affordable supermarkets and restaurants. I will always recommend this place to anyone wishing to stay in a clean, comfortable, quiet and convenient place.
Gina is an amazing host and is always available. The apartment is super cozy, clean, comfortable, and close to all amenities. I highly recommend it!!!
Gina is terrific. Rented it for my 21 year old daughter doing an internship in NYC

Very quaint flat in a great and very calm neighborhood. It is indeed very small but perfect for one person as the space is very optimized! It even includes an iron and a washing machine. Overall it feels very cosy and works perfectly as a pied-à-terre after long days exploring New York. Subways are very close, another plus. I usually like airbnbs notably for the opportunity to meet with the renter/ sub-renter which was not the case here, but Gina had set up a convenient pick-up location for me to get the keys by myself upon arrival. At a broader level, my stay in New York was fantastic and I felt well in this flat
Cute little apartment in Chelsea. Exactly as it looks in photo - new interiors, super cosy and in a great area. Gina was super helpful - thanks for the stay!

What a great little place to have discovered to stay at in NYC.  Perfect for one person. Small but not crammed. Well equipped and nicely  decorated. I felt immediately at home on arrival. 
I found the location brilliant , all I needed and more was within walking distance.  Great places to eat  minutes away , and with subway stations so near I got to Lincoln centre in record time. 

Also Gina left me with great info for anyplace of interest etc. , which is always useful. 

She  was in fact an all round perfect host. 

Will certainly book again.
Great studio apartment in a great location.   Modern and up to date.  Very Clean.
Gina is an outstanding host with a terrific, cozy place. Excellent location to get out and see the city.

Gina's place is just as described and as seen in the pictures. The location is fantastic and the place has everything you might need. Close to the subway and a nice walk into the city. I wouldn't hesitate in staying there again or recommending the place to anyone !!

Gina's place was very accurate to the images and was close to alot of great restaurants and the metro.  I only had a few problems during my stay, however Gina was quick to address the issues, overall was a great trip.

cosy but perfect for single person stay. love the area ! lots of art gallery around. there is 24H open restaurants, Rite Aid pharmacy just around the corner. Gina(host) is also wonderful well communication person.
Check-in was easy and the place was simple and clean. I would happily stay here again.
Very nice apartment and great neighborhood
Gina was helpful, flexible, and quick to respond. The location was close to everything and I really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere!

I loved my stay at Gina's. She is a wonder host, extremely prompt in her communication, checking in to see that things are okay. The City had a big winter while I visited and Gina made sure that the cold was controlled in the apartment. She also sent me a detailed message with all kinds of recommendations for the area, including a real New York bagel shop I was keen on checking out. I love walking Manhattan, so I walked up and down from Gina's apartment, but the metro connection is excellent also. The apartment is a compact, cute little treasure, and I really enjoyed it. Thank you, Gina, for the attentive, warm hospitality!

First, Gina was an amazing communicator. She was very easy to talk to, and quick with her responses. Her apartment was cozy and comfortable. I also appreciated that there were sufficient toiletries (as well as extra's in the closet!) Overall, I really enjoyed my stay here, and I would absolutely stay here again.
Gina's place was great! - clean, efficient, quiet.  Location in Chelsea was just what we wanted.  Short walk to Chelsea Market.  Gina was excellent, good communication.  Would stay again.
It was a very pleasant stay at Gina’s place. Chelsea is such a great area and living in Chelsea kinda gives me a “sex and the city” vibe. Love it!!

OTTIMO NIDO PER CHI DEVE VENIRE A LAVORARE A NYC PER BREVI PERIODI. PULIZIA E CURA DEI DETTAGLI SONO I PUNTI DI FORZA DI GINA OLTRE AD ESSERE UN HOST PREMUROSO E ATTENTO ALLE NECESSITA' DEL SUO GUEST. BRAVA GINA! OTTIMO RAPPORTO VALUE FOR MONEY E GRANDE FACILITA' NEI RAPPORTI.

The apartment is as shown, but best for one on a business trip than two who wish to hang around during the day. It is certainly compact but very clean and great location. It is on the ground level, so noise can be a bit of an issue if you are a sensitive sleeper.

Gina’s place was wonderful, cute and cozy and in a great location. Exactly as described and very quick and easy check in. Great communication at any time and always willing to help. The onily weird thing was that the listing had a 1pm check out (and in my trips section still says 1, I made sure to triple check) but was told it was 12 the night before so that threw me off a little but otherwise everything was great.

The apartment is located on a pretty tree-lined street, walking distance from multiple lines on the subway on the west side. 
The layout is really nice and homely and despite being street level it’s really quiet at night. 
Gina was so fast with responses, I would stay there next time I’m in NYC for sure

Hostess is excellent. She has thought of everything. Communication was A plus. She made arrival and leaving very easy. Her recommendations as to nearby cafes and restaurants were very helpful. Coffee and diners within one block. The apartment is located in a lively neighborhood   Very easy to catch cabs or Uber’s or Lyft. The apartment is small but yet has a full size tub. The apartment was super clean and it was stocked with coffee and tea which I appreciated. I walk with a cane. It being at street level was important to me. Excellent cable and internet. Highly recommend.
Perfect location, perfect size for one or two people looking to take a trip to the city.
Great location, great communication. Studio is small but has everything you need and the location is great. Perfect for 1 person or a couple. Great neighborhood.
Gina's place is in a nice neighborhood and on the first floor (no lugging bags upstairs!). Very quiet and comfortable. Within walking distance to lots of shops and the subway.

This little space was a perfect jumping-off point for the meetings and errands I had in the city. Coming back to Chelsea at night really felt like coming home - lots of amenities, friendly street life, comfortable bed . . . Picking up and dropping off keys was convenient and well-explained. Communication was lighting fast, including responses to specific questions about NYC advice. HIGHLY recommend. Thank you, G!

Gina’s place is in the most fantastic location in Chelsea. It was perfect for a solo traveller and was well-appointed with washing machine / dryer and steamer, kitchenette with fridge, toaster, kettle, coffee maker and mini gas stove. Gina was great to communicate with and sent me an awesome list of recommendations in the area. It’s super close to the High line and I walked along the high line daily to my conference at the Javits centre. Unfortunately the radiator was too hot and hard to turn down / off. It’s right next to the bed so sometimes I had to compensate by turning on the aircon to sleep at night. The key pick up and drop off is a few blocks away.

I stayed 5 nights in Gina's modern, comfortable studio.  As a female traveling alone, it was important to me to feel safe walking around the neighborhood alone, and I definitely did, even at night. The studio is compact but has everything you need, it was clean and the perfect place for a single traveler. The location is amazing- High Line Park is 2 blocks away, as is 24 hr drugstores and many restaurants. 5 short blocks to Chelsea Market. Metro stop was few blocks away, loads of bus stops, and easy pick up spot for Uber pick up.  If you're into walking, it's walking distance to so many different areas it all took me 15-30 min. It's an absolutely wonderful area to stay especially if you have already been to NYC a few times and want to go/do things more that the locals do!

I only had 1 issue during my stay, and Gina tried her best to resolve it. Unfortunately it couldn't be resolved till the end of my stay,  but Gina was kind and considerate, and had quick communication. She also has great tips for places to eat or go to if you need that. I would love to stay here again and would highly recommend!

All those reviews got it just right! Great location, and the place is just as described/pictured. Sparkling clean. Loved the bed, loved the shower, loved the neighborhood!  Gina responds quickly. Check in and out was easy and straightforward.

Gina was an excellent host.  The apartment was exactly as pictured: petite but highly functional, clean, modern and a very pleasant place to stay in a beautiful neighborhood.  When there was a slight hiccup involving Gina's Super insisting on doing work on her apartment (albeit at a convenient time during the late morning), Gina responded with appropriate dismay (she was not made aware of the work) and even went as far as refunding me a portion of my rental payment as a courtesy for my troubles.  Excellent communication and responses.  Very cozy apartment.  Highly recommend, especially just for one!
Excellent space in great location
Perfect for one person. Everything you need in the flat. Gina was an excellent communicator. Great location!

Gina's place is really stylish and cute. It's in a frankly perfect location in Manhattan (an easy walk into Midtown, and really close to the High line and Chelsea market). Gina is very thoughtful and communicates extremely quickly - it was a real pleasure to stay in her lovely apartment. Thank you so much for being such a considerate host!

Gina’s spot could not be more perfect and quaint. Would most definitely stay here again. She delievered quick communication and wonderful nearby recommendations. This was one of the best Airbnb Experiences I ever had. The apartment was exactly as described. Perfect for my needs. One the first floor, clean, adorable. It's small - but that's New York. It's perfect for a solo traveler - especially on there on business. I had everything I needed - a full kitchen, there was coffee and tea and other (more than) basic necessities already in the kitchen, a small fridge, coffee maker, toaster oven, even a microwave and a stovetop - and the most exciting part of all - a washing machine! Which in New York is as rare as a unicorn. I used the machine a few times, it's a washer and dryer and it was so helpful to be able to do laundry while I was in the city without having to send it out. Everything in the apartment is clean, and well designed. The bed was super comfortable. There is air conditioning and heat. The area as adorable - lots of really great high quality restaurants and shops, a grocery store one block away, places to get your nails done - coffee shops, cafes, everything you need in New York. It is about a 5 minute walk away from the subway. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

The apartment is super cute, clean, and cozy. It has all the basic amenities with extra personal touches. Upon arrival, you quickly get a true feeling of what it’s like to live on one of the quaintest blocks of Chelsea.

This is the second time I have stayed at Gina's apartment and I love it. It has everything you could possibly need while you are away and the location is amazing. Right near two subway lines and a nice walk to mid Town. Highly recommended.

Really cute space that was sparkling clean and had loads of extras like towels and blankets. Even had a clothing steamer which I really appreciated and I actually found this to be the quietest place I’ve ever stayed at in NYC. Note: if you are not able-bodied or have a lot of heavy luggage, the keys are a couple blocks away. But the second set of keys and auto-lock doors made check out much easier than check in! Overall, very comfortable stay and Gina was always prompt to respond. Would stay again!

Our stay in New York was a lot of fun. Gina's place in Chelsea was a cute, stylish little studio. The photos gave us a clear expectation of the space. There were dishes present for eating in, if we wanted. We enjoyed the coffee that was present for us in the mornings. Gina was quick to respond when I had questions before my visit. The hot water was immediate with the shower, and there were multiple shower toiletries available if needed. There was also a washer available with detergent and stain remover (which I did need at one point and was grateful for). The property is on the first floor, so the property has very easy access when bringing in luggage. There are several restaurants within a five minute walk (including a delicious bagel place around the corner where we had breakfast every day). The neighbors were also very quiet, we never heard anyone besides ourselves. And overall the property was very clean when were arrived. We never actually met or talked with Gina since she has efficiently set up check in to not require meeting anyone.

There were a few things that were not ideal. Sleeping was not very comfortable. You could feel the bars of the metal platform bed through the mattress, and the mattress was sinking in between the bars. The window also provides very little protection from the elements. We visited in February, and the city was very cold at night. There is a sheet of plastic and a towel taped against the window to try and block off the elements, but there was still a consistent breeze from outside that was most noticeable at night if you were unlucky enough to be the person sleeping on the window side of the bed. There were several heaters in the place, and that helped, but it caused one half of you to be hot while the other half facing the window was cold. We actually opted to head home one night early because we were eager to sleep in our own bed.

Located in historic central Brooklyn, you'll be steps away from great restaurants, cafes, nightlife, and transport.

They both have very comfy queen-sized beds with high thread count sheets. They also boast a lot of space under the bed for luggage or anything else. The house has central heating and AC separate controls for each room, so you'll never be too hot or too cold. As you can see in the pictures, the main room is a kitchen/living space which is shared. There is also a balcony outside the main space which has a stair access down to the garden. The garden is very large with lots of outdoor seating. The garden is shared during the week days with the coworking space I run on the first floor. The apartment comes with free WiFi during your stay, and I provide a set of towels as well. host.host_about:
Hi there,

I run a fashion design company working concept to completion in all aspect of the industry. I also run a co-working space where 70+ other freelancers share ideas and good vibes. I love all thing art and design. I'm very easy going and respectful. I'm interested in traveling broadly and living locally. When I travel, I prefer to live as much like a local and stay away from the "main attractions".

I love vintage and antiques.
I love motorcycles.
I love breakfast.
I love to read and understand current affairs.
I love a good chat and to learn about other peoples professions, especially if they're passionate about them.

I look forward to hosting and or staying with you.

reviews.comments: Sam's place was great. We loved the neighbourhood. Some great bars are just up the street and the subway is a short walk away. We never met Sam but he was easy to communicate with. Amazingly decorated and spacious apartment that felt like home. My only wish would have been that the place was a little cleaner but otherwise no other complaints.

A beautiful apartment with incredible attention to detail and excellent style! We loved staying at Sam's apartment. The location is great with tons of cool bars nearby, the Brooklyn Museum, Prospect Pk, and all the subway lines you could ever need. The kitchen is spacious with a great induction stove, and the main room is great for small gatherings with drinks. Lots of sunlight throughout. Very comfortable beds and the balcony overlooking the garden was really lovely. Everything from the spices, kitchen ware, towels and basic food items were well-stocked! Good central speakers in the kitchen for playing music. Sam was very communicative, accommodating and a very solid host! We'd love to stay there again.

Our stay in Sam's place was really nice! We never met Sam but he was always available to answer our questions during booking. A friend of his welcome us when we got there. She was very helpful with us, give us some cool places to go around. Electric problems did not allow us to use some heaters, so the temperature was a little cold, mostly for the person who slept in the lounge. We felt secure in the streets and you have to walk like 5 minutes to take the train that lead you on manhattan. Good place to stay! Thanks!

Sam's space is really stylish. He's clearly put a lot of work into making it a unique and classy home. We were travelling with our one-year-old toddler which presented some challenges, and I would not recommend this apartment to someone else travelling with a small child who might throw food on the rug, eat off the painted plywood floors, and pull things off shelves. We were able to make it work, and Sam was very helpful answering our questions. If you're young at heart, hip and excited to explore gritty Brooklyn, this place is ideal.

Sam was a great host and my family loved living in his beautiful apartment. The apartment has great light, a comfortable living space and a very tasteful decor, right from the coffee table to the chandelier in the bathroom. The kitchen is spacious for those who want to cook their meals. The area is great and has some wonderful restaurants and bars and really charming to walk around in. Unfortunately, we left a little bit of mess when we checked out, which probably means that we won't get to stay in this wonderful apartment again, but for those of you who can, you absolutely must.

Pour un voyage d'affaire, un de mes équipiers a séjourné chez Sam. Très agréable, quartier sympathique. Un appartement clair et un hôte prévenant !
Thomas était vraiment content de son séjour !

The neighborhood is an interesting one, with many places to get grocery or to eat at, and Sam was of good advice. The flat is nice, we had breakfast on the balcony every morning. It is very easy to go to downtown with either the C or 5 line, or to Conney Island the other direction.
We really enjoyed our stay at Sam's bright stylish apartment and enjoyed the colorful neighborhood.  Sam was also very helpful and responsive with communication.

Sam was a great host and his apartment was so comfy and enjoyable (very nice garden)! He left addresses of great places to go, plans of the neighborhood, etc. The neighborhood is amazing, lots of nice bars, very good restaurants and most important, nearby lots of trains station. We definitely enjoyed our stay thanks to Sam's apartment! Merci beaucoup Sam!!

All up a great stay.

It’s a really nice place.
