reviews.comments: We had an amazing weekend here! Martha and Øyvin are inspiring people, really open and kind. We were the first people to stay there after the renovations. Because of that, there were some minor complications to the room. This was handled well by the couple. Definitely recommend this place!

My mum and I stayed at Martha's and Oyvin's place in the beginning of April for 6 days and we had the most amazing time! The house is newly renovated and situated on a very privileged location with amazing views over the city of Barcelona on one side and the hills surrounding the city on the other side. It takes you about 30 minutes to get down to the center of the city by public transportation (first a bus, then a funicular and then the metro), which makes it a perfect place for those wanting to combine the calmth and peacefulness of the nature surrounding Barcelona and little trips to the inner city. Martha and Oyvin are a very warm and inspirational couple who like to share their life experience (which is mind blowing) and are really eager to meeting new people and getting engaged in all sorts of projects. My mum and I came back from this trip inspired and will definitely keep in touch with them! I would definitely recommend it to everyone, and mostly to open-minded people looking for an escape in an amazing setting!

I travel a lot. But this stay with Martha and her family was one of the biggest travel memories that I will remember forever. The place is stunning and it's a 10 min beautiful walk to the nearest communication transport into the central city. But I never wanted to leave :) 

Can't wait to get back!

I taveled a lot in my life, but never experienced so much at one place. Marthas house and family made my stay in their amazing house one of my absolute best travel memories. Can't wait until I come back!

We had a great time at Martha's. She's a lovely host with a great family that invited us into their home like we were one of their own. They were generous with everything and shared many inspiring stories with us. Advice, food and drinks were offered without even having to request. The place is located in a beautiful scenic village on the top of a mountain. It has an excellent towering view of Barcelona. Despite not being in the city centre, Barcelona was very accessible through public transport which did not even cost very much. This is the perfect place for someone who wants to learn about the rich culture Spain has to offer while relaxing in a place away from the hectic tourist areas yet still being within reach of Barcelona.

Martha made us so welcome and went out of her way to travel down to the town with us the first day to help orientate us. We did not expect to be invited to sit at Martha and Onyo's table every morning for the wonderful breakfasts Martha prepared, and we really appreciated that. We absolutely loved being able to walk in the woods, see wild     (tame really) boar, hear birdsong, breathe the clean air and swim in the pool in the mornings before we headed down the fenicular railway into town - we definitely had the best of both worlds. If we return to Barcelona we would love to stay here again and enjoy the reading room too that they  developing, Fiona and Jen

We had the privilege of staying with Martha and Øyvin for four days- whilst their property is incredible (along with the view that it offers), the undisputed highlight was the hospitality they provided and their dedication to an outstanding guest experience. Don't ask whether you should go but indeed how quickly you can get there- we'll be sure to return.

"Una calurosa acogida y una experiencia fantástica"

Venga a descubrir una maravillosa antigua biblioteca sin vacilación. Este lugar permite de relajarse a la calma después un día en Barcelona. La habitación es muy limpia y confortable con una vista sobre la piscina, el jardín y la iglesia de Tibidabo. En una palabra: magnífico.  
Todas las mañanas, hemos compartido un momento con Martha y Øyvi durante el desayuno. Ofrecen productos sanos y frescos para empezar bien el día. Esos momentos han permitido de intercambiar sobre experiencias, viajes, (Website hidden by Airbnb) 
Martha y Øyv son personas con altos valores, son sonrientes y son generosos. 
Muchas gracias para todo y volveremos pronto, es cierto.

Beatriz y Chloé

Un bel endroit et un accueil très chaleureux de Martha et de sa famille. Il est facile de rejoindre le centre ville par le funiculaire et le métro. Les photos sont justes. Un lieu calme que nous avons apprécié pour une pause en journée ou après la visite des lieux touristiques de Barcelone.

Martha and Oyvin's place is breathtaking. They were one of the most gracious hosts I've had through airbnb! The room is newly renovated and very comfortable with everything you need. The views, the hills, the running and hiking trails, the breakfasts in the morning, the converted library with the grand piano! I could go on and on. Not to mention, their very adorable dog Black. Who is very friendly! You are able to get a cab to the city centre if you don't have a car. Overall, it was such a nice change of pace and I hope to return! I highly recommend their place.

lovely hosts, nice people, very charming family with many inspiring stories. The room is very comfortable and has everything you need. 
They have a super nice dog and very friendly. 
I really recommend their place, calm and has some amazing views. We'll connected with the center. 
highly recommended.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for 6 days and would highly recommend it! Martha and Øyvin were such great hosts. Their place is absolutely gorgeous! Our room, the pool, and garden are absolutely beautiful - not to mention the INCREDIBLE views. The whole place is breathtaking. We were made to feel so at home, with a lovely breakfast each morning too :)

The property is situated a short walk from public transport in form of a bus or funicular, but better, it is surrounded by woods and picturesque trails which we loved exploring. It is incredibly peaceful and serene but is well connected to the city.

Martha and Øyvin are a very kind and inspirational pair - also their family we met are lovely too! They really made our holiday special and we loved chatting to them each morning. We hope to see you again - this place is so great! If not, thank you and good luck for the future.

Sally & Max xx

El lugar es muy agradable, y los dueños son muy acogedores. Desayunos excelentes! Solo hay que tener en cuenta que es un lugar alejado del centro con buena conexion de transporte publico. En el Tibidabo! Un lugar apasible para desconectar de los dias llenos de actividades.

the house and location are beautiful and Martha and Øyvin are very welcoming and kind people.. we couldn't have asked for more from our hosts, they really go the extra mile. once you figure out the public transport it takes no time at all to get to central barcelona, and if you are coming late then you can hail a taxi from the bottom of tibidabo without any problems.
we definitely didnt spend long enough here to enjoy properly so come for at least 3 days.

Wundervolle Menschen und ein einzigartiger Ort. Einfach unvergesslich! 
Nix für Menschen mit Angst vor Hunden.

What an utterly dreamy home & location! My Brother & I were so incredibly looked after by Martha & her family - it was amazing! The utterly unforgettable views & memories shared at Martha's home will be fondly remembered! I look forward to visiting again sometime soon! Xxx

Words cannot express how wonderful this residence is!  Martha and her husband made our first trip to Europe a magical experience!  She was open to communication before arrival, letting me know what items I needed to have with me and providing directions.  Breakfast with the family each morning was an unexpected treat!  Through open and meaningful conversation, I was able to learn about some of Barcelona's traditions and history.  The private room was very well kept and provided amazing views of Tibidabo and the city.  The house is close enough to the city, about a 20 minute funicular and train ride, but far enough away that the evenings were peaceful and quiet.  Staying at this residence made our trip magical and a return trip a necessity!  You will definitely leave a piece of your heart at the top of Tibidabo if you choose to stay at this amazing house!

A beautiful place located upon the hills of Tibidabo. Well worth the journey to get here and very close to excellent public transportation.  Martha and her family are incredibly kind and made us feel right at home. We are travelling with a toddler and they were very accommodating.

It was really in every way a nice spent time
Ania ,Marek and Zosia from Poland

This place made our trip to Barcelona amazing! We enjoyed the great breakfast (which Martha prepared for us every single morning), took a swim in the pool when it got too hot and gazed at the stunning sunset with a glass of wine. If you want to combine a city trip with a few relaxing days, there's no better place! 
Most of all we loved spending time with Martha and her lovely family! It was super interesting and nice to have chats and discussions with them! We'll for sure come back! Thank you!

The appartement is apart from the house, you've got your own place and the pool in front. 
Every morning a very nice breakfast, with all kinds of cereals and nuts and warm bread. Hospitality is erywhere! 

The place is high above Barcelona City. We walked a nice walk down to the edge of the City through the woods in about 30 minutes.  But when you dont like to walk, you can take the little bus to the funicular and get into the metro. All is in zone 1, so you dont have to but extra tickets. 

I will certainly go back to this place!

Superbe location qui correspond en tout point aux photos, 
Proche des transports en communs calme et frais la nuit, dans un cadre de verdure et une vue époustouflante .... 
Un accueil comme dans notre famille, merci à Martha et Ovin pour cet accueil si chaleureux et leur chien gentil mais foufou que notre fils à adoré, la piscine est très agréable surtout le soir en rentrant de Barcelone après avoir beaucoup marché ! Et le matin avant de partir pour se rafraîchir pour la matinée ... 
on a apprécier le petit frigo dans la chambre qui nous a permis de mettre des boissons au frais et de quoi faire l'apéro au bord de la piscine ..... 
nous avons aussi apprécier le petit déjeuner le matin ... et la salle de la bibliothèque est à couper le souffle, vraiment un endroit à voir et à connaître.
Merci encore pour cet échange dans la convivialité et l'amitié, à bientôt surement pour une prochaine visite.

This has been one of my favorite experiences with Airbnb. My only initial hesitation with booking Martha's place was the location given that its a bit outside of the city. This turned out to be one the biggest perks of staying here: stunning scenery, spectacular views, felt like staying in a private villa in an exclusive location. Getting into Barcelona was not difficult or time consuming at all, and taking the Funicular was super fun and different. Martha was gone during our 4 night stay so we were hosted by her daughter Alexandra who treated us like family instead of guests. The property is beautiful, right below the Temple Expiatori del Sagrat Cor which is just a short walk. Breakfast was a big plus and moving around was not a hassle. This was the perfect escape from the city, especially during the scorching summer heat, as the temperature in Tibidabo was always cooler and of course you could take a dive in the pool whenever. Overall, amazing place and excellent stay. Dont let the location deter you, it will end up being the highlight like it was for us. Thank you Martha, Alex and family, we will surely be returning to your lovely home!

We had an amazing stay at the house at the beginning of August. Martha was away, so her daughter Alex hosted us. She met us in the city centre and showed us the way up to the house. (it is a little bit out of the city, but easy to access and the views are worth it!) The funicular was off, but replacement buses were on to take us from the metro station up to the house. A taxi from the city centre is only around 20 euros if you want to stay out late too. The house was absolutely beautiful and we were in the pool everyday! If I was back in Barcelona I'd definitely stay here again, and have already recommended the house to people thinking about visiting the city.

What could I write that has not been said already? We traveled to Barcelona as tourists, but Martha, Øyvin and their family made us feel at home. We enjoyed several delightful days at their place surrounded by nature and the most beautiful views of the area. It was very easy to get to central Barcelona, but also to walk around the stunning paths of Collserola, where you can easily forget you are a stone's throw from the city. We will visit you again, without a doubt! Thank you so much for everything!

My father and me had a very pleasant  stay at Martha's home.  The home is easily reachable by public transport, and offers an amazing view on the city at the front side and  beautiful hills at the back side.  We will always  remember the hospitality, delicious breakfast and intense discussions about life with this inspiring family. Highly recommended.
Perfect location for an escape out of busy Barcelona. Martha and her family are just as welcoming as the house.
Amazing location and the owners were very easy to get on with. A+

A stunning place to stay in Barcelona!
Martha is an excellent and caring host und the house is more than beautiful. 
Good transport connection, amazing view over the town and a totally peaceful place.
We can recommend it to everyone looking for a spacious, quiet and luxurious home in Barcelona.

We had a wonderful time at Marthas place! She and her family are great hosts and we almost felt like we belong to family, especially when we had breakfast together in their kitchen. And as this was not enough, the house is just amazing and has a breathtaking view.
Good to know: 
They also have a big (nice) dog... maybe just good to know if you are scared. 
The connection to the city is very good, if you take the funicular.

Oh my, what to say! Our stay with Martha and Oyvin was nothing short of perfect. We felt right at home throughout our whole stay and absolutely feel in love with Black! Sharing life stories and listening to advice during breakfast was so lovely and really made us feel comfortable and not one bit intrusive. Our private room was equipped with everything we needed. The location is a prime spot for a more quiet scene as opposed to the hustle and bustle of the city, which is exactly what we wanted. Super easy transportation into the main city and it was a delight with panoramic views on your walk down to the bus or cable car station. We would highly recommend Martha and Oyvin as host and the location in itself to anyone! Thank you so much for everything once again!!! See you in Australia ☺️
Very spacious place. Martha was a really nice and helpful host.
Beautiful place to stay, friendly atmosphere away from the noisy crowds. Would love to be back!

Words can not even scratch the surface to the deep positive impact and memories, Martha and her lovely family left in our hearts, while sharing their home for a few days with us. Inspiring. Warm-Hearted. True Philantropists.

This was such a great spot to be at during my time in Barcelona! Martha and her family were so welcoming and hospitable--I felt like a part of the family immediately. The location has a private entrance, so you can come and go as you please. The house is a bit farther outside of the city than expected, but the view is spectacular, and the house is so beautiful (make sure to ask for a tour of the salon). Thank you again Martha for a lovely home away from home.

Located on the top of Mount Tibidabo with incredible views of Barcelona below. We enjoyed our easy funicular and tram ride up/down to the city and our quite oasis waiting for us at the end of our day. With everything that was going on in Barcelona during the time we were visiting, it was comforting to get away from the hustle & bustle and stay in a beautiful private suite. Martha and her husband are incredible hosts and made us feel comfortable and apart of their family. It was nice to start the day with a healthy breakfast, great conversation and tips on where, what to do and to how to get there.

Superb room and location - views are stunning

Martha and family (and Black the dog) were very friendly and bent over backwards to help us-  booking trips, taxis etc. 

Lovely breakfasts.

Highly recommended

Martha and her family curate an amazing historical property which was the library of Almirall. Almirall was a founding figure in the Catalan independence movement. It was a real honor to stay in such a significant, beautiful, and serene setting. But what made my stay great was simply interacting with Martha and her family. Martha is incredibly kind, open, interesting and generous as a host. She has a wonderful family who are all inspirational people. This is what the sharing economy and airbnb are all about.

This room suited our needs in Barcelona perfectly. The beds were comfy, the shower was hot, and the views were incredible. Martha and her family’s generous heart and hospitality made the trip. They took incredible care of us: offering great food recommendations, showing us their incredible home, spending time with their very loveable German Shepherd, and even making us soup when we got terribly sick. It was an unforgettable stay and we are blessed to have met them and stayed here.

We had five amazing days in Barcelona and enjoyed M. and Ø.'s hospitality very much. A very good room with a view (into the Collserola nature reserve and the valleys surrounding Barcelona) and with excellent mattresses. Thanks for the lovely breakfasts!
Super friendly family and nice clean and beautiful room. A bit small unit and car required.
Stunning view, gorgeous space and wonderful hospitality, what more can you ask for? This is a MUST for people looking for a cool experience in Barcelona!!

I have loved my stay in this lovely house! Alexandra and Carolina have been amazing and so helpful, even with my delayed and late check in. I have felt like home, a great place to stay in Barcelona and the view up to the hill is amazing! Thank you girls :)

We had an amazing time at one of the most beautiful places on the top of the mountain. It is close to an amusement park, but you can’t hear a thing. The view is amazing. It is very easy to go from the house to placa de Catalunya (30 min by public transportation). The breakfast was local what was very nice and delicious. We recommand this place to everybody. There is a dog who listens to the name ‘black’. He is very playfull but so sweet. Thank you for a beautifull vacation!!!

Our stay was amazing. It was the perfect place for my niece and me for our stay  in Barcelona. The room is private, with its own entrance and has an amazing view. Alexandra's hospitality was authentic and she created a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Even the dog, Back, was charming. Alexandra provided us with good tips and recommendations for places to eat in Barcelona. Highly recommend!
Great hosts and the views were amazing. They have a very friendly dog which reminded me of home. Would recommend this option to any and everyone.

I couldn’t recommend this enough! Tibidabo is beautiful and an amazing oasis away from the city. We were served a beautiful breakfast every morning and our hosts were so friendly, accommodating, and helpful. There is a friendly German shepherd named Black who will want to be your best friend from the moment you arrive - he’s big but gentle. Public transportation into the city is very easy, although if you are a night owl, you’ll have to take a cab up to the house if you are out past 930. The space is comfortable and serene, it was hard to leave every morning! Overall I would highly recommend staying here, just make sure to budget some time in your agenda to hang out at this comfortable home.
We really enjoyed coming home to the beautiful views overlooking Barcelona. The entire family go out of their way to accommodate a unique and enjoyable experience.

We were just enchanted by your hospitality and openness. And your wonderful place on the Tibidabo with that spectacular view over Barcelona, in that old library, we couldn't have found any better. Kind regards, Jann

This accommodation is amazing if you’re looking for spectacular views, peace and quiet and somewhere to get away whilst you visit Barcelona. It was extremely clean, access to a pool and patio in the evening and the girls provided breakfast each morning. The best thing by far is the view down to the city and the cathedral at night. Amazing!
Quite far from the City. You should take into account time and $$ to get to city central.

Great Place! Great Location on the top of the mountain!
Hosts are great! Best breakfast I ever had on AirBnb!

Wouldnt say that this type of Appartements is usual for airbnb. It was more like a 5 stars hotel with a cute, local breakfast every morning. The view is breathtaking and the hosts were friendly and gave us good tips for eating and exploring barcelona. 

Thank you! ❤️

This is a truly special place. Maria and her husband were out of the country, so I was hosted by their lovely daughter Alex. The home is one of the most stunning Airbnb’s I have ever had the pleasure of staying in. The views are lovely, and I enjoyed taking a dip in the pool at the end of each day. Their German Shepherd became my best friend and followed me around during my stay (great if you love dogs). Mass transit stops nearby, and once you get your bearings it is not difficult to use. Truly a remarkable stay.
Accueil très chaleureuse et appartement très bien équipé. Une vue époustouflante et un calme parfais.

Staying here was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Martha was away, but her children are wonderful - very generous, warm, inviting - and made a lovely breakfast for us each morning. The library is amazing! And the views are breathtaking!
Stay here if you get a chance - it is a very special place and family!

Martha’s place is truly special. Her kids showed us the utmost hospitality and care. We were so impressed with the breathtaking views and the history of the library property. The room is a nice size for two. Clean space, comfy beds, and hot shower. The home is not a far travel to the city and is easily accessible by public transportation.  For late nights we were able to take a cab home with no problem. For a short stay we were able to relax, take a dip in the pool, hang out with black (very sweet dog), and make our way to the city. Well worth the visit and travel around town. Highly recommended!
Great host. Beautiful location and nice views.  Relaxing place.

Beautiful villa - very peaceful! Breathtaking views especially during sunset...

Alex (Martha‘s daughter) and her siblings took great care of us, always responded quickly and were very helpful and flexibel. They also prepared a delicious breakfast - including the famous ‚pan con tomate‘ - every morning!

Great for those who enjoy being in nature, have a car (in case you want to be in the city for dinner etc - cab drivers didn‘t find the place easily) and love dogs (black, the dog, really enjoys company)...

Depending on the purpose of your stay, it is a lovely and very special place!

Many thanks - we hope to be back!

My mum and I had a lovely stay here. The room we stayed in was comfortable and clean. Carolina and Alex were really friendly and helpful and had some good tips for things to do. The views from the house were amazing and watching the sunset from the patio outside was so relaxing. Getting into Barcelona was so easy - following the instructions Carolina gave us, it took between 20-30mins. I would definitely recommend staying here - thank you!

Alex, Carolina and Blacky are the best host! warm, friendly and very relaxed. the villa is a paradise. I love everything about it. I am looking forward to staying there again. again, I am grateful for the warm welcome at your home.

Best single Airbnb experience that I've ever had. A great stay was made unforgettable with the unexpected additions of Black (the dog) and Alexandra (Martha's daughter). Stay here if you get the chance!!

Notre séjour a été fantastique. Le lieu a une vue magnifique sur Tibidabo et sur Barcelone. Tout est très propre et conforme aux photos. Nous avons été très bien reçues et Alexandra nous a même accompagné au supermarché pour faire quelques courses. Notez juste que la cuisine n’est pas accessible normalement pour cuisiner. Et le chien, Black, est très joueur et infatigable :)
Amazing place, must visit! Such a unique location and building. Martha’s daughters were lovely. Thank you for taking care of us!

Thank you for an amazing time at your house. This place is truly magical, and your daughters took such good care of us during our stay. We will miss the catalan breakfast with the incredible view accompanied by the dog Black! We really hope to be back sometime. 
Katrine & Peter

We had an amazing stay. The home, the pool and the surrounding area are beautiful! Martha was not around for our visit but her daughters were very helpful. Communication, restaurant recommendations, and public transit advice were all amazing. The private space is just that, very private. We didn’t have much time to enjoy the shared space but it is very beautiful as pictured. Staying here made for an amazing introduction to Barcelona, we would absolutely love to stay here again.

A peaceful setting with easy transport links into the centre. Alex and Caro could not have looked after us better. It was a perfect place to spend a few days relaxing. Black, the young German Shepherd, is a big part of the experience, so if you love dogs, this is highly recommended.

Martha's daughters were hosting us. They were so kind and nice. Place was best airb&b I ever been. So clean and awesome. They gave us breakfast which was so good. There are big dog "black" which is so cute. Everything was so perfect in their place.

Perfect place to discover the city when you like incredible views and quitness at the end of the day. Martha's daughters were our hostesses during our stay, they where super friendly and served us a nice breakfast every morning. Placa catalunya is only 25min away with public transport, altough we rented a Vespa which makes every trip up and down the mountain of Tibidabo like a dream! Don't look any further, this is the place you're want to stay in Barcelona.

Maison splendide avec une vue sur le tibidabo à couper le souffle! 
Hyper simple à trouver, vous êtes sur les hauteurs de barcelone, au calme et en même temps à 20 min du plein centre en transports, c’est top!
Black le chien est très joueur mais gentil! Attention pas de clim dans la chambre donc en été les nuits sont très chaudes mais heureusement on peut se baigner à toute heure c’est top;)

What an amazing space hosted by such wonderful people. The room is a perfect bolt hole set in gorgeous surroundings just a 25 minute trip on public transport from the centre (or a very reasonably priced taxi when it’s late). The short distance out of town is worth it for the unique stay and hospitality of Martha and her husband, who are faultless hosts; not forgetting their adorable dog who will just want to play with you all the time. A delicious breakfast is provided each morning (yogurt, bread, cheese, fruit etc) perfect fuel to head out and explore the city all day. Some days we would come back for a siesta before heading out again in the evening, but the travel links are great so was very easy to follow Martha’s instructions even on our first attempt. If you look for places with character and warmth, then I couldn’t recommend this highly enough! We hope to be back in the near future!

I honestly dont know where to begin, absolutely everything about this place was wonderful: lovely hosts, cutest dog, best views and comfy beds. This is one of the reasons I love airbnb, Martha and her daughters opened their home for us and made us feel so welcome.

A most  memorable, unique  and special experience not only of Barcelona trip  but of  decades of travel . A truly magical setting , amazing hosts , comfortable stay - an ideal retreat : close enough to the main attractions of the city but perfect distance to revitalize and rest after a day of sightseeing . It’s a retreat vacation within a vacation . The views from the room and through out the grounds of the property were breathtaking and out of this world . Martha and entire family went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable , well taken care of , with great recommendations and  invaluable warmth and welcome . The site itself of the Antigua Biblioteca Almiral has a remarkable  history aswell as an  inspirational story . It’s a work of love and creativity and as guests we really felt it . The breakfast and  beautiful Black, the German Shepherd added to an already perfect stay . It’s a rare treat , a deep memory , and nostalgia to return as we say goodbye.
Beautiful setting if you don't mind being away from city centre and like dogs, host family extremely hospitable and caring.

Wir haben uns bei Martha oben auf dem Tibidabo-Berg, hoch über Barcelona, sehr wohl gefühlt. In dem sehr schönen Zimmer mit eigenem Bad konnten wir uns sehr gut von den Eindrücken der Großstadt entspannen.
Die Gastfreundschaft und Hilfsbereitschaft der Familie ist außerordentlich gut. Nach kurzer Zeit fühlt man sich schon fast als deren Mitglied.
Das Frühstück war super lecker und abwechslungsreich.
Wer die Unterkunft bucht, sollte ein Herz für Hunde mitbringen, da das Anwesen von einem lieben aber unternehmungslustigen Vierbeiner gut bewacht wird.

This stunning property was the perfect place to recharge after spending the day in the bustle of Barcelona. There was so much to love about  this AirBnB.  Located on a mountain overlooking the city, the views from Martha's property and the drive up to it are simply breathtaking. The accommodations were stylish, comfortable and very clean. But what truly makes this property five-star quality was the warm hospitality of Martha and her family, including the family German Shepherd that you cannot help but love. Martha went above and beyond, providing us with a hearty breakfast each morning, directions and tips on transportation, and sharing the history of her beautiful home with us. 
By far one of the best AirBnBs we have stayed at. Highly recommend.

Amazing!!! Martha was so nice and helpful! She has such a beautiful soul! The place is a bit far from town but we had no regrets. The view was amazing! We enjoyed walking to Tibidabo and looking at the beautiful place. Martha's place is small and cozy. My husband and I loved it! Muchas gracias Martha!

This is a truly special place with views that are beautiful all times of the day. Make sure to set aside time late afternoon and evening to enjoy the incredible sunsets and relax on the terrace by the pool. The hosts are very helpful with all questions. Their gorgeous shepherd will look to bond with you on arrival so be sure you are a dog fan! The history and beautiful view make this special. Plan  on meals down the mountain and a little extra time if you want to go downtown Barcelona.

Fantastic accommodation, perfect location, u could get the whole view of Barcelona. Very enjoy the stay in Martha’s place, clean, comfortable and nice shower. It’s very nice to talk with Caroline the host’s daughter, beautiful girl, sharing the gap year which drive through China. Special experience choice of your first time in Barcelona, love this city, so relax and chill.

Thank you for an exceptional time. You made us feel exceptionally welcome and your property is simply beautiful. We especially loved the conversations with Martha and her daughters about the stories they shared of their childhood, travels and family. It was all well received. We look forward to keeping in touch with Martha
A really stunning location and facility with hosts who truly understand the word “hospitality”  highly recommended and surprisingly accessible to all of Barcelona.

It ‘s was very amazing place. All was very perfect. The room was very clean and modern. It was the best view in my life. The way from apartment to center of the city is 20 min. Every day we were walking up and down the street, and enjoyed the walk. I recommend each guest, try to stay here. It’s very nice trip!

Staying at Martha and Oyvin's home on Mount Tibidabo was one of the highlights of our trip. They are wonderful hosts - very welcoming and accommodating. The location was wonderful - the views of Barcelona were breathtaking, and you were really able to appreciate life as a local walking through the village. It was a nice retreat to return to Tibidabo after a day or time in the city and would highly recommend to anyone.

Just as the reviews say, this place was magical and just perfect. My stay was absolutely wonderful. Martha and her kids were extremely nice and helpful. They called me a taxi to ensure I was on time for the airport (as the home is a little out of the city and taxis can be tricky at times). I felt safe and comfortable which was a huge deal to me as a single female traveler. Martha checked in with me every day to make sure I was happy and doing okay, I loved this. It made me feel even better. If you get the chance, stay here...you won't regret it!

It was our best Airbnb experience so far. Martha and her great family did their best for us to feel comfortable and welcomed, as we were at home. We stayed at their place for almost a week, and we want to repeat this experience as soon as possible (and advice everyone we know to do the same ). 
Every morning we had a Catalonian breakfast all together, talking about literally everything! Martha’s family travelled all around the world, so believe us — they have so many stories to share . 
Our room was so simple and so perfect. It had everything we needed for comfortable stay (great view is included ). 
Can’t not to mention Black — the cutest and the biggest puppy we ever played with . He is definitely the part of our great time at this house. 
I guess, it’s just impossible to share our thankfulness and describe how we miss that time at Martha’s place. You should just try once...

You should stay here.

The apartment is up in Tibidabo, which is a thirty or forty-five minute commute from most of Barcelona. From the street out front you can clearly see all of Barcelona -- and on a clear day, Mallorca. The view is the first memory you'll make here. 

Martha and her family are very warm and interesting. Take time to ask them about their travels and the history of the home. Their dog Black is enormous, and enormously charming.

The library and attached homes are really something. There's a pool, though it was too cold to swim in when I was there in November. The grounds are beautiful. The church and amusement park nearby are worth a visit. 

The lodging itself is clean, comfortable and private. It has a terrific view. They have gone to some lengths to make sure that everything feels right.

I can't say enough nice things about this place or these people. I will be back.

Martha and her family hosted us in a warm and aimicable way. They provided everything needed for our stay in the house,as well as some useful advice and recommendation about the trip and traffic to Barcelona landmarks. The breakfast is provided every morning and their house is very fantastic with a modern & classic style after refurnishing the main hall of a previous famous Spanish writer. Plus,Martha has a cute dog called black and we played with him everyday. Tips:he likes playing sticks with people. Next time we will stay in Martha‘s venezuela airbnb house maybe
It was the second and hopefully not the last time we stayed here and that probably says it all. M. and Ø. are fantastic hosts in an exciting city. A very inspiring way to start the New Year!

Our stay at the library was fantastic. There are beautiful views from the property, including of the church atop Mt. Tibidabo. Martha and her family were gracious hosts that made a wonderful breakfast each morning and joined us to chat about current events and the day ahead. They were also always willing to provide great recommendations. Public transport very near the Airbnb made getting into Barcelona easy each day and yet the distance offered great serenity and quiet for good sleep each night. We highly recommend this Airbnb.

The apartment is quite a big old style flat with original features and tiled floors. I look forward to welcoming to the heart of the city. *Keep in mind  Because the flat is old, the bathroom is very tiny.   It can also be noisy during the night, earplugs are a good solution The apartment is on the 4th floor with no lift I don't have central heating, just electric heaters
space: The room has a double bed and an exterior balcony. It is great for one person.

reviews.comments: genial todo bien . he estado como en casa. y buena ubicación y mery es muy amable y atenta. lo recomiendo!

Très bon accueil de la part de Mary !!! Une chambre idéalement placée pour un prix humer raisonnable !
Je recommande ;)
Wonderful location, old town <3

I didn't have the opportunity to share a lot of time with Mary, but she was kind when I arrived and when I left. Regarding the house, I missed cleaning in the room as well as in the bathroom. For a couple of days its a cheap place to have a roof over your head
Great location, cool apartment, nice host. Highly recommend.

I love the location of Mary's place! Its really close to a nice park where also the Arc de Triomf is. Also a walk to the beach is easy to do. Mary was really nice to me. I arrived late in the night and I had also some delay with the flight. And she still gave me a very kind welcome. The place itself was good for me. I slept there everyday really good and I felt everything was clean. I can recommend everybody this place. Also the price is amazing! its definitely worth it. If I come back to Barcelona in the future I probably check if her place is still available!!! Thank you for your kindness and the nice staying!

In one sentence - worth of the value. The district is very central, you can reach the beach in 15 minutes, bars, restaurants, amazing Gothic district - all of these are around. The room is for one person, since it is really small. And keep in mind about the ear plugs that Mary mentioned - on weekdays it's ok with the noise, but on weekends there  is more of it. Mary is helpful and a nice person, so in general - i liked my stay there, thanks once again!

La chambre est très agréable et bien située à Barcelone. Si on aime marcher, plusieurs lieux d'intérêts sont accessibles à pieds. Sinon, les transports sont au bout de la rue, des deux côtés. Mary a été très gentille et arrengeante. Il faut cependant éviter les bagages trop lourd, il n y a pas d'ascenseur ! Je recommande.
The host canceled this reservation 48 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Very nice room with a small balcony and great view. Really central, close to everything. The bathroom is small and simple and the kitchen is not included and there is no elevator but for the pice it's great. Perfect for a short stay in Barcelona!

Für den günstigen Preis befindet man sich super zentral mitten in der Altstadt Barcelonas. Alles ist schnell erreicht, sowohl Sehenswürdigkeiten als auch Hafen, Meer und die berühmte La Rambla. Für den Preis sollte man aber auch kein Luxuszimmer erwarten, gedacht ist es wirklich zum übernachten um Tags Barcelona erkunden zu können.

It's close to the Gothic quarter and you reach every places easily
Next Subway is just 5min far away from home
Price performance was perfect

Very central, perfect to explore Barcelona by foot! I very much enjoyed my stay in Mary's lovely apartment. Mary is very helpful and we had good communication throughout my stay. Je recommande vivement !

I couldn't have asked for a more perfect place to spend my time in Barcelona. Mary was communicative and attentive. The room was comfortable with lots of natural light and best of all the place is within walking distance to all the main attractions. I recommend Mary's place without hesitation. Thank you Mary for a wonderful stay!
Excellent location in old district of Barcelona, the place is perfect for solo travellers and adventurists who plan to explore day and night life in this vivid city!

reviews.comments: Kristina was very flexible about letting me in, both when I first arrived and late at night. The rest of the stay went well too. I would recommend staying with her if you're just looking for somewhere to sleep after a long day in New York.

Great area, the central park is 15 mins by bus, the flat was clean and ready to take, Cristine was nice and friendly. 
I recommend that place! 
Thank you so much!

Le aspettative che avevo al momento della prenotazione riguardo questo soggiorno non sono corrisposte alle reali condizioni in cui mi sono ritrovata.
Nell'appartamento eravamo in tre anziché in due, con la madre di Kristina.
Inizialmente sono riuscita ad adattarmi ad abitudini e usi differenti dai miei, Kristina e sua madre sono state gentili nel permettermi di utilizzare il loro sale, fornirmi asciugamani puliti, prestarmi caricabatterie, sono state carine quando sono stata male, pensavo di aver instaurato un buon rapporto di convivenza, anche accettando situazioni particolari e condizioni diverse da quelle per cui avevo scelto questo alloggio, ma i successivi due mesi sono stati difficili.
Ci sono state pesanti incomprensioni verbali riguardo le condizioni igieniche e pulizie, a mio parere non accettabili e per le quali non mi sono mai lamentata, ma anzi sono stata rimproverata, e sull'utilizzo degli spazi comuni e regole casalinghe. Non mi sono sentita più  libera di muovermi in casa.
Ultima spiacevole sorpresa è stata essere svegliata il giorno del check-out per dover lasciare la stanza in anticipo rispetto a quanto Airbnb mi aveva comunicato.
Credevo Airbnb fosse un buon sistema per viaggiare, conoscere nuove persone, creare scambi culturali e magari rapporti con chi vive e conosce altre città, non è stato così e purtroppo non so se mi fiderò ancora di quel che è scritto negli annunci.
Credo che  per soggiorni lunghi come il mio non sia una buona opzione, ma per vacanze di pochi giorni, stando poco in casa, questo alloggio possa andar bene, è in una buona posizione, vicino alla metro Q, efficientissima, 20 minuti a piedi da Central Park e vicina ad un altro piccolo parco lungo l'East river, adatto per correre e rilassarsi, a starbucks, sempre utile e buoni supermercati.
Buona fortuna e viaggio a chi va a scoprire New York, città da molte sfaccettature, ma sicuro da vivere nella sua palpabile libertà.

A fine, comfortable bed in a clean, convenient apartment that's a good place to just stay the night, but don't expect to want to hang around. No air conditioning means it will likely be pretty hot in the summertime. Convenient to the subway (2 long blocks away), on a busy street, shops and food are nearby, as is a lovely park on the East River. Kristina is very communicative and nice, and her place is a fair price for a NYC stay in a nice neighborhood.

It is all about guests having the right expectations and landlords being honest about what they have to offer. This place is not for everyone and you need to see if it is a suitable for you. I personally this this place is good if you:
-Only stay for a short term and just need a cheap place to crash at
-Do not care much for messiness
-Do not care much for privacy
-Can sleep easily under any circumstances

Below is the pros and cons of this place.
Pros:
- Located in UES with many bars and restaurants around
- Q line is only 5-10 min away on foot
- Mattress is comfortable
- Walk-in closet in the bedroom
- Water pressure isn’t too bad
- Rent is inexpensive (is it worth what it has to offer? It’s up to your expectations)

Cons:
- There is no heating system for this unit; the building controls it. It’s only automatically turned on during the winter. On the chilly nights in spring/fall, they use their gas oven in the kitchen to heat the house. (Isn’t this a safety hazard? (Hidden by Airbnb) says it run the risk of carbon monoxide poisoning but they would probably say it’s been working for them well.)
- There is no air conditioning system in the bedroom. Apparently it’s only in the living room and they were reluctant to turn it on when it was 84 degrees outside (that was 29th April (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) , you can check the weather history).
- It is misleading that they have laundry as the amenities. The building does not have washer/dryer. You’ll need to use a laundromat open for the public outside the building. It is $3 to use a small washer and $6 for a bigger one. To use dryer, it’s a 25 cents for 7 min.
- It is a 1-bedroom apartment. The landlord and her mom sleep on the couch outside. She told me her mom is going to stay there only for a week. I cut my stay short before verifying this is true, but based on the review below written in italian, it seems that the mom stayed there for the whole time. Given that the landlord doesn't know how the laundromat outside works because only her mom has been doing the laundry for her, her remarks are credible.
- Bath tub and bathroom sinks were clogged. But this is easily fixable.
- Bathroom is quite messy but I found it tolerable. It’s really up to the individual. The italian lady down there seemed to have been not OK with that.

I find the description of their listing quite misleading but I do NOT have the evidence that they intentionally try to trick people on purpose. You just need to know what the place has to offer and see if the price you’re paying is worth it. Ask the right questions and have the right expectations and you will be fine.

Kristina was a great hostess. Super helpful and understanding. Always available if I needed anything but totally gave me my space. The apt is great, clean and comfortable. Neighborhood is very safe, easy to get around with plenty to do if you want, yet quiet enough if you don't. I strongly recommend Kristina as a hostess & her apt as well.

Kristina fue super amable durante mi estadia. Fue muy flexible con mi check in y check out. La ubicación del apartamento es cercana al metro y es una muy buena opción precio-calidad. Lo recomiendo y sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí!
Nice stay in UES. Kristina is a nice host.
Kristina is very helpful and nice. I arrived late and it was not a problem at all. Everything was very uncomplicated. Many Thanks.
Great location, close to transit and room is spacious. Host is very accommodating and sweet.
Great location wonderful accommodations overall a positive experience

It is on the 4th floor, so if you have a suitcase larger than a carry-on, it is a bit of a struggle to lug it up to the 4th floor. Kristina was very sweet and I enjoyed chatting with her.

The apartment is a very good location

Kristina was very welcoming and gave me the opportunity to visit NYC on a budget.  The location was terrific: short walk to Central Park and all sorts of connections within a short walk for public transit (buses and subways).  People staying at Kristina's should be prepared to walk up to the fourth floor (i.e. relative fitness to climb 3 sets of stairs).  Thank you Kristina!!

Originally, I had wanted to stay two nights at this place and was disappointed that only one night was available.  However, it turned out to be a blessing in disguise. Although I checked in during the afternoon to pick up the keys and meet Kristina, a gracious, friendly host, I did not check out the bed.  As for the PROS, this place is convenient, near transpo, safe, and relatively reasonable.  As for the CONS, I discovered a very old, worn, stained bottom sheet covered with pilling that felt like sandpaper, along with an old lumpy pillow that was covered on both sides by a very stained pillowcase.  The lack of a top sheet increased my concern and discomfort for potential health hazards from countless guests who used the comforter in place of a top sheet. The air conditioner cools the living room, not the guest room (especially when closed for privacy), which only has small fan. The bathroom sink continues to drain very slowly as reported in May 2017 (I did not try the shower for the same reason). If the host secures new, comfortable sheets along with a new pillow for the guest bed and gets the drains cleared, I would definitely give this place more stars! It’s a great location if you want to get some exercise. Be prepared to climb 50+ steps from the street level to the 4th floor!

Kristina was very kind and communicated quickly. Checking in and out was easy.  Location was amazing! Beautiful park around the corner right on the river, and only 2 blocks away from the Q train. Streets were quiet and well lit at night. Lots of convenient stores/restaurants and a Starbucks next door. Host provided oscillating fan in room which was a nice touch. PACK LIGHT(ish) 3 sets of narrow stairs but definitely manageable. I have suggested to the host to provide a full length mirror in the bedroom, but otherwise advise you to bring your own handheld mirror if you prefer to get ready in your bedroom versus the bathroom. Great for solo travelers and short visits to the city. Looking forward to a return visit.
Affordable option if you’re looking for somewhere just to sleep & clean up for a night. Kristina was very friendly.

Great place! Near subway and bus stop! Downtown 10 min. away in metro. Kristina is a great host. Great place near everything you need in NYC.

Comfortable room in a quiet building!
Nice room, bid bed, big window, 10 min walk to Q train

It was great!

This was a nice place to stay, and very convenient for my needs.  My host displayed excellent communication as well.
Great hostess and wonderful place to live for 3 weeks! Thank you so much!

I would never stay there again.  I slept there three night and I couldn't wait to wake up to get out.  I had to be at work for 8am 10 minutes walk, I made sure to leave by 6:15AM. Horibble and then both her and her mother slept on the couch in the livingroom. The bedroom had not AC just a small fan.  But the livingroom was freezing because that is where the AC was.  She mentioned that it had AC, not in the room only livingroom. I would never recommend  this place to anyone.  Especially she did not tell me that her mom was there for the week until I arrive and saw the host the second night.

You will be staying at close quarters with Kristina and the flat is small but that's NYC and for the price it is good. (I'd booked 3 nights but my plans changed and I only stayed 1).

Overall great place when price considered, but you get what you pay for.  Location is terrific, room itself could use some work. Host was non-existent during the day, but her mother (who slept on the living room couch with the host at night) let me in and was cordial.
Kristina was nice and thoughtful, my mom stayed at her place and allowed me to stop by and visit for a moment after a 7hr flight. According with her, the bed was confortable and the apartment quiet.

neighborhood_overview: This neighborhood is the most densely populated area of Quebec, with stately Victorian grey-stone row houses and beaux-arts styled apartment blocks at the edges of the neighborhood. It is a primarily institutional neighborhood, with a university, junior college, seminary, hospital and architecture museum among many private schools, colleges and technical schools at its core.
notes: We will always make sure to check in and check out our guest. With our 24hr checkin service you can be sure that you will always have someone checking you in at any given time. Upon arrival or before, you will need to fill out an online pre-check-in form that will be sent to our guest services or front desk manager, so that he can prepare your arrival and everything else that is necessary for your stay. Looking forward to having you as our guest at Destination Stays
transit: The neighborhood is served by two Montreal Metro Green line stations. Guy-Concordia station in the east and Atwater station to the west. Georges Vanier station on the Orange line is just south of Shaughnessy Village in nearby Little Burgundy. The area is also well-served by numerous bus lines terminating at Atwater Station that connect Westmount, Cote-des-Neiges and much of the rest of the urban core. The Claire-Morissette bike path on De Maisonneuve Boulevard cuts through the centre of the neighborhood and the area is well served by Bixi stations.

The place was great! The location is a foodie's dream, so many restaurants! The place was also very cute, small, but clean and was great for the two of us.
Daniel was a very welcoming and responsive host. The listing was perfectly located, impeccably clean, and nicely decorated. I would definitely recommend this listing!
Amazing host, amazing place! Enjoyed our stay, Daniel was more than helpful, and the apartment was very clean, if we ever find ourselves in Montreal again, would definitely go back.
Great communication and central location.
Daniel is the best! Super friendly, very helpful, and incredibly responsive. Don't miss out on this guy!

Dan was a great host and did everything possible to make my check-in and stay as smooth as possible. The room was exactly as pictured. It's only a few steps from the Metro which is a real convenience when it's cold and snowy. It was my first experience with Airbnb, and it was a good one.

Infelizmente não foi boa minha estadia no apartamento do Daniel. Apesar da localização ser excelente o apartamento não acomoda 3 pessoas apenas casal . Fomos eu , meu marido e minha filha de 15 anos e o apartamento apresenta apenas 1 cama de casal e a terceira acomodação era um colchão de inflar que estava furado. Imediatamente comunicamos o Daniel sobre o ocorrido e ele demorou 12 horas para nós responder e exigiu foto do colchão furado para verificar a veracidade da informação. Como era véspera de feriado de Natal nos informou que não poderia comprar um novo nem emprestar um outro colchão e que tínhamos má sorte . Ficamos lá por mais três dias nos revezando eu e minha filha num sofá de 2 lugares para não dormirmos no chão em pleno inverno canadense. Além disso não havia lavadora nem secadora de roupas como no anúncio. Recomendo o lugar apenas para casais não serve para família e Daniel não é um anfitrião confiável.
The apartment was in a fantastic area and was cute and clean. Daniel was easily accessible if we had any questions or concerns.
Response time is great and made sure everything was good to go before and after arriving

Daniel was a great host. Very easy to communicate with and the apartment was spectacular. Everything looks exactly as seen in the pictures. Location is a close walk downtown and our stay was pleasant. 

Thanks for everything!

reviews.comments: This was my first time using Airbnb and had a great experience, will definitely use again!  Patrick was a great host, very professional, friendly, and overall a great guy.  The bedroom in which I stayed was very comfortable, there were fresh bed linens and towels ready for my arrival and the host made me feel welcomed. Patrick has a very spacious, nicely decorated apartment, that is in a great neighborhood close to the metro.  The directions on how to arrive to apartment using public transportation was fantastic.  Patrick has a busy work schedule but I was able to enjoy a chat with him and having something to eat together.  Would definitely recommend Patrick as a host to travelers going to Montreal.

Spotlessly clean, cool and very comfortable apartment that is in a nice neighborhood. We felt very lucky to have found such a great place at short notice and Patrick was the perfect host. Easily the best airbnb experience we've had and would highly recommend Patrick and his place to anyone planning a trip to Montreal

Patrick and his place were awesome. Great location near a trendy area and very cool, clean and tidy apartment. Very well equipped kitchen. We had fun chilling and chatting with Pat in the evenings - he suggested some awesome things for us to see which really made our time in Montreal! Highly recommended, you da man Pat.
It was a lovely apartment in a quiet but lively neighborhood. The room itself is neat and artistic! Patrick is a very nice and considerate landlord.
We had to cancel our reservation a few days before arrival, which must have been an annoyance to Patrick. However he wished us a great trip, and was very kind about it.

Great experience, would totally recommend it to anyone! Patrick is a very friendly and attentive host. He's always willing to give a recommendation about anything Montreal! His stylish apartment is always clean and quiet and close to public transit. His dog is very friendly dog and respectful. Definitely a good experience!

J'ai passé un très agréable séjour chez Patrick. Il est une personne ouverte à la discussion et qui est de  bon conseil concernant la ville Montréal et le Québec en général. Son appartement est très  bien situé et très propre. N'hésitez pas à passer un séjour chez lui, vous vous y sentirez comme chez vous.
Un très bon accueil de Patrick dans une chambre et un appartement très agréables. Merci Patrick et à bientôt!

Very nice place to stay, I definitively recommend it. The neighborhood is very quiet, easy to park your car in front. Downtown is a bit far by walk (1h at least, Montreal is huge!), but there is a subway station 5mn away and it will take you downtown in 20mn.
Great host, clean room. Beautiful apartment. Not very central but easy to get places by metro.

Gorgeous old apartment with plenty of character in a beautiful neighbourhood, 5 minute walk from metro station. Its a little ways from Downtown Montreal but there are plenty of shops and restaurants around the corner. Patrick is a great host, the bed was very comfy and the apartment was easy to find. Looks exactly like the pictures. Very quiet at night, the dog doesn't make any noise and is very calm.

I would definitely recommend this place, especially if you appreciate heritage homes and woody neighbourhoods.

Patrick was a great host! Very helpful in finding things to do in the city, the apartment was very close to the metro and it was easy navigating. The apartment was lovely with a sweet little balcony to enjoy snacks and drinks.  I would absolutely consider returning to Patrick's welcoming home if we should return to Montreal.

Patrick was an excellent host, and it couldn't have been a better first experience with airbnb. The house and the room was very clean and the dog was very tame. Also, the location was ideal to arrive with car, because you have the possibility to park in the street and walk to the metro.
Very enjoyable stay with Patrick! Super relaxed, and easy going. Friendly and helpful.  Beautiful room with a wonderful view of the sunset. Thank you for such a memorable first stay in Montreal!

I had a comfortable stay at Patrick's house . He gave me good advice where to look around . His place is spacious , tidy and the location is great for those who are foodie since the famous market Jean- Talon is walking distance from the house I cant help going back for more oysters and cheeses . If you feel like cooking on your own you can get the freshest produce in Jean-Talon . And it is 3 minutes walking to subway takes just 20 minutes to get to downtown . Patrick's dog Jarva is super cute and friendly very easy to get along with him .

Très bon séjour dans l'adorable appartement de Pat. Chambre spacieuse et lumineuse, salon et cuisine confortables et bien équipés le tout à moins de 10 min du métro et des bus. Vraiment un place de choix pour un séjour à Montréal! Pat est accueillant et super arrangeant, on se sent comme à la maison! Je conseille.

Logement un peu excentré mais proche du métro pour se rendre dans le centre. Quelques bonnes adresses à proximité (cinéma, restaurants, supermarchés). L'appartement est grand. Le lit, un peu petit pour 2 personnes. Bref, bien pour quelques jours si vous souhaitez découvrir la ville. Et n'hésitez pas à demander à Patrick, il saura vous conseiller.

Pat's place was great. I was a long term guest and I found it very comfortable and convenient. The animals were both sweet and it was a very nice place to stay. The metro was very convenient and parking was easy to find. I'd highly recommend staying here!

Patrick was a welcoming and accommodating host. His place has a very relaxed, comfortable atmosphere. Everything was as I expected; all facilities very adequate and efficient.  The bed was super comfortable, I slept well.  I agree its the best spot in town!!!

Patrick was great, room was great, location was great. His dog was friendly and never barked when we snuck in late. We would have hung out with him more but our schedules didn't line up. All of his suggestions were on point, if we return to Montreal we will definitely try to stay with him again

I had booked another room but since there was a problem with that listing, I went to Patrick’s place. So it was a very last minute booking but he kindly accommodated me. He was very fast in answering the messages. Patrick and his girlfriend recommended me very interesting restaurants, so ask them for that! ;)
The room was very clean with a comfortable bed. Also Patrick provided me some towels. The dog, was very friendly, quiet and respectful. The place was close to metro (5mins) so you can reach the down town in 25 mins.

This was our first time using airbnb and it was a pleasant experience! We had a nice stay at Patricks apartment and he is a very friendly and welcoming host. Thank you very much for letting us stay in your home!
Convenient location, comfortable bed, friendly welcome. Thank you so much, Patrick!

I had a good stay at Patrick's apartment.  He was very responsive to messages and he was friendly and helpful in providing directions. His dog is quite sweet and quiet. The apartment is walking distance from the subway and bus lines.  The room was as pictured in the listing.

Venant pour la première fois à Montréal , j'ai été agréablement surpris par l'accueil chaleureux et la gentillesse de Patrick et de sa compagne Édith . Ils sont aussi très attentifs à ce que leurs hôtes se sentent à l'aise et ils n'hésitent pas à donner de précieux conseils pour visiter Montréal .
Leur appartement , décoré avec beaucoup de gout , est très spacieux , propre et très bien tenu . Le quartier est calme et sympathique , avec le métro et toutes sortes de commerces tout proche. Bref , une autre bonne raison pour moi de revenir à Montréal , est d'aller redonner un petit bonjour à Patrick et Édith .

We had a terrific stay at Patrick's place. The neighbourhood was quiet and very lovely. The subway is just a five minute walk, making the Jean Talon Market among many other sites and attractions easily accessible. The apartment itself was just as advertised, but with even more charm and was very clean. Patrick himself is very kind, and responsive. I highly recommend staying with Pat and his cute dog (who is totally gentle and calm).
Merci encore Patrick et Edith pour cet accueil chaleureux ! Au plaisir de vous recroiser à Montréal !

J'ai choisi cet appart car il a l'air vraiment chic et ça m'a absolument pas déçu. Toutes les pièces sont bien meublées (un divan et plusieurs chaises très confortables). La cuisine est tout équipée. Les animaux du appart étaient trop adorable et extrêmement calme. Juste une marche de 5 minutes du Métro. Patrick et sa copine étaient très arrangeants et réspecteux. Je me suis senti comme chez moi. Vraiment un excellent choix pour un séjour à Montréal.

We throughly enjoyed our stay with Patrick and his lovely girlfriend. Their apartment was beautiful and conveniently located to public transportation. There is also a street just two blocks south with plenty of delicious restaurants and a lush park as well; the neighborhood is perfect and gave us a real sense of authentic Montreal while avoiding the overrun tourist areas. Their dog Java was a sweet heart and always the first to welcome us in. The hosts were a great resource and gave us many recommendations of things to do and places to visit during our stay. Overall we had a terrific stay in Montreal and would love to return soon!

This place is not only exactly as pictured, it is also super close to the metro. The Jean-Talon market is close, walkable, and there are a couple of great parks close by. I would recommend BOTH he space and the host.

Je suis arrivé dans un appartement bien entretenu et par les propriétaires qui était  adorable ! Le quartier était super sympa avec une station de métro à 2 pas du logement !
Expérience à refaire !
Dream home, period. Pat is a super nice host, and his place is super clean and cozy. Five mins walk to metro. Will definitely stay again. Highly recommended.
The place is 5 min walk to the metro and close bus stop. Pat and his girlfriend Edith have been friendly host. Edith recommended places to eat around as I was new to Montreal. Great stay

What a lovely and kind couple. I felt comfortable and at ease with them and they were both so good at recommending local spots and good places to go in town. I really appreciated that. The flat is lovely and light and only about 5 mins walk from a metro station, as well as a park and the many cafes and shops on Beaubien. Highly recommend.
A very polite and friendly couple, close to the subway station with market on the side. Very cozy and beautiful house besides very clean.

Patrick’s place was perfect and its great location made it super convenient to get around! The apartment is just as amazing as it looks in the photos and everything is kept in great condition. Being five minutes away from the Iberville metro station made it super easy for us to get from place to place and really make the most out of our stay! Would 100% recommend staying here to anybody and would gladly come back the next time I’m in the city.

This is by far my best Airbnb experience! 
Patrick and Edith are not just a lovely couple but wonderful human beings.  They were very amicable and were always available for any help or guidance.  About the place, it is designed and decorated with artsy touch, minimal yet deep, and very clean too. It has a pretty tranquil vibe to it and their dog and cat would be very nice company. For me, the balcony was the cherry on the top.  Metro is 5mins walk away and grocery store is steps away - which is awesome.  And yeah, they have some pretty amazing recommendations so don't forget to ask them. :)

Will definitely visit again, highly recommended!

we had a very good time in this apartment. it's cosy and offers you everything you need.  close to lots of interesting stores and the center.  it was very easy to communicate with miguel and he was super friendly. definitely recommending this apartment.

Miguel's place is top notch. It doesn't get much better. For a short or long-term stay, this place is awesome. I love the area: artsy, trendy and cool. una estancia estupenda en casa de Miguel, muchas gracias por toda la información y la amabilidad

Would recommend!

Bonne situation dans Porto,bruyant côté rue...

Belle décoration mais un manque d entretien ...

Miguel was very responsive and the location of the apartment is perfect for a weekend in Porto!
Fomos muito bem recebidos pelo Miguel que nos deixou dicas preciosas para a nossa estadia, o apartamento impecável, sossegado, muito central próximo de tudo!
Quite apartament, but close by to The Porto going out area. Everything is in a walking distance

Miguel è una persona molto disponibile che ci ha aiutato e suggerito posti da visitare e per mangiare. Molto gentile da parte sua, ci ha fatti entrare prima nell'appartamento nonostante il check-in fosse alle 15.00. Consiglio questo appartamento per soggiorni corti di un week-end se non si ha intenzione di mangiare in casa.
Non ci ha dato questa casa che avevo prenotato bensì un'altra che ha al primo piano (visibile nel suo profilo). Appena arrivati abbiamo subito informato Miguel della scarsa pulizia del bagno e ci ha detto che avrebbe mandato di nuovo la signora delle pulizie anche se non fu necessario. 
La casa è molto carina ma a mio parere non è adatta per un lungo soggiorno dato che il riscaldamento è elettrico e l' angolo cucina è sacrificato, manca l' essenziale come sale, olio ecc. Nella casa si può trovare detersivo per piatti, spugna, bagnoschiuma, phon, carta da cucina e da bagno (anche se per 4 persone in un soggiorno di 5 giorni ci vorrebbero più di 2 rotoli).
Nel nostro caso erano giorni piovosi e le finestre di legno non sono molto isolanti quindi la casa rimaneva umida. 
Il frigorifero è di quelli piccoli,  non so se si fosse rotto però le cose fresche si sono rovinate. 
Detto questo la casa rimane un buon compromesso perché si trova in una posizione strategica a pochi passi dal centro e supermercati.
Bom local, confortável apesar de alguns contra-tempos.
Great location, nice spot, very nice host.  Porto is an amazing city and this place is in the heart of it.
Espaço limpo, confortável, super acolhedor, perto de vários locais de interesse.
Appartement bien situé

El alojamiento de Miguel está en una zona perfecta de la ciudad, una vía peatonal cerca de los monumentos y edificios más signifivativos. En este piso está todo lo esencial para pasar unos días explorando Porto.
Alloggio in zona pedonale, vicino al centro.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado, cerca de todo y en una calle peatonal muy agradable. Es pequeño pero lindo y Miguel es muy atento. Totalmente recomendado.
Perfecta ubicación y Miguel fue muy amable. La casa tenía todo lo necesario para pasar un fin de semana en Porto

Miguel's place couldn't be in a better location! It's very easy to find too. 

Some hand soap and tea/coffee wouldn't go amiss in future.

I have never given a negative review but unfortunately I cannot give this apartment / stay a positive review. When we arrived we were told we had been 'upgraded' and were given a different apartment to the one we had booked. The apartment we were given was sadly not yet fully operational / suitable for guest rental. Issues included exposed wiring in a bathroom powerpoint which was a potentially dangerous situation given that the bathroom floor was extremely wet due to inadequate shower drainage.  When this powerpoint was used it shorted the household power. Other issues included water leaking from the kitchen wall, inadequate heating, security issues (apartment could be entered via a hole in the wall and through a locked cupboard door), no hot water in the kitchen. I let Miguel know in detail the issues we encountered, but he was out of town until late in the evening, however he did come by the following morning but was unable to resolve the issues during our stay.  Once these issues are resolved this apartment certainly has the potential to be a great place to stay. It has a lovely ambience, is well furnished and is in a great location.

Apartment for tourist use with license number: HUTB-001800.

reviews.comments: Francisco was an excellent host.  He met us and took us through the apartment.  It is located in a busy neighborhood and may get noisy outside on Friday and Saturday. Estábamos en un grupo de 10 amigos, luego el piso estaba lleno a sua capacidad total. El salón y la cocina (las áreas comunes) son suficientement grandes para que todos estuviéramos juntos, lo que es muy bueno. A nosotros nos gustó mucho el acceso del piso, que es hecho directamente desde la calle en una esquina (está en la planta baja del edifício, con un piso arriba, y otro abajo), es muy práctico y trae mucha vida al piso. Pero, por eso, el local donde hay uno de los sofá camas en el sótano, no tiene ventanas y es un poco más frío que las otras habitaciones. Y por eso también, el piso no tiene mucha luz natural (los vidrios de las ventanas no son completamente transparentes lo que es bueno para la privacidad, pero no tan bueno para la iluminación).
Tuvimos un problema con una de las dos duchas pero Francisco estuvo siempre accesible por mensaje y vino cambiar la manguera desde que posible.
El barrio del Poble-Sec es perfecto, con mucha vida, bares, restaurantes, se hace todo a pie y tampoco está lejos del casco antiguo. El piso fue una buena solución de alojamiento para un grande grupo.

Francisco's place was perfectly located for our trip to Sónar Barcelona; only a ten minute walk from the 'by day' site. It accommodated ten people comfortably and was as pictured. 

For some reason Francisco had only made the bed for eight people, there was no hand soap in the 2nd bathroom and he hardly spoke a word of English - which was fine since I could manage in Spanish, but I don't envy those who have no Spanish and will try to work out the check-in details with him over the phone. On that note, Francisco was very insisting - to the point of being rude - that I don't call him again until I'm outside the apartment: 'don't call me on your way, don't call me around the corner, just call me when you're in front of the house.' That would've been fine if he would've been inside waiting, but after I called it took him twenty minutes to come over and open (he said five).

There were ten of us on our way to an all-night festival so I was surprised that Francisco only had two sets of keys (and only one alarm-disarmer). When I asked if it was possible to have more sets he arrogantly told me it was an impossibility (when of course he can have more keys cut) and that he had rented the place to a group of friends, not ten individuals. While that is true, it still over-complicated things for us and when you're renting such a big place I think an investment in one or two more sets would really please your guests.

The flat is in a great location... lots of great food options within a few minutes walk as well as great public transport nearby.  Unfortunately there were several issues when we first arrived including cleanliness issues as well as ripped and dirty furniture not represented by the photos shown in the listing.  These were brought up to the host and he responded promptly and had folks out to fix things like a broken bed, missing linens, broken railing, moldy bathroom, missing glass door on the shower, etc within 1-2 days.  We had booked the flat with the description stating that it can fit 10... long story short... it can fit 10, but not comfortably and with 2 keys total, it is very hard to make plans with a larger group.  Additionally, it's important to note that some of the "rooms" which sleep 2 each are not rooms so privacy can also be a concern.  1 of the rooms is in the basement which does not have AC to it, so this could also be an issue if the weather is warm.  While we were in town, the weather was warm so we had to run the AC... which we were messaged that it was too loud for the neighbors a few days in to our stay.  Additionally, like other guests have stated, the hot water heater accommodates about 2 showers at a time, so with a group of 10, this makes getting ready for the day very difficult.  We had 1 of our group members leave after the first night due to some cleanliness, privacy and difficulties with the 2 key issues.  Overall, it's in a great location, so if you have a small group or if you don't care about showering or having only 2 keys, it is wonderful!

THIS WAS THE WORST AIRBNB EXPERIENCE: 
Our check out meeting was supposed to be at 11h. You came at 10:40 when we were still getting dressed and you tried to get in. you came back at 10:50, you said that we only have 5 minutes and you entered inside while the girls were almost naked. This is called harassement. Until now we stayed polite because we are all well educated and came to Barcelona to enjoy our weekend not to create problems even if your attitude was very rude, you don’t know what is apologizing and what is tourism.
At 11:02, you started screaming and threatening us that we won’t have our money back( the change from the taxes + late check in)  because we had 2 minutes delay which is extremely annoying. Until now we didn’t say anything we just got off the house without even checking if we didn’t forget anything because it was 11:02 and you seemed very impatient and agressive toward all of us while we were just asking for our money back( the change from taxes) 
This being said, let’s come back to how things happened during this weekend:
1- the communication to retrieve the keys was extremely bad, we spent around 2 hours to succeed to reach you. The person that was supposed to give us the keys didn’t answer our call for one hour and then my friend waited for 30 minutes before she came!!!!! And she didn’t have the change and still we didn’t say anything even if it was cold and dangerous. As we are regular travelers we learned to be indulgent and to be human in our exchanges which is not your case.
2- The pictures on airbnb don’t look like reality, they are fake as we didn’t have the same furnitures, the house is very dusty and dirty, we even found a cockroach!!!!  The beds are very thin and uncomfortable. And above all, the house is very noisy we hear everything when we are sleeping from outside.
3- Let’s now talk about the neighborhood, what about these guys who sit in front of your house all the day smoking weed, drinking and talking aggressively to us?? What about these neighbors who threw eggs on us because we were talking from 8:00 pm to 9:00 pm(from 10:00 pm we were at the restaurant, with proof)?? Your house is  insecure. 
4- Even inside the house, it’s dangerous:
- electrical plugs not covered and my friend got hurt
- no electricity in one room
- insects in the ceiling and on the table
- the entrance door is very fragile and we were very afraid that the guys on the step in front of the door got in because they were knocking at the door.
Ultimately, it seems very enigmatic for us how there were some old good comments as this is the worse Airbnb experience for the 10 of us. We are very disappointed of your agressive attitude and we intend to take the necessary measures to make sure that this bad experience won’t occur for other travelers and to restore justice for all of us.

summary: A spacious, private studio with high speed Wi-Fi wireless internet. It is located in historical district of Sultanahmet oldcity center. This area is called Kadirga and it's famous with it's local restaurants. There are more gorcery stores and supermarkets in this are since it's not %100 touristic area. There is children playground right in front of the building.
space: Car parking is also available just in front of the apartment and it's 5 euros per day ( per 24 hours). There are historical Turkish baths and many supermarkets, local restaurants in the area.
