* la lumière de salle de bain fonctionne avec un détecteur de mouvement qui ne capte pas si vous êtes dans la douche. Il faut donc utiliser le flash de son portable.
Good location

Fantastic little apartment, ideal for a weekend break in Istanbul. Located on a road with lots of good cheap street food, only ten minutes walk from the main tourist spots of Sultanahmet including the blue mosque and Hagia Sophia. Great road of restaurants just three minutes away with great atmosphere and decent prices - although everyone will try and lure you in! It's a very steep climb up a hill to public transport but not a problem if you enjoy a walk!

Apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Only problem is the noise. The doorbell is loud and people coming in and out kept us awake one night!
Ganz bequem und guter Lage. Jederzeit kann ich Empfehlen. Emre ist nette man und freundlich. Die Zimmer ist preiswert. Blaue Moschee nur 6-7 min zu fuss.

Appartement simple, des lits un frigo,
Les - :  pas toujours le nécessaire de cuisine, plaque vieille..pas de machine a laver, assez froid (pas de chauffage, la clim chauffe mal) fortes odeurs dans la salle de bain, et les draps sont pas changé de la semaine...les serviette retiré mais pas rajouter...

Les + : 
Bon emplacement loin du tumulte de la ville mais dans le centre historique de Sulthanamey.Emre est réactif,plein de petits boui boui autour, restaurants, ménage fait durant le séjour, et quartier calme !

Mr Emre was very helpful and friendly with us help us showing around especially being Turkish interpter when needed.
Highly recommended place to stay in Old Istanbul
Удобное расположение до основных достопримечательностей (пешая доступность). Оперативные ответы и помощь от хозяина квартиры.

L'appartement d'Emre est davantage une petite chambre d’hôtel où l'on a les équipements attendus sauf la machine à laver. L'appartement est globalement assez propre.
Il est très bien placé (à 10 min à pied de la mosquée bleue et de sainte Sophie) et dans un quartier authentique. Nous avons aussi apprécié qu'il y ait en face un supérette où nous avons pu faire des courses.
Emre est très réactif et très sympa. Nous recommandons cet appartement.

Great place to stay at! Few minutes from Sultanhamet and Kumkapi, nights are silent and days (till late) are really lively. There is plenty of supermarkets, food stores in the whereabouts, a hammam 50mt away and lots of shops all around. Didn't meet Emre at all (maybe because we were out all day) but got kind hospitality and everything we could need from his friend (a girl, I can't remember her name). Finally, I would recommend ***** at Emre's always!! *****

Unser Aufenthalt war super. Wir sind bis zur Yenikapi Metro Station vom Flughafen durchgefahren und sind dann mit Uber für 13 (2-3€) TL zur Unterkunft gefahren. Der Check In war super einfach, leider haben wir Emre an dem Tag nicht persönlich getroffen, aber seine Assistentin, die 24/7 im Haus ist, hat uns die Schlüssel überreicht. Unser Zimmer hat nach Zigaretten gerochen, da wir Nichtraucher sind und den Geruch nicht gewohnt sind, haben wir auf Anfrage von Emre sofort ein anderes Zimmer bekommen. Ein Pluspunkt. Die Lage war auch sehr gut, in 5-10 min waren wir an der blauen Moschee, Hagia Sophia und am großen Bazar.
Die Unterkunft an sich war sauber und der Service war auch gut.
Emre ist super nett und hilft sofort, wenn ihr Probleme oder Fragen habt!

Nur zu empfehlen. Gerne wieder!
Be ready with your water to drink on arrival
The apartment was as described and all went smoothly with the exception if some confusion at check-in which wasn't a massive problem. Otherwise a decent and good value place to stay for a few days.

I recommend a stay at Kadirga's.  We could not have asked for a better location!!!  It was so close to many of the main sites (we didn't use transportation around the city at all - walked everywhere).  There are a lot of small markets if you need to pick up food or other supplies.  There are also a ton of local restaurants and cafes.  We loved the location!  The apartment was well equipped and VERY clean.  The only thing that we would have liked different were doors/curtain on the shower or extra towels for the wet floor.  We did not meet the host at all, which would have been nice just to be able to thank him in person.  I would absolutely stay here again!

Нам было приятно остановиться в доме у Emre. Отличное расположение, все достопримечательности близко, район безопасный, хороший супермаркет напротив. В доме все работало исправно. Наша комната была как заявлено на фото.

No es un apartamento, es una habitación de hotel sin servicios de hotel. Hay una nevera, un microondas y un pequeño fogón, pero luego no te puedes sentar a tomar un café. Mi piso era el bajo y daba a un patio sucísimo lleno de porquerías. Durante el día se usaba como aparcamiento de coches y si abría la ventana se llenaba de humo la habitación. El apartamento tampoco estaba muy limpio.
Emre is a great host. He can help you with all your travel needs.
Logement bien situé pour visiter le vieil Istanbul. Mais la salle de bain est  en très mauvais état . Et on n'a rencontré personne...
Great location and Emre was a fantastic host. Gave us a lot of local tips and attended to our requests quickly

(-) Please be aware that you have to walk UPHILL for around 15 min from the location to Beyazit Station (T2)- main street to start visiting the attractions; the room and bathroom are quite cold since there is no sun beating over the place during the day,  there is mildew over the ceiling in the bathroom due to humidity.

(+) Good and quick communication with the host, fast check-in, room and bathroom were very clean, spacious room, nice park in front

We were disappointed when we first walked into the room because it's not nearly as nice as it appears in the photos. The WiFi was poor - simple browsing is a challenge. The washing machine was broken so we couldn't do laundry on site. Other than that it was a nice stay. Fairly good location. We feel like we overpaid for the place. I wouldn't want to pay more than 20euro/night for it. We spent a week here. In hindsight, we'd spend a few nights in this area and a few nights in Galata.

I stayed with mixed feelings after our stay. Our host seemed very nice and was helpful in what we asked for, a huge help was the fact that we could check in very early and also leave our luggage in the lobby after we checked out. What I didn't like however was that he was very slow in answering my messages, before and during the stay . The room looks much better in the photos than it really is. The furniture is quite old, worn out, the bed sheets were clean but had holes in them, mattresses were really dirty.. The bathroom looks unclean mainly because it is oldish as well and the worst thing was a very bad smell that we had during the whole stay and couldn't find where it came from. The location however was very nice i would say it is a nice neighbourhood and close to main attractions.
The kitchenware is all rusty and not neat. Not at all as described by the host.

Очень понравилось, бюджетный вариант, лучше намного чем хостел, хотя по ценам идентичны, чисто, тепло, удобная кровать.  Местоположение супер, единственное что долго искали адрес, так как Гугл карта показывала не верно, до метро 10 минут пешком, до трамвая 5 минут, вечером есть где погулять, тихий, не шумный район, с окна виден супермаркет, ночное заведение типа кафе, парк.
Рядом с домом аптека.
В комнате есть все удобства для готовки, глажки. 
Очень рада что гостили именно здесь.
Советую и Вам))

This place isn't as nice as it looks in the pictures. The assistant who was meant to let us in when we first arrived didn't answer the door when we rang the bell so we were stuck outside at night with our luggage wondering what to do, thankfully I connected to the wifi from the cafe over the road to contact him that we were there and it was sorted. The rest of the stay was average but it's good for the amount of money you pay.

clean place and safe, u need to prepare yourself for walking if u want to use public transportation.
if u have elderly ppl, make sure to get room in 1st level.
communication is quick, and this place closer to a lot of restaurants.
Location is good.

Our room was a bit different than the photos. It wasn't too bad but also not what I expected. Compared to photos the room is a bit less nice overall.

The location is okay. 5-10 minutes walking distance from Blue Mosque and tram line.

We didn't have any problems with amenities.

name: Stunning Tamarama 2BR apartment with ocean views
summary: If you like the ocean and to surf you won’t find a better place to spend Sydney this summer. With sweeping and uninterrupted views across MacKenzie’s Bay, Tamarama, Bronte and beyond our home is an ocean and surfing lover’s paradise. This 2-bedroom apartment is also very spacious with a large King room with sun room and a second double room with a separate fold-out single bed. When in the large open plan living and kitchen areas you feel like you can reach out and touch the ocean!

Home to some of the city’s top restaurants, cafes, boutique shopping and a number of stunning beaches – including Bondi, Tamarama, Bronte and Coogee. Your home during your stay is our spacious and light filled 2-bedroom apartment with uninterrupted views over Mackenzie’s Bay, Tamarama, Bronte and beyond. If it’s boutique shopping, trendy cafés, restaurants and art galleries then head straight to Bondi’s Hall Street and Curlewis Street which offer everything that you might need. If you’re looking for food and can’t take yourself away from the beach then maybe drop into Icebergs, North Bondi RSL or the Bucket List to get a taste of the local dishes and a cold beverage while marveling at the stunning ocean views. If you want to explore the stunning beaches and coastline between Bondi and Coogee just continue south of Bondi and follow the path to the neighbouring beaches: Tamarama beach, affectionately known as Glamarama to the locals due to the beautiful and glamorous nature of many of it’s visitors, is a small and stunning beach just 10-minute walk from Bondi Beach (25 minutes using the coastal path). notes: An initial supply of fresh linen, bath towels and toiletries (shampoo, body wash and toilet paper) will be provided along with a fully equipped kitchen and washing machine.
transit: While you remain in Tamarama, Bondi and Bronte everything is within a short walking distance.  A 5 to 10-minute drive or 10-minute bus ride will take you to Bondi Junction, the closest shopping centre and transport hub for the City and other beaches.  A further 10-minute train ride will take you to Town Hall, the heart of the CDB, and another 10 minutes to Circular Quay where you’ll get to enjoy the sights of the Harbour Bridge and Opera House, The Rocks, and everything else that this wonderful city has to offer. All this from the closest bus stop only a 5-minute walk away on Dudley Street. All bus and driving times are subject to traffic flow and buses depart approximately every 10 minutes.

Ben

reviews.comments:
Amazing location and view, we had to extend our stay as we couldn't part with the view and outdoor living area.
So close to have a swim or head to Bondi entertainment/shopping area.
I've never had a better place to sit and look at a view for hours each day. The best.

house_rules: I love nice people and polite. Pets no allowed. Definitely it is an apartment for  nonsmoker people

host.host_about:
My name is Ana, I live in Barcelona for 35 years, is my city.
I’m a holistic therapist &
naturalist intuitive healer-
The calm and tranquility is reflected in my home and my person.
I like to offer an atmosphere of harmony and happiness, as any kind of tip and help for finding out curious locations of the city ...
I have traveled the world over, love to travel. And I have lived in different countries.
Trying to learn the way of living of its people...I like to travel as much as I can :)
My interests are cinema,  and art. 
I love cooking, biking, and movies.
I speak English, Portuguese,Spanish and Italian and understand French.
I am respectful of the planet, nature and ecology.
I love recycling...

reviews.comments:
Staying at Ana's place was just a PERFECT experience!! It was my first AirBnB experience, but I was very happy that I found such a nice host like her. :) Since the moment I met her, her smile never left her face. :) She is very calm, kind, and very lovely. :) I stayed at a very pretty private room and everything was there, even TV and DVD Player. Also there was little air conditioner, so I could have cool nights in hot Barcelona. :) 
Ana is always helpful so whenever I asked for help, she always kindly helped me. :) She also speaks good English so there was no problem with communicating. :)
Her place is very close from a metro station and the area is very very safe area. Also it is very close from Sants which is like a central station of Barcelona, so when you go to other cities or airport, you can reach them easily and quick. :) The area has everything you need.. bakery, super markets(even 24 hours one), book shop, internet cafe, pharmacy, bars, restaurants, etc.. and also there was night bus line from Catalunya 1 block away from the house. So when there is no more metro, I could come home safely by night bus. :)
In a word, it was a very lucky and perfect choice staying at Ana's place. :) For me, it was more than just an accommodation because I met such a lovely and beautiful person as hostess and I know we will meet again and again as good friends in near future. :)
All the best to you, Ana! Miss you already!! :) 
Muchas gracias por todo, Ana! :)
Quite simple but great place for a very fair price. Has everything you need. Perfectly located and still very quiet. Ana was great and very friendly. Would go there anytime again.
l really enjoyed being with ana. she was a great, relaxed host. she was also wonderful in giving me all the information l needed to see all the cities sights.

Staying at Charming room was a really good experience. I was looking for a calm place where to stay while going to the university. Everything was great!!
Ana is a really kind person and will give you enough tips to go out the city.

Ana is a delight and her home is spotless and always clean.  It is in a wonderful part of town and you can get everywhere by metro, bus, or walking.  At night it is quiet and cool and the room with a comfortable bed is right next to the bathroom.  While you do share the bathroom with Ana you would never know she had been in it.  It is almost as if she cleans it EVERY time she uses it.

In the morning there is a big pot of coffee and some toast if you wish.  I never ate breakfast as it is not my thing but was always glad the coffee was ready when I woke up.

Anna was a welcoming and gracious host. My room was clean, comfortable, and roomy. Anna gave me plenty of privacy. She offered coffee, toast and jam for breakfasts, although I ended up buying food and making my own--she left me space in the fridge. 

Air conditioning took the edge off the heat; there was a fan in the bedroom and a small stereo as well as TV. I wasn't always comfortable in the Living Room as her bedroom and office were right off it, and she was often there, so I mostly kept to my room. Guests should note that while the room profile shows a washing machine, her notes say she will wash your clothes for 8 euros per load. 

The location was very good, just a couple blocks from the subway and within extended walking distance of several key sites. I was given keys so I could come and go as I pleased. I appreciated the quietness of the space. I would recommend this place to others.

Ana welcomes you to her lovely, impeccable home in a lovely neighborhood, very well situated for all means of public transportation.  She extends herself immediately and always, to attend to your comfort, as if in your own home, to feel at home. She can facilitate your being able to experience this slice of life in Barcelona and beyond, as you get to know her adopted city.  You will be hosted by a very lovely person, very personable, open, friendly and caring, who will try to help you find the Barcelona you are looking for.  I don't think you would find a better host anywhere, and she deserves the full trust she absolutely offers her guests from the first moment.

staying at chaming  room was a wonderful experience.The room was very clean y comfortable and the location was excellent.Ana is very kind,helpful .She is very pleasant to provide informations and suggestiones when  I stayed in Barcelona .Thank you .

Ana has a wonderful clean apartment in a beautiful neighbourhood in Barcelona. There are great places to eat and drink close by, some even on the same block.

Ana is a great host and is very helpful in answering any questions I had about the city. She had advice about transportation and things to see during my first visit to Barcelona.
Listing was as advertised, room pleasant and clean. Anna the landlady was very nice and accommodating and went out of her way and constantly kept the place clean. Location and building nice.

Ana is a wonderful host and her apartment is very clean, in a safe charming and quiet neighborhood, with excellent Wifi. Very close to the metro and buses, but an easy 20 minute walk to most of the touristy type things but a nice calm space to come home to after a day if sightseeing. The room and apartment has all you need, nearby are several restaurants and bakeries, with non-tourist prices (ie good pricing). Ana provided maps and tips on all things Barcelona and was very easy going and personable throughout my stay. 100% recommend.

Fantastic experience, clean and spacious room. 
Great location to visit the city. Ana Isabel was always kind and available 
Would definitely recommend!!!

Ana kindly welcomed me to her place and was knowledgable about the ins and outs of Barcelona. Her neighborhood is quiet and a ~15 minute walk from La Rambla. I felt safe walking around day or night. (I'm also male.) There is an elevator that goes to her floor & I was happy my rented bike fit inside that.

The room was as described - the bed was comfortable, the apartment quiet,  and I slept very well. I didn't spend much time hanging out during the day. The shower head had a little bit of trouble fitting in the holder but it was minor.

Localizado em um bairro tranquilo dentro de uma cidade cosmopolita como Barcelona, o charming room foi cenário de um período fantástico. Ana Isabel sempre simpática, sorridente e prestativa torna sua estadia ainda mais agradável.
Espero retornar...

Ha sido una experiencia d lo más positiva. La ubicación estupenda y Annais te lo facilita todo y te da toda la información que necesites. Me he encontrado muy a gusto,  como en mi propia casa. La habitación completa y la cama muy confortable pero además ella esta pendiente d cualquier cosa que pudieras necesitar. No tengo más que palabras d agradecimiento y desde que pueda pienso repetir.
Sitio muy bien situado, limpio y acogedor, Ana Isabel muy atenta y amable.

Ha sido una buena experiencia, el piso esta muy centrico en una zona tranquila.Ana ha tenido un trato excelente, dispuesta en todo momento a aclarar mis dudas y hacer de mi estancia acogedora. Realmente recomendable
Ana se ha portado muy bien, muy atenta y siempre ayudando en lo posible. El apartamento se encontraba muy limpio siempre y es muy cómodo

Ana Isabel is a kind hostess, she respects boundaries, was very helpful and welcoming too. You will not feel like a stranger in Barcelona if you decide to live with her. The room was nice and clean, the neighborhood was quite and people were always friendly everywhere I went.

Ana made me feel very welcome and was a nice host. The bedroom was clean and comfortable. The location was perfect for my needs - close to many restaurants and where I was working, and also near the main tourist spots.

Annais' apartment is nice, cozy and ideally located.

I got in Barcelona late at night and Annais was waiting for me, she gave me a quick and efficient tour of the apartment and of my room, explaining all the features and amenities available. 

Annais is a great host: very efficient, kind, understanding, helpful and discrete. 

I highly recommend this solution if you're looking to spend a few days in Barcelona!

I have spent 3 days & night at the Annais place. Everything was perfect. She very nice and always ready to assist you for all you need. Place to see or the way to go for some place, etc. She a very nice person and you feel like at home. It's very private too. I will return anytime. I recommend this place.
Thank you Annais to be your guest

Annais welcomed me with a little packet, telling me her house was my house. I really appreciated the little map she provides with information about tapas, grocery stores, and pharmacies on the block. She gave me very useful tips and ideas a couple of time I interacted with her during my stay. The flat/room are exactly as shown in the photos. I tend to be private person, so when I was siesting or having to work, I tended to stay in my room. When she says she will leave you alone, she means it:) She let me have my much-needed space without making me feel weird about it. I really like the location. It is within walking distance to tourist attraction and the tourist busses. Two busses (right in front of her building) take you to the Placa Catalunya (sp), which you can use to A) take the bus to the airport and B) to start your walk down Las Ramblas. Another couple of buses, about two  blocks away, go down Las Ramblas (from which you can turn off to Bari Gothic), one of those two going along the coast of La Barceloneta (sp). The Metro, which is two blocks away, is but 3 stops from La Sagrada Familia. I liked how I could get to everything but wasn't in a neighborhood of tourists (I do think I noticed other airbnb-ers in the barrio though!). The neighborhood was nondescript yet pleasant...

Me sentí como en mi casa. La habitación es muy cómoda y tiene muy buena energía el lugar. Annais es muy amable. Me ayudó mucho a ubicarme en la zona, me aconsejó y fue muy predispuesta a ayudarme con todo tipo de situaciones cotidianas de mi nueva vida en Barcelona.   La casa es muy limpia y te brinda mucha privacidad para leer o descansar. Todo muy lindo. La verdad no quería irme!

Annais es una persona muy amable y te sientes como en casa nada más llegar. Te ayuda mucho en cuestión de moverte  por la ciudad y conocer los lugares útiles cerca como supermercados, cajeros ...
En cuanto al piso, está en pleno centro en una zona muy tranquila pero con muchas tiendas, restaurantes... La habitación está genial.. una cama enorme, televisión por cable, WiFi, calefacción central... que más de puede pedir?  
En resumen, lo recomiendo plenamente

It was one amazing week, I passed one week for work and i sleep in Annais's house, she was very friendly with me, all the explication of the city and the room it's really cozy and hot, the bathroom it's perfectly working and biggest too, internet was super fast so i'm feel comfortable and i succede to working perfectly.

Thanks Again.
Grazie davvero è stata una fantastica settimana, dovevo lavorare e sono riuscito a farlo anche la sera quando avevo bisogno di internet (super veloce).
bagno grande, e comodo, stanza davvero molto accogliente tv via cavo armadio e comodino con una scrivania e uno specchio. La stanza era davvero calda. 

Grazie ancora.

Annais is a lovely lady and genial host. She knew that I wouldn't make it in to the city until 8PM and was patiently waiting for me at the front door when I got out of the elevator to welcome me in.

Carmen is a nice and warm host. Her place is small but cosy and very convenient. The location is perfect to visit HK : both close to lively areas at night, and to nature paths for an early jogging.

The flat is cosy and very well located, and Carmen was really helpful throughout our stay! Just be aware that the apartment may not be suitable for 3 tall adults (as it was our case), as beds are very small.

There are 2 types of AirBnBs - one feels like a hotel and the other is someone's actual home. This is the latter - do not expect a hotel experience. Location is great (Star St in Wanchai has boutique shops & nice restaurants, you're less than 5 min walk from the MTR and less than 30 min walk to Central). Building is more modern than most in the area, with a doorman and elevator. Apartment has an open view (not easy to come by on HK island!) Carmen keeps her place tidy and well equipped with everything you need. Bed is short (as others have noted) and the sofa is small too. Bathroom is basic but shower has hot water and ok pressure. Kitchen is tiny but there is plenty of space in the fridge and a water boiler. Carmen is friendly and super responsive! Bottom line: Great for a couple of nights only.

I stayed with my parents and it was great to have a separated bedroom from them. The apartment was not huge because of HongKong's high population density, but it was simply decorated and comfortable enough!  Some of visitors were too tall for the bed but with my 155cm height, I had no problem sleeping on it.  Hot water from shower was abundant. The view of skyscrapers from windows was good. I could even partly see New Years fireworks from windows. 

Apartment concierges were at a ground floor 24 hours. They open the entrance door when you come home. Some of them can communicate in English. They are all kind and helpful.

Carmen was super kind and communicative host. Her indication was accurate and helpful. She kindly left an octopus card for visitors to charge and use. 

There is a washing machine in a listing but HongKong was too humid to dry laundry fast.  You can use a laundry shop next to the apartment. They wash and clean your laundry in a day.

The location was only a few minutes from a tram station. 
Walkable distance from Central and Causeway Bay. 

There are many towns in HongKong but I am totally satisfied with staying in Wanchai. 
Wanchai has modern skyscrapers, hipster attractions, and daily local markets and small restaurants.  St Francis street looked very sophisticated and I didn’t feel unsafe. In front of the apartment, there are rainbow stairs which looks like an Instagram shooting spot and a lot of foreign people were taking photos. If you are a vegetarian, I strongly recommend a restaurant “天然齋 Green Veggie” 15min from the apartment.

neighborhood_overview: This enigmatic city of skyscrapers, ancient traditions and heavenly food will fascinate, whether it's your first visit or your 50th. Culture Beyond the glass and steel of Hong Kong’s commercial persona, the city also boasts a vibrant cultural scene that features the eclectic influences of its Chinese roots, colonial connections and a wondrous pool of homegrown talent. Here, you’re just as likely to find yourself applauding at Asia’s top film festival as joining in dawn taichi or reading the couplets of a local poet to the drumbeat of a dragon boat. Culture could also mean indie music under the stars, a classy art walk, your first Cantonese opera – not to mention the exhibitions and events staged year-round at the many museums and concert halls. Why I Love Hong Kong I love Hong Kong because it has a complexity that eludes definition, sometimes even by its own people. I'd definitely recommend this apartment as a great place to stay in Hong Kong, especially if you're looking for a less touristy location.

During the typhoon we've had some issues with the toilets not flushing and the AC not working (most likely user error) and Jessa and her team were extremely prompt with responding and sending someone over. Issues were resolved within hours!! Fantastic place to stay
房东肯定是个很懂生活的人,房子装修的风格很美,厨房所需应有尽有,想得很周到,特别是床垫很舒服,非常适合一家人出行,服务很周到,房东也很耐心,很满意

It's a great experience living in Jessa's apartment in Hongkong and our family enjoyed a lot during the trip. The location is very convenient and close to the harbour city. The apartment is very clean and there's no problem in communicating with Jessa and her manager Kris. They are very warmhearted and polite. We had a good time in Jessa's apartment and wanna thank them again!
The owner is friendly and the booking process was so fast. I booked day -1 and yet she is okay with it. The place is clean and definetely will stay there when I get back!

It was really a pleasure having stayed at Jessa's apartment. Me and my family had a comfortable stay. Jesse and Kris have been very responsive to my concerns and made sure things were properly communicated. 

Special thanks to Kris who has been so accommodating and approachable.

Good points:
1) Apartment is conveniently located near MTR exit (less than 5-min walk)
2) A nearby supermarket to get your daily needs like water
3) A LOT of restaurants nearby including local eateries. There's even a Korean resto! (Seng Seng)
4) Strong water supply with instant hot water
5) Comfy beds and pillows
6) Well-equipped kitchen with a complete set of glassware
7) Umbrellas. It was raining on our 2nd day and the umbrellas came in handy.

Room for improvement:
1) Directions on how to get to the meeting place e.g. which exit to take from MTR exit as there were lots of exits
2) Standardised ON/OFF light switches
3) Working clock in at least one of the rooms, if not all

Thanks again Jessa and Kris! We would definitely recommend your apartment/s to our families and friends.

The apt is in the residental area but still near the metro station. There are many places for eating. The decoration and electronic appliance are convenient and comfortable. My cousin played PS3 everyday.  Enjoy the trip in HK very much.
位于庙街附近,出门非常方便,但是由于位于闹市区,周围的环境不是很好,是香港非常传统的住房｡房东布置的很漂亮,很用心,但希望卫生方面能再注意一点细节,例如厕所门口的地垫就不是很干净｡
We booked in at the last minute just before traveling, but Jessa was kind to give us a quick reply, so we were able to book in. The place and location was great! Thank you very much!

这间公寓很棒,无论是从前期沟通以及交通以及公寓环境来说,都比预设好一些｡交通很便利,乘坐机场快线到九龙,打个车就三十来块,所以非常ok｡环境也很好,虽然香港的大楼和电梯看着破旧(香港都这样几乎),但公寓里面很赞哦!!两个卫生间,三个房间,空间非常大!也很干净,厨房也很棒,但我们没机会用到,因为楼下很多很多吃的,点心店很多 哈哈哈!jessa是个非常nice的人,前期沟通回复很快,接待的经理kris也很不错,在指定地点等我们,也把公寓情况介绍很仔细｡总之体验不错哦,下次去人多的话还是会选择这里入住滴~

Jessa is very responsive and easy to work with! Our flight was delayed and we arrived rather late, but the apartment manager, Kris, kindly waited for us at the meeting point, which was quite easy to look up in the uber app. The location is great, very close to MTR. Because it is in a bustling area of the city, guests should have reasonable expectation for noise. We had a situation where our flight was very late in the evening of our checkout & another guest was coming so we couldn't leave our luggage. However, Jessa & Kris gave us a very smart recommendation to drop the luggage at the in city airport check-in, extremely convenient! Thank you Jessa and Kris!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Hong Kong logeant à l'appartement de Jessa dans le quartier de Kowloon. Ce dernier est idéalement placé (proche de 2 stations de métro, restaurants et commerçants à profusion autour de l'immeuble). L'appartement en lui-même est très fonctionnel, la literie en latex très confortable. 
Les points négatifs ont été l'absence de rideaux occultants dans les chambres (il fait jour vers 7h du matin). À cela s'est ajouté la présence d'un chantier au pied de l'immeuble, causant du bruit du lundi au samedi à partir de 8h du matin.
We spent a very nice time in Hong Kong sleeping in Jessa's flat in Kowloon. It is really well situated next to 2 tube stations, and restaurants and shops run all around the building. The flat in itself is really functional, the latex beds are very comfortable.
The only bad points were the lack of thick curtains in the bedrooms (sun rises à 7 o'clock in the morning). There were also a construction site next to the building, making noise starting at 8 o'clock in the morning, from mondays to saturdays.
房间干净整洁,设备齐全,地理位置优越,下楼就能吃到东西,离海港城比较近,步行过去就可以!

Jessa Marie is an amazing host! She was so helpful in so many ways to make our experience in Hong Kong the best it could be. She had someone meet us and run us through the whole apartment which was very helpful. The apartment is amazing and we are a family of five and we have plenty of rooms and bathrooms to accomodate us all. The apartment is very centrally located and there are so many great restaurants and things to do close by. There were lovely little touches in the apartment with snacks and flowers as well, and it was very clean and stylish. We would definitely stay here again and Jessa Marie made our stay fantastic.

Great apartment. It’s really big apartment for Hong Kong. Really good furniture and design. There are heaters in case it gets too cold. Because Hong Kong isn’t nice during winter.Good location. Mtr is near. Fresh market just round the corner.
I recommend the place.

这次是我们第一次到香港,尝试使用airbnb发现是一次很棒的体验｡Jessa的房子相比起中国内地的比较小,但是放在寸金寸土的香港来说就很大了,比一般的香港家庭的房子要大很多｡客厅和房间都很干净,厨房很多用具都很齐全,在厨房自己做饭没有问题｡插头很多,可以尽可能地给用电设备充电｡所在的街区离柯士甸地铁站很近,楼下有糖水铺烧烤铺,7-11和药店也有,早餐和夜宵是可以满足的,出行也十分方便｡房间里提供的Wi-Fi也很快｡美中不足的是浴室的水压不算很大,并且提供的被子便薄,搭配加热器使用在冬天大概需要穿保暖内衣加一两件衣服才能较好入睡｡房东一路上都很热情,guest manager也很热情,很耐心解答了一些问题,希望被子这样的小问题房东可以在之后解决一下,提供更好的体验｡
房間乾淨舒適､附近有非常多美食,房東也非常熱情,非常推薦｡
房间在香港来说已经是很大了,设施设备都很不错,干净整洁｡床睡得很舒服,比迪斯尼乐园酒店的床还舒服一些｡就是这是老房子,坐电梯的时候总是会有点惊吓...地理位置还算是很便利,离地铁站只有几百米｡总之,这是一次愉快的住宿体验｡谢谢Jessa Marie...
非常好的位置,购物和美食近在咫尺

This house is very good! quiet in the night,There are 5 minutes walk for The (Website hidden by Airbnb) very near.

house manager kris is so kindly.many restaurants on the 1floor

房子很好,走路去地铁站只要5分钟,很近,管家Kris人非常好｡房子1楼有很多饭店,晚上很安静｡
여럿이 가서 편하게 머물기 좋아요

I would say thank you to Jessa and Kris. Jessa is always give promote reply before our trip and give us corresponding info. And Kris is our guest manager, he is nice man and with patient~he bring us to the apartment and details introduce everything we need.
The Apartment is really great and convenient. There’s many restaurants downstairs and open till midnight. The location is nearly Austin station(walking 5 min.) Highly recommend
The house is very beautiful and quiet. The location is near metro station and easy to find. It is really worth to reside.
非常干净整洁,下次来还订这个!
一家人带孩子和两个老人出行,有3个卧室,完全够住｡再加上2个人也gou够了｡房间装修不错,干净,地理位置很好｡地铁站很近,转线方便,去哪里都方便｡楼下有很多吃的,美食一条街｡打车到维多利亚港30-40块｡非常建议人多去住｡
需要用英文沟通
Good location, friendly host and very quick respond time. Will rent from again.
公寓位置非常好,离九龙､佐敦站都很近,楼下小吃很多,煲仔饭和点点心很好吃,隆重推荐!管家Kris非常不错,安排的很好,设施交代的很清楚,最后离开的时候行李忘在公寓了,Kris马上安排司机送来,让我能及时赶上飞机,真的太贴心了!特别推荐这个公寓!
The house is very clean and beautiful.

The toilets were not working for a period of time, Jessa told me the building was doing the maintenance, both showers are  small I can understand, that’s Hong Kong, the 2nd shower the curtain keep getting on me when I was taking the shower, and when I turned I burned my back, my daughter was taking shower one time a lizard fell on her head she was screaming
This morning the shower was not working, I called the manager and followed the instructions the water was hot for a little while and turned to cold again, basically we had the cold shower this morning 
Besides that, the location is good, very convenient, lots of restaurants and shops around, Jessa was very good at replying emails, but I don’t think I’ll come back next time

My summary is this:
A very nice and well located Kowloon apartment, close to Austin Station,  clean, nice and well equipped. With the three bedrooms with double beds, two bathrooms (shower), a smart kitchen and a living-room with a sofa bed for two,  it was perfect for our family of six grown-ups. And we experienced a very nice and efficient conversation and fine service from Jessa Marie, Anwar (driver) and Kris (guest manager). 
It is near to subway, bus and railway, (and taxi) so public transport is easy and efficient. We bought Octopus cards for the public transport.
We found shops and restaurants around the corner and for products we looked for Tsim Sha Tsui nearby and a few subway stations away Mongkok with its open markets 
and focused shops. Like running shoes, clothes, photo equipments - whatever we looked for we found it. Then there is the Star Ferry or subway to Hongkong island, with shops, ware houses, Victoria Peak,  and a lot more to experience.
There are also a number of fine trekking paths on Hongkong island for example. We tried out the Dragon Back which is beautiful and somewhat demanding (if you are 80 like me).
In all, I can just highly recommend Jessa Marie's apartment! (And airbnb!)
And get some good walking shoes! Hongkong is worth it. I'd like to come back.
/Christer Ekman, Sweden

Great place! Lovely homey vibe, clean and easily accessible. Nearby has many great restaurants. If you are looking for “at home” feel in Hong Kong I think this is a great place to go for. Beds are comfortable enough and the water is HOT, which is good! Jessa, the owner, is very quick with replies and helpful informations.

처음이용해보는 에어비엔비라 걱정했지만 궁금한사항에 대해 호스트가 빠르게 답변해주었고 그에 신뢰감을 느꼈다.   숙소는 생각했던것보다 훨씬 깨끗했고 인테리어도 좋았다.  베개나 침구류도 마음에 들었고 주방엔 커피와  차 간단한 쿠키도 준비되어있어 마음껏 먹을수 있었다.  식기류도 분위기있고 준비해간 와인을 먹을때도 좋았다.
위치는 엘리먼츠몰과 연계된 구룡역에서 도보 15분정도 걸렸던 것 같고 마카오로 가는 페리터미널도 걸어서 15~20분 정도 걸렸던 같다.. 구룡역은 고속전철과도 연계되어  공항갈때도 편리하게 이용할수 있다.
홍콩이란 특성때문에 9명 전원이 사용하긴 다소 좁을수 있지만 그 인원에 대한 준비는 잘 되어있다.  우린 아주 만족스럽게 이용했고 누구에게라도 권하고 싶은 장소이다
참, 가능하면 체크인시간은 맞춰가면 좋을듯 하다...우리는 버스를 이용했는데 숙소를 못찾아  체크인시간 거의 2시간이 지나서  도착하는바람에  관리인(?)이 바깥에서 우릴 기다려주느라 넘 고생했다. 오랜시간 기다리면서 힘들었을텐데 짜증없이 친절히 대해줘서 구세주를 만난듯이 넘 고맙고 감사했다

Excellent and stylish interior design. Lots of eateries available throughout the day and night. The friendly security guard makes our day and provides good direction. Some nice parks around for morning walk and playground for kids to play

Great location if you want to stay in Kowloon, very close to Temple night market, MTR, and Kowloon CBD. Jessa & Kris are very quick in responding to your questions. The apartment is in good size, especially in Hong Kong. Rooms are clean and have most of everything.
Cool place! Nice and Modern internally. Good Location about 8 minutes walk from Elements and Kowloon station!

The location of the apartment is very good for shopping. The apartment is well equipped. The decoration is very new. Jessa was keep in touch with me around the vacation. Her manager- Kris was a professional resident manager. As the apartment near the road , and it was a little bit noisy at night, closing the window will be much quieter.

Beautiful home away from home with super soft bed and silky bed sheets, fully functional kitchen, ample entertainment (with PS and Apple TV). Kris was kind enough to introduce to us the gorgeous apartment thoroughly during our check in!

Great location with a few MTR within 10-15 mins walking distance. Although would recommend group with elderly to take 2 bus stops to Jorden station while  Kowloon station (with town check in) is accessible over the sky garden. Tons of awesome local food option just a few steps away from apartment (点点心!) 7 eleven and supermarket are also at the adjacent buildings

house_rules: No smoking inside, but in the balcony. Not available for a party or event. Guests wash dishes used by themselves. Bathroom towels belong to flat. No shoes in the apartment. Please make sure closing the main door while coming and going. I try to respect others and the environment Please try not to leave lights, electric appliances or water running unnecessarily. Thank you! Just keep in your mind it's a house not a hostel ;) If you have a question, a problem or an emergency, just contact me on the phone or email. I will respond as soon as possible. Welcome to İstanbul.

host.host_about:
I'm a designer. I'm living in 4.Levent which is known "business center" of Istanbul. I have a little penthouse where it's located in the middle of the tower blocks, the malls, subways and bus stops are within walking distance of my house. You can take a bus or subway easily where ever and when ever you want to go.
I try to make my life easier since the traffic is the biggest problem of Istanbul... I don't like the crowd and choas but I'm lucky to have the tiny lovely peaceful penthouse which has two rooms. I stay at the one of room. I sometimes spend time at outside because of working and hanging out. My guests can book up my room aswell if I don't sleep there.
I travel as much as possible. I really enjoy travelling and meeting new people&cultures. I love reading books, watching movies, learning and teaching, cooking and sharing, exploring, painting, walking and dancing like a crazy...
Something like that about me...
Hope to meet and host you with pleasure.

Nos dias mais frios tem sempre ao seu dispor aquecimento central, para que torne a sua estadia acolhedora. A sua chegada e durante a sua estadia estarei sempre disponível para o receber e dar-lhe algumas dicas
neighborhood_overview: A cidade do Porto está cheia de atrações turísticas. Mesmo pertinho temos a Estação de São Bento, a Igreja da Sé, a Praça da Liberdade, a Torre dos Clérigos, a Livraria Lello, o Museu da Fotografia, o Palácio da Bolsa, o Mercado do Bolhão, Rua Santa Catarina e sem esquecer a zona da Ribeira e muito mais… Do outro lado do rio, mas perto também, encontra o Cais de Gaia onde pode disfrutar de uma visita as caves do Vinho do Porto como também uma viagem de teleférico onde pode apreciar uma belíssima vista sobre a cidade do Porto. A 1 minuto do apartamento encontra agências de turismo, estação de metro, estação de comboio, praça de táxi, autocarros turísticos e tradicionais e parque de estacionamento. Se for apreciador de praia, a nossa cidade tem ótimos acessos às praias e á costa. Para uma saída noturna e sem complicações encontra a 5 minutos uma zona de bares e discotecas. E sem esquecer, esta zona esta privilegiada com variadíssimos restaurantes para que possa apreciar a fantástica comi
transit: Caso venha de avião tem sempre o metro ou táxi.  Se usar o metro , segue ate a  Estação da Trindade e ai tem de mudar de linha. Muda para a linha amarela sentido Santo Ovidio e sai em São Bento
interaction: A sua chegada e durante a sua estadia estarei sempre disponível para o receber e dar-lhe algumas dicas sobre a vida da cidade.
house_rules: Regras não há muitas, faça apenas como se fosse o seu lar.  Pedimos para que não fume dentro da casa.
