neighborhood_overview: The neighborhood is lively and is a cultural mixing pot. local market on the weekends. children playing in the streets. local fruit and markets open all hours.
notes: We have 6 apartments, all similarly decorated. All apartments have a lounge with settee, bedroom with double bed, kitchen and shower room/toilet. Apartments 1 and 5 do not have a balcony or terrace. Apartment 2 has a large terrace. Apartment 3 and 4 have balconies. Our pictures are annotated with details of which apartment they show.
transit: Greystone is 5 min walk from 2 metro stops. 15 min walk from the ferry service and 2 min walk from bus stops. We can organize a travel card before your arrival, upon request,
access: Various restaurants, cafés and bars, are just a few steps from Greystone Apartments. Taksim Metro Station is within 5 minutes walking distance allowing easy access to other sites of the city such as the historic Sultanahmet. The iconic Galata Tower is a 20-minute walk away. Private car hire services to Ataturk Airport, 25 km away, can be organized upon request. Feel at home in one of our beautifully renovated apartments set amidst the hustle and bustle of Bohemian Beyoglu. Explore the historical quarters of Old Pera and Galata just minutes walk away. And visit the many restaurant, boutiques, museums and galleries.
interaction: We personally greet our guests to hand over the keys. We spend quality time with every customer explaining where you are and what is local. we have specially made a brochure of things to see and do seen through the locals eyes. We can offer our guests the choice of an organized private taxi and local travel cards are also available.
house_rules: Our apartments have been designed for couples who want to relax in our quiet apartments. Children under the age of 13 are not usually accepted. ıf you contact us with personal requests we can discuss this. One older child or adult is charged EUR 30 per person per night in an additional bed. We provide a futon with all bed linen. cash /Visa ,  The hotel reserves the right to pre-authorise credit cards prior to arrival.

host.host_about:
We are an Anglo Turkish family run business, renting out refurbished apartments tastefully decorated to a high standard. 

Our 19th century apartments are situated among 18th century Armenian architecture, where churches and mosques mingle. You can feel the energy and pulse of this unique area. As a person who enjoys photography this is the area for you to explore and wander. Staying at our apartments you have a range of amenities right on your doorstep. Taksim underground metro station is within easy walking distance, putting the whole of Istanbul at your disposal.

We would like to offer our guests a comfortable and cultural stay with either long or short term agreements in the historical Tarlabashi district in the heart of Istanbul.

reviews.comments: Great flat, Nice host, good location!

The flat is finished to a good standard and is the perfect size for a couple having a long weekend. The location is excellent where you can walk to bars, restaurants, and all the main tourist sites. You can also easily get taxis from the main road.

Julie was a wonderful host, giving us local advice about Istanbul and what to do to get around. When I fell ill and had to go to hospital she went above and beyond, accompanying me to hospital so she could speak to the Turkish doctors. We want to come back to Istanbul soon so that we can stay with Julie again!
l'ost e' stato molto gentile e (Website hidden by Airbnb) ha fornito molte indicazioni su tutto, il posto corrispondeva esattamente alle nostre aspettative

L appartement est confortable,joli et tout équipé et comme sur les photos et très proche de la rue piétonne principale et à 10min à pied de taskim! Il se trouve cependant en limite d un quartier assez délabré mais qui est en pleine transformation. Pas de problème de securité et ce n est pas gênant car l'immeuble est en tres bon état et dedié à la location!Julie et son employé sont sympas disponibles et serviables! Tres content de mon sejour! Merci

Julie personally welcomed us at the apartment and informed us about all the important things including places to visit and all the necessary stores around the apartment. She was very friendly and always available for help during our stay.The apartment is located in the middle of Beyoglu (10 Minutes away from Taksim Square), a district where you can hardly find any tourists. (which is great if you want to feel like a real person from Istanbul). The apartment is exactly like shown in the pictures. It is very clean and you have everything you need. All together it was a very nice stay and i can just highly recommend this apartment ! We will definitly book this apartment again if we come back to Istanbul!

Our trip to Istanbul was brilliant, made even better by the beautiful and well-maintained apartment as our base. It is perfectly situated to the bustling nightlife and great places to eat, and to get the team over to the historic district. Julie had left lots of useful information in a pack, which we used - including booking a great local luxury Hamam - and she also arranged taxis for us to and from the airport, which really helped. Great service, lovely apartment. Perfect :)

Die Fotos des Apartments entsprechen der Realität, gut eingerichtete Stadtwohnung, Balkon mit Abendsonne mit Blick auf das Strassenleben der Nachbarschaft. ( Apt 4 ) Das Haus liegt knapp ausserhalb der Ausgangsszene von Beyoglu in einem lebendigen Wohnquartier im Umbruch. Für uns war es ideal, wir würden die Wohnung wieder buchen.

It was a wonderful time we had at Greystone! Great place! The interior is amazing and we enjoyed the nice terrace...
The recommendations of Faruk were great and we enjoyed the best turkish food we ever had with a Raki ;-)

Unfortunatelly we haven't had the chance to meet Julie. But she always helped out if we had any questions!

The only think was that we didn't expect to pay extra for a third person when we arrived... But we managed in the end.

I would definately recommend that place!

Julie's apartments are a great place to stay in Istanbul. We loved the comfortable rooms and especially the big balcony (Apartment 2)...although we didn't really use it as the weither was a bit rainy. Julie was a great help explaining our confused taxi driver where the Greystones Apartments are located and arranging a ride back to the airport on very short notice. I can highly recommend this lovely place in the heart of Istanbul!

The neighborhood was very authentic, felt like we lived there. Great proximity to main artery of the city, shopping street. Apt was clean, modern, beautiful, spacious, shining, awesome shower. Beautiful little touches. Julie was welcoming, kind, gave us a homemade guidebook. I would recommend! :)
We loved the apartment and Julie was incredibly helpful!

What a wonderful place in Istanbul. We spent many an evening on the expansive terrace off our bedroom, enjoyed coming home to fresh towels and a made bed, were pleased to find everything we needed was already available, and loved how easy it was to walk to many of Istanbul's highlights from our front door. The Greystone team was a sheer delight - helpful, friendly, generous, and fun. I highly recommend staying with them and I personally can't wait to return. Thank you, Miss Julie and Faruk!

I really could not fault the Greystone apartment. I stayed in apartment 2 which was on the first floor. You get a lot for you money, big apartment with tall ceilings, very tastefully (and newly) decorated and with a huge terrace which was nice but I hardly used it as I was out so much. 

The host was very friendly and communicative. In terms of location it's within a stone's throw from the main shopping and nightlife of Taksim but enough out the way that it won't disturb your sleep. Restaurants, cash machines etc are all less than a five minute walk. It's barely a minute from the main road so you're not walking deep into a potentially dodgy neighbourhood. Do your (Hidden by Airbnb) maps homework before you get there and it's easy enough to find. 

I took the Havatas bus from Attaturk Airport which took around 50 mins and dropped me off in Taksim (Point hotel). From there it was about a 15/20 minute walk. If you come with suitcases however you'll want to get a cab as the pavements in Istanbul are not build for cases! Next time I'm in Istanbul I'll definitely be coming back here.
This is a very quiet great place, in a great location. We had a wonderful time. Julie was a great host.

My boyfriend and I spent 4 nights here for over New Years. We really loved the apartment. It was very spacious and nicely decorated. The heating worked really well (which was useful as it was freezing with 2 foot of snow!) and the kitchen was well equipped. The area is great. Close to all the bars and restaurants. Really responsive communication  from Julie. The only minus was the water temperature in the shower was slightly temperamental.

Julie was an incredible host!!! nothing was too much trouble and she went over and above with enquiries and her response times were excellent!
The apartment is exactly as you see on the photos. Homely, spotlessly clean and just a breath of fresh air! The apartments are maintained daily. 
Wifi is excellent. Just about everything is within walking distance and there are loads of fantastic restaurants and bars close by. If you feel the desire to self-Cater there are two brilliant fruit & veg stalls a couple of doors down and a good little supermarket. I always felt safe in the street, even at night and staying at Greystone offered a brilliant insight into local life whilst being so close to all of the attractions! And I was an Airbnb virgin too!
I seriously could not have had a better choice of accomodation for this trip!! Thanks so much for an incredible stay Julie!!!!

Thank you so much Julie and Faruk for making our stay wonderful. The apartment was just perfect specially the decor. It had everything we needed and so convenient location. We didn't want to be right in the middle of Taksim square's hussle bussle and noise but not too far either, we could walk to Istaklal street. Julie advised us very clearly about the traffic to the airport which we didn't know and would have missed our flight otherwise.
Hope we can comae back again :)

We, My wife and I, had a wonderful expérience, location is great (not in a touristic area) close to supermarket and Sightseen. 
We felt very welcome and the apartment was cosy and clean.. 
i Highly recommend it..

Julie and her apartments are amazing! She was there to welcome us when we arrived and provided us with a map and a booklet of places to go. The apartment is exactly what you see in the photos. The location was perfect, only a few blocks away from Istiklal and the Beyoglu district but far enough to where its not too loud. Theres alot of great food nearby and markets if you want to cook. We wanted to really feel like we were living in Istanbul for the few days we were there and Julie helped us achieve that, thanks Julie!

Faruk and Julie were absolutely incredible people, very helpful and kind. Anything that we ever needed was handled immediately and with care. The place itself was PERFECT for my fiance and I, the view from the balconies were stunning and exactly what we were looking for in a home in the city for a month. The place was cleaned 3 days out of the week by the live in house keeper, Hatije, who was an unexpected but very welcomed surprise. 10 min walk to Taksim square with plenty of great places to eat every day, or fresh vegetables from the markets right outside the front door!  If you stay here, you must go have a bite to eat at Merhi, it's great place to have some traditional Turkish home-cooked foods. The Turkish rice pilaf is an instant favorite of ours now. We heard some news of some areas being dangerous, but never felt a bit in danger ourselves and we traveled all throughout the city. We will stay here again and again every chance we get to return! Thank you so much Julie and Faruk, you are amazing!

Julie as a host was fantastic and communicative. The apartment was beautifully decorated and clean. My friend and I really enjoyed using the terrace. Location near the busy Karakoy area was perfect. Loved everything about the stay. The apartment manager was also extremely hospitable and helpful. Would def stay here again!

Julie was a great host, readily available anytime I needed.  The apartment is central to Taksim Square, and is located in a safe & secure building.  There were lots of restaurants & bars nearby that were a short walk away.  
The unit itself comes with all the luxuries of home and is well equipped for visitors.  It was even stocked with toiletries, a hair dryer, fresh towels, and I was greeted with fresh fruit, and teas/coffees on arrival.
I highly recommend Greystones for a visit in Istanbul!!

Julie is a great host! We stayed in the Greystone for a month and she was always there for us. The apartment is very clean and well decorated, it feels like home. The kitchen is fully equipped so I prepared our meals easily. Would definitely recommend Julie's apartments!
Julie she is very nice, her apartment is very clean, easy to buy some foods for cooking. And there r many restaurants.I should be stay there again if I come to Istanbul.

Logement bien situé, un peu de marche pour accéder aux transports en commun et à l animation. Bon rapport qualité prix.  Séjour agréable.  Aurions aimé deux chaises longues ou fauteuils pour se relaxer sur la terrasse

We want to live in Julie's apartment. The furnishings and decor are beautiful. The terrace is lovely. Its not right next to the Metro, but it's close enough, maybe a brisk 10-minute walk. And there are loads of taxis at all hours. It's also walking distance to a few nice bars and restaurants.

Квартира находится в очень колоритном районе Тарлабаши. Это особенно оценят любители творчества Орхана Памука. Светлая и уютная, продуманная до мелочей обстановка и отзывчивые, приятные хозяева, которые относятся с любовью к своему делу. Очень понравилось!

Я жила в комнате №2. Комната как на фото, очень уютно, чисто и красиво. В квартире есть все, что нужно. По приезду нас встретил менеджер, напоил чаем с печеньем, пока ждали вселения. Квартира находится недалеко от крупной магистрали с автобусными остановками, в 5 минутах ходьбы от İstiklal Cd. - пешеходной торговой улицы, 5 минут езды до центра. Внизу расположены лавки со свежими фруктами и овощами, супермаркеты.

Fantastic communiction for this well situated, clean, comfortable flat. We enjoyed our stay a lot and would recommend this spot to a friend. Thanks for helping us so quickly when we locked ourselves out!
A clean and stylish apartment right in the heart of Taksim. It has all the amenities one would need. Thank you for making our stay so memorable and for organising everything that we needed.

Fantastic apartment and very central to everything. We walked to Galata bridge and Sultanhamet which was around 3.5kms. And we walked to Sisli and Basiktas easily. Julie was a great host, told us about an awesome Flea market in Faraköy with antiques that were out of this world. The apartment had everything we needed for our 1 month long stay; the wifi was great, the central heating throughout the apartment made us feel cosy, right at home. The street is a residential neighbourhood, it took a bit to get used to as it’s not a very touristy area; however Taksim and everything else was only a 5min walk. The local grocer next door was really friendly, he works night and day and always has a smile. We will definitely be back here again.

Julie’s apartment was a great size with nice light and a good patio off the bedroom. We were supplied with everything we needed for a comfortable stay (we really appreciated the bottle of water in the fridge as we settled in). The location was very convenient for exploring the city on foot, and there was a nice produce store downstairs. The wifi signal wasn’t the strongest in Apartment 2, and we could not get a signal for the international satellite channels. The bedroom was nicely decorated, but the bed frame was extremely creaky with every small movement when sleeping. The maps on the coffee table with little notes from previous visitors was a very nice touch.

Very Nice apartment,perfectly located in Beyoglu district.Tramways,shops and pedestrian avenue at 5'. The perfect place to discover Istanbul : spécial thanks to our hosts for their disponibility and advices.

Loved this apartment (stayed for a month)! 

WiFi was a little slow but I think that goes for most of Istanbul (especially in the historic areas).

Tip! Top!
Super Lage!
Genossen den Aufenthalt im Haus und in der Stadt
Well attended, well taken care of, great location, clean. So many pluses not a single negative. I'll definitely stay here again if I go back to Istanbul.

Julie’s apartament is confortable and really well sited, just next to a restaurants / bars area and 10’ walking from Taxim square. 
Good comunication and julie was always ready to help. 
If visit Istambul again, we’ll go to julie’s apoartment for sure!

Die Unterkunft von Julie ist super schön. Wir waren begeistert von der Lage und der Größe der Wohnung. Man kommt fußläufig zur großen Einkaufsstraße in Taksim und hat direkt Supermärkte ums Eck. Die Wohnung ist stylisch eingerichtet und mit der Klimaanlage ist man vor der Wärme von Außen super schützt. Die Terasse ist toll, um Abends ein Glas Wein zu trinken und die Istanbuler Nachbarschaft zu beobachten. Es kann abends schon etwas lauter werden durch die spielenden Kinder. Aber wer Istanbul wirkich authentisch erleben will, der sollte diese Wohnung buchen.
Very stylish apartment and Julie was an excellent host

It was really nice hosting warm and comfy housing.
Well facilitated, super market on down side a hell of restaurants and coffee shops close to home.

neighborhood_overview: Greenpoint is the quieter and chiller area immediately next to Williamsburg, although the two neighborhoods are basically continuous. Together they make one of the coolest places in Brooklyn. That said, we love living in the quieter Greenpoint area but having instant access to amazing restaurants, super cool bars, incredible nightlife, live music, art galleries, fashionable boutiques, record stores, etc… It’s the best of both worlds and we think you’ll love it too! Greenpoint has a vibrant mixture of older Polish residents, young families, and trendy hipsters. You’ll enjoy walking tree-lined streets, passing 100+ year old 3 story buildings and brand new high rises. Old polish bakeries sit next to a diverse mix of ethnic restaurants. There is a Farmers Market on Saturdays in McCarren park and also on Sundays in McGolrick park.
notes: Check in is at 3pm, check out by 11am. Requests for early check in or late check out must be made at least 1 week in advance.

Well where to start? There are two types of guest, the tourist and the traveller.  I prefer to think of myself as the latter, which is why staying at Charles apt was ideal for me.  It was an amazing and memorable stay.  Charles is a Gentleman and went out of his way to accommodate both myself and my daughter.  The local people we encountered were awesome, anytime I went to the corner store the locals would assist me, and one man even tried to pay for my lotto ticket when I fudged around in my wallet to find change, he put his money on the counter for me "here you go Mami' he said , and I will never forget that. I strongly recommend staying with Charles if you are a "traveller" and want to experience the "real" NYC, cuz nowhere better to find it than in the Bronx.  We made memories there, and for that I am forever grateful.  Thank you Charles for the comfortable bed, the laughs and above all your kindness and generosity
Liz n Lily xx

Charles is really taking care of his guests. He is a very responsible and easy-going person. I have never seen such great bedclothes in the Airbnb place! The room and especially the bed is absolutely perfect.
Excellent hospitality!

~10min walk to the subway, which has several places to eat (Subway, Dunkin, McDonald's, etc.) Yankee stadium subway, btw! Straight 30min shot on the subway to all the main attractions. Totally clean and quiet and comfortable (and affordable)! And Charles is nice too, so... We loved it!
Small room and far from the center but 5 min walking from subway station. Charles was a nice host.
Charles's hospitality cannot be matched. He truly made our visit to NY unforgettable. You will definitely get more than you paid for if you book with him.
All was good. Next time we will come only here. There was not always hot water. Host Charles was watching TV quietly until 1 a.m.

Perfect and thoughtful host. He made us warm breakfast and checked in when we're out at midnight.:) The bed is very cozy and floor is shiny and clean. Hope the carpet and tub can be cleaned too. Definitely recommended!
Très bon séjour pour ce prix. Par contre, le quartier n’est pas super surtout pour deux jeune femmes.
Nice place, Charles was very welcoming and friendly. There is some noise from the street but the neighbourhood is nice and the house close to public transport, restaurants and shops.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was perfect for our touristing needs - comfy, clean, and warm room; short walk to subway with easy access to Manhattan; and great hospitality. Charles was very kind and accomodating - he let us check in late at night, offered us wine upon arrival, gave us towels and warm blanket, and even offered to make coffee and eggs. Would highly recommend this place :)

~25min by subway to the main attractions in the City.
5 min walk to the Yankee Stadium
There are two subway stations near this place and for me, that was a big advantage. 
Nice room and bathroom, overall good quality.
Mr.Charles place is very clean,and he also a very nice man
Charles is so nice, and the house is clean. The location is close to subway.
It’s a really nice place, very clean. Close to the metro and 15 Mins to Manhattan. Charles is very nice! Go for it
Great area to stay, host was extremely nice, close to trains and restaurants great place to stay if u ever visit NYC highly recommended
Room was clean and had everything we needed. Just had a great time staying with Charles, he’s a sweetheart!

Charles is an excellent host, knowledgeable and friendly. His apartment was very clean and comfortable.  4 blocks to Yankee stadium, great for seeing a game.  He is my favorite airbnb host ever! I would go back in a heartbeat!
Feel like family . One of the great things about The Bronx New York City.
good location, charles is a great host

Charles war sehr nett und wir konnten uns frei in der Wohnung bewegen. Das Haus ist sehr schlicht. Bis zur Metro sind es ca 5 min Fußweg. In allem war das preislich ok. Nachts war es immer wieder mal Laut.Wer Luxus möchte muss weiter zur Nächsten Anzeige.
Bronx is half an hour train ride to Manhattan, so plan accordingly
L'appart est proche des transports en commun. Charles est sympathique et arrangeant (Nous sommes arrivés vers 2h du matin)

Charles is a great host his hopitality is awesome and he is so generous he offered us cold water when we checked in as were so tired and is wa hot. As well night he offered us wine. The location is super great it is walking distance of subway 2, 4, 5 and D so whenever you want to leave Manhattan w
you will find plenty of options to go back home.
Awesome place to stay at, host is amazing
Charles is an excellent hosts. He made everything possible for our comfortable staying. Location is rather great, 15 minuets to the Central Park by subway

Charles is a great host! He is really friendly, thoughtful, easy going and a lot of fun. He stayed up in the middle of the night when we arrived even though we arrived much later then predicted. When we arrived he was so kind. He showed us around the apartment and guided us on his huge map in the living room how we could get to Manhattan and other main sites in the city. One day he even drove us to Central park and showed us a parade in Harlem. We also got us a really nice breakfast one of the days. We totally stayed for 10 days and couldn't have asked for a better host. It was a pleasure!
Ideal für kurzen und günstigen Aufenthalt in NY. Sehr gute Lage, sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung und Charles ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit.
At all times he was attentive with us and helped us at all times, nice apartment and clean, close to subway station and the Yankees stadium

Charles was great he offered us a cold bottle of water when we got there and some wine. He told us the best trains to catch and he even checked in on us when we were out late to make sure we were okay in the city

El lugar está muy cerca del metro, donde puedes llegar a todas partes en NY, Charles es muy atento y esta siempre al pendiente, el lugar está siempre limpio y charles fue muy respetuoso con nuestra habitación, nunca invadió privacidad
Charles was very welcoming and helpful. Great host! Walking distance from the stadium. Restaurants and bars are walking distance from the apartment.

Sehr offenherziger Gastgeber. U-Bahn ist sehr nah, alles ist schnell von dort zu erreichen. Das Bad musste mit insgesamt 6 Personen geteilt werden, es hätte sauberer sein können. Der Gastgeber hat scheinbar jederzeit Zugriff auf das Zimmer, den er auch nutzt um an eigene Gegenstände im Zimmer zu kommen, was wir aber nur durch Zufall festgestellt haben.
Charles war sehr nett. Er hat uns mehrmals Trinken und Essen angeboten! Die Unterkunft ist 5 Minuten von der U-Bahn und dem Yankee-Stadium entfernt.

The room is a lot smaller than it seems in the photos but that is the only place you can really be in, in the apartment as the living room is always in use by Charles. The bathroom was clean and we had towels provided. Also the apartment is only about a 6 minute walk to the subway station and about a 4 minute walk to target. Charles started off very kind and helpful, offering to give suggestions or tell us things to do and was kind enough to let an extra (unexpected) guest stay with us(she slept on the floor with some blankets). We had discussed paying him some extra money for this extra guest which was fine and we definitely didn’t mind doing that as it was only fair enough, however on the last morning Charles turned nasty and demanded that we pay him the money right that minute, even though I had just explained we were just getting our cases packed etc. It was extremely rude and unnecessary and was very off-putting. Also he accused us of staying after the checkout time which he said was 11am however there was a sign in our room that said checkout was 12pm so we were hardly to blame for that mistake. If you’re wanting somewhere to just sleep that’s only about a 30 minute subway ride to the main attractions in NYC, then this place will be perfect.

Charles was nice and quick to respond to our messages. The room was clean and small (which was fine for our needs) and right outside the living room where Charles slept. The location is a bit dicey, but Charles told us a safer route to go to get to the subway.
This was our second time staying at the place and as always Charles made sure it was relaxing. Its almost like visiting your family

Wir waren zu zweit 14 Tage Gäste bei Charles. Er hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen und uns sogar schöne Plätze gezeigt. Es gab zwischendurch frische Bettwäsche und Handtücher. Wir duften Küche benutzen und haben sogar Platz im Kühlschrank erhalten. Wir haben in Charles einen neuen  Freund gefunden. Jederzeit gerne wieder bei Charles zu Besuch
Super host, helpful and funny
Great location and Charles was kind!
Ett enkelt men ändå rätt prisvärt boende om man är beredd på att det är en bit att åka till Manhattann.

Charles is a great host! His apartment is well located, very close to the Yankee Stadium, quick walk to the metro station with multiple lines, some even run express so you get to Manhattan quick with one train ride. He has a very well equipped kitchen, it was really helpful to refrigerate our leftovers and heat them up for breakfast. Clean towels were provided. Even though his place is located in the Bronx, you can actually see the Empire State Building from the bedroom window! Charles is very welcoming, and chill. We enjoyed our evening chat, too bad our trip wasn't longer. Thanks a bunch, Charles :)
Charles est très sympa et accueillant ! L'appartement est propre et proche de l'arrêt de metro. En 25/30min nous étions à Central Park

Charles is awesome!! the subway is just 3 min ago walking and takes you anywhere in NY,  (a bit scary late at night, if you go on your own, but nothing really happens,) I would definitely recommend this place! :)
Staying at Charles place was great! Our room was clean and comfortable, we weren’t too far away from the Yankee stadium and the trains! Would recommend to anyone I know who plans to visit NY!

host.host_about:
Nice to meet you!

We are a group of three friends who share a passion for architecture, interior design, the outdoors, local hot spots and more. Matt & Aaron are currently on a road trip across North America. Follow them on insta! @therollingvan. Currently, Kaileigh holds down the fort in Montreal! 

We have traveled extensively for business and pleasure. We know the formula for a successful and pleasurable travel experience. Reliability, comfort, convenience, and exceeding expectations is how it's done! 

Anything worth doing, is worth doing right. As your hosts, we'll make sure we understand what is important to you during your visit. We'll provide the perfect recipe of local tips and recommendations to make your trip a success.

reviews.comments: Let me start by saying the pictures do not do this loft justice!! The loft is huge and was so comfortable for my family and I. The hosts provided my family with THE BEST recommendations, which gave us a local perspective that my family really enjoyed!! The apartment is stunning and was extremely clean. The beds were super comfy and had enough privacy for all of us. The location was simply out of this world - you are legitimately in the heart of Old Montreal and yet the metro stop was steps away which made it super easy to get to the BELL Center for a hockey game! Everything was perfect from start to finish. It has been the best Airbnb experience I've ever had! My family and I thank you Explore MTL!
Séjour très agréable, à refaire très vite

The location is perfect. Walking distance to many things especially Old Montreal, and the train is just around the corner if you want to go further. The hosts were also very helpful and responded quickly to any messages. The apartment itself looked just like the images and was perfect to relax in and play some pool before going out. The one flaw for us however was finding parking. There are multiple lots close by, but the attendants were never there so you can only pay for so long in the machine, which required us to wake up at 5am more than once to refill the meter.

We really loved the character of this beautiful big loft, somewhat of a hidden treasure considering the unassuming exterior. Perfect location close to everything, plenty of parking and a metro stop 5 min away! Pros: It has everything needed to cook yourself dinner, awesome pool table, wifi was fast and reliable, bedding and towels were clean, there was coffee and a blowdryer. Cons: no chalk for said awesome pool table, can't control the heat ( it was really hot!) , some utensils/dishes were dirty in drawers when we arrived, hanging your coat requires going to the bathroom, and I swear the upstairs neighbour operates a bowling alley!

Visited for one night with two older teens. We loved our hip digs!

The place was spacious and clean. The kids enjoyed shooting some pool during our down time and making coffee with the Bialetti!

Beds and bedding were comfy and cozy. Great water pressure in the shower. We had everything we needed.

Our hosts were very responsive to our feedback and questions and accommodating to our requests.

I would recommend!
Place is bigger than in pictures, communication was great and host was very willing to help in any way. Location is great and close to everything.

Great experience !!! I totally recommand this place. This big loft has a perfect location in Old port. Very clean, very stylish and makes you feel like you are part of the jetset of montreal. EXPLORE MTL gives an excellent service : clear instructions and very fast answers. You will find anything you need inside this loft !! 
Fares
Very clean, very spacious, good communication, and overall excellent stay!
Great place! Stayed with 4 and it was comfortable. Very large space and comfortable beds :) close walking to anywhere in old montreal
Great location, great (huge) space and easy in & out.
Great place and super spacious!
The place looks great literally identical to the pictures ! kitchen is fully equipped and the location is extremely convenient.
Amazing place! Very clean and exactly how it is on pics. We enjoyed the location and how it's close to everything. Being able to play pool as much as we wanted was definitely a huge bonus:)
Excellent spot for exploring old port on foot. Beautiful loft with bright and big windows, Netflix if you want to stay in a relax, and a very cool space! Really enjoyed it for our business trip!
Fantastic space, quiet neighbourhood close to many good Montreal spots!
J'ai adoré cette appartement. Excellent rapport qualité/prix. C'est grand, bien décoré, confortable et propre. Je recommande fortement ce logement.
The place was gorgeous with all the amenities you need to feel comfortable. The host was easy to reach and very quick to our messages. Perfect trendy and affordable loft for a Montreal getaway!

The apartment was great for a guys' trip to Montreal. It is close to everything. Particularly, the Bell Centre is an easy 15-minute walk one way, the old town is an easy 10-minute walk the other way. Very close to metro and large streets for transit to Rue St Catherine and other areas of the city. Note, however, that it is essentially a 2-bed apartment. The couches are not the best for sleeping. The nice modern shapes don't lend themselves to a comfortable sleeping position.

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour dans ce loft incroyable pour une parisienne habituée aux petits espaces. Très confortable, bien équipé, nous n'avons manqué de rien ! La communication avec Matt a été facile que ce soit à notre arrivée ou pour notre départ. Un grand merci. Recommandé sans hésitation !
This place is as good as the pictures. All the important places in walkable distance. Great find.
Very responsive and helpful hosts. Location is central to many destinations in Montreal. Many great restaurants, cafes, and other amenities all within walking distance.
Great location, great apartment and great organization on the part of the hosts.
The loft was amazing, much bigger than expected and in a great location downtown. The hosts were very accommodating and easy to communicate with. Would highly recommend.

Good location.  At first, it seems a bit outside of the hopping area.  But, the location is a short walk from Old Montreal, Downtown, St. Catherine, and St. Laurent.  The Studio Apartment was spacious and clean... would surely stay there again.

The loft was in a great location, right near so many good places to eat and sights to see in Old Montreal. The hosts recommended eating at Olive and Gourmando for breakfast which was a highlight for us. Checking in was very easy, there are parking lots all around the apartment, and it's above a bar if you're looking for that. The loft was clean, decorated nicely, smelled really good, and was comfortable. Thanks Matt and Kaileigh!

Vaste loft chaleureux bien situé.  Nous avons passé un agréable séjour.  Puisqu'il est situé en plein coeur de Montréal, il faut s'attendre à entendre toute sorte de bruit au cours de la nuit !  Rien de dramatique par contre.  Un endroit où je retournerais sans aucun doute !

Beautiful loft space!! Looks exactly as pictured,was close to all old Montreal sights. Hosts provided great communication and checked in to ensure we had everything we needed. Was also located right next to a great little restaurant/pub that were able to enjoy. Would definitely stay here again.

Overall a great experience. Not one complaint. It was a beautiful apartment in a great part of town. The apartment looks exactly as it does in the pictures. The location was prime.  Will definitely look into staying here again the next time I'm in town.

Great unit, great location. Host was willing to help in any way they could. 
Would recommend this unit.
Great choice for a weekend in the old port!

Everything was comfortable, clean, and convenient, as expected from the house information. A perfectly easy place to stay for a couple night trip to Montreal! Thanks for the good communication and smooth stay.

Great space, close to everything and unit was as described.
Easy communication with host.

Everything about this cozy loft was fantastic! The high ceilings and large windows allowed a sunny space. This apartment was clean, quiet and comfy. I felt right at home! I would definitely book again for our next visit.
Highly recommend!
Perfect location. Very clean, and looks exactly like photos!
Une décoration d'intérieur très sympa avec une vraie sensation d'espace, on se sent de suite bien, dans un univers inhabituel ;-) bien placé pour rayonner partout dans Montreal, un tres bon choix!
A great place in Old Montreal. Stay no where else but here. Great communication and service. Beds super comfortable.
Très bel appartement bien situé. Tout était clair et bien décrit.

I must say we really loved the space, it was clean and looks exactly like the picture. The kitchen functioned well, we managed to cook 3 great meals there. I would definitely stay here again. It located in a great location close to every where we wanted to go. Thanks for being our host.
Excellent location.  Very spacious studio.  Much more fun than a characterless hotel.  My kids loved it!

We were amazed by how great and beautiful this place was. We felt like it was our home at the moment we entered the apartment. Everything was clean, well located... Everything was on point! I have nothing else to say and I would definitely recommend this place. The instructions were clear and it was easy to communicate with the host. We were happy about our stay there.

We had a fantastic time staying here! The place was exactly as pictured and what we expected. Great location for checking out the old port, walking up to Crescent street pubs/clubs and hopping on the subway line to explore more of the city. Decor made for a really cool experience to stay in with a beer and shoot some pool (not a high end table but lots of fun). The double bed was a dream to sleep on, and the queen was towards to firm side (if that's your cup of tea). Fantastic place to make a base for exploring all montreal has to offer! I would recommend.
We had a really great time here!

This was our very first family vacation with a 13 week old baby and our stay was absolutely amazing!!! The loft was exactly what we needed and had everything plus more than we expected!!!  The location was great, parking super easy to find and restaurants galore!! Would stay here every single time with and without a kid when traveling to Montreal!
Place was exactly what I expected. Great location! Love the windows! Great communication with the host and recommend for an active person/group who wants to walk right into the action...
Such a cool loft! Celebrated a bachelorette downtown, and this was the perfect hang out spot for before going out! Way better than any hotel!
J'ai beaucoup apprécié mon séjour! Je suis souvent à Montreal pour le travail et assurément je louerai de nouveau cet appartement
Fast responding, nice, and great people. Place is very nice and as expected.
This was close to old montreal as described. It was convienient to take a long walk across the canal and enjoy the old part of the city

We had a great stay at Explore MTL.  The space was gorgeous and the location was perfect.  The host checked in to make sure everything was covered.  We highly recommend and would certainly stay here again next time we are in Montreal.
100% recommended

Great location and Value. Excellent list provided of local restaurants and area attractions although my favourite restaurant in the area, Holder, was mysteriously not on the list. I would definitely go back.

Place is central and parking really close.

It might be a bit noisy at night as expected by being so central.

The only thing that wasn't 100% during our stay was the cleanliness.  It could have been better.  But nothing that would stopped us from going again.

The space is located perfectly for exploring all of Montreal especially Old Montreal. Everything was clean and very comfortable for a relaxing stay.
hope to do it again soon.
Beautiful loft in a beautiful part of the city! Open space made for a very fun stay. I recommend the space to anyone.
The place was beautiful and clean as advertised. Perfect location for exploring old Montreal! I would recommend this place to anyone if you can manage to snag it.
The Explore MTL was great as was the flat!
This apartment was great! The interior is exactly as pictured and there are nice amenities. It's in a good location and the hosts were easy to communicate with and helpful.

Place was absolutely adorable! Exactly as pictured. Short walk to beautiful restaurants and amazing architecture. Hosts were great as well. Apartment was very hot and we had some trouble sleeping despite the extra fans that were provided. I donthink it was exceptionally warm for Montreal the night we stayed, in the 80s, so this is probably not a normal problem. Still good to consider if you're going to be traveling here on hot days. Overall, absolutely wonderful and would definitely stay again.

Explore MTL were quick to communicate and confirm things with, as well as being super helpful.  The loft itself was a perfect space for me and my best friend to stay and I would definitely stay here again.  It is within walking distance to Old Montreal and is in a great central location.  We enjoyed our stay very much!

Awesome unique spot, clean, walking distance to great restaurants.  Hosts were great with information and even made a list of all the spots close by to check out.  I would highly recommend this place to stay in your ever in the Montreal area!

The loft was spacious, clean, and very walkable to all of the main attractions in Old Montreal. Made full use of the included Roku and mini portable speaker. Would definitely recommend to future guests!
I only want to stay at this apartment now when I go to Montreal. I've been to many Airbnb's and this was hands down the best ine
We had a great stay at this location! Thanks again.
My son loved the pool table. Place was nice. Keep the curtains down to keep out the sun during the day.
Fun place and excellent location. The host was very responsive and I was able to check-in an hour after booking. Thanks again.

This place was perfect for me and my two young daughters.  Location was great.  We parked our car in a lot directly across from the loft and didn't touch it for the length of the trip.  We walked everywhere, which was the best way to explore.  The loft was open, airy, immaculate, and had everything we needed.  Checking in and out was a breeze.  We will definitely stay here again.

This place was perfect for me. I was here on business and didn't spend much time at the listing but it was very clean, had a clean bathroom with plenty of toiletries. The host was very responsive and the listing is centrally located in the city a short walk to Old Montreal and to the shopping. I'll stay here again on my next visit for sure!

The hosts were very helpful and had great communication. Unfortunately, the weather was extremely hot during our stay so having no A.C. was an issue. There was one fan for the whole space that was very noisy. The hosts were very accommodating and brought us two new quiet fans the next day. The wi-fi did not work either, so they let us use the wi-fi from the bar below. It was really noisy during the night with people yelling and arguing from the bar downstairs. The place has a unique personality and we loved the decor!
It's such a cool place with great location. We enjoyed our stay.

The place is as good as it looks! I thought it might be a little too good to be true based on previous airbnb experiences but the pictures properly represent it.  It's a wonderful space.  Explore MTL are fast and helpful.  We had a great time walking Montreal!  We will definitely have this place at the top of our list when we come back.
The house was clean, the beds were comfortable, the host was easy to deal with and very responsive. The location was awesome for walking to old Montreal.

The place is pretty much just one giant room with some dividers. The location is great but the house rules are rigid. 
A high cleaning fee and then they order you to do most of the cleaning work/prep.
The beds are by the windows so the morning sun will wake you up unless you're used to sleeping through that. Street noise is moderate. 
The place was clean and close to the metro.
Good place. Accurate with the description

This is a terrific location from which to explore Montreal! The apartment is really spacious and comfortable, and is just as pictured. We felt very safe in this neighborhood. And we were very close to everything in Old Montreal. The hosts were super about communicating - they provided plenty of clear instructions up front and were very responsive when we had questions. Their advance instructions also included a lot of area recommendations, and the one recommended restaurant we tried (Olive & Gourmando) was super. There were minor issues (dishwasher went on the fritz) that did not affect the enjoyment of our stay...stuff like this can happen anywhere. One caveat: if you arrive late (after 11) and park in the lot across the street, you will only be allowed to purchase parking until 5 AM and then will have to return to the lot, at which point you can purchase for a longer stretch (up to 60 hours, as far as I can tell...and we were able to extend after that as well). Everything is very close...you won't need your car.
Close to all Old Montreal sights and close to Metro
Great location, spacious, well-decorated loft, and outstanding responsiveness to a small issue that arose during our stay. We would absolutely stay here again!

Explore MTL made our visit to Montreal a memorable one. We felt comfortable and at home in their space and totally spoiled by their personalized customer service and unique insight of their city (so much better than staying in a hotel!). They went above and beyond for us and we only stayed a night! 

This "Vieux- Montreal" loft is spacious, trendy and bright. It's even better than the photos! Creative design, unique decor and eclectic mod furniture - the ideal space for my work vaca with the hubbie. Their home was spotless and well presented when we arrived. The kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed including complimentary coffee for the mornings and the lovely scented bathroom toiletries were a nice touch. The queen bed was uber comfy (seriously, where did you buy those sheets?!?). The wifi was fast and reliable (which is always important!), they also provided their Netflixs account and a portable speaker for us to use. 

The location was prime, located on one of the major streets in the Old Port. Surprisingly no noise from the street carried into the apartment. The loft was a quiet and cool escape from the bustling city outside.

Transportation: soo easy! We parked our car in the lot next to the apartment and opted for bixi bikes and the metro.

The lovely hosts provided amazing recommendations for the entire city (wow) - they're clearly experienced foodies!!! They were always available to answer our (unending stream of) questions, offer helpful suggestions and were just incredible throughout the entire process! The check-in process was made painless with their detailed instruction manual - which was much appreciated after a long day of travel!

Check- out: Easy but hard to leave!

Thanks again for an amazing stay. We will definitely be back!!!
Great apartment in a central location!
This location is a gemstone! Love the spaciousness of the loft and it's coziness. Will stay here again!
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the New York Style Loft in Montreal- thanks for the great amenities, location and atmosphere. Even put the pool table to good use!  Will be back!
Comfortable, clean and coo!

I recommend staying with this host if ever in Montreal. The location was perfect, quiet while a 10 minute walk to the the Old Port where there are tons of restaurants and shops. The decor of the apartment was fantastic and the amenities (high speed Internet, bathtub, coffee press, etc) made our stay very comfortable. Best of all our hosts communicated with us throughout our stay and promptly responded to our requests. My husband and I enjoyed our stay very much and highly recommend this BnB.
Great place exactly as advertised.
Perfect location. Great communication. Book it.
Centrally located to shopping and nightlife, the loft surpassed all my expectations and the host's hospitality was superb. Will be staying there again.
I'd come back anytime.  Great location, cool spot and had no issues whatsoever.
Super close to everything you will need to see if your planning on exploring old Montreal. And a truly beautiful loft
Je recommande beaucoup ce loft, très bon rapport qualité/prix, super beau et bien situé en ville et prêt du Vieux Port et de plusieurs bon resto.
This place is gorgeous! Close to the old port and great for walking around and checking it out

The location was great, right in Old Montreal. Unfortunately, we had some issues with our apartment that hurt the experience. We rented the apartment primarily because it was advertised as having a complete kitchen. The stove was not heating properly as well. Communication with the hosts was good but they were unable to offer any solution to the appliance problems as they were not present in the country at the time. Overall, while the location was nice, we were disappointed because we chose this property due to the fact it had a kitchen.

reviews.comments:
Nathaniel and Anthi were super friendly and considerate.
First, I received timely response upon my booking request. Then a detailed guidance was send to me before my check-in. During my stay, Anthi checked upon me to see if everything went well or if I needed any help. The check out process was also very easy and efficient.
The apartment is in awesome location close to the quite and hipster side of central, the room deco is stylish and simple, necessities were of high quality and aesthetics. Loved it.
So thrilled that Nathaniel is also a big fan of Monocle. I brought my own monocle travel guide with me yet to find Nathaniel has already prepared the Hong Kong edition along with other magazine subscriptions (;
Strongly recommend Nathaniel and Anthi’s place and big thumb’s up for their hospitality.

I really liked staying here.  It is a great location, easy to get to Central  (right near the escalator),  there is a supermarket on the next block, and it's easy to get cabs when needed.  The apartment is small (which is not unusual in Hong Kong!) , but super quiet, very clean, uncluttered, and had everything I needed for my three day stay.  The building is secure and has an elevator. Great place for a solo traveler.   Anthi, Nathaniel's sister, left some basics for me, and there was also a pod coffee machine, which I very much appreciated.  Also, the communication was superb.  I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment is super nice and clean with cozy decoration. Though the size is compact but everything you needed is there. (Not to mention most apartment in HK is compact anyway) Location is perfect for people who enjoy the nightlife of Soho and LKF. Since the apartment is located on the hill, the options getting there is quite limited. You can get there by taking the escalator but I highly recommend taking the taxi downhill as it only costs you about HK$30-40  then you have plenty options of transportations that you can take to places. 

Nate and Anthi are amazing. They have been super helpful and accommodating throughout our entire stay at the apartment. 

Thank you so much again. We highly recommend you to rent from them and we would love to stay here again in the future when I come back to visit.

This home is very central to everything at the HK island side. It is a decent size apartment and Anthi/Nath has been very prompt and hospitable since day one. Small thoughts like snacks, fruits, drinks upon arrival. Very clean and nicely decorated (a plus for people who like aseop shower items and those who need caffaine in the morning). Highly recommended.

I spent 1 month at Nathaniel's place and couldn't have felt more at home. The apartment is super nice, very bright and spacious with lots of stylish touches. Location is fantastic, right in the heart of Soho. Thank you, would definitely love to stay here again!

Ses rues bordées de grands arbres et ses espaces verts entretiennent une vie de quartier unique. Ses rues commerciales sont au cœur de véritables villages urbains. Ceux-ci sont animés par des gens de toutes origines qui prennent grand plaisir à se côtoyer. Territoire privilégié pour les plex, l’arrondissement offre des secteurs de maisons unifamiliales fort agréables. Les nouveaux condos ajoutent des options nouvelles aux ménages en quête d’un milieu de vie sympathique. Trois bibliothèques publiques, une Maison de la culture, de multiples installations sportives et de loisirs et quoi encore ? En fait, un espace urbain rêvé pour élever les familles. neighborhood_overview: Wan Chai is an unique place packed with old/new culture - historical buildings, local market as well as concept restaurants, bars, coffee shops with western influence. Fun place to explore. Hope you like it as much as I do! My place is located right in the middle of the main street of all the bars and pubs therefore it's very busy at night. Might not be suitable for you if you mind the busy night life activities. The house itself is quiet tho.
transit: To get around:  Wan Chai MTR station, Exit A1, is just across the road from the building. You can also easily take MTR, trams to go to everywhere in the city. From Airport: By bus, you can take A11 to Wan Chai and take off at Fleming Road, Hennessy Road.  By Airport Express, take off at Hong Kong station and then change MTR to Wan Chai, exit A1.
access: Just as you are at home!
interaction: Please advice me if you have any feedback and questions. I'd love to offer as much help as I could.
house_rules: I appreciate you do not smoke in the house area. But feel free to smoke at the rooftop area.

host.host_about: Hello there, I'd like to make Airbnb a great experience for both of us. :)

address.street: Wan Chai, Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong

reviews.comments: Nice place.非常方便,就在灣仔地鐵站口,房間小清新,乾淨,設施齊全,兩個小臥室兩張單人床,非常適合朋友閨蜜們一起住｡房東很熱情,在香港能租到這個房子很不錯啦｡

Three of us stayed here while we attended a trade show at the convention center. It was very convenient (across from the MTR exit and taxi stand at the door). Jessica was also kind enough to wait for us when our flight was delayed in arriving by about 2 hours. I would happily stay here again.

Outstanding, unexpected, memorable, unique, picturesque are but a few adjectives to describe Jessica's penthouse. It is one of these listings you can only find on AirBnB or through hearsay from friends. Your first reaction might be surprise or even wondering if you got to the correct place, but it will quickly leave you when entering the cutest, best equipped, cosiest place I've been given to stay at in my many visits to HK. 
It is simply the perfect fit for people who are tired of faceless hotel rooms and who love Hong Kong.
Many thanks for letting us stay there Jessica and be ready: we will be back :-)

This is one awesome apartment. Very private as it is on the penthouse level. Less than a min walk to the entrance of the MTR. The host provides Netflix, nespresso, tea and toiletries. Very spacious rooms and nice beds. The eateries downstairs is very popular with the locals. Very near to a few famous restaurants like Kam's roast. The host also responded very fast to our inquiries. This is one of the best Airbnb we stayed. Highly recommended.
We had such a great time at Jessica's apartment. Great location, and cozy home with lots of light. We will be back. Thank you!

All went well. Internet worked well and tv.  I think for roof top you need lounge equipment.  The shower was great and the beds comfortable.  The area was a bit subject but the convenience to the Hong Kong convention center was great

Fantastic host, Jessica: extremely helpful, cordial person. I cannot express how I appreciate her help and hospitality.
Thank you, dear Jessica.

We really liked this apartment, clean, light, central to everything and Jessica was a delight to deal with.  It's not conventional and has it's idiosyncrasies but for those wanting something out of the ordinary but affordable... book this!
房子私密性很好,干净整洁,有些小心思｡很温馨的房屋,深度睡眠喷雾和绘画本,都体现出房主的用心｡离地铁超级近,过个马路就是｡楼下的美食店也很棒,可以买早餐或是夜宵｡
Excellent location, Jessica is a perfect host, everything needed is there including a Nespresso machine! The rooftop is a wonderful "extra"!
床非常舒服,生活用品一应俱全,比酒店还棒!还有胶囊咖啡机!交通便利,出门就是湾仔地铁站,整体体验非常棒
Great, cozy, rooftop apartment located in the heart of Hong Kong. Easy access to transportation.

Мы останавливались в квартире на 2 дня. Общение с Джессикой было замечательным, очень отзывчивая и приятная девушка, на все вопросы отвечала нам очень быстро. Расположение квартиры очень удобно, центр, вход в метро напротив дома, вокруг есть и магазины, и кафе. 
Квартира небольшая, но мы разместились с двумя детьми. Важно, что действительно чисто, хорошие кровати, белье и полотенца, а также разные приятные мелочи вплоть до зубных щёток .
Мы остались очень довольны своим выбором и можем рекомендовать с удовольствием этот вариант проживания в Гонконге.
Джессика, спасибо!

Excellent location for us 2 work colleagues who were attending a trade show at the Convention Centre. The apartment had 2 small bedrooms with single beds, and was well fitted out with everything we needed. It was very clean and easy to access, check in etc. The highlight was the balcony, where we could relax and have a beer at the end of each long day. I def recommend this place and would love to stay here again.
Perfect location in Wanchai! Super terrasse for breakfast and chilling! Quiet! Jessica couldn'tbe a better host! Highly recommended!

This is a beautifuly-decorated, cosy and comfortable apartment that is close to the MTR and useful shops and ATMs/banks. 

The Nespresso machine and pods and tap filter are brilliant additions, as well as the free toiletries. 

Ideal for two single people/friends travelling. It might have been a bit of a squeeze to use the third bed.

Fantastic to have a private roof with seating area - we loved hanging out there! 

Highly recommended!
It's a very nice place that you can enjoy a great and warm service there, we like it so much.

It's location is great because there is a 7-11 located just opposite of where you stay. You have the MTR right across the street. The owner was quick in replying so I thought the communication was good. It's a good place where you can spend your time with your friends at the rooftop.

It would be great if there is more lightings provided at the rooftop. And it may not be suitable for couples as there are only single beds.

Overall, my friends and I are satisfied and pleased to have came across this apartment. Would definitely consider when going back to Hong Kong.
房子还是挺好的,就是太靠近夜场了,女孩子住在那里不是很方便
地点在湾仔,离地铁站很近,房子虽然小点,但整洁,功能也齐全,房东也很热情,有问必答

The apartment is on a block with some adult businesses -- so if the presence of that offends you, you might want to look elsewhere. It didn't bother us! The apartment was charming. Fantastic location and an incredible value for a 2BR compared to other rentals in Hong Kong. Highly recommended!

Communication with Jessica was super easy, she always replied within minutes. High accuracy - you will find everything like described. We loved the place - it is within walking distance from shops, restaurants, nightlife, public transport and nevertheless quiet. The rooftop area is nice for having a drink although it can get really hot. Highly recommend Jessica's place!

Great small apartment directly across from the MTR station. 2 Bedrooms (with curtains in doorways).  Comfortable beds and comforters with duvet covers. Had a little trouble getting the TV to work. A/C, hot water and Wifi all worked well. Had a fantastic time and would recommend this apartment!
Superb location in the centre of Wan Chai and right by the station - would definitely recommend to any first visitors to the city.

Great for singles and small families. Not so for groups with elderly as need to walk up stairs to the apartment. Although the rooftop area and pipes outside looked old and building had a massage parlour on one floor, the rooftop apartment was bright, cosy and cheery. Aircon was good to keep cool on hot day and bed was comfortable. Instructions and responses were clear. Very near to MTR exit and 7-11. Lots of food options around, including Cafe De Coral nearby, and a stall selling egg waffles and curry fish balls just downstairs. Well-kept place!

Really good and great value for money accommodation. Helpful and spot on host. Superb location for us next to Convention Centre in HK (were there for conference). Good Aircon, from the outside looks a bit dated (as everything in HK) but really nice inside. clean, spacious (to HK standards), good electricity, reasonable wifi speeds, Nespresso machine and capsules. LOVED ID, would return and recommend.
It is actually very great though little bit small
Cosy place very close to the metro.

Unique little apartment on a Wanchai rooftop. Very central. 
On a sunny day, it's like having your own private beach. Bathroom has two windows, really nice light.
Only issues were small mattresses (one"twin" in each time room), and unusable WIFI - really a problem if you have to do work while traveling.
MTR역 바로 앞에 있어서 좋았어요.

My stay in Jessica's apartment was wonderful and highly recommended.  Her communication was very quick with any question I had, and her apartment was easy to find and access.  The building is next to an elevated walkway leading directly to the nearby conference center, so it was the PERFECT for attending events there. AC and internet were flawless, subway access immediate, food options plentiful.  Stay here.
Awesome location, great coffee machine.  Snug apartment but actually well-sized for Hong Kong.
Nice location, easy access!

Great location right next to Wan Chai station! Excellent value for money! Clean, comfortable and much better than expected! 
Free wifi and Netflix a bonus! 
Overall great value!

Super close to the station,  this small clean cool apartment has heaps of welcoming touches that make a difference - complimentary tea/coffee/toothbrushes, Netflix, key safe check in. A very convenient and comfortable place to stay.

This place is such a great find! Stayed here with our 2 year old and loved every minute of it. 3 air conditioners, unbeatable location. MTR is literally 20 metres from the front door. Wan Chai local area is great. Awesome food, just a 20 minute walk to the waterfront. Really quick and helpful communication with Jessica. Highly recommend staying here!

This place was absolutely amazing! It’s literally right across the street from an MTR station. It was a super convenient!

I’d definitely recommend this place for anyone going to Hong Kong!
Great location right next to the MTR, lots of local eateries and taxis. Good value for money and Jessica was great at responding to any enquiries!
Very nice place and location
The place is fantastic. Great location. Great privacy. Every details is well thought of. Plenty of plates and utensils. I would definitely come back to stay here again.

Leuk klein appartementje op de top van de wereld. Kleinhuisje boven op flatgebouw. Van alle gemakken voorzien. Ijskast, nespresso apparaat (zelfs met wat koffie) een waterkoker en voor de liefhebbers tv met netflix. 

Makkelijk vlakbij de metro. In een lekker bruisend buurtje. Inderdaad met wat nachtclubs maar daar heb je verder geen last van en het voelt ook als een veilige buurt). Je bent overal zo met de metro. In de straat achter het appartement zit een iets grotere supermarkt met meer verse producten dan de 7eleven.

Coole Location. Wir kam im Dunkeln an, folgten der Wegbeschreibung, fuhren auf das Dach und waren erstmal ein klein wenig ratlos, ob man da tatsächlich irgendwo wohnen kann..und sahen dann das kleine Häuschen. Sehr privat, und mit der Dachterrasse großzügig und weitläufig im sonst so engen Hong Kong. Die Wohnung selbst ist so wie auf den Fotos. Die Lage ist top. Wir würden die Wohnung wieder buchen.

Location is everything about this unit. Right off wanchai mtr, perfect for business travellers, especially those going to HKCEC. Great value for its size and location. Its hongkong, so its pretty roomy for hongkong apartment size. Host is also very responsive which was super helpful.

1. This place does NOT have an elevator. The elevator goes ALMOST to the floor it's on, but not quite. So if you have mobility issues or don't want to haul your luggage up a few flights of stairs, you're out of luck.
2. The Wifi NEVER works. So better bring your own - even though it says there's Wifi here, there isn't. Doesn't matter how many times Jessica comes over to "fix" it. Guaranteed less than 12 hours before check-in you'll get a note saying "oh the Wifi isn't working, but it should be fixed today!" That's bull. The Wifi never works.
3. The bedrooms are NOT bedrooms - they have NO closets and NO doors.
4. The bathroom spray attachment is held together with a bent, rusty wire hanger.
5. The tap water smells like sewage.
6. Location: Right in the middle of streetwalker alley. If you are either a) a prostitute, or b) looking to pick one up for cheap, this is the place for you. You're a disgusting sex tourist, but hey - have at it. If you DON'T want to stay in someone else's for-pay wet spot, though, avoid this place like the plague.
7. The code for the front entry DOESN'T WORK, so you better hope that the front door is left wide open (yay, security!) or the weird troll that minds the hallway is there to buzz you in.
Great location directly opposite the MTR station. Clean and comfortable. Couldn't ask for more.
Good location cozy apartment
Convenient location to many places of interest and eateries.  No issue getting around.

Jessica’s place is a real gem in Hong Kong. Exactly like described. Great location, great value and great host. It was very clean, homey and can easily fit 3 person. The place is very close to the Subway station and various bus stops. It’s very easy to get around. We also liked that there are so many great food options close by. Jessica was such a great host - she was helpful, responsible and friendly. We would highly recommend Jessica and her place for anyone who’s traveling to HK.
The apartment is lovely and great located. Jessica was a very nice host.

It's a very nice little apartment located a few steps away from Wan Cai MTR. It's well maintained, clean and cozy. Beds are single size, but very comfortable. Shower is good and kitchen has all the necessary tools. WiFi worked fine, but sometimes it got slower (maybe too many people were sharing a same bandwidth?).

It's perfect for two people or small family. Three of us managed to stay comfortably though. Very good value.

Jessica was super responsive to every question that we had! The location is great, it is right in the middle of Wan Chai with easy access to everything you'd want to do, along with the MTR station. Be warned that the area directly to the right of the place is filled with Gentlemen's clubs and if you are a Western man, you will get harrased to join from every establishment you pass. But the location is pretty ideal.

The place is very small, but it really has everything you need. It can't fit much more than two people though. But it was clean and easy to check in and out of. Would definitely recommend!
홍콩 스타일 옥탑방

房子的地点就位于湾仔地铁站出口的对面,公共交通非常方便｡周围的基础设施,例如便利店,饭店应有尽有｡值得一提的是所处的是酒吧一条街,不过即便晚上也不会吵,所以喜欢酒吧就很方便不喜欢也OK｡    设施也是配备得很齐全,基础的洗浴和餐厨用品都会有｡而且房间也特别干净｡    最后一定要说,房主人超好,真的超好!什么问题都会很快回复很快解决｡她还有一个新装修的在同一栋楼里,也很干净而且更宽敞,如果订不到这间建议入住那间的｡
Thanks for a great stay!! Great flat in convenient location!
사진보다는 좁지만 대체로 만족했습니다.
很好的

superb location! Fuss-free check in and check-out. Jessica was super prompt in  her replies and very very helpful. 

good street food and plenty of eating choices around the block, 7-11 across the street. Mtr entrance is just 1min away! will definitely stay here again!
Good location, quick response.
위치가 완차이역에서 30초 거리입니다. 호스트분과 연락도 잘되고 메세지로 도움 많이 주셨습니다. 방 인테리어도 심플하고 이쁘고 이불도 너무 뽀송뽀송하고 좋습니다. 아침마다 커피머신도 유용하게 사용했습니다. 다음에 또 오고싶은 훌륭한 숙소입니다 :-)
湾仔站A1出来就是了､地理位置非常好,走到铜锣湾也可以坐地铁也可以､房间很干净,但是在天台,不过很满意啦､家里还有香味嘻嘻
Jessica人非常棒!很好溝通!房間乾淨舒適,唯一小缺點是用水時馬達聲比較大聲,其他都很滿意｡

Ideal for 2 adults, third can use the slide-out mattress. 

Located in busy business area, but hardly hear anything at the top floor. 
AC's work in all rooms, super clean home with super clean sheets/towels, slightly small rooms/ kitchen / shower, nice big balcony to stretch leg and do yoga.  Refrigerator and toaster present, microwave would have been a welcome good to have. 

Host is super fast to respond and helpful. 

Easy access to pub and restaurant, metro train and taxi at your door (50 Meters and just outside the apartment). Area is safe even late into the night, did not see any issues. Central area to get bus, metro, cab or tram to reach destinations. 

You have to get drinking water from outside. 7 eleven is 100 feet away. 
Overall, liked the stay, no complains.
Very convenient place if you are going to the exhibition center, it's a 7 min walk.
房間與圖片相符,交通方便舒適,房東友善｡

The location of Jessica’s place is nice. Easy to go to the Exhibition Centre.
We had a great time there.

Very central with great, big rooftop. The apartment itself is quite small (typical HK) and there are curtains instead of doors for the bedrooms, but it’s perfect for a couple of friends looking for a convenient and affordable place. Jessica made the entire process very easy and hassle free. Would stay there again!

Great location. To expect to have the guard doing his rounds intermittently at day and night

It is a walking distance away from the Masjid Centre for Halal Dim Sum, about 10 mins walk.
Place is clean

Die Unterkunft liegt direkt an einer MTR Station, zwei Halte von Central entfernt. Die Nachbarschaft ist lebhaft mit viel Streetfood direkt vor der Tür (am Geruch kann man sich allerdings auch leicht mal stören). Alles in allem ein perfektes Preis-Leistung Verhältnis
Great location, easy check-in, and had everything we needed.
This place is great location! Great view from the rooftop! Jessica was quick with replies, always made sure we were set with towels, and utilities! Overall great place!

Very nice airbnb with a really cool and big roof terrace (good for photos). The bathroom could be a little bit cleaner, but that was no problem at all. The water pump in the kitchen is a little bit loud. One of the three air conditioners was broken, but jessica took care of it immediately.

Very good location. There are so much shops and restaurants around. MTR is across the street. Jessica responded very fast and helped as where she could.

The situation is very good, but the 2 bedrooms are very small ( around 5 m2) each.
You must put the luggage in the (Website hidden by Airbnb) you can’t move in thé appartement.
If it’s only to sleep, the appartement is perfect!
great location - you only have to cross the street to the MTR
此處交通方便 下樓過馬路就是灣仔站入口,附近有多家小食店,地理位置很好,離甘記燒鵝 華星冰室 利苑灣仔都是10分鐘路程,非常方便｡

It's very good location where you can walk around Wan chan area.
And you can easily see many bars and food shops.
If you want to stay in Wan Chai area, I'll recommend you this place.
离地铁站很近很方便 楼下也有很多小吃 房间虽然不大但是需要的东西一应俱全 住着很舒适
No big problems I would stay here again with my family.
I really enjoy staying at Jess’s house. The location is grate, really close to the exhibition hall and also close to shopping area and foods. Love it!!!

Second time and once again did not disappoint. 
Jess is great to deal with and the place is fantastic value.
The space is small - but has a lot of character. It’s a stand-alone space on top of the roof - lots of privacy. Great location and value for the price.
湾仔地铁出门就到,非常方便!!!
Very convenient location and nice rooftop flat, perfect for a week-end getaway
Really good location in the city, the location on the roof is pretty hilarious, great it you want an inexpensive place to sleep and go out into the city from

We were very disappointed with this accommodation. We are Airbnb owners. The few  most important things are location, cleanliness and comfort. The accommodation did not offer any of these. Questionable elevator, have to haul luggage up one storey and over pipes; unfinished, poorly plastered walls, ceiling coming apart in bathroom, poor smell from foil oil scent sticks; owner should invest in their real estate and carry out basic repairs to make this tin rooftop shack minimally acceptable.
Because of the so-called central area (which is a prostitution and drinking district), it appears that they can fetch high amounts for seedy accommodation.
Nice place
地理位置极佳,公共交通方便,楼下就有吃的,有生活便利店,生活还是挺方便的｡唯一的缺点就是相对于内地的房子小了些,床品都很干净整齐,适合跟朋友还有家庭居住｡

For Hong Kong standard, the apartment is quite spacious for 3 people as you have living room to relax. On the first day, the room was a bit dirty but Jess handled the issue very well. She sent the cleaner and refund the cleaning fee. Appreciate her hospitality. Overall, it's a good place to stay!
위치가 정말 좋았습니다! 완차이역에서 건물까지 1분이에요! 굿굿

Overall great value and can't beat the location.  The place is definitely small and the beds are twins.  Also, note the bedrooms have curtains for doors to save space so it doesn't get completely dark in the bedrooms.  We had two adults and a baby and the space was just big enough for us.  Wouldn't recommend more people unless you are not going to spend much time there.
겨울시즌에는 조금 추워요. 난방시설이 따로 없고 조그만 라지에이터 하나로는 추웠습니다.
great location, train station is right next to the apartment block. also having the whole rooftop to ourselves was great.

Pleasant stay at a great location in HK. The flat was clean and easy to find. Jess responded quickly to our questions.
I'd stay here again when I'm in the city.

Perfect location to all of the activity. MTR station just across the street. Jess’s instructions were excellent for getting in to her place. It was flawless! Amenities are basic but we were comfortable staying there.

Jess’s place is absolutely perfect! A little rooftop gem in the heart of HK! She was quick to reply and was super obliging to assist with storing luggage. Can’t wait to get back HK and stay here again!
Jess's place is nice and cozy! Lovely and convenient, right in front of an MTR exit so very easy to find.
완차이역 A1출구 바로 앞에 있어서 너무너무 편했어요! 바로옆에 편의점도 있어서 너무 좋았습니다. 집이 생각보다 작았지만 큰 불편함은 없어요.
地點真的很好 ,房間設備都蠻齊全,有雀巢膠囊咖啡機,但提醒要自帶膠囊,非常棒的房子!
很不错,尤其是天台的感觉,非常棒!

위치가 너무너무 좋았어요 공항에서 ael타고 센트럴에서 환승하고 완차이역으로 오면 바로앞에 숙소가 있었어요! 바로옆에 맥도날드랑 편의점도 있었고 주변엔 간단히 맥주한잔 할수있는 곳도많아서 너무 좋았습니단 ㅎㅎ 무엇보다 Jess가 친절해서 좋았어요!! 
(숭겅응 잉잉당 항장망중닝깡 꽁 덩챙굥강셍용!!)
