L'arrivée et le départ sont très pratiques. Merci à Savannah qui a accepté de garder nos bagages quelques heures pour que nous puissions profiter de notre séjour jusqu'au dernier moment.
Terrific place

We had a lovey stay in Brooklyn. The place was just as pictured, clean, and spacious. The walk to the subway (Utica station) wasn't too far. We didn't use the kitchen but it was lovey and seemed ready to prepare a feast if that's your fancy. We really appreciated the washer and dryer as it was super hot and humid while we visited, so we threw clothes in the washer once we arrived home from exploring for the day. The neighbors were friendly and we felt safe walking anytime, morning and night. Savannah and Carsten were super helpful and answered all of our questions quickly. They also suggested the Honduran restaurant when we requested a recommendation. We ate at Milk and Pull and Natural Blend around the corner on Malcolm X and enjoyed it. We also ate at La Perla Del Ulua a short and cheap Uber or Lyft ride (less than $10) away. The restaurant is authentic Honduran, we enjoyed the carne asada, baleada, and tajeditas con carne. It is cash only and the a service was a little inattentive but the restaurant was slow and the waitress was quick to respond to any of our requests. My Honduran husband was please with the traditional cuisine and we always appreciate being able to get a little taste of home. We would love to stay at Savannah's place again if we were to return to Brooklyn.

Great place, really lovely, spacious, beautifully  decorated, sweet yard out back. Totally unexpected for New York. Neighborhood is gritty, urban and partly gentrified. We loved it. And loved the restaurant recommendation (Saraghina, for both pizza and for morning pastries). Savannah was a great host and the directions, check-in and check-out were super easy (we had to check in very late). Five stars!

Belle maison au coeur d'un "vrai quartier" de Brooklyn. Belle expérience à vivre. Tout le nécessaire est présent dans la maison pour passer un séjour formidable. La petite supérette Healthway située au carrefour en face est parfaite pour gérer le quotidien et compléter les produits frais achetés sur le marché d'Union Square. Deux stations située à 10' (Utica & Kosuscko) permettent d'atteindre le coeur de Manhattan en 40' et de gérer facilement ses déplacements avec les subways directs ou locaux. Nous reviendrons à NYC !!

The house is beautifully designed; very comfortable and attractive. The subway network was good and the apartment was a ten minute walk from the station we used. Unfortunately we didn't meet the host or have much contact which was a shame. Otherwise a great stay.
Savannah's place is quite lovely. Updates are beautiful, beds are comfortable.  Thank you for sharing your wonderful home with us.

Amazing place, first time staying in Brooklyn, we really enjoyed the location. 
A lot of food nearby chinese, thai, indian, jamaican, indonesian.  Subway will take you to manhattan in 30'.
The apartment is lovely, clean, silently, safe neighborhood, we did appreciate the washer and drier.

Absolutely loved Savannah's place.  Pics depicted exactly as her home is and would move into a home like this tomorrow, very quirky and lovely design features.
Subway about 15 min walk from house which was no problem in morning but in the evening after shopping / sightseeing felt like a hike.  One of the three nights we stayed we had comments made at us by people on the stoops as we passed by which was a little uncomfortable.
Really lovely outside area at the house but would benefit by table chairs on the deck as downstairs area felt as if it belonged to downstairs neighbours and weather would encourage outside living which we couldn't experience.
The house felt like someone else's home and that we were somewhat intruding, there was food left in the fridge and freezer, yet the dinnerware available was not suitable for 4 guests or cooking dinners.  Aircon in house very noisy but nothing good earplugs won't sort out.
On our last night there was what sounded like gunshots outside the house with a police helicopter hovering above for most of night and next morning when we left.  This may have just been an isolated incident that we were unfortunate enough to happen upon.
Putting the negatives aside, we loved the house.
Savannah's place is located in the heart of Brooklyn. There are groccery stores near by. It takes a bit long to get into the city because of the traffic. But very easy parking. Thank you!

Very big and nice house in a typical neighborhood. We just missed a little more care of the details in the kitchen.
We didn't meet Savanah personally but she was very helpful at any time answering our questions.

Our stay in New York, at Savannah's home has been such great experience for our family. Her house is very nice and confortable. Brooklin looks like being in a movie. Communication and suggestion made by our great host was very helpfull ! Thank you so much.

Savannah and Carsten were great hosts!!!  If you're heading to a vacation in NYC this Airbnb is a MUST book. The pictures don't do her place justice.  It's beautifully decorated, airy, clean and the linens are top quality. The location was perfect for exploring Manhattan, Coney Island, Dumbo, Brooklyn and so much more. Carsten was very helpful to our family of 5 and stopped by to make sure we had enough linens and such. The cot and couch were made up for our boys and turned out to be very comfortable for both of them (each boy is over 6'2ft). The kitchen was perfect for cooking, and the deck/garden area was very nice as well.  I can't wait to return to Savannah's and know I will be in my home away from home.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Savannah. L'appartement est grand et confortable. Le quartier est "pittoresque". Nous n'avons jamais eu de sentiment d'insécurité de nuit comme jour. Il faut près de 35 minutes en métro pour rejoindre le centre de Manhattan, métro accessible en 10 minutes à pied. Nombreux commerces et restaurants à proximité. Nous n'avons pas rencontré Savannah mais nous avons eu une bonne communication.
This place is cozy and magical. Small town vibe in the middle of the big city. You'll love it

Прекрасный дом! Мы жили семьей из четырех человек, всем было комфортно и уютно, очень чисто. Классная кухня, много посуды и различных специй, готовить было одно удовольствие. Удобное расположение, безопасный район, рядом метро и продуктовые магазины. Всем рекомендую!
We loved the neighborhood. The home is beautiful and well kept. Breakfast or lunch at the Healthyway a must!!
Logement super! Très jolie déco. On n'a vraiment pas été déçu. Le seul hic un peu loin de Manhattan en transports publics (bon c'est surtout qu'on n'a pas l'habitude des longues distances en Suisse;)
Such a cute and quaint place. Very spacious living room/ kitchen area. Great bedrooms and bathrooms. Everything as pictured. We really enjoyed our stay.
Great locations! Even better host!
These accommodations are among my favorite! Just gorgeous space- great for 2 couples! Great value.

Beautiful home, perfectly clean. A few options exist for buying groceries just one or two blocks away. We found parking very near the front door. Overall it was a lovely stay in a lovely home in a lovely part of NYC.

The brownstone was beautiful; huge, bathrooms and kitchen were all updated. It was so nice to have a separate bedroom and bathroom for the kids. 
Only concern was location. We didn't feel safe walking around at night and had to rely on Uber. Everywhere we wanted to go during the day was quite a walk. We did take the subway into Manhattan one day, but didn't feel comfortable coming back on subway and taking the walk back, so we ubered. 
Check in and check out was super

The place is beautiful. Worked perfectly for us with two bedrooms and three bathrooms. The washer and dryer was a lifesaver, since two of us came from another trip and one was headed on another directly from Brooklyn. Go to Manny's for breakfast -- only a few blocks away!

We had a fabulous week staying in Savannah's house, 10 min walk to the subway gave us easy access to anywhere. The local area has plenty of choices for delis and several eating out options within a few minutes walk. THe immediate area was quiet (by NYC standards) and people were very friendly. We didn't meet our host but communications were good and check in and out was easy. The house itself is lovely, my daughter enjoyed playing the piano. the master bedroom was super comfy. the bed in the second double room was quite firm but was fine for us, the single bed in the living room was ideal for our teenage son. We didn't cook but the kitchen was well equipped for anybody who wanted to use it. All in all, a great place to stay.

Le logement de Savannah est formidable. Un salon avec un divan hyper confortable, des lits super confortables aussi, 2 salles de bain (dont une pour la chambre des maîtres), une salle d'eau au rez-de-chaussée. Le style de l'appartement est magnifique. Savannah nous a donné de précieux conseils avant d'arriver à New York. Le dialogue avec elle est très simple. Nous n'avons pas eu besoin de ses services lors de notre séjour à New York. Le lieu où est situé l'appartement nous a un peu déçu. Le quartier n'est pas des plus accueillant mais tout est sécuritaire. Il ne faut pas se laisser impressionner par ce qu'on voit. Tout le monde est bien sympathique. Mais bon, ce n'est pas encore Williamsburgh, Greenpoint ou Bushwick. L'appartement est situé à 15 minutes du métro. Le soir, après une longue journée de marche à travers la ville, ça peut être un point négatif! Malgré tout ça, je recommande sans hésitation cet appartement.

We loved Savannah's house.   It exceeded our expectations. 
It was comfortable, clean, attractive, well-lit, well-equipped and with many interesting touches - art works, quirky furniture etc.  Bathrooms and bedrooms were absolutely up to standard.  

Having a piano was a bonus.

Thank you Savannah and Carsten.
Everything was perfect ! We've loved Savannah's lovely home, very comfortable and well decorated. My family and I have had a great time here. We highly recommend this place !
Geweldig huis in een opkomende buurt. Vlakbij winkels en restaurants.
great stay! large, two bedroom, two floors.  good kitchen for a full thanksgiving feast!

We enjoyed our stay in Savannah’s home! I like the clean, stylish and lovely house. 
Bathroom and bed are very clean and comfortable.
We are really satisfied our stay.

Loved this place! Lots and lots of quirky atmosphere, 10 minutes walk from Utica Avenue Station on the A or C line which takes you directly into Manhattan. The place was super clean, with all amenities as described by Susannah. If you like cooking like me, the kitchen is your dream come true. Cozy, nice and warm in these winter days, we truly enjoyed staying and would love to repeat the stay some time in the future.

we had great day and feel like at home, it is very well located, you can move through Brooklyn by bus and in Manhattan by subway, many nice restaurants within small walk and people around are nice and friendly, we like to come back one day.

Me and my friends stayed in this awesome house for 9 nights. We lived without any inconvenience during our stay here. Also, it was warm even though there was a snow storm.

Good atmosphere, comfortable and a stylish interior.

There were many subway stations, bus stops and marts near the house.

We loved it so much, thank you.

Das Haus in Brooklyn war genau das, was wir gesucht hatten. Die Bilder beschreiben das Haus ziemlich gut. Die Ausstattung ist super, es lässt sich alles damit kochen. Fast direkt nebenan ist ein kleiner Laden und mehrere Subway Stationen sind in 10 min Laufentfernung. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist großartig.
Savannah is a wonderful host. The home was clean, beautiful designed and easily accessible to where we needed to get to. Highly recommend!

neighborhood_overview: Palm Beach, affectionately known as 'Palmy', is situated at the end of Barrenjoey Peninsula, less than an hour's drive from Sydney Harbour Bridge, the Opera House and the CBD. Palm Beach is blessed with a unique contrast of lush evergreen bushland and beaches of golden sand, and enveloped by the pristine waters of the Pacific Ocean and the calm sailing paradise of Pittwater. Just a short boat ride and a packed lunch and you're able to enjoy some of the most beautiful and isolated beaches in Sydney.
transit: Palm Beach is accessible by a few different methods, the most interesting of which is by Sea plane, either Sydney Seaplanes or Sydney by Seaplane are able to get you there safely. From Sydney airport you can pre book a shuttle bus, try My Shuttle or ASN or grab a taxi or Uber for the fastest journey door to door. If you have time on your side, there's a train to the city and then the L90 bus to Palm Beach.
access: The guest has the entire apartment to themselves to enjoy. Access to the apartment is via the building front door back gate and roller door. Early check in can be arranged by prior arrangement with host.

reviews.comments: Ótimo apartamento na zona sul do Rio de Janeiro. Super limpo, espaçoso e bem equipado. Recomendo.

We stayed here for three nights and Paulo and his daughter were in constant contact with us  helping to answer any questions as well as providing useful tourist information. Upon arrival they had printed some suggested restaurants and some local landmarks to help us navigate around easier. They also met us on arrival to walk us through the apartment. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. These are by far the best hosts that I have ever had at an air BNB, can't say enough about how great they both were.

Fui com mais dois amigos e tivemos uma ótima estadia! O Paulo e a Cláudia (esposa) são muito receptivos e dispostos. O apartamento é bem localizado (metrô, restaurantes, supermercado) e muito aconchegante!
Apartamento excelente, limpo e confortável.

Non posso dire altro che grazie, l’appartamento è stato perfetto, la nostra settimana a Rio è stata fantastica perché avevamo questo posto per poterci riposare ogni volta volevamo! Tutti i comfort presenti, per una famiglia è l’ideale. Zona tranquilla, supermercato sotto casa aperto fino alle 10! 
Fantastico, lo consiglio vivamente!
Grazie Laura

Estivemos no Rio no Reveillon de 2018 e adoramos tudo! O apartamento é muito bem localizado, com mercado, padaria e restaurantes na mesma rua, e também fica de fácil à pontos turísticos.
Sobre o apartamento, é muito idêntico às fotos, tudo muito limpo e bem equipado. O apartamento possui portaria 24h, quartos grandes e bem ventilados. Podemos destacar a recepção e hospitalidade do Paulo, que foi muito gentil e nos deu muitas dicas ótimas para aproveitarmos nossa estadia no Rio. 
Sem dúvidas voltaremos em breve! Obrigada por tudo Paulo, foi ótimo estar em seu apartamento!

I often visit RIO but this expérience was the best ever. The flat was so clean. Paulo Cesar is so helpfull an reactive + informations available about restaurants, bars. Supermarket just downstairs. Everything is done to make you Feel at home. Even the doormen smile downstairs  (not so common in rio). I will come back and definitly recommand to friends.  Thks again Paulo Cesar.

Paulo e Claudia foram atenciosos e nos deixaram a vontade. Lugar exatamente como nas fotos. Limpo, bem localizado, todo reformado e com tudo o que precisamos! Metrô pertinho, perto do Aterro! Padaria muito boa a meio quarteirão! Recomendo!

Paulo e sua esposa foram muito simpáticos e atenciosos no que diz respeito à dicas do RJ. Não foi preciso levar nada, o ap tem toalhas e roupas de cama à disposição.
Recomendaria, se fosse possível um ar condicionado na sala (O Rio é muito quente!!!) Mas não é nada que desabone o ap que é muito limpo. A internet também é excelente, assim como o quadro de canais da tv a cabo - Parabéns!!!
Recomendo muito o local e quando retornarmos para o RJ certamente procuraremos ficar no mesmo lugar!

O apartamento e muito confortável, limpíssimo, e muito agradável. O predio tb e muito limpo e agradável, com funcionários simpáticos e prestativos.
O bairro e ótimo com varias facilidades no entorno como supermercado, banco, restaurantes ,bares,  farmácia, etc. Muito próximo das praias de Copacabana, Ipanema e Leblon e aeroporto Santos Dumont.
A única critica e que a rua onde esta o predio e bem movimentada tendo um pouco de barulho na parte da manha,  mas não me incomodou muito, isto por  que moro num bairro muito silencioso e não estou acostumada com barulho.
Mas gostei muito de me hospedar nesse apto e voltarei novamente.

Apartanento maravilhoso, muito bem equipado, limpo, tudo Novo.

A uma quadra da praia do Flamengo.
Recepção maravilhosa do Paulo e da Claudia, muito atenciosos.

Locação excelente, fica perto de Metro, supermercados, farmácias e praia. O paulo e a Claudia são muitos simpáticos, ajudaram-me muito.
Paulo's hospitality is incredible. This place is amazing, cozy and with a good energy. A lot of services at walking distance. This host makes the Airbnb greater.
Lugar ótimo. Localização excelente. Muito bem recebido pelo (Website hidden by Airbnb) certeza voltarei.

Great Location, Excellent local tips, Grocery Store on the 1st floor (easy to haul groceries and water just up the elevator), and $R10 uber ride to Copacabana beach.  Best place to stay a bit away from the tourist locations and still be able to have a great time at Copacabana or Ipanema beaches.  Local tips for easy no hassle visits to Christo Redentor and Pao de Azucar.  The space was comfortable, clean, and secure.  Lots of hot water and great water pressure.  All around an excellent stay.  There is only one air conditioner in the apartment, which is in the master bedroom.  Just something to be aware of if you have guests who will be sleeping in the second bedroom.  There is a ceiling fan in the second bedroom but no AC.  I would recommend staying here.

This place is amazing . Great apartment with most of the amenities you need. Washer in the house , great internet, cable, the beds are very comfortable, the area is safe and there is a concierge there 24/7. The host are amazing and always ready to help if you have a problem. They are extremely professional, polite and courteous. I go to Rio every year and I will rent again with them for sure.
The apartment is exactly like the photos and has everything necessary for a great stay in Rio! The hosts are super nice and helpful. Thank you Paulo and Claudia!

O apartamento é incrível. Extremamente limpo, confortável e com uma localização invejável. O Paulo é uma ótima pessoa, foi sempre super atencioso e simpático com a gente. A estadia foi tão agradável, que nos fez sentir-se em casa, sem sombra de dúvidas voltaremos outras vezes.

A Cláudia e o Paulo são anfitriões excelentes e de muito bom gosto. O apartamento é bastante confortável, bem limpo e com tudo funcionando muito bem. A localização do prédio é ótima, e os porteiros são muito simpáticos. Espero que esteja disponível na próxima vez que eu voltar ao Rio.

Vanessa was amazing. She answered every question promptly for us. The location was quiet but close to restaurants and everything else. We had a wonderful time at rosira house. Thanks Vanessa!

The flat is very well located, just near the historic center and 5 minutes walking of the night life. It is very quiet though as the street is a small one. Close to many sites you want to see.  Easy to walk and see everything.  Great nightlife nearby also.

Vanessa es una persona muy amable,  la atención fue muy buena, su departamento esta muy bien ubicado y equipado con lo necesario, es bastante amplio, la decoración es muy linda, lo cual hace más agradable la estadía, muy recomendable.
Nice apartment at a top location in Porto. Very friendly and helpful host.
Nous avons passés un excellent séjour dans cet appartement qui est très fonctionnel. Vanessa est à l'écoute et se met à notre disposition ! Nous recommandons vivement ce logement.
Curtimos do pouco tempo que passemos na Rosita House. A Vanessa é uma senhora muito simpática e a casa é agradável para um fim de semana no Porto
Obrigada pela hospedagem mas penso que deveria ser melhorado no quesito mofo.
The apartment was really nice, vanessa was a very friendly host. Thank you Vanessa!!

The appartment is very clean, spacious and comfortable (good bed, shower, etc.). Location is very central. Litterally one minute walk to close by bars and restaurants. Vanessa is a great host who will help you with anything you need and she is always available for any questions (very quick response on my messages). Definately recommended!
Had a great stay at Vanessa's place. Very clean and comfortable. She was available and had recommendations for our short stay in Porto.

L appartamento e semplice ma dotato di tutto ciò che serve : cucina con tutti gli accessori e macchinetta del caffè- asciugamani-shampo bagnoschiuma . La posizione è centrale, scendendo una scala ci sono locali ristoranti pub-la metro e a pochi minuti. Tutte le attrazioni principali sono a 10minuti di camminata.

Vanessa's place is very good!! Close to everything, clean and comfortable for 4 people (also for kids). She provided us with a kid-bed and kid-chair! We really enjoy our stay in Porto also thanks to this apartment! We definitely recommend it!

host.host_about:
Hi everyone!

We are Eva & Jacques and we work in the travel and tourism industry. Our company is AB Apartment Barcelona. What we aim to do is offer each of our guests the best Barcelona experience, from start to finish. So as soon as you begin to book your stay right up until the moment you leave Barcelona, my team and I will be available to help you with any questions you might have, or even just to offer you some friendly advice. 

We have one office open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, meaning you can contact us anytime you want, day or night. We speak many languages between us, and we’re all tourism professionals. Plus, we know all the best places to go in Barcelona, from sights and attractions to bars and restaurants (including where the locals go) so we can help you make your time in the city the most memorable with our insider tips ;)

By renting your apartment in Barcelona through me, you’ll be in safe hands.

We looking forward to meeting you soon!

Die Wohnung ist hochwertig eingerichtet und liegt mit Blick auf den Placa de Catalunya sehr gut. Eigentlich perfekt. 

Leider hat der in der Wohnung zu hörende Lärm den Aufenthalt teilweise zur Qual gemacht, so dass ich diesen vorzeitig abbrechen musste (s. unten). Die noch einige Zeit existierende Großbaustelle im Nebenhaus wurde in der Beschreibung leider verschwiegen. Ab 7:30 Uhr morgens sind Bohren und Hämmern oft durchgehend bis abends in teils unerträglicher Lautstärke zu hören. Aber auch ohne diese Baustelle sind Vibrationen und Rumpeln der Metrolinien bis 1 Uhr nachts und ab ca. 5 Uhr morgens zu hören. Für Personen mit leichtem Schlaf sicher eine Herausforderung.

Der Gastgeber AB Apartments (Eva & Jacques) ist ein gewerblicher Apartmentverwalter von fast 200 Apartments und kennt daher zwangsläufig nicht die tatsächliche Situation jedes einzelnen Apartments. Bereits die Frage, ob das Schlafzimmer zur Straße heraus liegt, konnte nicht beantwortet werden. Nachteilig ist ebenfalls, dass man die Schlüssel zur Unterkunft nur im Büro von AB Apartments abholen kann und nicht direkt am Apartment. 
AB Apartments konnte mir immerhin eine deutlich günstigere Ausweichunterkunft anbieten, verweigerte aber die Erstattung der Differenz. Nur durch die Mediationsstelle von Airbnb konnte eine Erstattung erreicht werden.

Damit überwiegen die negativen Erfahrungen mit Eva & Jacques leider die positiven.


ENGLISH
The apartment is very well furnished and has a good view to the Placa de Catalunya. Nearly perfect. 

Unfortunately, the noise to be heard in the apartment made the stay partly a torture, so that I had to cancel the stay prematurely (see below). The construction site in the adjoining house was unfortunately not mentioned in the description. From 7:30 in the morning, drilling and hammering can often be heard continuously until evening, sometimes at unbearable volume. But even without this construction site, vibrations and rumbling of the metro lines can be heard until 1 o'clock at night and from about 5 o'clock in the morning. A challenge for people with a light night's sleep.

The host AB Apartments (Eva & Jacques) is a commercial apartment manager of almost 200 apartments and therefore inevitably does not know the actual situation of each individual apartments. Already the question whether the bedroom is facing the street could not be answered. Another disadvantage is that the keys to the accommodation can only be picked up in the office of AB Apartments and not directly at the apartment. 
After all, AB Apartments could offer me a notably cheaper alternative accommodation to the noisy apartment, but refused to refund the difference. Only through the mediation center of Airbnb a refund could be achieved.

Thus the negative experiences with Eva & Jacques unfortunately outweigh the positive ones.

We had great communication from the host & the check in (located at an office near by) was really efficient ! The location is fab - right on plaça catalunya close to metro, taxi’s and buses. Unfortunately due to building work next door or above at 7:45 everyday bar Sunday we were woken by drilling and hammering all day with no respite (I accept this is external) but the building work looks on going & the metro line underneath rumbles so the building vibrates every few mins . The air con was a much needed asset & worked great ! A few issues which previous people have mentioned - the shower in the second bathroom leaks badly and floods the floor which makes it really dangerous & slippery. Some items have been damaged / chipped  and probably need throwing out or replacing. Few light bulbs didn’t work & could do with checking / replacing.

The house was in a lovely location, yet quiet and peaceful .. he also has a garden and we were able to have some fruit. He has a lot of good recommendations on the area or what ever you want to know. Obrigada Joaquim you're the best!!!! :D if we are back in Porto we know exactly where to stay !!
The best night of my trip to Portugal. The welcome was great and the hospitality second to none. I had so much fun. Thank you

Encore merci Joaquim ! Nous avons passées 3 jours vraiment très spéciaux. Tu es une belle personne. Je recommande aux voyageurs qui passent dans le coin de faire un détour par chez toi. Je n'ai plus de mots pour décrire ces beaux moments passés avec toi. Merci. 
Tiffany et Angéline.

Une super expérience pour moi. Joaquim saura vous recevoir comme il se doit ! C'est une personne adorable, toujours disponible et près à vous aider. L'endroit est typiquement portugais, très propre et agréable ; c'est la campagne.  J'ai eu droit aux repas locaux et à quelques initiations au ukulélé. Je conseille vivement l'endroit pour ceux qui veulent s'immerger pleinement dans le lifestyle portugais, et moi qui n'ai jamais parlé la langue, ça n'as pas été une barrière! A melhor pessoa que conhecemos em nossa viagem.

Recomendo muitíssimo!

If you walk the Camino Portugues and you don’t mind a little detour, you should stay at Joaquim’s place! I had a wonderful time there and enjoyed a lovely conversation as well as amazing food / wine. A very unique and authentic experience!

joaquin ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit.

Obrigada da alma para hospitalidade. Foi a melhor experienca airbnb. Eu recomenda com toda confianca.

accueil et generosité

Die Unterkunft liegt etwas abseits des Jakobsweges. Joaquim ist sehr gastfreundlich und hilfsbereit. Er verwöhnt seine Gäste sobald diese das Haus betreten.
Das Bett ist für große Menschen  (>180 cm) etwas zu klein. Ansonsten ist alles vorhanden was benötigt wird.

Joaquim laisse sa maison comme notre maison, les parties communes sont en libre accès. Notre chambre donnait sur la route et donc un peu bruyante au passage des véhicules. Nous sommes venus en moto et elle a dormi à l abri. Joaquim est une personne très accueillante.

O Joaquim foi super atencioso e acolhedor. A sua casa, apesar de antiga é bastante acolhedora e muito limpa. Os meus pais adoraram a estadia e a minha mãe ficou encantada com o seu quintal! Totalmente recomendable, estuvimos dos días en su casa y ha sido una experiencia que repetir,  Joaquim es un hombre muy amable que te hace sentir como si estuvieses en tu propia casa

Nous avons passés une merveilleuse semaine chez Joachim. La maison de Joachim se situe dans la campagne, plutôt calme et pittoresque, à seulement quelques kilomètres de plusieurs belles villes accessibles par le bus. Joachim est une personne merveilleuse pleine de joie, une personne chaleureuse qui vous fais vous sentir chez vous dés votre arrivée, très arrangeante et pleine de bons plans. 
Je recommande chaudement cet hôte !

Joaquim est un super hôte, très attentionné avec qui la communication  a été très bonne malgré la différence de langues. En mélangeant français et anglais nous avons réussi à bien nous comprendre.
La maison est située à 20 min en voiture de l’aéroport de Porto, très pratique si comme nous vous souhaitez passer une dernière nuit avant d’attraper un vol en matinée.
Je recommande vivement!

neighborhood_overview: Around Casa Flores good wine, good food, the most traditional products and all the essentials, the best view, the romantic walks and the main touristic landmarks are guaranteed. Still it is also a quiet residential area, accessible, in the heart of Old Gaia, 10 minutes walking distance from Porto historical centre and 30 minutes away from the beach by public transport. In the streets that surround Casa Flores you will smell the aroma of the worldwide famous nectar, Port Wine. If your going for a tasting you just need to walk out the front door and go for a few metres to the most renowned cellars: Offley, Sandeman, Calém, Ferreirinha, etc. And if you enjoy good food as much as good wine try the typical restaurants in the neighbouring streets. Or you can always buy some genuine produce in the grocery stores next door, take it home and cook your own portuguese inspired meal.
transit: We suggest that you walk and explore the surroundings, go across the river through the D. Luiz I bridge, get on the old tram to the beach in Porto or get a bus to the beaches in Gaia. You can also enjoy the view over the city by cablecar. Our location is perfect to travel by bus, boat or walking. And if you want to go a little bit further you can also get a train (10 minutes walking distance) and discover other precious gems in the region.
house_rules: - Please note that between 10 pm and 10 am you should avoid loud noises and high heels in the apartment, the common areas and the front of the building in order to respect your neighbours.  - Access to people outside the booked guests are not allowed without previous notification. - Please note that you cannot give your house keys to anyone. - Please leave the kitchen area tiddy. -Lighting of candles is not allowed. - When leaving the apartment please be sure all the electrical equipments are turned off and all the windows closed as well as all the doors.

reviews.comments:
The apartment that is located on the south bank and very close to the river and the famous bridge but located in some small street so it is quieter.
It was comfortable and clean.
Gisela was kind and gave me some advice about the city.

Gisela has been an amazing host and her flat is incredibly cute. It is in an old building that has belonged to her family for a long time, and it has been renovated very well and with taste. The room is cosy but it has everything you would need for a few days stay. We arrived at 2 am because our flight was late and Gisela waited for us to welcome us.. She has been really professional and extremely kind, making us feel at home and being there for us all the time. The flat is on the south bank of the river, where the port wineries are, but really close to the city centre. Plus it's a very nice walk to do in the morning and it takes about 8-10 mins max. I would definitely come here again and I loved my stay, thanks Gisela!

Gisela's place is wonderful and newly renovated so everything is very clean. Although I didn't meet Gi myself, she was very friendly and helpful in our messages. Her lovely cousin Joana met me at the place and was really kind and helpful. The room itself had almost everything I needed for my stay with lots of additional treats such as sample of local wine! The area is right next to the river front of Vila Nova de Gaia and all the sights but is in a quiet side street so you get the convenience of a quiet nights sleep and easy access to beautiful views. I had no issues and would thoroughly recommend :)
The appartment is located in the great place. It is near the vine cellars on the opposite site of Ribeira. Very comfortable and modern studio!

First of all, Gisela is the loveliest and most interesting person! Checking in was a breeze, the directions given for the trip from the airport were simple to follow and accurate and she was waiting for us when we got there. Gisela gave us the best recommendations for places to eat in Porto!

The studio itself is exactly as shown in the pictures. It was very clean, new and everything was in working order. The bed was very comfortable. We note that our unit was on the 2nd floor and the steps were a bit uneven but manageable. The windows let in alot of light (which I loved). The shower had sufficient volume and power and everything worked and was in good condition. Would highly recommend this place for 2 persons on a short break! The area is very close to the river and but is just off to one side and very quiet!

Bonito apartamento bien situado.  A 5min de la Rivera de oporto por el imponente puente Luis I, Pero muy tranquilo.
Aunque es pequeño, tiene todo lo necesario para una  escapada de varios días. Anfitriona atenta y muy simpática, fue flexible en horarios de  entrada y salida.

Very nice stay. We checked in late without any Problems. Gisela was very kind and helpful. The flat was small but very clean and had everything you need. The flat is near of many wine cellars and near to the river. Nevertheless it was very quiet in the street so we could sleep well. All in all a lovely shelter for two people.

Great place to stay at Porto. Formally, it's not exactly Porto, but that's even better since you'll always have a beautiful view to Porto and be close to portwine cellars! It is really good located too: not so far away from the historical centre of the Porto and pretty quiet and cozy at the same time. Gisela was very helpful and made a great introduction to the city! We'll definitely recommend this place!
Gisela is the greatest host ever! She took her time showing me around and gave me a few very useful tips. Following her advice I saw Porto the way locals do. Highly recommended!

Que dire sur notre expérience chez Gisela si ce n'est que tout était parfait. Elle nous a chaleureusement accueilli le premier jour, avec une multitude de bons plans pour visiter au mieux Porto. Elle est d'une grande gentillesse et toujours là en cas de problème ou si l'on souhaite plus d'informations au cours du séjour. Pour ce qui est de l'appartement, il est parfait pour un weekend prolongé à deux. Très propre et très bien situé, le quartier est très agréable, à deux minutes à peine des rives du Douro et de la vue splendide sur le coeur de Porto. Bref je vous conseille de foncer chez Gisela pour une belle expérience dans cette charmante ville.
This is the perfect spot for a porto vacation. The room is clean, cozy and comfortable.  Gi is truly a superhost, she knows Porto and is so warm and welcoming...we will return. Thanks for everything!

La casa di Gisela è in una posizione fantastica. È curata, pulitissima e profumata. Gisela è stata molto precisa nel darci tutte le informazioni per entrare, dal momento che era fuori città. consiglieremo sicuramente il suo appartamento!!!!

Magnifique appartement, très romantique. Idéal pour un petit séjour en amoureux.
L'appartement est proche de tout, et très bien situé.
L'hôte est accueillante et attentionnée.

Gisela was so helpful, and although I didn't actually get to meet her she was always on hand if we needed anything at all. Her place is in a wonderful setting, within easy walking distance of everything you'd want to see in Porto. Really clean flat, and Gisela was also able to help out with my early check-in and request to leave my bags at hers for the morning we checked out. 
Absolutely perfect place to stay for a weekend in Porto, thanks very much!

Perfect little studio if you want to visit the port wineries. They're all within easy walking distance. The studio is very well taken care of and has a kitchenette if you wanted to stay in and cook. Everything was very clean and adorable. We would definitely stay here again.

Kaunis ja siisti asunto hyvällä sijainnilla kaikkien portviinikellareiden lähellä. Pienestä keittiöstä löytyi kaikki tarpeellinen aamiaisen syömiseen ja Wi-Fi toimi erinomaisesti. Lähellä rannassa paljon ravintoloita ja sillan yli pääsee kätevästi toiselle puolelle Portoa. Suosittelen lämpimästi!
Gisela's place is perfect. Nice, comfortable, clean, well-equipped, we loved it. The location is also good, close to the riverside with lots of restaurants, cafes.
Great location and quiet neighborhood. The studio is ideal for couples who want to visit the city for 2-3 days. Gi was very nice and helpful from the start.

Posto assolutamente raccomandato, una permanenza meravigliosa! L'alloggio è veramente curato in ogni dettaglio e la pulizia è eccellente. È fornito di un angolo cottura per chi volesse prepararsi qualcosa da mangiare a casa. Quando si arriva tutto è preparato per farti sentire a casa, nulla è lasciato al caso! Comodissimo per visitare le cantine, e comunque molto comodo anche per visitare il centro storico. Gisel offre ottimi consigli su cosa visitare e dove andare a mangiare, è la Host ideale!
Perfectly located, the house is great and Gisela a really nice host.
Sitio encantador y perfecto para visitar Oporto. La infitriona un encanto. Nos ha encantado.
Recomended

Gisela was a very good host, always available for every question, the apartment is lovely and in a perfect location (near the wine cellars, which is always good ;)), in a very quite area but still near everything you might need!
Great, quite apt right in cellars. Recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay There. The apartment is bigger and nicer than in the pictures. Close to 2 parkings and tout restaurants as well. 10 minutes walk from Porto center. I recommend to anyone.
Perfect location, cozy apartment, friendly and helpful owner. Superb!

We had a perfect time at Gisela's place.  Apartament is big enough for 2. Very cosy and sweet. We even get a welcome drink;) we recommend this place for couples for a romantic stay. Good location, next to restaurants and wineries but not in the noisy city center.

We had a great stay at Gi's apartment. The building has been recently renovated with modern fittings and appliances. It's just a short walk to the Port wineries and the bridge over to the city, and there are several nice restaurants nearby. Recommended!

A lovely clean and beautifully decorated studio among the port cellars. A couple of minutes walk from all the action in front of Cruz and Sandeman, the cable car and the river taxi, yet nice and quiet at night. Gi made us feel very welcome and catered for our early arrival.

Gisela was very forthcoming and warm-hearted during the whole organization. She has a great repertoire of tips and advices of what to do, and was flexible regarding the check-in. The apartment is comfy and corresponds exactly to the pictures. And its location is perfect! Thank you very much Gisela!

This flat is even more charming than the town of Porto! I went with my husband for a quick weekend visit. Every detail was stylish and sweet - I loved the way the wifi password was "published" :) The flat is well-equipped, you can really find everything that is needed for a comfortable stay. It's a pity we couldn't meet Gisela in person, but maybe next time! :)

Gi’s place is perfect... location is very special, yet cozy and quiet for a visit to historic Porto. Communication was also piece of cake and very quick response in case of any need... lots of thoughtful touches in the flat to make you feel at home. Thanks again! I highly recommend staying here. Great value on all points.
Apartamento excelente, muito aconchegante, com estilo e muito bem localizado, certamente será a nossa escolha na próxima ida ao Porto.

We loved our stay here! Gisela was the most amazing host, welcoming us in person with great tips and a lovely local gift on arrival. The location was close to the wine cellars and waking distance to the rest of the city. The studio felt brand new, it was warm, and extremely clean and tidy and made us feel at home. The studio is perfect, located amongst the famous wine cellars. Everything was super clean, we had everything we needed and we were looking forward to coming back home after the whole day walking around and exploring Porto! :) Absolutely loved it and would recommend!

Gorąco polecamy!idealne mieszkanko dla pary na kilkudniowy pobyt w Porto. Idealna lokalizacja, pomocna gospodyni i magiczna atmosfera mieszkanka sprawila, że nasz pobyt był wyjątkowy.

This is such a hot spot! Perfect location and the presentation is amazing! Very impressed and very comfortable! I will definitely return! Many mahalos for the great experience

Perfect location! Walk in to beautiful ocean. The location is so peaceful that you can hear the wave sound all day. The house and room are vey clean and comfortable.

Dominique is wonderful, she goes out of her way to make you feel welcome and respected in her home. Location is unbelievable, close to downtown and right by the ocean! Absolutely would recommend to a friend and can't wait to stay here again! :)

Really wel’ Managed !!  I would definitely go back and suggest this perfect place right on the beach :)

Dominique, was an amazing host, she went above and beyond to make it a great experience. Very helpful and  generous.  The home was very cozy and welcoming.  Even her dog was generous and helped me open a coconut! Lol  I would definitely stay here again and tell friends to stay here when in Kona.

Her place was oceanfront which was wonderful and the bamboo room was on the ground floor—very convenient.  Really enjoyed my stay!

Great spot!
Great room, great location and very friendly host. We enjoyed the stay very much

We had a great time! Dominique was great and super accomodating.

Bamboo room is quiet and peaceful. Beautiful sunsets every evening! Gracious host. Thanks for everything!

The Bamboo room was very quiet, cozy and the bed was really comfortable! The condo is very well located and Dominique and Linda was so kind and nice with us! We will keep great memories from our stay ! Thank you :)

Mahalo!

very nice room well located close to downtown

Dominique was a great host. We really enjoyed chatting with her and all the suggestions she provided us with of places to visit in and around Kona. Also, we loved playing with her cute and friendly dog. The place is located in a good  spot in Kona that was fairly quiet and close to the beach. We would still recommend having a rental car or using the trolley to get around the rest of Kona. The condo itself is old and there was a few plumbing issues and leaks during our stay which wasn't so fun to deal with while on vacation. Now saying that Dominique was very quick to have the problems resolved and acted professionally. The bed was comfortable and we slept well but the curtains are thin and a lot of light shines through the windows around 6:30am, it didn't really bother us as we are early risers but to others it may be annoying. A lot of guests buy beach chairs, umbrellas, mats etc. during there stay and then have left it at the house which you are able to borrow when going to the beach. This was a nice added touch as it saved us from having to buy or rent.
A wonderful location, great host, and comfortable bed!!

neighborhood_overview: El Eixample (Ensanche) es uno de los distritos más populares de Barcelona. Fue diseñado por el urbanista Idelfons Cerdà, quien se basó en el flujo del tráfico y el aprovechamiento de la luz solar para ampliar la ciudad. El Eixample se caracteriza por sus bloques de casas con forma octogonal, sus amplias calles y su carácter residencial y comercial. Está dividido en dos zonas, el Eixample Esquerre (Izquierdo) y el Eixample (Dret) Derecho, en las que encontrará una amplia oferta de tiendas y establecimientos de restauración. El Eixample Esquerre está delimitado por el Passeig de Gràcia y la Plaça d´Espanya, donde se localiza el recinto ferial de Montjuïc y la fuente mágica. También en el Eixample Esquerra está el Parc de Joan Miró, presidido por la escultura "La mujer y el pájaro" de este conocido artista catalán, y el centro comercial de las Arenas, ubicado en una antigua plaza de toros. Hi everyone!

We are Eva & Jacques and we work in the travel and tourism industry. Our company is AB Apartment Barcelona. What we aim to do is offer each of our guests the best Barcelona experience, from start to finish. So as soon as you begin to book your stay right up until the moment you leave Barcelona, my team and I will be available to help you with any questions you might have, or even just to offer you some friendly advice. 

We have one office open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, meaning you can contact us anytime you want, day or night. We speak many languages between us, and we’re all tourism professionals. Plus, we know all the best places to go in Barcelona, from sights and attractions to bars and restaurants (including where the locals go) so we can help you make your time in the city the most memorable with our insider tips ;)

By renting your apartment in Barcelona through me, you’ll be in safe hands.

We looking forward to meeting you soon!

First off, Jacque dispelled all of the negative things and nightmares we have heard about air bnb.  The apartment was very modern and equipped with all the necessities a family of 2, 3, or 4 may need.  It is located in one the most beautiful locations in Barcelona. Every morning we had the options of a cafe right downstairs or fresh fruits or an upscale supermarket 2 blocks away. Our son is very finicky with food so it was cool to have chicken wings and fries as an option at the corner (lol) You are in walking distance of all the local transportation (metro). Taxis are readily available right outside your door which are affordable when going to the city. My husband actually ran 3 miles to the beach took a swim and ran back, that's how convenient this location is. Just wanted to say very special thank you to Jacque For making our first time using air bnb a superb experience. You are what one dreams of when doing business from abroad or locally. You were consistent, punctual, caring, alert to our concerns and most importantly and this where most people doing business fail......you communicated consistently and made us feel like you genuinely cared about our well being. For that my my family and I thank you considerably. We look forward to contacting you in the near future for other trips abroad...btw we will be referring you as we have already begun to do to many of our close friends and associates. Thank you, thank you, thank you.

Eva&Jacques (E&J) have a lovely modern apartment here and run a very professional AirBNB. we stayed for 5 nights and explored the city, and each night the apartment was our sanctuary to come home to. E&J are very responsive to any requests, and answered all of our questions very quickly through email or text. A few very minor things were highlighted and E&J sent maintenance people that day to sort it out. very impressive.
Apartment is located in the Eixample District which is positioned between the hubub of the main town, and the Sants and Placa d'Espanya areas, so generally well located for all needs. It is ideal for families as it is a quiet area, although there can be some traffic noise as the apartment is on a busy road (but for children this is better than party people shouting and bottles smashing you would get in the centre of town, and the combination of very good double glazing and air-conditioning was not an issue at all). 
Our kids loved the offset bunkbeds, which meant bed time was a synch.
The area seemed to be in the process of a regeneration, and we even noticed a BrewDog on the corner one block away which could be a good or bad sign! but in general a lovely friendly neighbourhood.
The only minor negatives (as mentioned by others) the shower was rubbish and needs replacing, and the kitchen could do with a few more basic utensils.
But to sum up. we are already planning our next trip to Barcelona, and we plan to stay with E&J. thank you Eva & Jacques for a great introduction to a lovely city.

Great & quick responses from host. Apartment is as mentioned. Parking was a bit difficult but regardless it was close to many amenities. The apartment is located on the first floor and one can either walk to it or use elevator. This is a one bedroom apartment with three tiny balconies overlooking to a small street perpendicular to the greater street passing along the beaches. The ocean is near and one can see it from the balconies just turning head to the left. And definetely one can hear the ocean from the apartment. There was not much furniture in the apartment, but all the necessary  items (double bed, tables, chairs, sofa, wardrobes, etc.) were there. The apartment was equipped with electric stove with oven, dish washer, microwave oven, coffee machines, washing machine and TV. Although the last one didn't work (I suppose because of unpaid cable subscription) - but who needs a TV when the ocean is nearby!
There was no Wi-Fi, but there was excellent coverage for Vodafone 4G prepaid SIM card in the apartment.
We stayed in the apartment at October and it was quite cold in it. The problem is that the sun never looks at the narrow street and the apartment windows. Although I suppose it may be a good feature during summer hot weather. As for free parking near the beaches - this feature is definetely better during cold seasons - during summer it might be crowded.
For me the bed matress was too hard and be prepared that one night you may be attacked by mosquitos (get ready a fumigator).
When I was booking the apartment via Airbnb I corresponded with Natalia who spoke Portuguese only, but when I arrived I've got a phone call from a man (speaking English and French) who said that he was owner of the apartment. The keys were given to me by the man's sister who provided me very good introduction in plain English (I'd like to thank her again here!). Unfortunately I could not contact the owner directly because the phone number given at the site was unreachable. A day before leave I was visited by a Portuguese only speaking man who said he was another owner of the apartment. In result I little bit puzzled, but anyway I enjoyed the staying there! Thank you very much, the misterious owner!

neighborhood_overview: Eixample is Catalan for ´extension´, meaning an extension of the old Barcelona city. Eixample was designed by Catalan-born urban planning visionary, Ildefons Cerdà, who took traffic and sunlight (amongst many other things) into consideration when creating the plans for this new district. Eixample is now characterised by its octagonal blocks and its grid-like pattern, with wide streets and both commercial and residential areas. It is split into two parts, Eixample Esquerra (Left, or in Spanish, Izquierdo) and Eixample Dret (Right, or in Spanish, Derecho), both of which are home to some fantastic restaurants and stores. Eixample Izquierdo is delimited by the grand, Passeig de Gràcia, a paradise for shopping and dining, and Plaça d´Espanya, where the Montjuïc Magic Fountain and one of the biggest convention centres in Barcelona can be found. The Parc de Joan Miró, with its iconic ´Woman and Bird´ sculpture created by the Barcelona-born artist, is also situated here, as well as the Arenas

This apartment is modern and nice.  Comfortable beds and living area.  The shower stall is very small in the second bathroom and the hot water was somewhat erratic when people were getting ready in the morning.  Quiet at night and excellent window blinds to block light.

You will be using Metro a lot as this neighborhood is not itself full of sights or shopping.   Metro stop is about 8-10 minutes walk away.  The Barcelona metro system is excellent and clean.  

This place is managed by a large rental company which does make it seem a bit impersonal.   For checking in, you have to go to the rental office, then it is a long walk with luggage (especially in the heat) to get to the apartment.  The city blocks are really long in Barcelona!  Also, there were a couple strange things like having service personnel enter the apartment without asking or notifying us, and requiring guests to empty all apartment trash at checkout and put it into a dumpster down the street.  They did solicit guest input so I do have hope that these issues are addressed.  

Jacques and Eva, the Airbnb hosts, were outstanding and very quick in responding to our questions and offering assistance.  They checked in with  us via the Airbnb throughout our stay and offered to arrange a taxi if we needed it.

Definitely great value for money. Very nice apartment in a centrally located part of Barcelona. Easy access to all places of interest. 
Very communicable hosts and the checking in & out process couldn't have been any easier and accomadating. 
Thanks for having us.
Great place, better vibes. Highly recommended staying here

The apartment's location was very central and within walking distance to sights as well as two metro lines. It was updated and big enough for a couple and a third traveler. The rooms were not very big but for a city apartment, not too bad. It's probably helpful to know that one of the showers is European size which means if you're over 6 feet with broad shoulders, you probably can't fit in it. The beds were ok but  not super comfortable. We hoped the two single beds could be joined for extra room but they were different heights. Also, we were surprised to see that the courtyard (one of the main reasons we booked this space) was not on the room but in the middle of the apartment complex, on the ground level, and surrounded by other apartments. The only important issue we had during our stay was lack of internet for four out of the five days we were there which affected our ability to research and plan activities. The property management company attributed it to a building-wide issue. Lastly, only one person at a time could shower. There seemed to be very little cold water so one person ended up showering with excruciatingly hot water.  I notified the host for this issue but there was no acknowledgement of the issue or action taken.

Eva and Jacques were very responsive to questions. The apartment manager was very helpful and responsive, and are available 24 hours/day to sort out problems and answer questions. The keys are picked up from an office which is at a different location from the apartment, some renters may need to take a taxi if unable to walk with luggage (although the distance is walkable for some people). The apartment is well-located and easy walk to Placa Catalunya,  there are many restaurants, stores, taxis outside your doorstep. It is quiet at night. Be aware that there is a cat in the lobby and with that comes cat hair, litter box etc, which may not be desirable for everyone. The inside of the apartment was very clean, sparsely decorated with 4 dining chairs and a small couch. It has clean, comfortable beds and bedding/towels. Plan to bring own soaps, laundry, cleaning supplies,  etc as the limited supplies provided will not last for longer than a day or two.
Great location. Walking distance to Plaza Catalunya. Plenty of markets and restaurants within a short walk. Never heard a sound from neighbors, and security is very comfortable.

Минусы: у жилья нет хозяина, компания массово сдает апартаменты, это чувствуется, не хватает комфорта, уюта и продуманности некоторых вещей внутри. Отличные фото, яркие и красивые, вживую все несколько хуже, потому что фото сделаны, когда все было новым, постепенно апартаменты устаревают и за ними плохо следят. WiFi работает очень плохо, мы так и не поняли как включить горячую воду в душевой, шкафы и системы хранения отвратительные (нет полок и очень мало вешалок), мы не смогли разложить одежду, все лежало в чемоданах, даже нет вешалки/крючков для одежды на входе. Один матрас из 4 был не очень,  но можно неплохо выспаться, это не проблема. В целом кое-где что-то отваливается из фурнитуры, по мелочи. Мебель в гостиной и кухне в плохом состоянии, стол с повреждениями, диван пора поменять, сильно промят, выглядит плохо, телек показывает не все каналы, достаточно маленький. Кухня заслуживает отдельных слов, изначально сделана очень не продумано и плохо, теперь стала постепенно разваливаться, маленькая узкая посудомойка (в комплекте самые дешевые капсулы, вся посуда в разводах), микроволновка 2 метра от пола, очень неудобно, все полки очень высоко, если рост 170-175 крайне неудобно. В ванной и на кухне есть минимальный приветственный пакет для уборки, готовки, хим средства, салфетки, но это ровно на 1 день. Почему нельзя оставить обычный большой шампунь/гель для душа в ванной, зачем делать как в гостинице маленькие флаконы на 1 раз?! Так же соль, перец, масло на кухне!? Салфетки, губки!? Каждый гость покупает это все в полном объёме, оставляет, а Вы просто выкидываете. Резюмируя: стоимость достаточно адекватная для января (не сезон), но не хватает хозяина, который сделает чтобы гостям было удобно, комфортно и все было продумано. Второй раз я бы не остановилась, постоянно путешествую по Европе, можно найти апартаменты лучше за эти же деньги, но фото и описание сбивают с толку, кажется, что круто, приезжаешь и все немного не так.

L'appartamento si trova in una zona comoda centrale e ben servita da taxi autobus e facile per approvvigionarsi di cibo e cio' che serve per qualche giorno di permanenza. Unica pecca che il lavandino del bagno piu' grande restava con l'acqua stagnante e sotto la lavastoviglie quando si apriva si smontava il pezzo che copre i piedi della cucina.....piccolezze insomma nel complesso l'appartamento era pulito e con ascensore  al piano.....ah dimenticavo le tende nelle stanze da letto  io ce le avrei rimesse ;)

host.host_about:
I have a dwelling in Bondi Beach and live with my partner. I am often out trying new cafes, restaurants and bars throughout the city. In summer I love swimming at Ice Bergs pool or in one of the  many amazing beach and harbours in Sydney. I am passionate about local and handmade clothing and homeware products. I  frequent local organic farmers markets mostly Bondi beach and Double Bay, but also like The Carriage Works markets. When I am not attending to guests, I enjoy hand making my own clothing and tending to my honey bee hive. 

I am available to guests within 20 minutes from their property. I provide a 24 hour point of contact for guests. I do my best to keep the place perfectly maintained and hire professional cleaners  to make sure the place is in impeccable condition for incoming guests.

My two roommates and I were lucky to find a 5 night rental upon our arrival in Sydney. What initially started as a bad experience because of the overwhelming cigarette smell was improved when our host Elise came to freshen up the place that same night. Overall, an okay experience until the last day when it ended up being awful because of Elise’s passive aggressive and rude attitude. We asked Elise if we could leave our luggage after we checked out because we were gonna be in town all day and didn’t want to keep our luggages with us. In my messages I repeated multiple times that I would pick up my luggage in the evening. Elise agreed and in my thank you message I said we would swing by at night, she said have a good evening. Her instructions included washing the dishes and taking out the trash (which to my fault I didn’t see but we only left two dishes and left the trash in the basket). She stated we should be out by 10, we left the Airbnb at 9 and left our bags packed. I received an incredibly passive aggressive call at 3 asking why we hadn’t picked up the luggages and saying the place looked like a pig-stye (actual wording she used). The message had never stated a time to pick up the luggage and I had said evening/night at least three times in my request. She was extremely passive aggressive and disrespectful on the call. She asked when we would pick up the luggage because she had a dinner party that she would have to leave early from if we came in the evening. After stating that it would be incredibly inconvenient for her to leave her dinner party early multiple times, she then said she would have to charge us for keeping our luggage there. I firmly disagreed because it was not something she had mentioned before or something we had agreed to. I simply stated that if she had wanted to charge a fee she should’ve stated that before. She then began to ask if we were gonna leave a bad review, which genuinely came out of nowhere. I said no and she said that if we were gonna leave a bad review we were to come and pick up our bags immediately, but if we were gonna leave a good review we should chill where we were and we could come at night to pick up our bags. I thought this caveat was unprofessional, especially considering no time was set for us earlier. We were unhappy with this caveat so we said we would come pick up our bags immediately. She said that meant we were gonna leave a bad review and so she was gonna leave the Airbnb because she felt “threatened” (actual words again). The phone call was an awful 9 minutes that I would never repeat again. The phone call sourly ended with Elise saying she couldn’t wait...

Elise’s home is very close to the cutest eateries and not far from the main city at all. Couldn’t have chosen a better place to stay for New Years!

This apartment was a good choice for the provided amenities and convenient location. The walking distance to shops and cafes in Glebe was awesome for a visitor from out of town.

The fact that this apartment is on the first floor made air movement and noise in the evenings a little bit of an issue, but for the value that is just something to consider.

Overall this was a good experience!

This is an amazing modern creatively designed studio! We absolutely loved the interiors and thought put into making this space work. All the small bonus touches really made it feel like an hotel experience. The location is close enough to shops and cafes yet is still nestled amongst a quiet residential area.  Elise was great to deal with during the entire process, and communication was prompt friendly and honest. Would definitely stay again if we're in the area.  This is an absolute gem of a place if you're looking for a creative and stylish home at an affordable price point compared to your standard boxed apartment!

Great apartment in the city; we loved the location. The space was clean  and neatly furnished. Parking was better than anticipated as we found a parking spot close by each time. Elise was very friendly and helpful.
Elise was quick to reply and helpful with any questions we had! Beautiful and clean place, short walk to shops and take away places. Very kid friendly and fitted all our needs as a family of 5 :)
Great!
Great place & good hospitality
Great apartment! It was large, spacious, well equipped, and clean. Check-in and check-out was very easy/quick!
pretty good
地理位置十分好,旺中带静很有历史感,房东准备很充足,十分棒,下次来会再次入住
Great location, clean, modern and fully equipped

Elise responded very quickly and was a great host. The place was clean and provided all standard amenities. 
Walls must be thin as we could hear everything from the streets to next door neighbours. Other than that, convenient location and great accommodation. Would recommend. Thanks again Elise.

neighborhood_overview: As zonas circundantes do apartamento (Ribeira do Porto e Caves do Vinho do Porto) atraem milhares de turistas todos os anos. Ao hospedar-se no meu apartamento estará pertíssimo da zona ribeirinha com o seu casario colorido e ruelas antigas. Nesse local, existem imensos cafés e restaurantes simpáticos, onde poderá desfrutar da cozinha portuguesa tradicional, apreciar os maravilhosos vinhos portugueses e maravilhar-se com a vista fantástica do rio Douro e da Ribeira do Porto. A rua do apartamento, apesar de estar pertíssimo desses locais interessantes e animados, é bastante sossegada durante a noite, pois é uma rua de trânsito condicionado, o que lhe oferece o melhor de dois mundos.
transit: Os autocarros "Hop on/Hop off" param a poucos metros do apartamento na Avenida Diogo Leite (a avenida ribeirinha), onde existe também uma praça de táxis. A poucos metros de distância, poderá embarcar num cruzeiro pelo rio Douro. Junto ao cais de embarque, poderá também utilizar o teleférico até ao Mosteiro da Serra do Pilar e desfrutar da sua vista magnífica ou caminhar no tabuleiro superior da famosa ponte D. Luís I. Há uma estação de metro (estação de General Torres) a 600 metros do apartamento.
access: Terá acesso ao pátio, onde poderá saborear uma bebida ou uma refeição enquanto desfruta da brisa refrescante num dia quente de verão.
interaction: Estarei à sua espera durante o check-in, mostrar-lhe-ei o apartamento e os aparelhos/utensílios.  Como presente de boas-vindas, irei oferecer-lhe: 1 garrafa de água  1 pacote de sumo ou ice tea Bolachas “crackers” Café moído Cápsulas de café expresso Saquetas de chá  Açúcar Dar-lhe-ei dicas sobre os locais mais importantes a visitar no Porto. Poderei também recomendar alguns restaurantes para as suas refeições, onde vou habitualmente com a família e amigos, tudo para que possa ter a melhor experiência de viagem durante a sua estadia no Porto.
house_rules: - I aim to offer you the best experience during your visit to Porto. Enjoy this apartment as if it were yours. Please, keep it clean and tidy. - You may smoke on the patio. - Noise is not allowed from 10 pm until 9 am. - While the parking is free of charge at a local parking facility (always based on availability, which must be requested and confirmed at the time of the reservation), the guests will be fully responsible for any damage caused by them/their cars during their stay. In case of any damage, the guests must pay the total amount of damages caused.

host.host_about: I have always worked on multicultural environments. At first, as representative in Europe of portuguese textile companies; then, as owner of a textile decoration company where I had the opportunity to meet pleople from every part of the globe, as Fabric Purchasing Manager of a US-based company, and presently as owner of a translation & webdesign company which clients are located worldwide. I love to meet culturally different people and learn a bit more about their countries and their travel experiences.

reviews.comments: Clean, bright, airy, and incredibly comfortable! Located one block from the river and a short walk to great restaurants, wine tasting, and the historic center of the city. We LOVED Porto and look forward to staying here again next time. Couldn't have asked for a better situation.

We had a great time in Porto thanks to Maria and her apartment! Maria was a great host and helped as soon as we had any questions. And the apartment was very well situated, 2 steps away from the river with a great view on Porto! Thank you Maria for this wonderful experience!

La estancia fue una maravilla gracias a María. La casa estaba muy limpia y el recibimiento también. Nos ofreció para los primeros días café y té para desayunar. Teníamos también agua y zumo. Repetiría sin lugar a duda y lo recomiendo 100%. Muchas gracias María!

This is a great little apartment for a couple - brand new, super clean, well appointed and so conveniently located - quick walk across the bridge (or by the water taxi) to Rebeira, and I think actually better to be a bit away from the other side. You will feel less like you are in a tourist ghetto at Maria's place. Maria is lovely, btw and extremely helpful!

What a find this apartment is! It was tastefully decorated with a comfortable bed and good soundproofing from the street. We were next door to a great shop selling handmade cork products, a couple of small local supermarkets and a great restaurant on the street. We were a stones throw from the river front and in the heart of Porto wine caves area. Marie was a good host, waited to greet us upon arrival and left us some welcome goodies. I recommend Porto to anyone as it won't disappoint.

The apartment is located perfectly steps from the Douro river and port tasting rooms.  A quick and beautiful 10 minute walk over the bridge.

The check in was seamless, we arrived earlier than planned and Maria was there to meet us and show us into the parking garage.  The garage is a bit tight getting in and out so if you're renting a car go for a compact.  

Once inside the apartment was lovely, clean and well decorated. Maria offered a choice of one full size bed or two twins which was perfect since we were friends traveling. 

Maria was a terrific host and available to help with questions and suggestions. Would definitely stay again if I returned to Porto.

A réserver les yeux fermer
L appartement est tout rénové
Maria est tres disponible et arrangeante
L appartement est situé a 50 metres du douro côté sud (cave)
Il est mieux de réserver de ce côté pour eviter la foule
Encore merci
Wonderful location, helpful host, adventurous parking (for uninitiated, but manageable). Apartment is spacious and comfortable.

Maria's apartment is in a perfect location. It was impeccably clean and had everything we needed and more.  The welcome gift was a nice touch. Maria is a wonderful host. As the apartment hadn't been occupied the night before, she let us park the car early and drop off our bags before check-in as we had booked a tour for the day. Would definitely stay at her place again if I'm ever back in Porto.

Maria is a very nice person and it was a pleasure to meet her. She was helpful and easy to reach, especially since she lives in the same building. The appartment is beautiful, clean and comfortable. It must have been renovated very recently, as everything looks brand new. It is located close to the river, the restaurants, bridge, etc. The location is ideal but it is also on a commercial street so bear in mind that it gets active pretty early in the morning as shop owners prepare for the day. The seagulls and other animals also get going early so you may have to get up and close the windows if you want to sleep in.  The area is quite peaceful at night, though. We loved staying there and would definitely do so again in the future. Highly recommended!

Maria is lovely. She is friendly and made check in very easy. The flat is in a great location. Close to everything but not in the center. There was a little construction noise during the day. The night was quiet and the bed comfortable. A lovely flat... I would stay again.

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment very much. The size of the apartment ist perfect for a couple. It was very clean and we liked the location, too. And: Maria is a great host and answers messages quickly.

Location molto curata a due passi dalle aziende produttrici di porto, il valore aggiunto è dato dalla disponibilità e cortesia della locatrice.
Consiglio il pernottamento!
Stay at Maria's place was short - and with nothing to complain! Clean, quiet, comfortable, garage across the street, superb location.

The flat was great! So beautiful and Clean. An awesome place totally worth, Close to the Most beautiful Porto spots!
One of the best Airbnb experiences!

Maria's place was incredible. The unit itself was so close to everything and within walking distance. Maria really made us feel welcome from the minute we met her and made sure we had everything we needed. She even went out of her way to grab us some milk for our 1.5 year old son. She is a wonderful host and we would love to recommend her!

Nice flat veru well equipped closed to the Douro river, Sandeman cellar and Porto Cruz trendy café. Ideal starting point to visit Porto and its cellars.

Maria was a wonderful host and helped us personally upon arrival to Porto. Her apartment is close to all of the Port wine houses and a great to spot from which to explore Porto. I recommend her apartment whole heartedly.
Excellent apartment - great location, well appointed, with a very comfortable bed. Maria was extremely helpful and quick to respond. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Maria is a wonderful person, extremely  attentive and available all the time... The appartement is perfectly situated to see everything in Gaia and Porto.  The apartment is very large, confortable and immaculately clean. Her home is like our home! So if you visit the city of Porto, I strongly recommend that you stay on the side of Gaia and in Maria's (Website hidden by Airbnb) will always stay in my heart ❤️ thanks again 
Renée & Martin

Maria's apartment is beautiful and in a prime location. It was a quick 2 minute walk to the river and there are plenty of cafes right outside the apartment. She was a terrific hostess and provided us with lots of helpful information about the area.

La casa de Maria Fernando es maravillosa, tan bonita como bien cuidada y llena de detalles tales como la botella de vino de Oporto y el desayuno con los que te obsequia a la llegada. 
Está muy bien ubicada, a escasos 5 minutos del puente de Luis I y además dispone de un parking privado muy cerquita de la casa y sin coste adicional, cortesía de la anfitriona. 
Nos hizo la estancia en Oporto realmente agradable.
Great place. Well located. Modern, clean and neat. Wi-fi and parking included.

Excellent space so near to everything

Would return and definitively recommend the apartment

All of the port houses are there and the neighbourhood felt safe. There is a spectacular view of the city, and the train station is about 10-15m away. It was convenient for the boat cruise as well. 
The apartment is spotless and well-appointed and comfortable. Great to have so much extra space. I would highly recommend staying here!

Maria has been a brilliant host! I booked her place for my parents and they absolutely loved it! They still haven't stopped talking about their brilliant stay at Maria's even though they're already back since two weeks. I can definitely recommend staying with Maria. She is very kind, easy to communicate with and a great host!

Maria est une personne accueillante, gentille et disponible qui nous a fait nous sentir très à l'aise tout de suite. L'appartement est très bien situé, bien équipé et très propre. Lit très confortable. Nous avons pu laisser l'auto au garage et nous promener à pied dans Vila Gaia et dans Porto étant à proximité du Pnte Luis. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour.
Ótima estadia! Muito bem localizado, apto. super bem decorado, funcional, aconchegante, com cortesias da anfitriã! Excelente, recomendamos para casais que querem desfrutar do Porto!
와이너리 근처에 위치한 이 집에선 조금만 나와도 건너편 아름다운 풍경을 볼 수 있었습니다. 물론 역사적 명소들이 강 건너에 있지만, 다리를 건너기에 어렵지 않았습니다. 호스트였던 마리아는 굉장히 친절했습니다. 추천하고 싶은 집입니다.

We spent 6 nights at Maria’s place and  we were really comfortable !  The bed is so comfortable and even for the baby :) the shade cut all the light in the room ror a better sleep.
